russian: $Мокрица$? Эррол дарил мне их в детстве! Они мне тогда не нравились — не нравится и сейчас!
bulgarian: A $Roly Poly$? Errol used to give me those when we were kids! I didn't like it then, and I don't like it now!

english: Errol's really into the fancy stuff, but I'm partial to Darcy's dark roast with a bit of cream. It's a nice start to my Saturday.
french: Errol aime les boissons élaborées. Moi, j'ai un faible pour le café de Darcy avec un soupçon de crème liquide. Rien de tel pour démarrer le samedi.
russian: Эррол любит всякое с выкрутасами, а я предпочитаю простую тёмную обжарку от Дарси с каплей сливок. Отличное начало субботы.
bulgarian: Errol's really into the fancy stuff, but I'm partial to Darcy's dark roast with a bit of cream. It's a nice start to my Saturday.

english: I used to start every morning with burnt coffee and a hammer, before I retired. Turned out I was burning the beans when I roasted them. So glad Ryis figured it out!
french: Quand je travaillais, ma journée démarrait avec un café brûlé. C'est Ryis qui, plus tard, m'a expliqué que je torréfiais les grains trop fort.
russian: Раньше я начинал утро с подгорелого кофе и с молотком в руках. Потом выяснилось: это я зерно сжигал. Рад, что Риз это понял!
bulgarian: I used to start every morning with burnt coffee and a hammer, before I retired. Turned out I was burning the beans when I roasted them. So glad Ryis figured it out!

english: I used to burn my coffee every morning, so I got a taste for it... Darcy won't burn it for me, though. Fair enough.
french: Mon café avait un drôle de goût, mais je m'y étais fait... Darcy refuse de griller son café pour moi, mais c'est compréhensible.
russian: Я раньше каждое утро кофейные зерна сжигал, так и привык... а Дарси не хочет их для меня жечь. Ну, справедливо.
bulgarian: I used to burn my coffee every morning, so I got a taste for it... Darcy won't burn it for me, though. Fair enough.

english: Ryis is all about Darcy's iced coffee... Ice? In coffee? Must be a Capital thing...
french: Ryis adore le café glacé de Darcy... Des glaçons dans du café ? Encore un truc de la capitale...
russian: Риз обожает холодный кофе от Дарси... Лёд в кофе? Должно быть, столичная замашка...
bulgarian: Ryis is all about Darcy's iced coffee... Ice? In coffee? Must be a Capital thing...

english: It's a rule of thumb that a shirt's gotta have a good collar... old Louis understands that.
french: Une chemise se doit d'avoir un col amidonné... Notre Louis en est bien conscient.
russian: Главное в рубашке — правильный воротник... а Луи это понимает.
bulgarian: It's a rule of thumb that a shirt's gotta have a good collar... old Louis understands that.

english: Louis always tells me I should dress like I'm retired, even if I won't put down the hammer. These easy breezy clothes do put a little spring in my step...
french: Louis dit que je devrais m'habiller comme un retraité, même si je n'ai pas vraiment arrêté. Ces vêtements sont tellement agréables à porter...
russian: Луи всё твердит, что надо одеваться, как будто на пенсии, даже если молоток не отпускаешь. Лёгкая одежда правда бодрит...
bulgarian: Louis always tells me I should dress like I'm retired, even if I won't put down the hammer. These easy breezy clothes do put a little spring in my step...

english: Louis tells me Ryis came by earlier... I'd like to think Ryis got some of his style from his ol' Uncle...
french: Louis m'a dit que Ryis est passé un peu plus tôt... Il tient sûrement sa classe naturelle de son vieil oncle...
russian: Луи сказал, что Риз заходил утром... хочется верить, стиль он перенял от своего старика-дяди...
bulgarian: Louis tells me Ryis came by earlier... I'd like to think Ryis got some of his style from his ol' Uncle...

english: Purple and pink clothes are for everyone, [Ari]! Louis will tell you himself.
french: Le rose et le violet, ça va à tout le monde, [Ari] ! Louis te le confirmera.
russian: Фиолетовая и розовая одежда — для всех, [Ari]! Луи сам тебе скажет.
bulgarian: Purple and pink clothes are for everyone, [Ari]! Louis will tell you himself.

english: Merri's always stopping by the woodshop to ask about this and that... I don't mind it. Always happy to talk shop!
french: Merri fait toujours un arrêt à l'atelier pour poser des questions... Ça ne me dérange pas. J'adore parler boutique !
russian: Мэрри часто заглядывает в мастерскую: то спросит, то уточнит... я не против. Люблю поговорить о дереве!
bulgarian: Merri's always stopping by the woodshop to ask about this and that... I don't mind it. Always happy to talk shop!

english: It's like I always tell Merri... you have to be careful picking your varnish. A good varnish completely changes the feel of the wood!
french: Je le dis toujours à Merri... il ne faut jamais choisir un vernis à la légère. Un bon vernis change complètement le grain du bois !
russian: Я всегда твержу Мэрри: лак надо выбирать осторожно. Хороший лак полностью меняет восприятие древесины!
bulgarian: It's like I always tell Merri... you have to be careful picking your varnish. A good varnish completely changes the feel of the wood!

english: Ryis thinks I don't know that he got that bookshelf from Merri... I don't mind.
french: Ryis croit que je ne sais pas que cette bibliothèque vient chez Merri. Ce n'est pas grave.
russian: Риз думает, я не знаю, что он взял ту книжную полку у Мэрри... Да пусть.
bulgarian: Ryis thinks I don't know that he got that bookshelf from Merri... I don't mind.

english: It's a reminder that I've got to keep on my toes if I'm going to be the best furniture maker in Mistria... er, best RETIRED furniture maker. Haha!
french: Ça me rappelle seulement que je dois persévérer si je veux être le meilleur menuisier de Mistria... Enfin, menuisier à la RETRAITE. Ha ha !
russian: Напоминает мне, что нужно держать форму, если я хочу быть лучшим мебельщиком в Мистрии... ну, лучшим НА ПЕНСИИ, хаха!
bulgarian: It's a reminder that I've got to keep on my toes if I'm going to be the best furniture maker in Mistria... er, best RETIRED furniture maker. Haha!

english: This dresser Merri's got for sale looks awfully familiar... almost like one I made, back in the day. But this one's marked as vintage... couldn't be mine! ... Right?
french: Le buffet que vend Merri me dit quelque chose... On dirait un meuble que j'avais fabriqué à l'époque. Mais c'est écrit « vintage ». C'est pas le mien alors ! Pas vrai ?
russian: Комод у Мэрри на продаже выглядит подозрительно знакомо... почти как тот, что я делал. Но этот помечен как винтаж... Тогда он не может быть моей работы... Ведь так?
bulgarian: This dresser Merri's got for sale looks awfully familiar... almost like one I made, back in the day. But this one's marked as vintage... couldn't be mine! ... Right?

english: Stillwell's giving out these love fortunes, have you heard? Might try it out myself...
bulgarian: Stillwell's giving out these love fortunes, have you heard? Might try it out myself...

english: What does Stillwell mean when he says "The middle of the process is no time to determine the outcome"? I asked about love, not building a bookshelf...
bulgarian: What does Stillwell mean when he says "The middle of the process is no time to determine the outcome"? I asked about love, not building a bookshelf...

english: "Love is the adventure that awaits you." That Stillwell... he sure does know how to get a fella excited!
bulgarian: "Love is the adventure that awaits you." That Stillwell... he sure does know how to get a fella excited!

english: Stillwell told me "The waltz of love comes in twos and threes..." Is that a musical reference? I can't read sheet music!
bulgarian: Stillwell told me "The waltz of love comes in twos and threes..." Is that a musical reference? I can't read sheet music!

english: That fella is sour as a lemon and you can't even make him into a good salad dressing!
french: Ce type est tellement désobligeant qu'il me couperait presque l'appétit !
russian: Этот парень кислый как лимон, только его даже в салат не выжмешь!
bulgarian: That fella is sour as a lemon and you can't even make him into a good salad dressing!

english: Meeting Taliferro really makes you appreciate our local nobility, doesn't it?
french: À côtoyer Taliferro, on n'en apprécie que plus l'aristocratie locale, pas vrai ?
russian: Когда встречаешь Талиферро, начинаешь ценить наших местных дворян.
bulgarian: Meeting Taliferro really makes you appreciate our local nobility, doesn't it?

english: And he's not! He's getting everyone else to cook!
french: Mais ce n'est pas lui qui cuisine ! Il fait travailler les autres !
russian: Ничего! Но поручает готовить всем остальным!
bulgarian: And he's not! He's getting everyone else to cook!

english: That's a pretty good racket, if I do say so myself.
french: C'est une belle arnaque, si tu veux mon avis.
russian: Неплохую схему придумал, я должен сказать.
bulgarian: That's a pretty good racket, if I do say so myself.

english: I wanted to visit Taliferro's booth to see what the chef was cooking...
french: Je compte me rendre au stand de Taliferro pour voir ce qu'il préparait...
russian: Я хотел зайти в лавку Талиферро, посмотреть, что он готовит...
bulgarian: I wanted to visit Taliferro's booth to see what the chef was cooking...

english: Taliferro complimented my hair... I'll give it to him. He's got an eye for the finer things.
french: Taliferro m'a complimenté sur mes cheveux... Je dois lui reconnaître ça, il a l'œil pour les belles choses.
russian: Талиферро сделал комплимент моей причёске... Вынужден признать: вкус у него отменный.
bulgarian: Taliferro complimented my hair... I'll give it to him. He's got an eye for the finer things.

english: Public opinion of Taliferro ain't really fit for consumption!
french: Les gens n'apprécient pas du tout Taliferro !
russian: То, что народ думает о Талиферро, — совершенно не годно к употреблению!
bulgarian: Public opinion of Taliferro ain't really fit for consumption!

english: I keep an ear out, and let me tell you...
french: J'écoute ce qui se dit, et tu sais quoi ?
russian: Я держу ухо востро, и знаешь, что я тебе скажу...
bulgarian: I keep an ear out, and let me tell you...

english: Well, I guess it was pretty vibrant...
french: En revanche, on ne passait pas inaperçu...
russian: Ну, он был, конечно, ярковат...
bulgarian: Well, I guess it was pretty vibrant...

english: Back in my day, when we dyed our hair, we had one shade of red, and we liked it!
french: À mon époque, quand on se teignait les cheveux, il n'y avait qu'une nuance de rouge et ça nous plaisait bien !
russian: В мои времена, если мы красили волосы, то был всего один оттенок красного — и нам этого хватало!
bulgarian: Back in my day, when we dyed our hair, we had one shade of red, and we liked it!

english: Vera gives me and Ryis a 2-for-1 discount, on the days we can make it out here together. She's a good one!
french: Vera nous fait deux pour le prix d'un, à Ryis et moi, quand on arrive à se caler un rendez-vous ensemble. Elle est sympa !
russian: Вера даёт мне и Ризу скидку «два по цене одного», когда мы вместе приходим. Хорошая она!
bulgarian: Vera gives me and Ryis a 2-for-1 discount, on the days we can make it out here together. She's a good one!

english: My nephew Ryis was talking about dyeing his hair blue... might be a good look on him, come to think of it.
french: Ryis, mon neveu, a envie de se teindre les cheveux en bleu... En y réfléchissant, ça lui irait bien.
russian: Мой племянник Риз говорил, что подумывает покраситься в синий... если подумать, может, ему бы и пошло.
bulgarian: My nephew Ryis was talking about dyeing his hair blue... might be a good look on him, come to think of it.

english: Vera says she'll dye my hair to get the white out, and I might take her up on it!
french: Vera a dit qu'elle me fera une coloration pour masquer mes cheveux blancs. Je vais peut-être me laisser tenter !
russian: Вера предлагает закрасить мою седину... может, и соглашусь!
bulgarian: Vera says she'll dye my hair to get the white out, and I might take her up on it!

english: Don't suppose they work on tools, too? Imagine powering up a lathe... or a hand-plane...
french: Tu crois que ça marche sur les outils aussi ? Tu imagines si ça pouvait améliorer un tour à bois... ou un rabot...
russian: Как думаешь: на инструментах, небось, не работает? Вот бы усилить токарный станок... или, например, рубанок...
bulgarian: Don't suppose they work on tools, too? Imagine powering up a lathe... or a hand-plane...

english: That Wheedle was saying his $Snake Oil$ makes weapons more effective!
french: Wheedle dit que son $huile de couleuvre$ rend les armes plus efficaces !
russian: Хлюст недавно сказал, что его $змеиное масло$ делает оружие эффективнее!
bulgarian: That Wheedle was saying his $Snake Oil$ makes weapons more effective!

english: But it's sure got personality!
french: Mais il n'a pas d'équivalent !
russian: Но он точно индивидуальный!
bulgarian: But it's sure got personality!

english: I can't say that Wheedle's style has style...
french: Je n'irais pas jusqu'à dire que le style de Wheedle me plaît...
russian: Не скажу, что стиль у Хлюста какой-то особенно стильный...
bulgarian: I can't say that Wheedle's style has style...

english: Just don't tell Ryis, alright?
french: Mais ne dis rien à Ryis, d'accord ?
russian: Только Ризу не говори, ладно?
bulgarian: Just don't tell Ryis, alright?

english: Wheedle's $Fast Food$ sure looks tempting, doesn't it? Imagine, zooming through work AND having a tasty snack!
french: L'$encas sur le pouce$ de Wheedle donne envie, pas vrai ? Tu imagines, travailler plus vite tout en se régalant !
russian: $Фастфуд$ Хлюста выглядит весьма соблазнительно. Только представь: в момент управишься с делами И СРАЗУ вкусно поешь!
bulgarian: Wheedle's $Fast Food$ sure looks tempting, doesn't it? Imagine, zooming through work AND having a tasty snack!

english: Why yes, I DO have a good eye for a bargain! And yes, my tastes ARE exquisite! I'm glad you noticed!
french: Il a raison quand il dit que j'ai l'œil pour les bonnes affaires. Et puis, c'est vrai que j'ai très bon goût. Tu as remarqué, toi aussi.
russian: Ну да, я ПРАВДА разбираюсь в качестве! И да, у меня ПРАВДА изысканный вкус! Спасибо, что заметили!
bulgarian: Why yes, I DO have a good eye for a bargain! And yes, my tastes ARE exquisite! I'm glad you noticed!

english: There's something nice about stopping by Wheedle's booth to get buttered up a little...
french: Il y a un petit quelque chose d'agréable à s'arrêter au stand de Wheedle pour s'y faire cirer les pompes.
russian: Хорошо иногда бывает зайти к Хлюсту в лавку и послушать приятной лести...
bulgarian: There's something nice about stopping by Wheedle's booth to get buttered up a little...

english: She knew all my favorites! That's a sign of good taste.
french: Elle connaissait tous mes titres préférés ! C'est un signe de bon goût.
russian: Она знает все мои любимые песни! А это признак хорошего вкуса.
bulgarian: She knew all my favorites! That's a sign of good taste.

english: That Zorel really knows her music!
french: Cette Zorel, elle maîtrise vraiment la musique !
russian: Зорель отлично разбирается в музыке!
bulgarian: That Zorel really knows her music!

english: Don't you think he looks a bit like me, [Ari]?
french: Tu ne trouves pas qu'il me ressemble un peu, [Ari] ?
russian: Не думаешь, что он на меня похож, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Don't you think he looks a bit like me, [Ari]?

english: The other day, I was looking at that $Caldosian Emperor Bust$, over in the antiquities section of the Museum.
french: L'autre jour, je regardais le $buste d'empereur caldosien$ dans la section des antiquités du musée.
russian: На днях я смотрел на тот $бюст кальдосийского императора$ в музейном разделе антиквариата
bulgarian: The other day, I was looking at that $Caldosian Emperor Bust$, over in the antiquities section of the Museum.

english: On many a winter evening, Terithia and I would join Errol to roast up the Sweetroot he brought back from his day in the Mines. Warmed you right up!
french: Souvent, lors des soirées d'hiver, Terithia et moi, on retrouvait Errol pour faire rôtir le rhizome sucré qu'il rapportait après sa journée à la mine. Ça nous réchauffait tout de suite !
russian: Зимой мы с Теризией частенько приходили к Эрролу — он приносил сладкий корень из шахт, и мы его жарили. Сразу согревало!
bulgarian: On many a winter evening, Terithia and I would join Errol to roast up the Sweetroot he brought back from his day in the Mines. Warmed you right up!

english: That $Sweetroot$ in the Museum's collection took me back!
french: Ce $rhizome sucré$, dans les collections du musée, m'a rappelé des souvenirs !
russian: Этот $сладкий корень$ из музейной коллекции вернул меня в прошлое!
bulgarian: That $Sweetroot$ in the Museum's collection took me back!

english: Good day, [Ari].
french: Bien le bonjour, [Ari].
russian: Доброго дня, [Ari].
bulgarian: Good day, [Ari].

english: Mistria is such a charming little town, isn't it? Everyone is so fashionable, I feel right at home.
french: Mistria est une charmante petite ville, n'est-ce pas ? Les habitants savent se vêtir. C'est un bonheur pour moi.
russian: Мистрия — такое очаровательное местечко, правда? Все такие модные — чувствую себя как дома.
bulgarian: Mistria is such a charming little town, isn't it? Everyone is so fashionable, I feel right at home.

english: Remember, [Ari], it's not just clothes, it's confidence. There's nothing quite like knowing how well-dressed you are!
french: Les vêtements ne font pas tout, la confiance en soi est également un facteur important. Il faut avoir conscience de sa propre élégance. Tâchez de ne pas l'oublier, [Ari].
russian: Помни, [Ari], одежда не просто ткань, это уверенность. Нет ничего лучше, чем осознание, как хорошо ты выглядишь!
bulgarian: Remember, [Ari], it's not just clothes, it's confidence. There's nothing quite like knowing how well-dressed you are!

english: He's better at tying his cravat than some nobles.
french: Il maîtrise mieux les nœuds de cravate que bien des aristocrates.
russian: Он повязывает платок лучше некоторых аристократов.
bulgarian: He's better at tying his cravat than some nobles.

english: Errol is such a delight to tailor for!
french: C'est un vrai plaisir de confectionner des vêtements pour Errol !
russian: Шить для Эррола — одно удовольствие!
bulgarian: Errol is such a delight to tailor for!

english: I have some excellent pieces in stock today, take a look.
french: J'ai de magnifiques pièces en stock aujourd'hui, n'hésitez pas à y jeter un œil.
russian: У меня сегодня отличные вещи в наличии, загляни.
bulgarian: I have some excellent pieces in stock today, take a look.

english: In the fall, your clothing should be all about layers.
french: L'important en automne, c'est la superposition des couches.
russian: Осенью главное — это многослойность.
bulgarian: In the fall, your clothing should be all about layers.

english: This evening weather is turning a bit brisk, isn't it? It's nearly time to bring out the wool and down!
french: Le temps se rafraîchit le soir, n'est-ce pas ? Les vêtements en laine ou en duvet seront bientôt de mise.
russian: К вечеру холодает, правда? Самое время доставать шерсть и пух!
bulgarian: This evening weather is turning a bit brisk, isn't it? It's nearly time to bring out the wool and down!

english: If you are looking for an article of clothing, you may rest assured that I personally cut and sew every garment you'll find at my booth.
french: Si vous cherchez à vous habiller, sachez que je coupe et que je couds chacun des vêtements qui se trouvent dans ma boutique.
russian: Если ты ищешь новую одежду, не сомневайся: все вещи на моём прилавке пошиты вручную лично мною.
bulgarian: If you are looking for an article of clothing, you may rest assured that I personally cut and sew every garment you'll find at my booth.

english: My stock changes with the week, so if you find something you simply have to see yourself in, don't wait!
french: Mon stock change chaque semaine alors si vous trouvez une pièce que vous souhaitez essayer, ne tardez pas !
russian: Мой ассортимент меняется каждую неделю, поэтому, если что-то приглянулось, не стоит медлить с покупкой!
bulgarian: My stock changes with the week, so if you find something you simply have to see yourself in, don't wait!

english: Greetings and salutations! My name is Louis.
french: Salutations ! Je m'appelle Louis.
russian: Приветствую, привествую! Меня зовут Луи.
bulgarian: Greetings and salutations! My name is Louis.

english: It was such a delight to see Holt today! He has a positively enviable collection of sweaters, and a fanny pack for truly every occasion.
french: Quel plaisir de voir Holt, aujourd'hui ! Sa collection de pulls me rendrait presque jaloux et il a une banane différente pour chaque occasion.
russian: Сегодня повидался с Хольтом — сплошное удовольствие! У него просто завидная коллекция свитеров и сумка на пояс на все случаи жизни.
bulgarian: It was such a delight to see Holt today! He has a positively enviable collection of sweaters, and a fanny pack for truly every occasion.

english: I do enjoy autumn. A light jacket is such a versatile garment this time of year!
french: J'aime l'automne. Une veste légère est le vêtement idéal en cette période de l'année !
russian: Мне нравится осень. Лёгкая куртка в эту пору — вещь универсальная!
bulgarian: I do enjoy autumn. A light jacket is such a versatile garment this time of year!

english: Don't be shy of loud colors, [Ari]. Sometimes a pop of color is just what an outfit needs to come together.
french: Osez les couleurs vives, [Ari]. C'est parfois la petite touche qui parachève une tenue.
russian: Не бойся ярких красок, [Ari]. Иногда яркий акцент — именно то, что завершает образ.
bulgarian: Don't be shy of loud colors, [Ari]. Sometimes a pop of color is just what an outfit needs to come together.

english: [Ari], what a magnificent outfit!
french: Quelle magnifique tenue vous portez là, [Ari] !
russian: [Ari], какой великолепный наряд!
bulgarian: [Ari], what a magnificent outfit!

english: It does sound fun.
french: Voilà qui pourrait être divertissant.
russian: Звучит заманчиво.
bulgarian: It does sound fun.

english: Merri and I were chatting earlier, she suggested I go hunting for older pieces to renew...
french: Je discutais avec Merri, et elle m'a suggéré de chiner des vêtements passés de mode et de les remettre au goût du jour...
russian: С Мэрри мы недавно болтали. Она предложила искать старые вещи, чтобы переделывать их...
bulgarian: Merri and I were chatting earlier, she suggested I go hunting for older pieces to renew...

english: Let me know if you need anything tailored, won't you?
french: Si vous avez besoin d'ajuster des vêtements, n'hésitez pas à faire appel à moi, entendu ?
russian: Если нужно что-то подогнать по фигуре — обращайся!
bulgarian: Let me know if you need anything tailored, won't you?

english: It's wonderful to design things now that are meant to be worn on a busy day outdoors. So much freedom!
french: C'est un plaisir de concevoir des vêtements qui peuvent être portés pour une dure journée de labeur en extérieur. Je suis bien plus libre !
russian: А теперь шью то, в чём можно бегать по делам весь день. Такая свобода!
bulgarian: It's wonderful to design things now that are meant to be worn on a busy day outdoors. So much freedom!

english: In the Capital, I used to design much more... ceremonial clothing.
french: Lorsque je vivais à la capitale, les vêtements que je confectionnais étaient plus... formels.
russian: В столице я создавал куда более... церемониальные наряды.
bulgarian: In the Capital, I used to design much more... ceremonial clothing.

english: What a perfect end to a perfect day! I tell you, this hamlet has the most agreeable weather in all of Aldaria.
french: Cette journée s'achève aussi bien qu'elle a commencé ! Le temps est bien plus doux ici que dans le reste d'Aldaria, croyez-moi.
russian: Идеальное завершение идеального дня! Говорю тебе, в этой деревушке самая приятная погода во всей Альдарии.
bulgarian: What a perfect end to a perfect day! I tell you, this hamlet has the most agreeable weather in all of Aldaria.

english: Ah, the plights and delights of the traveling tailor! I delight in working with new customers, but packing my wares at the end of the day... that's a plight, to be sure.
french: La vie d'un tailleur itinérant est faite de joies et de difficultés. J'adore travailler pour de nouveaux clients, mais ranger mes marchandises en fin de journée... Quelle plaie !
russian: Ах, тяготы и радости кочевого портного! Работать с новыми клиентами — восторг, но собирать товар в конце дня... вот уж тягота.
bulgarian: Ah, the plights and delights of the traveling tailor! I delight in working with new customers, but packing my wares at the end of the day... that's a plight, to be sure.

english: It warms my heart to leave lighter than when I arrived! I hope my pieces bring joy and a touch of style to their new homes.
french: Repartir plus léger qu'en arrivant me réchauffe le cœur ! J'espère que mes créations apporteront élégance et joie à leurs acquéreurs.
russian: Греет душу уезжать налегке! Надеюсь, мои вещи принесут радость и стиль новым владельцам.
bulgarian: It warms my heart to leave lighter than when I arrived! I hope my pieces bring joy and a touch of style to their new homes.

english: As always, it was delightful to see you, [Ari]. I hope to wow you with my selection the next time we meet!
french: Comme à l'accoutumée, ce fut un plaisir de vous voir, [Ari]. J'espère que mes articles vous surprendront toujours lors de mon prochain passage !
russian: Как всегда, рад был тебя видеть, [Ari]. В следующий раз постараюсь поразить тебя своей подборкой!
bulgarian: As always, it was delightful to see you, [Ari]. I hope to wow you with my selection the next time we meet!

english: And so we come to cut the thread of another day. Dressing others... oh, it's an exhilarating life, [Ari].
french: Voilà encore une nouvelle journée qui s'achève. Consacrer sa vie à vêtir autrui est absolument exaltant, [Ari].
russian: И вот мы отрезаем нить ещё одного дня. Наряжать людей... ах, что за восхитительная жизнь, [Ari].
bulgarian: And so we come to cut the thread of another day. Dressing others... oh, it's an exhilarating life, [Ari].

english: Another Market Day comes to its fruitful conclusion! I wish you a splendid and stylish evening, [Ari].
french: Encore un jour de marché qui se termine ! Je vous souhaite une soirée aussi passionnante qu'élégante, [Ari].
russian: Ещё один базарный день подошёл к завершению! Желаю тебе чудесного и стильного вечера, [Ari].
bulgarian: Another Market Day comes to its fruitful conclusion! I wish you a splendid and stylish evening, [Ari].

english: Practicality and fashion must walk hand in hand, especially when you work the earth!
french: Élégance et commodité doivent aller de pair, en particulier si vous travaillez la terre !
russian: Практичность и мода должны идти рука об руку, особенно если работаешь на земле!
bulgarian: Practicality and fashion must walk hand in hand, especially when you work the earth!

english: Before I close up, I must ask... are you making certain to wear appropriate footwear?
french: Avant de fermer boutique, permettez-moi une question... Les chaussures que vous portez sont-elles adaptées à vos besoins ?
russian: Прежде чем закрыться, должен спросить... ты точно носишь подходящую обувь?
bulgarian: Before I close up, I must ask... are you making certain to wear appropriate footwear?

english: Now, where did I put my sewing kit...?
french: Mais où ai-je bien pu mettre mon nécessaire de couture ?
russian: Так... куда же я положил свой швейный набор?..
bulgarian: Now, where did I put my sewing kit...?

english: Evening, [Ari]. I'm just getting packed up.
french: Bonsoir, [Ari]. J'étais justement en train de tout ranger.
russian: Добрый вечер, [Ari]. Я тут собираюсь потихоньку.
bulgarian: Evening, [Ari]. I'm just getting packed up.

english: Repairing your own buttons builds appreciation of the garment, and a patch makes it truly one of a kind.
french: Savoir recoudre un bouton permet d'apprécier d'autant plus un vêtement, tandis qu'une petite retouche le rend unique.
russian: Пришитая пуговица учит ценить вещь, а заплатка делает её по-настоящему уникальной.
bulgarian: Repairing your own buttons builds appreciation of the garment, and a patch makes it truly one of a kind.

english: A bit of advice while I'm packing up, [Ari]. It does a young person good to learn a bit of sewing, no matter their station.
french: Permettez-moi un petit conseil pendant que je range mes affaires, [Ari]. Les jeunes gens devraient apprendre les bases de la couture, quelle que soit leur vocation.
russian: Пока собираю вещи — совет, [Ari]. Молодёжи полезно научиться шить, кем бы они ни были.
bulgarian: A bit of advice while I'm packing up, [Ari]. It does a young person good to learn a bit of sewing, no matter their station.

english: The gentleman has such an eye for color and silhouette! He always surprises me in the ways he mixes and matches my pieces.
french: Ce jeune homme a vraiment l'œil pour les couleurs et les formes ! La façon dont il assortit mes créations me surprend toujours.
russian: У него потрясающее чутьё на цвет и силуэт! Каждый раз удивляет, как он сочетает мои вещи.
bulgarian: The gentleman has such an eye for color and silhouette! He always surprises me in the ways he mixes and matches my pieces.

english: It was good of Ryis to stop by today.
french: Cela m'a fait plaisir de voir Ryis, aujourd'hui.
russian: Риз сегодня заглянул — это было приятно.
bulgarian: It was good of Ryis to stop by today.

english: You know, she was one of my favorite customers in the Capital! It's a dream to be dressing her once more.
french: C'était l'une de mes clientes favorites quand je vivais à la capitale ! Je suis ravi de pouvoir l'habiller à nouveau.
russian: Ты знаешь, в столице она была одной из моих любимых клиенток! Снова её наряжать — мечта.
bulgarian: You know, she was one of my favorite customers in the Capital! It's a dream to be dressing her once more.

english: It was wonderful to see Elsie today. She is a vision, is she not?
french: Ce fut un bonheur de voir Elsie, aujourd'hui. Quelle allure, n'est-ce pas ?
russian: Сегодня увидел Элси — она же просто видение!
bulgarian: It was wonderful to see Elsie today. She is a vision, is she not?

english: Not everyone can incorporate bones in their outfits, but she works it!
french: Tout le monde ne peut pas inclure des os dans ses tenues, mais elle y parvient !
russian: Немногие готовы использовать в своём образе кости, но ей это удалось!
bulgarian: Not everyone can incorporate bones in their outfits, but she works it!

english: That Seridia... simply impeccable fashion sense.
french: Cette Seridia... Elle a un sens de la mode très pointu.
russian: У этой Серидии... Непревзойдённое чувство стиля.
bulgarian: That Seridia... simply impeccable fashion sense.

english: I'd like to think my off the rack selection is second to none, but let me know if you're looking for something special.
french: J'aime à penser que ma collection de prêt-à-porter est déjà exceptionnelle, mais si vous cherchez quelque chose de particulier, n'hésitez pas à me le dire.
russian: Хотя я горжусь своей коллекцией готовой одежды, если хочешь чего-то особенного — просто скажи.
bulgarian: I'd like to think my off the rack selection is second to none, but let me know if you're looking for something special.

english: Spring cleaning should start with your wardrobe. Out with the old, and in with the new!
french: Tout grand ménage de printemps doit commencer par la penderie. Adieu les vieilleries, place au neuf !
russian: Весенняя уборка должна начинаться с гардероба. Старое — прочь, новое — в путь!
bulgarian: Spring cleaning should start with your wardrobe. Out with the old, and in with the new!

english: What effervescent summer weather we've had today! I hope future Market Days bring more of the same.
french: Nous avons profité d'un magnifique temps estival, aujourd'hui ! J'espère que les prochains jours de marché seront comme celui-ci.
russian: Сегодняшняя летняя погода была просто шипуче-прекрасной! Надеюсь, и в будущем базарные дни будут такими.
bulgarian: What effervescent summer weather we've had today! I hope future Market Days bring more of the same.

english: My days, linen and cotton! My nights, canvas and velvet!
french: Pendant la journée, je travaillerai le lin et le coton ! Et la nuit, la toile et le velours !
russian: Днём — лён и хлопок, ночью — бархат и брезент!
bulgarian: My days, linen and cotton! My nights, canvas and velvet!

english: It's still summer of course, but once I return to the workshop I must work on the autumn collection!
french: Nous sommes toujours en été, mais dès mon retour à l'atelier, je m'attellerai à ma collection d'automne !
russian: Лето ещё не закончилось, но в мастерской меня ждёт осенняя коллекция!
bulgarian: It's still summer of course, but once I return to the workshop I must work on the autumn collection!

english: Light, breathable materials are the cornerstone for any summer wardrobe.
french: Un tissu léger et aéré est indispensable pour les tenues d'été.
russian: Лёгкие, дышащие ткани — основа любого летнего гардероба.
bulgarian: Light, breathable materials are the cornerstone for any summer wardrobe.

english: It's not easy to deal with winter weather and be fashionable, but we must soldier on.
french: Affronter l'hiver et ses rigueurs en restant élégant n'est pas chose aisée, mais il faut tenir bon.
russian: Быть модным зимой — непросто, но мы справимся!
bulgarian: It's not easy to deal with winter weather and be fashionable, but we must soldier on.

english: In winter, there's nothing so relaxing as a bit of delicate needlework in front of a roaring fire.
french: L'un de mes plaisirs, en hiver, est de m'installer confortablement devant un bon feu de bois et de faire de la couture.
russian: Зимой нет ничего уютнее, чем изящная вышивка у камина.
bulgarian: In winter, there's nothing so relaxing as a bit of delicate needlework in front of a roaring fire.

english: I'm especially happy to sell out of things in the winter. Wool is a bit heavy to carry, and it means someone in Mistria is keeping warm!
french: J'aime écouler tout mon stock en hiver. Déjà parce que je n'ai pas à rapporter toute cette laine très lourde, mais aussi, car je sais que les habitants de Mistria auront bien chaud.
russian: Особенно рад распродажам зимой. Шерсть тяжела, а значит, кто-то в Мистрии теперь в тепле!
bulgarian: I'm especially happy to sell out of things in the winter. Wool is a bit heavy to carry, and it means someone in Mistria is keeping warm!

english: Oh, you're a thoughtful one. Thank you for thinking of me on my birthday.
french: Oh, comme c'est aimable à vous. Merci d'avoir pensé à mon anniversaire.
russian: О, как трогательно. Спасибо, что думаешь обо мне в мой день рождения.
bulgarian: Oh, you're a thoughtful one. Thank you for thinking of me on my birthday.

english: A =Crystal=! Lovely! What should I use it for? Beads? Buttons? Perhaps an adornment...
french: Un =cristal= ! Qu'il est beau ! Que vais-je en faire ? Des perles ? Des boutons ? Peut-être une parure...
russian: =Кристалл=! Прекрасно! Что бы из него сделать? Бусины? Пуговицы? А может, украшение...
bulgarian: A =Crystal=! Lovely! What should I use it for? Beads? Buttons? Perhaps an adornment...

english: Ah, I suppose I can find some space for it in my bags...
french: Ah, je devrais pouvoir trouver de la place pour ça dans mes cartons...
russian: Хм, думаю, найду местечко для этого в своих сумках...
bulgarian: Ah, I suppose I can find some space for it in my bags...

english: Oh no no no [Ari], this will not do! I can't abide such a thing near my fabrics! A $Fuzzy Moth$ is a harbinger of disaster!
french: Non, non et non, [Ari] ! En aucun cas, cette chose ne doit se poser sur mes tissus. Une $phalène duveteuse$, c'est une catastrophe !
russian: О нет-нет-нет, [Ari], это никуда не годится! Я не потерплю такого рядом с тканями! $Мохнатая моль$ — вестник катастрофы!
bulgarian: Oh no no no [Ari], this will not do! I can't abide such a thing near my fabrics! A $Fuzzy Moth$ is a harbinger of disaster!

english: A most thoughtful gift, [Ari]. Thank you.
french: Quelle prévenance, [Ari] ! Merci.
russian: Это очень продуманный подарок, [Ari]. Благодарю.
bulgarian: A most thoughtful gift, [Ari]. Thank you.

english: You have a generous heart, [Ari]. My thanks.
french: Vous avez un grand cœur, [Ari]. Merci beaucoup.
russian: У тебя щедрое сердце, [Ari]. Прими мою признательность.
bulgarian: You have a generous heart, [Ari]. My thanks.

english: How lovely! There are some flowers that truly accentuate everything around them, don't you think?
french: Quelle délicate attention ! Certaines fleurs embellissent vraiment tout ce qui les entoure, vous ne trouvez pas ?
russian: Как очаровательно! Некоторые цветы способны подчеркнуть красоту всего вокруг, разве нет?
bulgarian: How lovely! There are some flowers that truly accentuate everything around them, don't you think?

english: Splendid! I'll be sure to turn this into something that shines.
french: Magnifique ! Je vais en faire quelque chose de sublime.
russian: Великолепно! Я обязательно превращу это во что-то притягивающее взгляды.
bulgarian: Splendid! I'll be sure to turn this into something that shines.

english: What a charming bloom! =Lilacs= have the loveliest scent, and they make fetching lapel flowers.
french: Quelle fleur magnifique ! Le =lilas= a une odeur si douce et il fait de jolies boutonnières.
russian: Какой прелестный цветок! =Сирень= пахнет восхитительно и идеально смотрится в петлице.
bulgarian: What a charming bloom! =Lilacs= have the loveliest scent, and they make fetching lapel flowers.

english: How beatific! How exceptional! I shan't forget this gift, [Ari]!
french: C'est divin ! Subline ! Jamais je n'oublierai ce cadeau, [Ari] !
russian: Как божественно! Как исключительно! Я не забуду этот дар, [Ari]!
bulgarian: How beatific! How exceptional! I shan't forget this gift, [Ari]!

english: You have my sincerest thanks, [Ari]. I will make most excellent use of this!
french: Je vous remercie infiniment, [Ari]. Je saurai en faire excellent usage !
russian: Прими мою искреннюю благодарность, [Ari]. Я найду этому лучшее применение!
bulgarian: You have my sincerest thanks, [Ari]. I will make most excellent use of this!

english: Materials of this caliber beg to be transformed into the finest of goods! I feel inspired! Touched by the divine! My deepest gratitude to you, [Ari]!
french: Des matériaux de cette nature appellent le raffinement ! L'inspiration vient ! Je suis touché par les dieux ! Je vous serai éternellement reconnaissant, [Ari] !
russian: Материалы такого класса так и просятся, чтобы их превратили в нечто изысканное! Я вдохновлён! Тронут свыше! Моя глубочайшая благодарность тебе, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Materials of this caliber beg to be transformed into the finest of goods! I feel inspired! Touched by the divine! My deepest gratitude to you, [Ari]!

english: Ahh, Mistrian soil truly makes for the finest vintage! Thank you, this is an elegant gift!
french: Ah, les vignobles mistriens produisent des millésimes incroyables ! Merci pour ce cadeau d'une grande finesse !
russian: Ах, почва Мистрии рождает величайшее вино! Спасибо за такой утончённый подарок!
bulgarian: Ahh, Mistrian soil truly makes for the finest vintage! Thank you, this is an elegant gift!

english: I thank you for your kindness.
french: Merci pour votre gentillesse.
russian: Благодарю тебя за доброту.
bulgarian: I thank you for your kindness.

english: Oh, for me? It's a nice thought.
french: Oh, c'est pour moi ? Quelle délicate attention !
russian: О, мне? Это... приятно.
bulgarian: Oh, for me? It's a nice thought.

english: Oh, what an enchanting =Red Wine=! Behold that luster, like the deepest of velvets. I will enjoy this, [Ari]!
french: Oh, c'est un =vin rouge= d'exception ! Regardez cette robe vermillon digne des plus grands millésimes. Je le savourerai, [Ari] !
russian: Какое чарующее =красное вино=! Посмотри, как оно сияет — словно бархат глубочайших тонов. Я буду искренне наслаждаться им, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Oh, what an enchanting =Red Wine=! Behold that luster, like the deepest of velvets. I will enjoy this, [Ari]!

english: What a delightful =White Wine=! Now, whatever shall I pair it with? I must be sure to draw out its complexities...
french: Quel =vin blanc= merveilleux ! Avec quoi vais-je le déguster ? Il doit pouvoir exprimer tous ses arômes...
russian: Какое изысканное =белое вино=! С чем бы оно хорошо сочеталось?.. Нужно обязательно раскрыть всю его глубину...
bulgarian: What a delightful =White Wine=! Now, whatever shall I pair it with? I must be sure to draw out its complexities...

english: I'm so inspired!
french: Elle m'inspire vraiment.
russian: Я сразу вдохновился!
bulgarian: I'm so inspired!

english: That $Porcelain Figurine$ at the Museum... what an outfit!
french: Cette $figurine en porcelaine$, au musée... Quelle tenue !
russian: Я видел в музее $фарфоровую статуэтку$... Ну что за костюмчик!
bulgarian: That $Porcelain Figurine$ at the Museum... what an outfit!

english: I used to go to sleep hugging my terrarium, but I kept getting ants in my bed...
french: Avant, je m'endormais en serrant fort mon terrarium, mais je me retrouvais toujours avec des fourmis dans mon lit...
russian: Раньше я засыпал, обняв террариум, но потом у меня в постели стали появляться муравьи...
bulgarian: I used to go to sleep hugging my terrarium, but I kept getting ants in my bed...

english: Oh, hello! Greetings!
french: Oh, salut ! Ça va ?
russian: Ой, привет!
bulgarian: Oh, hello! Greetings!

english: She doesn't believe me when I tell her I'm nocturnal!
french: Elle ne me croit pas quand je lui dis que je suis un animal nocturne !
russian: Она не верит, когда я говорю, что я ночной житель!
bulgarian: She doesn't believe me when I tell her I'm nocturnal!

english: Mama says we have to go to bed.
french: Maman dit qu'il est l'heure d'aller au lit.
russian: Мама говорит, пора ложиться спать.
bulgarian: Mama says we have to go to bed.

english: Some people count sheep to fall asleep, but I like to count beetles.
french: Certains comptent les moutons pour s'endormir. Moi, je préfère compter les scarabées.
russian: Некоторые считают овец, чтобы уснуть, а я считаю жуков.
bulgarian: Some people count sheep to fall asleep, but I like to count beetles.

english: It sure would be neat if the Dragonguard could all ride big ants!
french: Ça serait génial que les membres de la Garde des dragons chevauchent des fourmis géantes !
russian: Было бы круто, если бы вся Драконья стража ездила на муравьях!
bulgarian: It sure would be neat if the Dragonguard could all ride big ants!

english: I had a dream I was riding a big ant, like a horse.
french: J'ai rêvé que je montais sur le dos d'une fourmi géante, comme si c'était un cheval.
russian: Мне приснилось, что я скачу верхом на большом муравье, как на лошади.
bulgarian: I had a dream I was riding a big ant, like a horse.

english: I wonder what's the biggest bug that ever lived in Mistria...
french: Je me demande quel est le plus grand insecte qui ait vécu à Mistria...
russian: Интересно, какое самое большое насекомое жило в Мистрии...
bulgarian: I wonder what's the biggest bug that ever lived in Mistria...

english: Did you know a caterpillar can survive on only one large leaf a day? Amazing.
french: Tu savais qu'une chenille pouvait survivre en ne mangeant qu'une grande feuille par jour ? Incroyable.
russian: Знаешь, гусенице хватает одного большого листа в день, чтобы жить! Удивительно.
bulgarian: Did you know a caterpillar can survive on only one large leaf a day? Amazing.

english: Sometimes, at night, I twirl up my sheets and pretend I'm in a cocoon!
french: Parfois, le soir, je m'enroule dans mes draps et je fais comme si j'étais dans un cocon !
russian: Иногда ночью я заворачиваюсь в одеяло и притворяюсь, что я в коконе!
bulgarian: Sometimes, at night, I twirl up my sheets and pretend I'm in a cocoon!

english: Good night, [Ari]. Be sure to wake me up if you see a cool bug.
french: Bonne nuit, [Ari]. Réveille-moi si tu trouves un drôle d'insecte.
russian: Спокойной ночи, [Ari]. Разбуди меня, если увидишь классного жука.
bulgarian: Good night, [Ari]. Be sure to wake me up if you see a cool bug.

english: Bella the orchid mantis likes when Papa plays the lute. She kind of sways around...
french: Bella, notre mante orchidée, aime bien quand papa joue du luth. Elle se balance en rythme...
russian: Орхидейная богомолица Белла любит, когда папа играет на лютне. Она так мило качается...
bulgarian: Bella the orchid mantis likes when Papa plays the lute. She kind of sways around...

english: She's cool and strong, but most importantly she listens to me talk about bugs.
french: Elle est forte et courageuse, et surtout, elle m'écoute quand je lui parle d'insectes.
russian: Она классная и сильная, но самое главное — слушает, когда я говорю про жуков.
bulgarian: She's cool and strong, but most importantly she listens to me talk about bugs.

english: Dell's our leader!
french: C'est Dell, la cheffe !
russian: Делл — наша главная!
bulgarian: Dell's our leader!

english: There is a non-zero probability that Dell will jump in that fountain.
french: D'après mes calculs, les probabilités que Dell ne saute pas dans cette fontaine sont quasi nulles.
russian: Существует ненулевая вероятность, что Делл прыгнет в фонтан.
bulgarian: There is a non-zero probability that Dell will jump in that fountain.

english: Dinner is very important! That's what Doctor Valen told me!
french: Le dîner est un repas très important ! C'est la docteure Valen qui me l'a dit !
russian: Ужин — это очень важно! Так сказала докторша Вален!
bulgarian: Dinner is very important! That's what Doctor Valen told me!

english: Mr. Errol says insects used to be REALLY ginormous in the past. I wanna see!
french: D'après monsieur Errol, les insectes étaient gigantesques, avant. J'aurais trop voulu voir ça !
russian: Мистер Эррол говорит, что раньше насекомые были ОЧЕНЬ гигантскими. Хочу увидеть!
bulgarian: Mr. Errol says insects used to be REALLY ginormous in the past. I wanna see!

english: It takes me a while to go to sleep because I have to say good night to all my bugs, going in alphabetical order by genus.
french: Je ne vais pas me coucher de bonne heure parce que je souhaite bonne nuit à chacun de mes insectes, dans l'ordre alphabétique de leur taxon.
russian: Я долго засыпаю, потому что говорю «спокойной ночи» всем своим жукам в алфавитном порядке по родам.
bulgarian: It takes me a while to go to sleep because I have to say good night to all my bugs, going in alphabetical order by genus.

english: [Ari], [Ari]! How'd you get so good at catching bugs?
french: [Ari], [Ari] ! Comment tu es devenu<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they> aussi doué<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they> pour attraper des insectes ?
russian: [Ari], [Ari]! Как ты так хорошо ловишь жуков?
bulgarian: [Ari], [Ari]! How'd you get so good at catching bugs?

english: Wow, [Ari]! You're like a legendary bugcatcher!
french: Waouh, [Ari] ! Tu es vraiment devenu<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they> une légende de l'entomologie !
russian: Ух ты, [Ari]! Ты прямо легендарный ловец насекомых!
bulgarian: Wow, [Ari]! You're like a legendary bugcatcher!

english: Excellent. My name's Luc! I'm so excited to have a fellow insect enthusiast in town. Finally!
french: Génial ! Moi, c'est Luc. Je suis trop content qu'il y ait enfin quelqu'un d'autre qui aime les insectes dans cette ville !
russian: Отлично. Меня зовут Люк! Так здорово, что в городе появился ещё один энтомолог-энтузиаст. Наконец-то!
bulgarian: Excellent. My name's Luc! I'm so excited to have a fellow insect enthusiast in town. Finally!

english: Wait until I tell my sisters!
french: Quand je vais dire ça à mes sœurs !
russian: Вот только расскажу об этом сёстрам!
bulgarian: Wait until I tell my sisters!

english: You know, insects? My name's Luc and I'm a junior member of The Royal Society of Entomology.
french: Oui, les petites bestioles ! Moi, c'est Luc. Je suis un cadet de la Société royale d'entomologie.
russian: Ну, насекомые, жуки. Меня зовут Люк, и я младший участник Королевского энтомологического общества.
bulgarian: You know, insects? My name's Luc and I'm a junior member of The Royal Society of Entomology.

english: I get a birthday card from them every year in recognition of my work. If you join, maybe you will too!
french: Tous les ans, ils m'envoient une carte d'anniversaire en reconnaissance de mon travail. Si tu t'inscris, tu y auras peut-être droit, toi aussi !
russian: Они присылают мне открытку на день рождения в знак признания моих заслуг. Если вступишь, может, и тебе пришлют!
bulgarian: I get a birthday card from them every year in recognition of my work. If you join, maybe you will too!

english: Hello! Do you like bugs?
french: Bonjour ! Tu aimes les insectes ?
russian: Привет! Тебе нравятся насекомые?
bulgarian: Hello! Do you like bugs?

english: Y...yes?
french: Euh... oui ?
russian: Ээ... да?
bulgarian: Y...yes?

english: What?
french: Pardon ?
russian: Что?
bulgarian: What?

english: Mister Hayden sure is nice... I like him.
french: Monsieur Hayden est vraiment gentil... Je l'aime beaucoup.
russian: Мистер Хейден такой добрый... он мне нравится.
bulgarian: Mister Hayden sure is nice... I like him.

english: I'm hungry, and sleepy... like a sleepy, hungry caterpillar...
french: J'ai faim et j'ai sommeil... Comme une chenille qui aurait faim et sommeil...
russian: Я голодный и сонный... как гусеница, которая хочет спать и есть...
bulgarian: I'm hungry, and sleepy... like a sleepy, hungry caterpillar...

english: If you see one you gotta let me know, okay?
french: Si tu en aperçois un, préviens-moi, d'accord ?
russian: Если увидишь какого-нибудь — обязательно скажи мне, ладно?
bulgarian: If you see one you gotta let me know, okay?

english: Do you like bugs, [Ari]? I think they're pretty neat.
french: Tu aimes les insectes, [Ari] ? Moi, je les trouve vraiment fascinants.
russian: Тебе нравятся жуки, [Ari]? По-моему, они крутые.
bulgarian: Do you like bugs, [Ari]? I think they're pretty neat.

english: The Dragonguard spy network is all the insects I've trained to bring me information. It's, um... still a work in progress.
french: Le réseau d'espions de la Garde des dragons est composé de tous les insectes que j'ai dressés. Il y a... Il y a encore quelques détails à mettre au point.
russian: Шпионская сеть Драконьей стражи — это все насекомые, которых я дрессирую приносить мне новости. Ну... она пока в разработке.
bulgarian: The Dragonguard spy network is all the insects I've trained to bring me information. It's, um... still a work in progress.

english: Dell says we'll explore there, when we're older. That's good, I'll be less scared by then.
french: Dell m'a dit qu'on irait les explorer quand on sera plus grands. Tant mieux, j'aurai sûrement moins peur d'ici là.
russian: Делл сказала, что мы пойдём туда, когда станем старше. Это хорошо: я меньше буду бояться.
bulgarian: Dell says we'll explore there, when we're older. That's good, I'll be less scared by then.

english: I wonder what kind of insects are in the Mines!
french: Je me demande quels types d'insectes on trouve dans les mines.
russian: Интересно, какие насекомые живут в шахтах!
bulgarian: I wonder what kind of insects are in the Mines!

english: I wonder how Arthur keeps getting out... I should record this in my Tarantula File.
french: Je me demande comment Arthur arrive toujours à s'échapper... Je devrais consigner tout ça dans mon dossier Tarentules.
russian: Как Артуру удается снова и снова сбегать из террариума? Надо записать это в заметки по тарантулам.
bulgarian: I wonder how Arthur keeps getting out... I should record this in my Tarantula File.

english: I don't get it, but I'll do it for the kingdom!
french: Je ne comprends pas tout, mais je le ferai pour le bien du royaume !
russian: Я не понял, но сделаю ради королевства!
bulgarian: I don't get it, but I'll do it for the kingdom!

english: Queen Maple says she's marrying me off to a princess I've never met for political reasons, and if I'm lucky it might grow into love.
french: La reine Maple veut me marier à une princesse que je ne connais pas pour sceller des alliances. Elle dit qu'avec un peu de chance, j'en tomberai amoureux.
russian: Королева Мэйпл говорит, что по политическим причинам решила выдать меня за принцессу, которую я никогда не видел. И если повезёт, я её полюблю.
bulgarian: Queen Maple says she's marrying me off to a princess I've never met for political reasons, and if I'm lucky it might grow into love.

english: Mama keeps kicking Daddy under the table... I wonder if he's in trouble.
french: Maman donne souvent des coups de pied à papa, sous la table... Il a fait quelque chose de mal ?
russian: Мама всё время пинает папу под столом... Интересно, он что, провинился?
bulgarian: Mama keeps kicking Daddy under the table... I wonder if he's in trouble.

english: Morning, [Ari]! I'm thinking about what bugs the day will bring...
french: Bonjour, [Ari] ! Je pense aux insectes que je vais trouver aujourd'hui...
russian: Доброе утро, [Ari]! Думаю, какие жуки сегодня попадутся...
bulgarian: Morning, [Ari]! I'm thinking about what bugs the day will bring...

english: Most people think monarch butterfly, but I like sternocera aequisignata- the jewel beetle- way more.
french: Les gens pensent souvent au papillon monarque, mais pour moi, ce serait plutôt le sternocera aequisignata, ou scarabée moiré.
russian: Многие говорят, что монарх, но мне больше нравится sternocera aequisignata — жук-драгоценность!
bulgarian: Most people think monarch butterfly, but I like sternocera aequisignata- the jewel beetle- way more.

english: Maple asked me which bug is the most royal.
french: Maple me demandait quel insecte avait le plus l'air royal.
russian: Мэйпл спросила, кто самый королевский из насекомых.
bulgarian: Maple asked me which bug is the most royal.

english: Mom packed us lots of snacks, [Ari]! Here, you can have some.
french: [Ari], maman nous a préparé plein de choses pour le goûter ! Tiens, goûte ça.
russian: Мама собрала много перекусов, [Ari]! Вот, держи немного.
bulgarian: Mom packed us lots of snacks, [Ari]! Here, you can have some.

english: Maybe she went to the kitchen for a snack?
french: Elle est peut-être allée à la cuisine pour manger un bout ?
russian: Может, пошла на кухню перекусить?
bulgarian: Maybe she went to the kitchen for a snack?

english: Hi [Ari]. I'm supposed to be sleeping, but Bella the orchid mantis got out.
french: Salut, [Ari]. Je devrais être au lit, mais Bella, ma mante orchidée, s'est échappée.
russian: Привет, [Ari]. Я должен спать, но орхидейная богомолица Белла сбежала.
bulgarian: Hi [Ari]. I'm supposed to be sleeping, but Bella the orchid mantis got out.

english: I'm teaching Maple about the worker bees of apis mellifera, but she only cares about the queen bee.
french: J'enseigne à Maple l'importance des abeilles ouvrières de la famille des apis mellifera, mais tout ce qui l'intéresse, c'est la reine.
russian: Я учу Мэйпл рабочим пчёлам apis mellifera, но ей интересна только королева.
bulgarian: I'm teaching Maple about the worker bees of apis mellifera, but she only cares about the queen bee.

english: Please act accordingly, [Ari].
french: [Ari], tiens-toi bien.
russian: Прошу соблюдать протокол, [Ari].
bulgarian: Please act accordingly, [Ari].

english: I promised Maple we'd play royals today, so for the rest of today she's Queen Maple.
french: J'ai promis à Maple qu'on jouerait à la famille royale, aujourd'hui. Elle sera la reine Maple jusqu'à ce soir.
russian: Я пообещал Мэйпл, что сегодня играем в королевство, так что теперь она — королева Мэйпл.
bulgarian: I promised Maple we'd play royals today, so for the rest of today she's Queen Maple.

english: She's nice.
french: Elle est adorable.
russian: Она хорошая.
bulgarian: She's nice.

english: Rachelle woke me up today... she's a mantis religiosa, otherwise known as a praying mantis.

russian: Сегодня меня разбудила Рашель... она mantis religiosa, по-другому — богомол обыкновенный.
bulgarian: Rachelle woke me up today... she's a mantis religiosa, otherwise known as a praying mantis.

english: Some insects prefer to come out on rainy days, [Ari].
french: Certains insectes préfèrent sortir quand il pleut, [Ari].
russian: Некоторым насекомым нравится выходить в дождь, [Ari].
bulgarian: Some insects prefer to come out on rainy days, [Ari].

english: Dell likes to hold our Dragonguard meetings on rainy days. That's when we make all our plans for protecting Mistria!
french: Dell tient à organiser les réunions de la Garde des dragons les jours de pluie. C'est là qu'on organise la protection de Mistria !
russian: Делл любит устраивать собрания Драконьей стражи в дождливые дни. Тогда мы строим планы по защите Мистрии!
bulgarian: Dell likes to hold our Dragonguard meetings on rainy days. That's when we make all our plans for protecting Mistria!

english: Ma and Pa are busy today, so I'm watching the register. I can make change, I'm good at math! Want to see?
french: Maman et papa sont occupés aujourd'hui, donc c'est moi qui tiens la caisse. Je sais rendre la monnaie et je suis bon en calcul. Tu veux que je te montre ?
russian: Ма и па сегодня заняты, так что я сижу за кассой. Я умею давать сдачу, я хорошо считаю! Хочешь проверить?
bulgarian: Ma and Pa are busy today, so I'm watching the register. I can make change, I'm good at math! Want to see?

english: I like helping out, but I sure wish I could see over the counter.
french: J'aime bien me rendre utile, mais j'aimerais être un plus grand que le comptoir.
russian: Мне нравится помогать, но жаль, что стойка такая высокая: ничего не видно.
bulgarian: I like helping out, but I sure wish I could see over the counter.

english: According to my calculations, today has seen a fifty percent boost in sales because I'm behind the counter.
french: Si mes calculs sont justes, les ventes ont augmenté de 50 % aujourd'hui, grâce à ma présence à la caisse.
russian: Согласно моим расчётам, сегодня продажи выросли на 50%, потому что я за кассой.
bulgarian: According to my calculations, today has seen a fifty percent boost in sales because I'm behind the counter.

english: I mean, um, The Sleeping Dragon Inn.
french: Enfin, à l'auberge du Dragon qui dort.
russian: То есть, эээ, в трактир «Спящий дракон».
bulgarian: I mean, um, The Sleeping Dragon Inn.

french: La reine Maple a décrété que c'était l'heure du souper royal. J'espère que c'est un peu comme nos repas à nous.
russian: Королева Мэйпл говорит, что пора отведать королевский ужин. Надеюсь, он как обычный.
bulgarian: Queen Maple says it's time to partake of our royal dinner. I hope that's the same as our normal dinner.

виделавиделвидело ульев? Зачем спрашиваю? Эм... просто так!

english: Bees have a queen, but they can't have two, so one has to leave... and sometimes they fight it out for the crown!
french: Les abeilles ont une reine, pas deux. L'une d'elles doit donc partir. Parfois, elles se battent même pour la couronne !
russian: У пчёл бывает только одна королева, и если появляется вторая, одна должна уйти... иногда они даже дерутся за корону!
bulgarian: Bees have a queen, but they can't have two, so one has to leave... and sometimes they fight it out for the crown!

english: Miss Juniper will answer all the Dragonguard's questions about potions... I think.
french: Mademoiselle Juniper répondra à toutes les questions de la Garde des dragons à propos des potions... Enfin, j'espère.
russian: Мисс Джунипер ответит на все вопросы Драконьей стражи про зелья... наверное.

russian: Пора свернуться в клубочек в моей соте...
bulgarian: Time to get all curled up in my honeycomb...

bulgarian: Tall grass is a natural habitat for many insects.

russian: Овощи тоже сгодятся как дом для жуков, я думаю.

russian: Иногда под ними прячутся насекомые! Очень хочу увидеть, кого ты найдёшь!
bulgarian: Sometimes there's insects living underneath! I'd love to see what you find!

russian: Ух ты! Подарок на день рождения! Мне?!

french: Miam, à manger ! Merci, [Ari]. Je vais partager ça avec la Garde des dragons !
