bulgarian: Although objects from antiquity hold little interest for me, it seems there are also samples of modern flora and fauna on display...

english: Familiarizing myself with both may prove to be quite interesting.
french: Me familiariser avec eux pourrait s'avérer intéressant.
russian: Их изучение может быть весьма интересным занятием.
bulgarian: Familiarizing myself with both may prove to be quite interesting.

english: For instance, one could investigate who was on display at the pillory for the day...
french: Par exemple, il était possible d'aller voir qui était mis au pilori ce jour-là...
russian: К примеру, можно было посмотреть, кого сегодня выставляют на позорном столбе...
bulgarian: For instance, one could investigate who was on display at the pillory for the day...

english: Or pay a visit to a gladiatorial arena, as either competitor or spectator.
french: Ou de se rendre à l'arène des gladiateurs, comme participant ou spectateur.
russian: Или наведаться в гладиаторскую арену — и как участник, и как зритель.
bulgarian: Or pay a visit to a gladiatorial arena, as either competitor or spectator.

english: Tell me, what do the townspeople of this age do for entertainment?
french: Dis-moi, que font les habitants d'aujourd'hui pour se distraire ?
russian: Скажи мне, чем развлекают себя местные жители в эту эпоху?
bulgarian: Tell me, what do the townspeople of this age do for entertainment?

english: You could play cards at the Inn...
french: Nous pourrions jouer aux cartes à l'auberge...
russian: Можно поиграть в карты в трактире...
bulgarian: You could play cards at the Inn...

english: How about some fishing?
french: Que dirais-tu d'aller pêcher ?
russian: Как насчёт рыбалки?
bulgarian: How about some fishing?

english: You could visit the Museum!
french: Tu pourrais visiter le musée !
russian: Можно сходить в музей!
bulgarian: You could visit the Museum!

english: Intriguing! Is there betting involved?
french: Cela m'intrigue ! Est-il aussi possible de parier ?
russian: Заманчивое предложение! Там принимаются ставки?
bulgarian: Intriguing! Is there betting involved?

english: Perhaps I will seek it out. Much can be learned by winning the cherished possessions of others.
french: Je vais peut-être découvrir cela. On peut apprendre beaucoup de choses en gagnant les précieuses possessions d'autrui.
russian: Возможно, я попробую. Выигрывая себе чужие любимые вещи, можно узнать много нового.
bulgarian: Perhaps I will seek it out. Much can be learned by winning the cherished possessions of others.

english: You see, the worth of an object is measured by how badly one wishes to keep it. In that sense... my hoard is priceless.
french: Vois-tu, la valeur d'un objet se mesure à l'intensité avec laquelle on souhaite le conserver. En ce sens... mon trésor est inestimable.
russian: Видишь ли, ценность предмета определяется тем, насколько обладатель готов с ним расстаться. И в этом смысле... мои сокровища бесценны.
bulgarian: You see, the worth of an object is measured by how badly one wishes to keep it. In that sense... my hoard is priceless.

english: Ah yes... water hunting.
french: Ah oui... La chasse aquatique
russian: Ах, да... Охота в воде.
bulgarian: Ah yes... water hunting.

english: I approve of such a pastime.
french: J'approuve ce passe-temps.
russian: Такой досуг я одобряю.
bulgarian: I approve of such a pastime.

english: I would enjoy a distraction today, [Ari]. It is good to step away from one's work now and then.
french: J'aimerais me distraire, aujourd'hui, [Ari]. Il est bon de s'éloigner un peu du travail, de temps à autre.
russian: Сегодня я бы хотела отвлечься, [Ari]. Время от времени полезно отходить от работы.
bulgarian: I would enjoy a distraction today, [Ari]. It is good to step away from one's work now and then.

english: The children... They made an intriguing inquiry.
french: Les enfants... Ils m'ont posé une curieuse question.
russian: Дети... Задались весьма интригующим вопросом.
bulgarian: The children... They made an intriguing inquiry.

english: I am his elder, therefore it is only sensible that I would be the larger dragon.
french: Je suis son aînée, il est donc logique que je sois le dragon le plus grand.
russian: Я старше его, так что совершенно логично, что я являюсь и более крупным драконом.
bulgarian: I am his elder, therefore it is only sensible that I would be the larger dragon.

english: Surely you jest.
french: Tu es sûrement en train de plaisanter.
russian: Ты, должно быть, шутишь.
bulgarian: Surely you jest.

english: They wanted to know who is taller: myself, or that fool Caldarus.
french: Ils voulaient savoir qui, de moi ou de cet imbécile de Caldarus, était le plus grand.
russian: Они хотят узнать, кто выше: я или этот остолоп Кальдарус.
bulgarian: They wanted to know who is taller: myself, or that fool Caldarus.

english: You're definitely taller.
french: Tu es la plus grande, c'est certain.
russian: Ты совершенно точно выше.
bulgarian: You're definitely taller.

english: Caldarus might be a hair taller than you...
french: Caldarus est peut-être plus grand que toi d'un cheveu...
russian: Возможно, Кальдарус выше тебя на волосок...
bulgarian: Caldarus might be a hair taller than you...

english: It's hard to say!
french: C'est difficile à dire !
russian: Трудно сказать!
bulgarian: It's hard to say!

english: Yes, of course.
french: Oui, évidemment.
russian: Ну разумеется.
bulgarian: Yes, of course.

english: You would not lie to me, so it must be the truth.
french: Tu ne me mentirais pas, ce doit donc être la vérité.
russian: Ты не станешь мне лгать, так что это определённо правда.
bulgarian: You would not lie to me, so it must be the truth.

english: I am his elder, therefore it is only sensible that I would be the larger dragon.
french: Je suis son aînée, il est donc logique que je sois le dragon le plus grand.
russian: Я старше его, так что совершенно логично, что я являюсь и более крупным драконом.
bulgarian: I am his elder, therefore it is only sensible that I would be the larger dragon.

english: Still, to crush all doubt...
french: Néanmoins, pour qu'il ne subsiste pas le moindre doute...
russian: И всё же, чтобы развеять сомнения...
bulgarian: Still, to crush all doubt...

english: I will speak with Juniper. She will instruct me in the dark arts of...
french: Je vais aller parler à Juniper. Elle m'enseignera les sombres arcanes des...
russian: Я поговорю с Джунипер. Она должна просветить меня в тёмном искусстве...
bulgarian: I will speak with Juniper. She will instruct me in the dark arts of...

english: The platform heel.
french: Chaussures à talon.
russian: Высоких каблуков.
bulgarian: The platform heel.

english: Such a thing is impossible.
french: Une telle chose est impossible.
russian: Такого не может быть.
bulgarian: Such a thing is impossible.

english: One moment, [Ari]. There is a matter that I would like you to settle for me.
french: Un instant, [Ari]. Il y a un sujet que j'aimerais que tu tranches pour moi.
russian: На минутку, [Ari]. Я попрошу тебя разрешить небольшой спор.
bulgarian: One moment, [Ari]. There is a matter that I would like you to settle for me.

english: Do you ever gaze into the endless night?
french: As-tu déjà contemplé l'infinité de la nuit ?
russian: Ты часто всматриваешься в ночное небо?
bulgarian: Do you ever gaze into the endless night?

english: Through every one of my many lives... that vastness has been ever a companion, and my greatest source of power.
french: À travers chacune de mes nombreuses vies... cette immensité a toujours été une compagne, et ma plus grande source de pouvoir.
russian: Через все мои жизни этот бескрайний океан сопровождает меня... в нём главный источник моей силы.
bulgarian: Through every one of my many lives... that vastness has been ever a companion, and my greatest source of power.

english: Mark it upon your soul, [Ari]. If you are ever in true need... the night will guide you to me.
french: Imprime ceci dans ton âme, [Ari]. Si un jour tu en as réellement besoin... la nuit te guidera jusqu'à moi.
russian: В душе своей знай, [Ari]: если придёт нужда... ночь приведёт тебя ко мне.
bulgarian: Mark it upon your soul, [Ari]. If you are ever in true need... the night will guide you to me.

english: Mark it upon your soul, [Ari]. If you are ever in true need... the night will guide you to me.
french: Imprime ceci dans ton âme, [Ari]. Si un jour tu en as réellement besoin... la nuit te guidera jusqu'à moi.
russian: В душе своей знай, [Ari]: если придёт нужда... ночь приведёт тебя ко мне.
bulgarian: Mark it upon your soul, [Ari]. If you are ever in true need... the night will guide you to me.

english: [Ari], come closer and look up.
french: Approche et regarde-moi, [Ari].
russian: [Ari], подойди поближе и посмотри вверх.
bulgarian: [Ari], come closer and look up.

english: It seems to me that you are not intimidated by my presence, [Ari].
french: Ma présence ne semble pas t'intimider, [Ari].
russian: Я замечаю, что тебя не пугает мой облик, [Ari].
bulgarian: It seems to me that you are not intimidated by my presence, [Ari].

english: My tail... is "cool"?
french: Ma queue est... « sympa » ?
russian: Мой хвост... выглядит «круто»?
bulgarian: My tail... is "cool"?

english: I... see. You may touch it, if you like. However-
french: Je... Je vois. Tu peux la toucher, si tu le souhaites. Néanmoins...
russian: Ясно... Можешь потрогать, если хочешь. Только...
bulgarian: I... see. You may touch it, if you like. However-

english: Mind your fingers near the barb... it is sharp.
french: Attention à tes doigts près du piquant... Il est très acéré.
russian: Осторожнее возле шипа... Он у меня острый.
bulgarian: Mind your fingers near the barb... it is sharp.

english: Worry not. I shall not poison you.
french: Ne t'inquiète pas. Je ne t'empoisonnerai pas.
russian: Не переживай. Я не стану тебя травить...
bulgarian: Worry not. I shall not poison you.

english: Unless you are curious...
french: Sauf pour satisfaire ta curiosité...
russian: Если только ты не захочешь это испытать...
bulgarian: Unless you are curious...

english: Horns, sinew, tail, claws... I have honed all facets of my appearance to put fear in the heart of those who behold me.
french: Cornes, tendons, queue, griffes... J'ai affûté toutes les facettes de mon apparence pour insuffler la peur dans le cœur de ceux qui me regardent.
russian: Рога, мышцы, хвост и когти... Я подбирала все аспекты своей внешности, чтобы вселять страх в тех, кто решится обратить на меня взгляд.
bulgarian: Horns, sinew, tail, claws... I have honed all facets of my appearance to put fear in the heart of those who behold me.

english: Yet... these aspects do not seem to prevent you from drawing close.
french: Et pourtant... rien de cela ne semble te dissuader de t'approcher de moi.
russian: И тем не менее... Эти черты не мешают тебе со мной сближаться.
bulgarian: Yet... these aspects do not seem to prevent you from drawing close.

english: I think your claws are striking.
french: Je trouve tes griffes impressionnantes.
russian: По-моему, у тебя поразительные когти.
bulgarian: I think your claws are striking.

english: I'm into it. Your tail is cool.
french: Ça me plaît. Ta queue est sympa.
russian: Мне нравится. Хвост выглядит круто.
bulgarian: I'm into it. Your tail is cool.

english: Do you wish to see them more closely?
french: Veux-tu les observer de plus près ?
russian: Хочешь посмотреть на них поближе?
bulgarian: Do you wish to see them more closely?

english: The red of my nails is a natural color...
french: Le rouge de mes ongles est une couleur naturelle...
russian: Красный — это их естественный цвет...
bulgarian: The red of my nails is a natural color...

english: Once, my court sought to replicate the hue, but they found no material vibrant enough to match their natural luster.
french: Jadis, ma cour a cherché à en reproduire la teinte, mais nul n'a trouvé de matière assez vive pour égaler leur brillance naturelle.
russian: Однажды мои придворные захотели повторить этот оттенок. Но не смогли найти материал с таким ярким блеском.
bulgarian: Once, my court sought to replicate the hue, but they found no material vibrant enough to match their natural luster.

english: You... have been looking a long time.
french: Tu... regardes depuis un bon moment.
russian: Ты... уже долго на них смотришь.
bulgarian: You... have been looking a long time.

english: Tell me, [Ari]. Was this a cunning excuse to hold my hand?
french: Dis-moi, [Ari]. Était-ce là une ruse pour me tenir la main ?
russian: Признайся, [Ari], это был хитроумный план, чтобы подержать меня за руку?
bulgarian: Tell me, [Ari]. Was this a cunning excuse to hold my hand?

english: Curious...
french: Voilà qui est curieux...
russian: Любопытно...
bulgarian: Curious...

english: It is bold of you. And not unwelcome.
french: C'est audacieux de ta part. Et bien accueilli.
russian: Это звучит очень смело. Мне такое по нраву.
bulgarian: It is bold of you. And not unwelcome.

english: The way in which you greet me... without title or formality...
french: La façon dont tu t'adresses à moi... sans titre ni formalisme...
russian: Твоя манера обращения со мной... Без формальностей и без титулов...
bulgarian: The way in which you greet me... without title or formality...

english: Yet I have found that pursuing you soothes much of my thirst.
french: J'ai pourtant découvert que ma quête de ta présence apaisait l'essentiel de ma soif.
russian: Однако я выяснила, что стремление к тебе утоляет часть моей жажды.
bulgarian: Yet I have found that pursuing you soothes much of my thirst.

english: It was difficult at first, refraining from certain pursuits in this life...
french: Il a été difficile, au départ, de réfréner certaines quêtes dans cette vie...
russian: Вначале мне было трудно отказаться от некоторых стремлений в этой жизни...
bulgarian: It was difficult at first, refraining from certain pursuits in this life...

english: We are bonded by fate.
french: C'est la destinée qui nous lie.
russian: Мы связаны самой судьбой.
bulgarian: We are bonded by fate.

english: You are free to embrace me as the whim takes you.
french: Tu es libre de m'étreindre quand l'envie t'en prend.
russian: Ты можешь обнять меня, когда тебе заблагорассудится.
bulgarian: You are free to embrace me as the whim takes you.

english: Do not be concerned with propriety, [Ari].
french: Ne t'inquiète pas de la propriété, [Ari].
russian: Пусть приличия тебя не смущают, [Ari].
bulgarian: Do not be concerned with propriety, [Ari].

english: I do not think I could demonstrate every one of them for you, even across the full span of a lifetime.
french: N'imagine pas que je pourrais te faire la démonstration de chacune, une vie entière n'y suffirait pas.
russian: Не думаю, что смогу продемонстрировать каждый, даже за целую жизнь.
bulgarian: I do not think I could demonstrate every one of them for you, even across the full span of a lifetime.

english: However... it would please me to make the attempt.
french: Néanmoins... je serais ravie de le tenter.
russian: И всё же... Мы было бы приятно попробовать.
bulgarian: However... it would please me to make the attempt.

english: After countless reincarnations I have accrued many skills, well beyond the capacity of your average mortal.
french: Après d'innombrables réincarnations, j'ai acquis de nombreuses compétences qui vont bien au-delà des capacités du commun des mortels.
russian: После несчётных воплощений я обрела множество навыков, превосходящих возможности обычного смертного.
bulgarian: After countless reincarnations I have accrued many skills, well beyond the capacity of your average mortal.

english: It is refreshing to share in romance with you, [Ari].
french: Partager une idylle avec toi est rafraîchissant, [Ari].
russian: Разделять с тобой чувства для меня — приятное разнообразие, [Ari].
bulgarian: It is refreshing to share in romance with you, [Ari].

english: Being with you is much more pleasant. You desire to know me, and to share in mutual companionship.
french: Être avec toi est bien plus plaisant. Tu souhaites me connaître et profiter d'une compagnie mutuelle.
russian: С тобой мне гораздо приятнее. Ты желаешь узнать меня ближе и разделить переживания со мной.
bulgarian: Being with you is much more pleasant. You desire to know me, and to share in mutual companionship.

english: As a queen, it was expected I would make a match to strengthen political ties. And as a dragon, well...
french: En tant que reine, on attendait de moi des alliances destinées à renforcer des liens politiques. En tant que dragon, eh bien...
russian: Поскольку я была королевой, ожидалось, что я найду пассию для укрепления политических связей. И будучи драконом, конечно же...
bulgarian: As a queen, it was expected I would make a match to strengthen political ties. And as a dragon, well...

english: What were your political matches like?
french: À quoi ressemblaient tes unions politiques ?
russian: И какие были твои политические пассии?
bulgarian: What were your political matches like?

english: What is romance between dragons like?
french: À quoi ressemble une idylle entre dragons ?
russian: А как устроена романтика у драконов?
bulgarian: What is romance between dragons like?

english: They were acceptable, but largely without passion.
french: Elles étaient acceptables, mais pour l'essentiel dépourvues de passion.
russian: Приемлемы, но по большей части лишены страсти.
bulgarian: They were acceptable, but largely without passion.

english: Nothing more than pomp, ritual, and statecraft.
french: Rien de plus que l'apparat, le rituel et l'habileté politique.
russian: Пышные официальные церемонии — и только.
bulgarian: Nothing more than pomp, ritual, and statecraft.

english: A political union is a transaction of power, not a vow of affection.
french: Une union politique est une transaction autour du pouvoir, pas un serment d'affection.
russian: Политическая уния — это передача власти, а не признание в чувствах.
bulgarian: A political union is a transaction of power, not a vow of affection.

english: Being with you is... something new. You do not desire anything of me, other than myself.
french: Être avec toi est... quelque chose de nouveau. Tu ne désires rien de moi, hormis moi-même.
russian: С тобой всё по-другому... Ты не желаешь от меня ничего, кроме меня самой.
bulgarian: Being with you is... something new. You do not desire anything of me, other than myself.

english: Such a thing is... very attractive.
french: C'est là une chose... très attirante.
russian: Такое отношение... очень меня привлекает.
bulgarian: Such a thing is... very attractive.

english: I would describe it as fraught, as we are territorial creatures.
french: Je décrirais cela comme un risque, car nous sommes des créatures territoriales.
russian: Я бы сказала, что тяжко. Ведь мы территориальные существа.
bulgarian: I would describe it as fraught, as we are territorial creatures.

english: We are not communal by nature. Dragons do not wish to stay overlong with their own kind once they reach adulthood.
french: Nous ne sommes pas naturellement communautaires. Une fois adultes, les dragons ne souhaitent pas rester très longtemps avec ceux de leur espèce.
russian: По своей природе мы не социальны. Когда драконы достигают зрелости, они не любят задерживаться с роднёй подолгу.
bulgarian: We are not communal by nature. Dragons do not wish to stay overlong with their own kind once they reach adulthood.

english: I have been thinking of you, and of the past.
french: J'ai pensé à toi, et au passé.
russian: Я размышляла о тебе и о прошлом.
bulgarian: I have been thinking of you, and of the past.

english: We restored that balance together, [Ari].
french: Nous avons rétabli l'équilibre ensemble, [Ari].
russian: Мы восстановили равновесие вместе с тобой, [Ari].
bulgarian: We restored that balance together, [Ari].

english: Finishing each others' invocations...
french: En terminant mutuellement nos invocations...
russian: Продолжать друг за другом мегические формулы...
bulgarian: Finishing each others' invocations...

english: Twining our fingers as the spell reaches its peak...
french: En faisant de nos doigts des gestes jumeaux quand le sort atteint son apogée...
russian: Сплестись пальцами, когда заклинание достигает предела...
bulgarian: Twining our fingers as the spell reaches its peak...

english: Yes. I would enjoy doing that with you.
french: Oui. Cela me plairait de faire ça avec toi.
russian: Да. Такое занятие вместе с тобой принесёт мне удовольствие.
bulgarian: Yes. I would enjoy doing that with you.

english: As a progenitor of sorcery, I recognize how adept you have become at wielding spells.
french: En tant que mère de la sorcellerie, je reconnais que tu sais désormais très bien manier les sorts.
russian: Как прародительница чародейского искусства я отмечаю, насколько выросли твои навыки обращения с заклинаниями.
bulgarian: As a progenitor of sorcery, I recognize how adept you have become at wielding spells.

english: The way your power resonates with my own...
french: La façon dont ton pouvoir fait écho au mien...
russian: Твоя сила резонирует с моей...
bulgarian: The way your power resonates with my own...

english: I find it... thrilling.
french: Je trouve cela... palpitant.
russian: И это... воодушевляет.
bulgarian: I find it... thrilling.

english: Will you cast a spell for me some time?
french: Pourras-tu lancer un sort pour moi, à l'occasion ?
russian: Покажешь мне какое-нибудь заклинание когда-нибудь
bulgarian: Will you cast a spell for me some time?

english: What if we... joined our spells together?
french: Et si nous... unissions nos sorts ?
russian: А может, нам... объединить заклинания?
bulgarian: What if we... joined our spells together?

english: You wish to watch me... cast a spell?
french: Tu souhaites me voir... lancer un sort ?
russian: Ты хочешь посмотреть... как я колдую?
bulgarian: You wish to watch me... cast a spell?

english: I see.
french: Je vois.
russian: Понимаю.
bulgarian: I see.

english: If it would please you, you need only ask...
french: Si tel est ton plaisir, il te suffit de le demander...
russian: Если тебе это принесёт удовольствие, можешь просить, когда захочешь...
bulgarian: If it would please you, you need only ask...

english: Together...?
french: Ensemble...?
russian: Объединить?..
bulgarian: Together...?

english: Uniting our mana...
french: En unissant notre mana...
russian: Соединить нашу ману...
bulgarian: Uniting our mana...

english: After a long slumber, the magic of this land has reawakened...
french: Après un long sommeil, la magie de cette terre s'est réveillée...
russian: После долгого сна магия этой земли пробудилась...
bulgarian: After a long slumber, the magic of this land has reawakened...

english: You see, I am a firm believer that every being, mortal or otherwise, should have a hoard.
french: Vois-tu, je crois fermement que chaque être, qu'il soit mortel ou non, devrait posséder un trésor.
russian: Видишь ли, я твёрдо верю, что каждое создание — не важно, смертное или нет — заслуживает своей груды сокровищ.
bulgarian: You see, I am a firm believer that every being, mortal or otherwise, should have a hoard.

english: Perhaps it was presumptuous of me to believe you needed guidance in this sphere.
french: Il était peut-être présomptueux de ma part de penser que tu avais besoin d'un guide en cette matière.
russian: Возможно, я тебя недооценила, посчитав, что тебе нужен мой совет.
bulgarian: Perhaps it was presumptuous of me to believe you needed guidance in this sphere.

english: I appreciate that type of long-term planning. After all...
french: J'apprécie ce genre de vision à long terme. Après tout...
russian: Мне нравится такое долгосрочное планирование. В конце концов...
bulgarian: I appreciate that type of long-term planning. After all...

english: There is a chance we may one day join our hoards together.
french: Il existe une chance que nous puissions un jour réunir nos trésors respectifs.
russian: Возможно, наступит день, когда мы объединим наши сокровища.
bulgarian: There is a chance we may one day join our hoards together.

english: Therefore, I would like to help you begin a starter hoard.
french: Par conséquent, j'aimerais t'aider à commencer le tien.
russian: А потому я хочу помочь тебе начать.
bulgarian: Therefore, I would like to help you begin a starter hoard.

english: Tell me... where do your hoarding interests lie?
french: Dis-moi... Où se porte ton intérêt si tu devais accumuler quelque chose ?
russian: Поведай... Что тебе хочется собирать?
bulgarian: Tell me... where do your hoarding interests lie?

english: I like things that are ancient and valuable.
french: J'aime les choses anciennes et précieuses.
russian: Мне нравятся старинные и ценные предметы.
bulgarian: I like things that are ancient and valuable.

english: Maybe... money?
french: Vers... l'argent, peut-être ?
russian: Наверное... деньги?
bulgarian: Maybe... money?

english: How shrewd of you. Such items have great value and power, and they accrue further value over time.
french: Que c'est rusé de ta part ! De tels objets ont une grande valeur, beaucoup de pouvoir et leur préciosité s'accroît avec le temps.
russian: Как прозорливо с твоей стороны. Такие вещи хранят большую силу и со временем приобретают всё большую ценность.
bulgarian: How shrewd of you. Such items have great value and power, and they accrue further value over time.

english: If you leave an item in your hoard long enough, it may become priceless.
french: Si tu conserves un objet assez longtemps dans ton trésor, il peut devenir inestimable.
russian: Если достаточно долго держать предмет в своей сокровищнице, он может стать бесценным.
bulgarian: If you leave an item in your hoard long enough, it may become priceless.

english: Yes, I appreciate this type of forward-thinking. After all...
french: Oui, j'apprécie cette approche visionnaire. Après tout...
russian: Да, я ценю твою дальновидность. В конце концов...
bulgarian: Yes, I appreciate this type of forward-thinking. After all...

english: There is a chance we may one day join our hoards together.
french: Il existe une chance que nous puissions un jour réunir nos trésors respectifs.
russian: Возможно, наступит день, когда мы объединим наши сокровища.
bulgarian: There is a chance we may one day join our hoards together.

english: Your pragmatism pleases me.
french: Ton pragmatisme me plaît.
russian: Мне нравится твой прагматизм.
bulgarian: Your pragmatism pleases me.

english: Indeed, you would not have made it this far without knowing how to accumulate tesserae.
french: En effet, tu n'aurais pas réussi à aller aussi loin sans savoir comment accumuler des tesserae.
russian:
Воистину, без понимания, как копить тессеры, ты бы не

зашли

зашлазашёлзашло так далеко.
bulgarian: Indeed, you would not have made it this far without knowing how to accumulate tesserae.

english: There you are, [Ari]. Do you have a moment to speak? There is something I would like to discuss.
french: Te voici, [Ari]. Aurais-tu un moment pour moi ? J'aimerais parler de quelque chose avec toi.
russian: Вот ты где, [Ari]. Уделишь мне немного своего времени? Я хочу кое-что обсудить.
bulgarian: There you are, [Ari]. Do you have a moment to speak? There is something I would like to discuss.

english: Is this "$Dating$" a common practice among modern-day mortals, or simply a local curiosity?
french: Les « $rendez-vous$ » sont-ils une pratique courante, chez les mortels de l'époque actuelle, ou est-ce une curiosité locale ?
russian: Так называемые «$свидания$» — это повсеместная практика у нынешних смертных? Или это такой местный обычай?
bulgarian: Is this "$Dating$" a common practice among modern-day mortals, or simply a local curiosity?

english: In all my previous lives, I cannot recall any custom wherein a couple does pleasant, unstructured activities for... "fun."
french: Dans toutes mes vies précédentes, je ne me rappelle aucune coutume dans laquelle un couple fait des activités agréables, libres, pour... « s'amuser ».
russian: Ни в одной из прошлых жизней я не могу вспомнить традицию, чтобы пары без строгих правил занимались чем-то приятным... ради «развлечения».
bulgarian: In all my previous lives, I cannot recall any custom wherein a couple does pleasant, unstructured activities for... "fun."

english: You've never dated before?
french: Tu n'avais encore jamais été à un rendez-vous ?
russian: У тебя никогда не было свиданий?
bulgarian: You've never dated before?

english: I'd say it's pretty common.
french: Je dirais que c'est assez ordinaire.
russian:
Я бы

сказали

сказаласказалсказало, это весьма распространённая практика.
bulgarian: I'd say it's pretty common.

english: You need not phrase it that way! It is not as though I am an innocent youth.
french: Tu n'as pas besoin de formuler les choses de cette façon ! Ce n'est pas comme si j'étais une jeunette innocente.
russian: Не надо так формулировать! Будто твои слова обращены к невинному юнцу.
bulgarian: You need not phrase it that way! It is not as though I am an innocent youth.

english: I have courted, of course. With the intent to create alliances and to consolidate power.
french: J'ai eu des fréquentations, bien sûr. Dans l'intention de créer des alliances et de consolider un pouvoir.
russian: Разумеется, мне знакомы ухаживания. С целью создать союз или укрепить свою власть.
bulgarian: I have courted, of course. With the intent to create alliances and to consolidate power.

english: The pleasurable time I spend with you is very different, however.
french: Cependant, les moments agréables que je passe avec toi sont très différents.
russian: Однако времяпрепровождение с тобой — приятное. И это сильное отличие.
bulgarian: The pleasurable time I spend with you is very different, however.

english: I expect you to show me more of this... "$Dating$".
french: J'attends de toi que tu me montres d'autres de ces... « $rendez-vous$ ».
russian: Я рассчитываю, что ты дашь мне больше практики... «$свиданий$».
bulgarian: I expect you to show me more of this... "$Dating$".

english: I see. How interesting.
french: Je vois. C'est très intéressant.
russian: Понятно. Как интересно.
bulgarian: I see. How interesting.

english: When I was queen, the purpose of courtship was to create alliances and to consolidate power.
french: Quand j'étais reine, le but d'une cour était de créer des alliances et de consolider un pouvoir.
russian: Когда я была королевой, целью ухаживаний всегда были новые союзы и укрепление власти.
bulgarian: When I was queen, the purpose of courtship was to create alliances and to consolidate power.

english: The pleasurable time I spend with you is very different.
french: Les moments agréables que je passe avec toi sont très différents.
russian: А времяпрепровождение с тобой — приятное. И это сильное отличие.
bulgarian: The pleasurable time I spend with you is very different.

english: [Ari]. I have a question I would like you to answer for me.
french: J'ai une question, [Ari], à laquelle j'aimerais que tu répondes pour moi.
russian: [Ari]. У меня есть вопрос, на который я хочу получить ответ.
bulgarian: [Ari]. I have a question I would like you to answer for me.

english: And of my time trapped in the depths of the Ruins.
french: Et au temps que j'ai passé, piégée dans les profondeurs des ruines.
russian: И о том времени, что я провела в заточении в руинах.
bulgarian: And of my time trapped in the depths of the Ruins.

english: My crystalline prison was suffocating.
french: Ma prison de cristal était étouffante.
russian: В удушающе тесной кристальной тюрьме.
bulgarian: My crystalline prison was suffocating.

english: Every day, I longed to assume physical form... to take a breath under the night sky.
french: Chaque jour, j'aspirais ardemment à avoir une forme physique... afin de respirer sous le ciel nocturne.
russian: Каждый день я мечтала обрести физическое воплощение... Вдохнуть воздух под ночным небом.
bulgarian: Every day, I longed to assume physical form... to take a breath under the night sky.

english: After you freed me, I did just that.
french: Après que tu m'as libérée, c'est précisément ce que j'ai fait.
russian:
Это первое, что я сделала, когда ты меня

освободили

освободилаосвободилосвободило.
bulgarian: After you freed me, I did just that.

english: Cold and sharp, almost painful in my chest...
french: Froid et vif, presque douloureux dans ma poitrine...
russian: Морозный ночной воздух, почти обжигающий грудь...
bulgarian: Cold and sharp, almost painful in my chest...

english: That night air is what I think of when I see you, [Ari].
french: C'est à cet air nocturne que je pense quand je te vois, [Ari].
russian: Я вспоминаю его каждый раз, когда смотрю на тебя, [Ari].
bulgarian: That night air is what I think of when I see you, [Ari].

english: I was thinking of you...
french: J'étais en train de penser à toi...
russian: Я размышляла о тебе...
bulgarian: I was thinking of you...

english: Oh, I revel in it.
french: Oh, je m'en délecte.
russian: О, я упиваюсь этим взглядом.
bulgarian: Oh, I revel in it.

english: When you look at me, with those eyes of adoration...
french: Quand tu me regardes avec ces yeux pleins d'adoration...
russian: Когда ты смотришь на меня с таким обожанием...
bulgarian: When you look at me, with those eyes of adoration...

english: Here. A token.
french: Tiens. Un témoignage symbolique.
russian: Вот, возьми.
bulgarian: Here. A token.

english: I hunted this beast with my own claws... thinking of you as I struck every blow.
french: J'ai chassé cette bête de mes propres griffes... en pensant à toi à chaque instant.
russian: Я растерзала этого зверя своими когтями... И с каждым ударом я думала о тебе.
bulgarian: I hunted this beast with my own claws... thinking of you as I struck every blow.

english: As your mate, it is my duty to provide for you.
french: En tant que compagne, il est de mon devoir de subvenir à tes besoins.
russian: Как твой партнёр я обязана обеспечивать тебе пропитание.
bulgarian: As your mate, it is my duty to provide for you.

english: I wonder if hearing yours in return does the same for you...
french: Je me demande si entendre le tien en retour te provoque le même effet...
russian: Интересно, почувствуешь ли ты это, если я назову твоё в ответ...
bulgarian: I wonder if hearing yours in return does the same for you...

english: [Ari].
french: [Ari].
russian: [Ari].
bulgarian: [Ari].

english: It does thrill me to hear you speak my name.
french: Cela me donne le frisson de t'entendre prononcer mon nom.
russian: Меня пронимает дрожь, когда ты произносишь моё имя.
bulgarian: It does thrill me to hear you speak my name.

english: I began my existence as an immortal dragon, but chose to live a mortal life.
french: J'ai commencé mon existence sous la forme d'un dragon immortel, mais j'ai choisi de vivre une vie mortelle.
russian: Я начала своё существование как бессмертный дракон, но предпочла жить в мире смертных.
bulgarian: I began my existence as an immortal dragon, but chose to live a mortal life.

english: While you are mortal... yet imbued with the power of immortal dragons.
french: Alors que tu es un être mortel... pourtant imprégné de la puissance des dragons immortels.
russian:
Ты же

рождены смертными

рождена смертнойрождён смертнымрождено смертным... Но

получили

получилаполучилполучило силу вечных драконов.
bulgarian: While you are mortal... yet imbued with the power of immortal dragons.

english: You walk a line between the shapes of my soul.
french: Tu marches sur un fil qui sépare les différents aspects de mon âme.
russian: Ты живёшь на грани двух частей моей души.
bulgarian: You walk a line between the shapes of my soul.

english: Which makes you perfectly attuned to myself... And my tastes.
french: Ce qui fait que tu es en parfait unisson avec moi... et avec mes goûts.
russian: И потому ты идеально подходишь для меня... И для моих вкусов.
bulgarian: Which makes you perfectly attuned to myself... And my tastes.

english: I have noticed that there are some interesting parallels between us.
french: J'ai remarqué qu'il existe entre nous des parallèles intéressants.
russian: Я заметила между нами интересные параллели.
bulgarian: I have noticed that there are some interesting parallels between us.

english: The most prized treasure of my hoard.
french: Le trésor le plus précieux parmi toutes mes richesses.
russian: Ты — моё самое драгоценное сокровище.
bulgarian: The most prized treasure of my hoard.

english: There you are. You seem to be shining brightly today.
french: Te voilà. Tu sembles briller de mille feux, aujourd'hui.
russian: Вот ты где. Сегодня ты будто сияешь ярче.
bulgarian: There you are. You seem to be shining brightly today.

english: For I am not a demanding paramour.
french: Car je ne suis pas exigeante, en amour.
russian: Ведь я нетребовательная любовница...
bulgarian: For I am not a demanding paramour.

english: Though my taste in gifts may be lavish...
french: Quoique mes goûts soient parfois dispendieux en matière de présents...
russian: Хотя я и предпочитаю роскошные подарки...
bulgarian: Though my taste in gifts may be lavish...

english: And I should like to spend time with you often...
french: Et que j'aimerais passer souvent du temps avec toi...
russian: И я бы хотела проводить с тобой время чаще...
bulgarian: And I should like to spend time with you often...

english: That is my right.
french: J'en ai le droit.
russian: Таково моё право.
bulgarian: That is my right.

english: You need not fear, [Ari]...
french: N'aie crainte, [Ari]...
russian: Тебе нечего бояться, [Ari]...
bulgarian: You need not fear, [Ari]...

english: Me? The name's Stillwell. I can see the past, present, and future. All at once. It's a lot.
french: Moi ? Tu peux m'appeler Stillwell. Je vois le passé, le présent et l'avenir. Tout en même temps. Ça fait beaucoup.
russian: Я? Меня зовут Стиллвелл. Я вижу прошлое, настоящее и будущее. Одновременно. Да, это непросто.
bulgarian: Me? The name's Stillwell. I can see the past, present, and future. All at once. It's a lot.

english: I've come to Mistria on urgent business...
french: Passe me voir si tu veux que je te dise la $bonne aventure$. J'essaierai d'avoir l'air aussi surpris que toi.
russian: Заходи, когда захочешь, чтобы я прочитал твою $судьбу$. Я постараюсь выглядеть удивленно, когда ты придёшь.
bulgarian: I've come to Mistria on urgent business...

english: Hey [Ari]. Hmm? No, we haven't met before.
french: Bonjour, [Ari]. Comment ? Non, c'est bien la première fois qu'on se rencontre.
russian: Приветствую, [Ari]. Хмм? Нет, мы раньше не встречались.
bulgarian: Hey [Ari]. Hmm? No, we haven't met before.

english: I'm closing up, but the third eye is always open for you, [Ari].
french: Je ferme boutique, mais mon troisième œil reste toujours ouvert pour toi, [Ari].
bulgarian: Вече е време да затварям, но Третото око винаги е отворено. Поне за теб, [Ari].

english: Breaking down the booth is such a hassle... why is everything so heavy...
french: Le démontage du stand est une telle corvée. Pourquoi tout est aussi lourd ?
bulgarian: Уф, как мразя да прибирам сергията... Защо всичко е толкова тежко...

english: Fate has decreed... that I pack up my booth...
french: Le destin a voulu... que je démonte mon stand...
bulgarian: Съдбата повелява... Да прибера сергията...

english: I'm too sleepy to do booth breakdown... help...
french: J'ai trop sommeil pour démonter le stand... Au secours !
bulgarian: Толкова ми се спи, че не мога да прибера сергията... Помогни ми...

english: Well, be sure to find your way home... before fate intervenes...
french: N'oublie pas de rentrer chez toi... avant que le destin ne s'en mêle...
bulgarian: Хм, прибирай се, преди съдбата да се намеси...

english: You're up late, [Ari]... how do you have so much energy?
french: Tu es encore debout à cette heure-là, [Ari]... Où trouves-tu toute cette énergie ?
bulgarian: Будуваш до късно, [Ari]... Откъде намираш толкова енергия...?

english: But sometimes seeing them simply means it's time to go home.
french: Mais parfois, les voir signifie seulement qu'il est temps de rentrer chez soi.
bulgarian: Но може би просто означават, че е станало късно и трябва да се прибереш.

english: The stars can have many hidden meanings...
french: Les étoiles peuvent avoir de nombreuses significations cachées...
bulgarian: Звездите крият толкова много значения...

english: I inherited these robes, and this booth from my grandmother... they don't make mythical tents like this anymore.
french: Ce manteau et ce stand sont un héritage de ma grand-mère... on ne fabrique plus de tentes mythiques comme celles-ci, de nos jours.
bulgarian: Тази роба и тази сергия са ми завещани от баба ми... В днешно време не можеш да намериш такава мистична шатра.

english: Sigh. Better get packed up.
french: Soupir. Je ferais mieux de remballer.
bulgarian: Уф. Май просто трябва да си събера багажа...

english: Nora said I couldn't leave my booth here until next Saturday Market, even if I sleep behind the table...
french: Nora m'a dit que je ne pouvais pas laisser mon stand ici jusqu'au marché de samedi prochain, même si je dormais derrière la table...
bulgarian: Нора каза, че не мога да оставя сергията тук до следващия съботен пазар,\nдори да спя зад масата...

english: I'd be impressed if it wasn't so annoying.
french: Ce serait impressionnant si ça n'était pas si pénible.
bulgarian: I'd be impressed if it wasn't so annoying.

english: Everytime Seridia comes to my booth, she starts saying what I'm about to say, right before I say it.
french: Chaque fois que Seridia vient à mon stand, dès qu'elle ouvre la bouche, elle se met à dire exactement les paroles que j'allais prononcer, mais juste avant moi.
bulgarian: Everytime Seridia comes to my booth, she starts saying what I'm about to say, right before I say it.

english: Thank you, [Ari]... for showing me that the future is not always written.
french: Merci, [Ari]... de m'avoir montré que le futur n'était pas toujours écrit d'avance.
bulgarian: Thank you, [Ari]... for showing me that the future is not always written.

english: A birthday gift? I didn't see any sign of this!
french: Un cadeau d'anniversaire ? Je n'en avais perçu aucun signe annonciateur !
bulgarian: A birthday gift? I didn't see any sign of this!

english: Thanks... I think?
french: Merci... je suppose ?
bulgarian: Thanks... I think?

english: Thank you [Ari]. I see that your intuition has revealed what I like.
french: Merci, [Ari]. Je vois que ton intuition t'a révélé ce qui me plaisait.
bulgarian: Thank you [Ari]. I see that your intuition has revealed what I like.

english: I never expect others to know my tastes, but this is quite to my liking. Thank you, [Ari].
french: Je ne m'attends jamais à ce que d'autres connaissent mes goûts, mais cela me plaît beaucoup. Merci, [Ari].
bulgarian: I never expect others to know my tastes, but this is quite to my liking. Thank you, [Ari].

english: The crystalline seems so unreal... and yet, it reminds us of the natural order of things. Thank you for this wisdom, [Ari].
french: Cette transparence semble irréelle... pourtant, elle nous rappelle l'ordre naturel des choses. Merci pour cette sagesse, [Ari].
bulgarian: The crystalline seems so unreal... and yet, it reminds us of the natural order of things. Thank you for this wisdom, [Ari].

english: There's something about this that defies the cosmic order... I like it.
french: Il y a là-dedans quelque chose qui défie l'ordre du cosmos... ça me plaît.
bulgarian: There's something about this that defies the cosmic order... I like it.

english: The night, the moon, the stars, and the mysteries therein... all of these spark my interest. Thank you, [Ari].
french: La nuit, la lune, les étoiles et les mystères qu'elles recèlent... tout cela attise mon intérêt. Merci, [Ari].
bulgarian: The night, the moon, the stars, and the mysteries therein... all of these spark my interest. Thank you, [Ari].

english: A surprise...? Now that's rare. I love it, [Ari].
french: Une surprise... ? Voilà qui est rare. Merci, je l'adore, [Ari].
bulgarian: A surprise...? Now that's rare. I love it, [Ari].

english: Ah... could it really be?
french: Ah... serait-ce... ?
bulgarian: Ah... could it really be?

english: I foresaw that a figure would come before me, and here you are. What I did not foresee was the depth of your generosity. I thank you, [Ari].
french: J'ai vu qu'une silhouette allait se présenter devant moi et te voici. Ce que je n'avais pas vu, c'est ta profonde générosité. Merci, [Ari].
bulgarian: I foresaw that a figure would come before me, and here you are. What I did not foresee was the depth of your generosity. I thank you, [Ari].

english: Ah yes, one of my favorite foods, replete with the tartness of melancholy. This is exquisite. Thank you.
french: Ah oui, l'un de mes aliments préférés, au goût amer de la mélancolie. C'est délicieux. Merci.
bulgarian: Ah yes, one of my favorite foods, replete with the tartness of melancholy. This is exquisite. Thank you.

english: This thing, this object of mystery... I adore it, [Ari], and long will I contemplate it. Thank you.
french: Cette chose, cet objet plein de mystère... Je l'adore, [Ari], et je le contemplerai longtemps. Merci.
bulgarian: This thing, this object of mystery... I adore it, [Ari], and long will I contemplate it. Thank you.

english: I love it.
french: J'adore ça.
bulgarian: I love it.

english: There's something... unsettling about this.
french: Il y a là-dedans quelque chose de... perturbant.
bulgarian: There's something... unsettling about this.

english: Ah, thank you.
french: Ah, merci.
bulgarian: Ah, thank you.

english: The future always seems a little more bearable with a good glass of wine. Thank you, [Ari].
french: L'avenir semble toujours un peu plus supportable avec un bon verre de vin. Merci, [Ari].
bulgarian: The future always seems a little more bearable with a good glass of wine. Thank you, [Ari].

english: The only thing worse than receiving this gift was knowing it was coming.
french: La seule chose qui soit pire que ce cadeau, c'est de savoir que j'allais le recevoir.
bulgarian: The only thing worse than receiving this gift was knowing it was coming.

english: I'm not above making niceties with the little people. Hello to you.
french: Tu noteras que je n'ai rien contre les petites gens. Bien le bonjour, d'ailleurs.
russian: Я не чураюсь знакомств с простолюдинами. Привет тебе.
bulgarian: I'm not above making niceties with the little people. Hello to you.

english: But when I was quizzing her about it, she said her business partner, Dozy, helped her prepare it.
french: Lorsque je l'ai interrogée sur sa façon de faire, elle m'a dit que son collaborateur, Dozy, l'avait aidée.
russian: А когда я стал про него расспрашивать, она сказала, что пирог помогал готовить её партнёр Дрёма.
bulgarian: But when I was quizzing her about it, she said her business partner, Dozy, helped her prepare it.

english: Dozy... is a dog.
french: Dozy est... un chien.
russian: Дрёма... это пёс.
bulgarian: Dozy... is a dog.

english: I shouldn't expect these village rubes to know about sanitary preparation, but nonetheless... I do. DISQUALIFIED!
french: Je ne m'attends pas à ce que les rustres de ce patelin connaissent toutes les règles d'hygiène, mais il y a des limites... DISQUALIFIÉE !
russian: Мне не стоило ждать от этой деревенщины соблюдения правил гигиены, и всё же... Я ждал. ДИСКВАЛИФИЦИРОВАНА!
bulgarian: I shouldn't expect these village rubes to know about sanitary preparation, but nonetheless... I do. DISQUALIFIED!

english: That ill-natured woman with the gaudy boots, Juniper... She entered her $Bell Berry Bakewell Tart$ into the $Cooking Challenge$.
french: Cette femme désagréable au possible, chaussée de bottes d'un goût douteux, Juniper... Elle a présenté sa $tarte aux clocherelles$ pour le $défi gastronomique$.
russian: Женщина в броских сапогах и с дурными манерами, Джунипер... Она принесла $тарт из колокольника$ на $смотр блюд$.
bulgarian: That ill-natured woman with the gaudy boots, Juniper... She entered her $Bell Berry Bakewell Tart$ into the $Cooking Challenge$.

english: When I told her she failed utterly, she laughed at me! You know, I don't think she's taking my challenges very seriously.
french: Quand je lui ai fait savoir qu'elle avait lamentablement échoué, elle m'a ri au nez ! Je crois qu'elle ne prend pas mes défis très au sérieux.
russian: Когда я сообщил ей, что она с треском провалилась, она рассмеялась мне в лицо! По-моему, она не воспринимает мои задания всерьёз.
bulgarian: When I told her she failed utterly, she laughed at me! You know, I don't think she's taking my challenges very seriously.

english: I should file a complaint!
french: Je devrais porter plainte !
russian: Пора написать на неё жалобу!
bulgarian: I should file a complaint!

english: The little hellion, Dell... she turned in a mud pie for the $Chocolate Cake$ Challenge!
french: Cette petite chipie de Dell... Elle a préparé une tarte à la boue pour le défi du $gâteau au chocolat$ !
russian: Эта хулиганка Делл... На конкурс $шоколадных тортов$ принесла пирог из грязи!
bulgarian: The little hellion, Dell... she turned in a mud pie for the $Chocolate Cake$ Challenge!

english: But don't worry, I kindly gave him some advice.
french: Mais ne t'en fais pas, je lui ai donné un bon conseil :
russian: Но можешь не волноваться, я дал ему добрый совет.
bulgarian: But don't worry, I kindly gave him some advice.

english: I told him to leave the cooking to the experts!
french: Laisser la cuisine aux experts !
russian: А именно: сказал оставить готовку специалистам!
bulgarian: I told him to leave the cooking to the experts!

english: The burly curator, Errol... his $Crispy Fried Earthshroom$ was a disaster. More like Extra Soggy Earthshroom!
french: Le costaud qui est conservateur du musée, Errol... son $beignet de terramanite$ était une horreur. C'était plus de la bouillie de terramanite !
russian: Этот Эррол, бугай-куратор... приготовил настоящую катастрофу: не $земляные грибы в кляре$, а земляные грибы в слизи!
bulgarian: The burly curator, Errol... his $Crispy Fried Earthshroom$ was a disaster. More like Extra Soggy Earthshroom!

english: But he just made me look at his crystal collection!
french: Non, il m'a juste montré sa collection de cristaux !
russian: А он заставил меня рассматривать его коллекцию кристаллов!
bulgarian: But he just made me look at his crystal collection!

english: For an hour!
french: Ça a duré une heure !
russian: На протяжении часа!
bulgarian: For an hour!

english: That walking muscle, Olric... he stopped by earlier. I thought he was here to drop off his entry for the $Crystal Berry Pie$ Challenge...
french: Cette espèce de colosse, Olric, est passé tout à l'heure... Je croyais qu'il déposait sa création pour le défi de la $tarte aux baies de cristal$...
russian: Ольрик, эта ходячая гора мышц, недавно заходил... Я думал, он хочет отдать на смотр $пирог из кристальных ягод$...
bulgarian: That walking muscle, Olric... he stopped by earlier. I thought he was here to drop off his entry for the $Crystal Berry Pie$ Challenge...

english: But her dish was covered in edible flowers!
french: Mais son plat était recouvert de fleurs comestibles !
russian: Но у неё всё блюдо было усыпано съедобными цветами!
bulgarian: But her dish was covered in edible flowers!

english: I asked for an $Herb Salad$, not a flower arrangement! There will be no embellishments in my $Cooking Challenge$!
french: J'ai demandé une $salade aux herbes$, pas une composition florale ! Les fioritures n'ont pas leur place dans mes $défis gastronomiques$.
russian: Я просил $зелёный салат$, а не цветочные узоры! У меня на $смотре блюд$ прошу обойтись без украшений!
bulgarian: I asked for an $Herb Salad$, not a flower arrangement! There will be no embellishments in my $Cooking Challenge$!

english: That blonde woman with the dirt under her fingernails... Celine. She attempted my $Herb Salad$ Challenge.
french: Céline, la petite blonde avec de la terre sous les ongles... Elle a voulu participer au défi de la $salade aux herbes$.
russian: Селин, эта блондинка с грязью под ногтями... попыталась сделать для смотра $зелёный салат$.
bulgarian: That blonde woman with the dirt under her fingernails... Celine. She attempted my $Herb Salad$ Challenge.

english: This $Cooking Challenge$ is not about putting your own twist on it!
french: Le but du $défi gastronomique$ n'est pas de faire « sa recette » !
russian: В моём $смотре блюд$ отсебятина не принимается!
bulgarian: This $Cooking Challenge$ is not about putting your own twist on it!

english: And also? Too spicy!
french: En plus, c'était bien trop épicé !
russian: К тому же знаешь, что? Было слишком остро!
bulgarian: And also? Too spicy!

english: The old fisherwoman, Terithia... she said she had her own twist on the =Incredibly Hot Pot=.
french: Cette vieille pêcheuse, Terithia... elle prétendait avoir sa recette à elle du =ragoût super épicé=.
russian: Эта старая рыбачка, Теризия... сказала, что у неё своя версия =обжигающего жаркого=.
bulgarian: The old fisherwoman, Terithia... she said she had her own twist on the =Incredibly Hot Pot=.

english: But he made one mistake. His omelet... was too big!
french: Mais il a commis une erreur. Son omelette était bien trop grosse !
russian: Но в одном он ошибся. Его омлет был... слишком большой!
bulgarian: But he made one mistake. His omelet... was too big!

english: He said it was because he likes to share... unsophisticated! Naive!
french: Il a dit que c'était parce qu'il aime bien partager... Quel rustaud ! Naïf, même !
russian: Он сказал, что любит делиться... Как безыскусно! Как наивно!
bulgarian: He said it was because he likes to share... unsophisticated! Naive!

english: That brawny farmer in need of a haircut, Hayden... he almost passed my $Omelet$ challenge.
french: Le fermier bourru qui aurait bien besoin d'aller chez le coiffeur, Hayden... Il a failli réussir mon défi de l'$omelette$.
russian: Этому здоровому фермеру, Хейдену, не помешала бы стрижка... но он почти победил в смотре $омлета$.
bulgarian: That brawny farmer in need of a haircut, Hayden... he almost passed my $Omelet$ challenge.

english: I suppose even the nobles put their hands to work, out here in the sticks.
french: J'imagine que dans les trous perdus, même les nobles mettent la main à la pâte.
russian: Видимо, в здешней глуши даже знать вынуждена готовить.
bulgarian: I suppose even the nobles put their hands to work, out here in the sticks.

english: But his $Rice Ball$ was studded with chocolate chips. There's a recipe for a reason! No embellishments!
french: Enfin, sa $boulette de riz$ était truffée de pépites de chocolat. S'il existe une recette, il faut la suivre ! Pas de fioritures !
russian: Но его $рисовый шарик$ был покрыт шоколадной крошкой. Существует ведь рецепт! Никаких приукрашиваний!
bulgarian: But his $Rice Ball$ was studded with chocolate chips. There's a recipe for a reason! No embellishments!

english: That princely fellow whose hair nearly rivals mine... Eiland. He entered my $Rice Ball$ Challenge.
french: Cet aristocrate dont la coiffure pourrait presque rivaliser avec la mienne, Eiland... Il a participé à mon défi de la $boulette de riz$.
russian: У этого парня благородного вида, Эйланда, причёска едва уступает моей... Он участвовал в моём смотре $рисовых шариков$.
bulgarian: That princely fellow whose hair nearly rivals mine... Eiland. He entered my $Rice Ball$ Challenge.

english: How did he get the shape wrong? It's in the name!
french: Comment a-t-il pu se tromper sur la forme ? C'est dans le nom du plat !
russian: Даже форма указана в названии! Как он умудрился перепутать?
bulgarian: How did he get the shape wrong? It's in the name!

english: And let me tell you, it's not the Rice Ingot Challenge!
french: Je n'ai pas lancé le défi du lingot de riz, que je sache !
russian: Знаешь, я ведь не писал «смотр рисовых слитков»!
bulgarian: And let me tell you, it's not the Rice Ingot Challenge!

english: That blacksmith with the attitude, March... he submitted his entry for my $Rice Ball$ Challenge.
french: March, le forgeron au caractère de cochon... Il a participé au défi de la $boulette de riz$.
russian: Этот хамоватый кузнец Март... приготовил мне на смотр $рисовый шарик$.
bulgarian: That blacksmith with the attitude, March... he submitted his entry for my $Rice Ball$ Challenge.

english: Only she replaced half the ingredients with something she deemed healthier. And then she left out the salt!
french: Mais elle a remplacé la moitié des ingrédients par d'autres qu'elle juge plus sains. Et elle n'a pas mis de sel !
russian: Вот только половину ингредиентов она заменила, по её мнению, более здоровыми. И совсем не добавила соли!
bulgarian: Only she replaced half the ingredients with something she deemed healthier. And then she left out the salt!

english: You know what I call a salad like that? Compost!
french: Tu sais le nom que je donne à ce genre de salade ? Du compost !
russian: Знаешь, как я называю такой салат? Компост!
bulgarian: You know what I call a salad like that? Compost!

english: That haughty doctor, Valen... she turned in her $Tide Salad$ for my $Cooking Challenge$.
french: La docteure arrogante, Valen... Elle a présenté sa $salade des marées$ pour mon $défi gastronomique$.
russian: Эта гордая врачиха, Вален... принесла мне на $смотр блюд$ свой $подводный салат$.
bulgarian: That haughty doctor, Valen... she turned in her $Tide Salad$ for my $Cooking Challenge$.

english: But when I asked him to show me the sandwich, he told me he ate it!
french: Mais quand je lui ai demandé de me montrer son sandwich, il m'a répondu qu'il l'avait mangé !
russian: А когда я попросил его показать блюдо, он сказал, что его съел!
bulgarian: But when I asked him to show me the sandwich, he told me he ate it!

english: That's not a Cooking Challenge! That's lunch!
french: Ce n'est plus un défi gastronomique, c'est un véritable repas !
russian: У меня же тут кулинарный конкурс, а не обед!
bulgarian: That's not a Cooking Challenge! That's lunch!

english: That mustachioed buffoon, Holt... he decided to take on the =Veggie Sub Sandwich= Challenge.
french: Ce pitre à la grosse moustache, Holt... Il a décidé de s'essayer au défi du =sandwich aux légumes=.
russian: Этот усатый клоун, Хольт... решил принять участие в смотре =овощного сэндвича=.
bulgarian: That mustachioed buffoon, Holt... he decided to take on the =Veggie Sub Sandwich= Challenge.

english: I'm your host... Taliferro.
french: Je me présente... Taliferro.
russian: Его провожу я... Талиферро.
bulgarian: I'm your host... Taliferro.

english: I'm not sure what the $Merchant's Association$ is thinking, having Wheedle and I set up out here in the sticks.
french: Je ne sais pas ce qui a pris à la $guilde des marchands$ de nous envoyer Wheedle et moi dans ce trou perdu.
russian: Не знаю, о чём думали в $гильдии торговцев$, когда послали нас с Хлюстом в эту глухомань.
bulgarian: I'm not sure what the $Merchant's Association$ is thinking, having Wheedle and I set up out here in the sticks.

english: I can't say I have particularly high expectations.
french: Je ne dirai pas que je m'attends à grand-chose.
russian: Не сказал бы, что у меня есть какие-то ожидания.
bulgarian: I can't say I have particularly high expectations.

english: But if you do manage to complete my $Cooking Challenges$, you'll be rewarded with $Renown$ and $a variety of prizes$.
french: Mais si tu parviens à relever mes $défis gastronomiques$, tu recevras de la $renommée$ et $diverses récompenses$.
russian: Но если ты справишься с моими $смотрами блюд$, тебя ждёт награда: $репутация$ и $разнообразные призы$.
bulgarian: But if you do manage to complete my $Cooking Challenges$, you'll be rewarded with $Renown$ and $a variety of prizes$.

english: If you're interested, be sure to check out the $Challenge Board$ here at my booth on $Saturdays$.
french: Si cela t'intéresse, n'hésite pas à consulter le $panneau des défis$ ici, à mon stand, chaque $samedi$.
russian:
Если ты

заинтересованы

заинтересованазаинтересованзаинтересовано, подойди к $доске смотров$ в моей лавке в $субботу$.
bulgarian: If you're interested, be sure to check out the $Challenge Board$ here at my booth on $Saturdays$.

english: You must complete each $Challenge$ before you can move on to the next round.
french: Tu dois terminer chaque $défi$ avant de pouvoir passer au suivant.
russian: Каждый $смотр$ обязательно пройти, чтобы перейти в следующий раунд.
bulgarian: You must complete each $Challenge$ before you can move on to the next round.

english: Good luck, [Ari]. You'll need it.
french: Bonne chance, [Ari]. Tu en auras bien besoin.
russian: Удачи, [Ari]. Без неё тебе не обойтись.
bulgarian: Good luck, [Ari]. You'll need it.

english: Welcome to Taliferro's $Cooking Challenge$.
french: Bienvenue au $défi gastronomique$ de Taliferro.
russian: Добро пожаловать на $смотр блюд$ Талиферро.
bulgarian: Welcome to Taliferro's $Cooking Challenge$.

english: The booth is closed, [Ari]. You know what closed means, don't you?
french: Mon stand est fermé, [Ari]. Tu sais ce que signifie « fermé », n'est-ce pas ?
russian: Моя лавка закрыта, [Ari]. Знаешь, что такое «закрыто»?
bulgarian: The booth is closed, [Ari]. You know what closed means, don't you?

english: Okay, I'm done counting. But still, be silent!
french: Bon, j'ai terminé, mais quoi qu'il en soit... silence !
russian: Ладно, пересчитал. Но всё равно помолчи!
bulgarian: Okay, I'm done counting. But still, be silent!

english: Silence! I'm counting my silverware.
french: Silence ! Je recompte mes couverts en argent.
russian: Тихо! Я пересчитываю столовые приборы.
bulgarian: Silence! I'm counting my silverware.

english: A shame such colorful views are wasted on these country folk.
french: Quel dommage que ces rustres soient incapables de l'apprécier !
russian: Жаль, что такие красочные виды достаются деревенским бездарям.
bulgarian: A shame such colorful views are wasted on these country folk.

english: The leaves here are picturesque in the fall... a perfect backdrop for the close of Market day.
french: Les feuilles d'automne donnent une touche artistique à la place... C'est parfait pour conclure le marché.
russian: Осенью здесь такая живописная листва... Идеальный фон для закрытия базара.
bulgarian: The leaves here are picturesque in the fall... a perfect backdrop for the close of Market day.

english: How am I supposed to pack up when there's three mice running amuck in my kitchen?
french: Comment suis-je censé tout ranger avec trois souris qui mettent le bazar dans ma cuisine ?
russian: Ну и как прикажете собираться, когда у меня на кухне мельтешат трое мышей?
bulgarian: How am I supposed to pack up when there's three mice running amuck in my kitchen?

english: Those children were here earlier, rifling through all my cabinets...
french: Les enfants qui étaient là tout à l'heure n'arrêtaient pas de fouiner dans tous mes placards...
russian: Недавно ко мне прибежали дети и стали рыться в моих шкафах...
bulgarian: Those children were here earlier, rifling through all my cabinets...

english: How am I supposed to pack up when there's snow all over the counter!
french: Impossible de ranger mon stand avec un plan de travail couvert de neige !
russian: Как мне собирать вещи, если у меня весь прилавок в снегу?
bulgarian: How am I supposed to pack up when there's snow all over the counter!

english: Winter is exactly why I prefer indoor kitchens.
french: C'est à cause de l'hiver que je préfère cuisiner en intérieur.
russian: Я предпочитаю держать кухню в помещении как раз из-за такой зимы.
bulgarian: Winter is exactly why I prefer indoor kitchens.

english: Because I'm cold, that's why!
french: Parce que j'ai froid, tout simplement !
russian: Потому что я замёрз, вот почему!
bulgarian: Because I'm cold, that's why!

english: The $Cooking Challenge$ is closed for the day. Why?
french: Il n'y a pas de $défi gastronomique$, aujourd'hui. Tu veux savoir pourquoi.
russian: $Смотр блюд$ на сегодня закончен. Почему?
bulgarian: The $Cooking Challenge$ is closed for the day. Why?

english: Do I not look busy to you? Do you not see me packing up the pots and pans?
french: Tu trouves que j'ai l'air de me tourner les pouces ? Tu vois bien que je remballe mes marmites et mes poêles.
russian: По мне не заметно, что я занят? Ты не видишь, что я собираю кастрюли и сковородки?
bulgarian: Do I not look busy to you? Do you not see me packing up the pots and pans?

english: Begone, peasant!
french: Dégage, plouc !
russian: Прочь, деревня!
bulgarian: Begone, peasant!

english: The Market day is over, so I can dispense with the pleasantries.
french: Le marché est terminé. Je n'ai plus besoin d'être aimable.
russian: Базарный день закончился, так что я могу отбросить любезности.
bulgarian: The Market day is over, so I can dispense with the pleasantries.

english: Someone of my pedigree? And on a full stomach?
french: Quelqu'un de mon rang ! Qui a l'estomac plein !
russian: С моей-то родословной? И на полный желудок?
bulgarian: Someone of my pedigree? And on a full stomach?

english: I sample so many dishes throughout the day... and now I have to do the manual labor of packing the booth?
french: Je goûte déjà de nombreux plats tout au long de la journée... et en plus, je dois tout remballer moi-même !
russian: Я должен попробовать столько блюд за день... А теперь ещё и вынужден сам собирать лавку?
bulgarian: I sample so many dishes throughout the day... and now I have to do the manual labor of packing the booth?

english: But for some reason they don't seem to appreciate my presence. Perhaps they're intimidated?
french: Bizarrement, ils ne semblent guère apprécier ma présence, là-bas. Peut-être que je les intimide ?
russian: Хотя там по какой-то причине не очень рады моим визитам. Может, они меня боятся?
bulgarian: But for some reason they don't seem to appreciate my presence. Perhaps they're intimidated?

english: Who can blame them!
french: Ma foi, c'est bien normal !
russian: Не могу их винить!
bulgarian: Who can blame them!

english: Once I'm done packing up, perhaps I'll visit the Inn.
french: Quand j'aurai terminé de ranger, je ferai peut-être un saut à l'auberge.
russian: Возможно, когда закончу собирать вещи, загляну в трактир.
bulgarian: Once I'm done packing up, perhaps I'll visit the Inn.

english: Unbelievable. These yokels should be tripping over themselves offering to help me.
french: Je n'y crois pas. Ces paysans devraient faire la queue pour me proposer leur aide.
russian: Невероятно. Эти вахлаки должны в очередь выстраиваться, чтобы мне помочь.
bulgarian: Unbelievable. These yokels should be tripping over themselves offering to help me.

english: Are you here to pack up my booth? No?
french: Tu viens m'aider à remballer mon stand ? Ah non ?
russian:
Ты

пришли

пришлапришёлпришло собрать мою лавку? Нет?
bulgarian: Are you here to pack up my booth? No?

english: No one has ever suffered as greatly as I.
french: Personne n'a jamais souffert comme je souffre.
russian: Никому ещё не доводилось так страдать!
bulgarian: No one has ever suffered as greatly as I.

english: I can't believe I'm expected to pack up my booth in this summer heat.
french: Je n'arrive pas à le croire. Il faut que je remballe mon stand par cette chaleur.
russian: Поверить не могу, что мне надо собирать свою лавку в летнюю жару.
bulgarian: I can't believe I'm expected to pack up my booth in this summer heat.

english: If you're here for the $Cooking Challenge$, come back next week!
french: Si tu es là pour le $défi gastronomique$, reviens la semaine prochaine !
russian: Если ты на $смотр блюд$, то приходи на следующей неделе!
bulgarian: If you're here for the $Cooking Challenge$, come back next week!

english: Can't you see the booth is closed?
french: Tu ne vois pas que mon stand est fermé ?
russian: Не видишь, у меня закрыто!
bulgarian: Can't you see the booth is closed?

english: But I don't trust any of these buffoons to keep my cookware intact!

russian: Я обожаю жареную макрель! И знаю, что это любимое блюдо Эррола.
bulgarian: I love grilled Mackerel! And I know it's Errol's favorite.

english: I'm headed out for some beach fishing. Now's about the only time the Mackerel come out.
french: Je vais pêcher depuis la plage. C'est à peu près la seule période à laquelle on peut attraper du maquereau.
russian: Иду ловить на пляж. Сейчас самое время для макрели.
bulgarian: I'm headed out for some beach fishing. Now's about the only time the Mackerel come out.

english: Before I came to Mistria, I had a blacksmith melt all of my weapons down for fishing gear. It felt right.
french: Avant de m'installer à Mistria, j'ai demandé à un forgeron de fondre toutes mes armes pour en faire du matériel de pêche. Ça m'a fait un bien fou.
russian: Прежде чем приехать в Мистрию, я попросила кузнеца переплавить всё моё оружие на рыболовные снасти. Так чувствовала.
bulgarian: Before I came to Mistria, I had a blacksmith melt all of my weapons down for fishing gear. It felt right.

english: Hello, [Ari]! I see we both had the same idea... a morning walk on the Beach to affirm our one true love, the ocean. Oh, is that just me? KYA HA HA!
french: Bonjour, [Ari] ! Je vois qu'on a eu la même idée... Une promenade matinale sur la plage par amour pour l'océan ! Ou c'est juste moi ? Hé hé hé !
russian: Привет, [Ari]! Неужто мы подумали об одном? Утренняя прогулка по пляжу, признания в любви океану... А, то есть, это только у меня так? КЯ-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: Hello, [Ari]! I see we both had the same idea... a morning walk on the Beach to affirm our one true love, the ocean. Oh, is that just me? KYA HA HA!

english: The fish are always biting in the Narrows!
french: Ça mord toujours bien aux Terrasses !
russian: В Ущелье рыба клюёт всегда!
bulgarian: The fish are always biting in the Narrows!

english: Nary a nibble so far, but fishing's about patience, and striking when the time is right.
french: Je n'ai pas eu de touche pour l'instant, mais la pêche est une école de la patience. Le poisson finit toujours par mordre.
russian: Ни поклёвки пока, но рыбалка требует терпения — и умения подгадать момент.
bulgarian: Nary a nibble so far, but fishing's about patience, and striking when the time is right.

english: Night fishing is nice! You should try it some time, [Ari].
french: Pêcher de nuit est très agréable ! Tu devrais essayer, [Ari] !
russian: Ночная рыбалка — самое то! Тоже попробуй как нибудь, [Ari].
bulgarian: Night fishing is nice! You should try it some time, [Ari].

english: Lot of bites today, but no sight of the Big One. I'll catch him one day!
french: J'ai eu beaucoup de prises aujourd'hui, mais j'attends encore le GROS poisson. Elle finira bien par arriver !
russian: Сегодня много поклёвок, но Здоровяка я пока не видела. Когда-нибудь поймаю!
bulgarian: Lot of bites today, but no sight of the Big One. I'll catch him one day!

english: That ocean spray! I'm content. I'm a lucky old soldier, to get a retirement like this.
french: Sentir les embruns ! Je suis heureuse. J'ai de la chance de pouvoir profiter d'une retraite comme ça, après des années passées dans l'armée.
russian: Этот морской бриз! Я довольна. Счастливая старая солдатка заслужила такую пенсию.
bulgarian: That ocean spray! I'm content. I'm a lucky old soldier, to get a retirement like this.

english: So far so good, eh?
french: C'est le cas, non ?
russian: Пока что выходит неплохо, а?
bulgarian: So far so good, eh?

english: When I was a soldier, I promised myself I'd live a quiet life on the Beach.
french: Quand j'étais dans l'armée, je me suis toujours juré qu'un jour, je vivrais paisiblement sur une plage.
russian: Когда я была солдаткой, пообещала себе, что буду жить тихо на пляже.
bulgarian: When I was a soldier, I promised myself I'd live a quiet life on the Beach.

english: And the truth is, the rain brings some of the most elusive river critters out of hiding!
french: Et il se trouve que les créatures aquatiques les plus insaisissables sortent justement les jours pluvieux.
russian: Да и в самом деле, дождь выманивает из укрытий самых редких речных тварей!
bulgarian: And the truth is, the rain brings some of the most elusive river critters out of hiding!

english: A little rain never stopped me from casting my line!
french: Un peu de pluie ne m'a jamais empêchée d'aller pêcher !
russian: Дождь никогда не помеха для моей удочки!
bulgarian: A little rain never stopped me from casting my line!

english: Fishing when it's raining is a whole other thing, you know?
french: Pêcher sous la pluie, c'est une expérience totalement différente, tu ne trouves pas ?
russian: Ловить рыбу под дождём — это совсем другое дело, знаешь?
bulgarian: Fishing when it's raining is a whole other thing, you know?

english: I'm picking up some rations for a little rainy day fishing expedition.
french: Je prépare quelques encas pour une petite partie de pêche sous la pluie.
russian: Закупаюсь пайками для небольшой дождливой рыбалки.
bulgarian: I'm picking up some rations for a little rainy day fishing expedition.

english: Welcome to the shore, [Ari]! Now, what can I do you for?
french: Bienvenue sur le rivage, [Ari] ! Alors, en quoi puis-je t'aider ?
russian: Добро пожаловать на берег, [Ari]! Ну, чем могу быть полезна?
bulgarian: Welcome to the shore, [Ari]! Now, what can I do you for?

english: Welcome to my humble bait and tackle shop, [Ari]! Let me know if anything strikes yer fancy.
french: Bienvenue dans mon humble magasin de pêche, [Ari] ! Si quelque chose t'intéresse, n'hésite pas.
russian: Добро пожаловать в мою скромную лавку приманок и снастей, [Ari]! Скажи, если что-то приглянулось.
bulgarian: Welcome to my humble bait and tackle shop, [Ari]! Let me know if anything strikes yer fancy.

english: I'll be right here! Just let me know when you're all set.
french: Je ne bouge pas d'ici ! Fais-moi signe quand tu auras trouvé ton bonheur.
russian: Я тут буду! Просто дай знать, когда созреешь.
bulgarian: I'll be right here! Just let me know when you're all set.

english: I have a soldier's palate, but I can truthfully say I ain't had cooking like hers anywhere else in this wide world.
french: J'en ai goûté des trucs, quand j'étais dans la marine, mais franchement, sa cuisine surpasse tout ce que j'ai pu manger à travers le monde.
russian: У меня вкус солдатки, но честно скажу: такой кухни я больше нигде в мире не встречала.
bulgarian: I have a soldier's palate, but I can truthfully say I ain't had cooking like hers anywhere else in this wide world.

english: Reina's got a gift!
french: Reina a un vrai don !
russian: У Рейны талант!
bulgarian: Reina's got a gift!

english: They're squiggly and quick, so you gotta stay sharp!
french: C'est un poisson agile et rapide, alors il faut toujours rester sur le qui-vive !
russian: Они шустрые и скользкие, так что держи ухо востро!
bulgarian: They're squiggly and quick, so you gotta stay sharp!

english: Now's the best time to fish up some sand lance!
french: C'est la meilleure période pour pêcher le lançon !
russian: Сейчас лучшее время ловить рыбу-песчанку!
bulgarian: Now's the best time to fish up some sand lance!

english: Perfect weather today eh, [Ari]? Perfect for fishing, anyway!
french: Le temps est idéal aujourd'hui. Pas vrai, [Ari] ? Idéal pour pêcher, en tout cas !
russian: Отличная погода сегодня, а, [Ari]? Для рыбалки — так точно!
bulgarian: Perfect weather today eh, [Ari]? Perfect for fishing, anyway!

english: The whole crew was on alert, but dawn broke quite suddenly, and the ghostly thing simply vanished...
french: Tout l'équipage resta sur le pont, mais l'aube se leva sans crier gare et la silhouette fantomatique s'évanouit sans laisser de trace...
russian: Экипаж поднял тревогу, но вдруг рассвело — и призрачный корабль просто исчез...
bulgarian: The whole crew was on alert, but dawn broke quite suddenly, and the ghostly thing simply vanished...

english: It was the dead of night when a ship appeared off the starboard bow... it had a shimmer to it.
french: Au beau milieu de la nuit, un navire apparut par tribord, au niveau de la proue... Il émettait une sorte de lueur.
russian: Это случилось глухой ночью, когда по правому борту появился корабль... он весь мерцал.
bulgarian: It was the dead of night when a ship appeared off the starboard bow... it had a shimmer to it.

english: Breathe in that sea air, [Ari]! Invigorating, isn't it?
french: Respire donc ce bon air marin, [Ari] ! C'est vivifiant, n'est-ce pas ?
russian: Вдохни этот морской воздух, [Ari]! Бодрит, правда?
bulgarian: Breathe in that sea air, [Ari]! Invigorating, isn't it?

english: It's hard to explain, but the sea seems quietest on a Sunday. Which is to say, pretty noisy anyway! KYA HA HA!
french: Je ne sais pas comment l'expliquer, mais la mer semble toujours plus calme, le dimanche. Elle reste toujours aussi bruyante, hé hé hé !
russian: Трудно объяснить, но по воскресеньям море как будто тише. Всё равно шумит, конечно! КЯ-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: It's hard to explain, but the sea seems quietest on a Sunday. Which is to say, pretty noisy anyway! KYA HA HA!

english: KYA HA HA!
french: HÉ HÉ HÉ !
russian: КЯ-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: KYA HA HA!

english: Morning, [Ari]. See any fish on your way over here?
french: Bien le bonjour, [Ari] ! Tu as vu des gros poissons en venant jusqu'ici ?
russian: Доброе утро, [Ari]. Попалась какая рыба по пути?
bulgarian: Morning, [Ari]. See any fish on your way over here?

english: Getting groceries, [Ari]? Me too. Stay warm now!
french: Alors, on fait ses courses, [Ari] ? Moi aussi. Surtout, couvre-toi bien !
russian: За покупками, [Ari]? Я тоже. Держись в тепле!
bulgarian: Getting groceries, [Ari]? Me too. Stay warm now!

english: Slow day today. The fish must be sleepy.
french: C'est calme aujourd'hui. Les poissons doivent se reposer.
russian: Сегодня тихо. Рыба, должно быть, дремлет.
bulgarian: Slow day today. The fish must be sleepy.

english: It smells like fine weather today. Blessings from the ocean are always welcome.
french: Le temps devrait être clément et la mer calme aujourd'hui. Tout ce qui vient de l'océan est une bénédiction.
russian: Сегодня пахнет хорошей погодой. Благословения океана всегда кстати.
bulgarian: It smells like fine weather today. Blessings from the ocean are always welcome.

english: Now it's a fishing rod. How things change!
french: Maintenant, c'est une canne à pêche. Que de changements !
russian: Теперь — с удочкой. Как же меняются времена!
bulgarian: Now it's a fishing rod. How things change!

english: When I was a soldier, I slept with a spear by my bed.
french: Quand j'étais dans l'armée, j'avais toujours ma lance près de mon lit.
russian: Когда я была солдаткой, я спала с копьём у кровати.
bulgarian: When I was a soldier, I slept with a spear by my bed.

english: Some days I like to come out here and size up the ocean. Just give it a good stare-down.
french: Parfois, j'aime venir ici pour jauger l'océan. Je le fixe du regard pour l'intimider.
russian: Иногда я прихожу сюда просто поглазеть на океан. Так, устроить морю проверку на прочность.
bulgarian: Some days I like to come out here and size up the ocean. Just give it a good stare-down.

english: What's better than fishing on a rainy day? Goin' to the Inn and enjoying the hearth and a hearty stew!
french: Tu sais ce qui est encore mieux que de pêcher un jour de pluie ? Venir à l'auberge pour se régaler d'un bon ragoût roboratif au coin du feu !
russian: В дождливый день хорошо рыбачится... А ещё лучше сидится в трактире у очага с плошкой сытной похлёбки!
