bulgarian: Every day I expect Juniper to limp in here with a twisted ankle from those ridiculous boots of hers.

english: Juniper's out for the morning, which makes it the perfect time for a peaceful visit to the Bathhouse. She always hovers when I'm here...
french: Juniper s'absente le matin, c'est donc le moment idéal pour profiter des bains en toute tranquillité. Elle vient toujours me voir quand j'y suis...
russian: Джунипер по утрам не бывает, так что это лучшее время для спокойного визита в купальню. Она всегда кружит вокруг, когда я там...
bulgarian: Juniper's out for the morning, which makes it the perfect time for a peaceful visit to the Bathhouse. She always hovers when I'm here...

english: You're keeping busy, aren't you? That's good.
french: Tu as toujours quelque chose à faire, hein ? C'est bien.
russian: Дела идут, да? Это хорошо.
bulgarian: You're keeping busy, aren't you? That's good.

english: [Ari], you look well! I hope you're keeping warm.
french: [Ari], tu as l'air en forme ! J'espère que tu penses à bien te couvrir.
russian: [Ari], ты выглядишь здорово! Надеюсь, не мёрзнешь.
bulgarian: [Ari], you look well! I hope you're keeping warm.

english: Landen and my father grew up together, back when the town was more populous. Landen and Errol were always getting into trouble and my father was always patching them up.
french: Landen et mon père ont grandi ensemble. À l'époque, il y avait plus d'habitants. Landen et Errol n'arrêtaient pas de se chamailler et mon père devait toujours les réconcilier.
russian: Ланден и мой отец росли вместе, когда город был более людным. Ланден и Эррол всегда попадали в неприятности, а мой отец их латал.
bulgarian: Landen and my father grew up together, back when the town was more populous. Landen and Errol were always getting into trouble and my father was always patching them up.

english: I like to keep my office clean. Nothing's more unsightly than a dusty skeleton. I'm running a clinic, not a haunted house.
french: J'aime que mon cabinet soit impeccable. Il n'y a rien de plus désagréable qu'un squelette poussiéreux. Je tiens une clinique, pas une maison hantée.
russian: Мне нравится держать кабинет в чистоте. Нет ничего хуже пыльного скелета. У меня ведь клиника, а не дом с привидениями.
bulgarian: I like to keep my office clean. Nothing's more unsightly than a dusty skeleton. I'm running a clinic, not a haunted house.

english: Celine loaned me a very interesting book about medicinal herbs. I wonder if Nora can procure these oils and extracts for me.
french: Céline m'a prêté un livre très intéressant sur les herbes médicinales. Je me demande si Nora pourrait se procurer ces huiles et ces baumes pour moi.
russian: Селин одолжила мне очень интересную книгу о лечебных травах. Интересно, сможет ли Нора достать эти масла и экстракты.
bulgarian: Celine loaned me a very interesting book about medicinal herbs. I wonder if Nora can procure these oils and extracts for me.

english: Good for her! My father would be happy to see it.
french: Elle a vraiment la main verte ! Mon père serait heureux de voir ça.
russian: Молодец! Мой отец был бы рад это видеть.
bulgarian: Good for her! My father would be happy to see it.

english: The roses were here during my father's time, too, but Celine has really brought the manor garden back to its former glory.
french: Ces roses étaient déjà là du temps de mon père, mais Céline a rendu au jardin du manoir sa gloire d'antan.
russian: Эти розы росли ещё во времена моего отца, но Селин действительно вернула сад особняка к прежней красоте.
bulgarian: The roses were here during my father's time, too, but Celine has really brought the manor garden back to its former glory.

english: The manor garden is looking nice, even in the winter. I wonder how Celine does it.
french: Le jardin du manoir est toujours impeccable, même en hiver. Je me demande comment s'y prend Céline.
russian: Сад у особняка такой ухоженный, даже зимой. Интересно, как Селин с ним справляется.
bulgarian: The manor garden is looking nice, even in the winter. I wonder how Celine does it.

english: Unless Juniper is at the till. Then I come back later.
french: Sauf si Juniper est à l'accueil. Dans ce cas, je reviens plus tard.
russian: Если только Джунипер не на кассе. Тогда я прихожу позже.
bulgarian: Unless Juniper is at the till. Then I come back later.

english: This isn't medical advice per se, but I find that a bath in the morning sets a good tone for my day.
french: Ce n'est pas vraiment un conseil médical, mais je trouve qu'un bain matinal me donne de l'entrain pour la journée.
russian: Это не врачебная рекомендация, но я считаю, что утренняя ванна задаёт правильный тон моему дню.
bulgarian: This isn't medical advice per se, but I find that a bath in the morning sets a good tone for my day.

english: There's a particular blend of immunity-boosting tea I like to drink on rainy days... not that rainy days cause colds! I just like the taste.
french: Quand il pleut, j'aime boire un thé particulier qui renforce l'immunité... Ça ne veut pas dire que la pluie provoque des rhumes ! C'est juste qu'il a bon goût.
russian: Есть один особый чай для укрепления иммунитета, который я люблю пить дождливыми днями... не то чтобы дождь вызывал простуду! Просто вкус хороший.
bulgarian: There's a particular blend of immunity-boosting tea I like to drink on rainy days... not that rainy days cause colds! I just like the taste.

english: I prefer less hustle and bustle, to be honest.
french: Désormais, je fuis l'agitation.
russian: Честно говоря, мне нравится, что меньше суеты.
bulgarian: I prefer less hustle and bustle, to be honest.

english: Mornings were so much noisier in the Capital.
french: Dans la capitale, les matinées étaient bien plus bruyantes.
russian: Утро в столице всегда было намного шумнее.
bulgarian: Mornings were so much noisier in the Capital.

english: I do love a nice mulled wine.
french: J'apprécie un bon petit vin chaud.
russian: Обожаю глинтвейн.
bulgarian: I do love a nice mulled wine.

english: Speaking as a doctor, knowledge of the past helps me address problems of the present.
french: En tant que docteure, j'estime que le savoir du passé nous aide à résoudre les problèmes du présent.
russian: Говорю как докторша: знание прошлого помогает лечить проблемы настоящего.
bulgarian: Speaking as a doctor, knowledge of the past helps me address problems of the present.

english: It's good that Eiland and Errol are creating a record of things.
french: Eiland et Errol font du bon travail en répertoriant toutes sortes de choses.
russian: Хорошо, что Эйланд и Эррол составляют записи.
bulgarian: It's good that Eiland and Errol are creating a record of things.

english: It's always nice and quiet here. It's easy to be contemplative, hand-in-hand with nature and the past.
french: J'aime le calme de ce lieu. Ces spécimens trouvés dans la nature et ces objets du passé invitent à la contemplation.
russian: Здесь всегда тихо и спокойно. Легко задуматься, гуляя рука об руку с природой и прошлым.
bulgarian: It's always nice and quiet here. It's easy to be contemplative, hand-in-hand with nature and the past.

english: Impressive.
french: C'est impressionnant.
russian: Впечатляет.
bulgarian: Impressive.

english: The Museum's collection has grown since the last time I was here.
french: La collection du musée s'est étoffée depuis ma dernière visite.
russian: С моего последнего посещения музея коллекция существенно пополнилась.
bulgarian: The Museum's collection has grown since the last time I was here.

english: I suspect I have you to thank for it.
french: Mon petit doigt me dit que tu n'y es pas pour rien.
russian: Думаю, за это мне стоит поблагодарить тебя.
bulgarian: I suspect I have you to thank for it.

english: Oh, hello [Ari]. Are you also doing grocery shopping? The produce is looking especially fresh today.
french: Tiens, bonjour [Ari]. Tu fais quelques courses ? Les produits ont l'air particulièrement frais aujourd'hui.
russian: О, привет, [Ari]. Ты тоже за продуктами? Овощи сегодня особенно свежие.
bulgarian: Oh, hello [Ari]. Are you also doing grocery shopping? The produce is looking especially fresh today.

english: It's uncanny how healthy Olric is. I've seen that man do his workout in the rain and snow and walk away with nary a sniffle. Terrible hayfever, though.
french: Olric mène une vie incroyablement saine. J'ai vu ce garçon s'entraîner sous la pluie et sous la neige, mais il ne prend jamais froid. En revanche, il a des rhumes des foins terribles.
russian: У Ольрика просто жутко крепкое здоровье.. Видела, как он тренировался под дождём и снегом и отделался лёгким насморком. Только сенная лихорадка мучает.
bulgarian: It's uncanny how healthy Olric is. I've seen that man do his workout in the rain and snow and walk away with nary a sniffle. Terrible hayfever, though.

english: I'm still trying to figure antidotes for these last two. You don't suppose Juniper knows, do you? She seems like she would.
french: J'essaie de découvrir un antidote pour ces deux-là. Tu crois que Juniper saurait quelque chose ? Ce serait bien le genre.
russian: Всё ещё ищу противоядие для последних двух. Как думаешь, Джунипер знает? Думаю, это возможно.
bulgarian: I'm still trying to figure antidotes for these last two. You don't suppose Juniper knows, do you? She seems like she would.

english: It's rare that I get the chance to work out of doors, but I got lucky this week. I've been finishing up this survey of poisons.
french: Je sors rarement pour le travail, mais ça m'est arrivé cette semaine. Je termine une étude sur les poisons.
russian: Редко получается работать на улице, но на этой неделе повезло. Заканчиваю исследование ядов.
bulgarian: It's rare that I get the chance to work out of doors, but I got lucky this week. I've been finishing up this survey of poisons.

english: Eiland found a record of an old plague, but after reviewing a few primary sources, I'm inclined to believe that it was just a bad case of food poisoning.
french: Eiland est tombé sur un document décrivant une ancienne épidémie. Après avoir étudié les premiers éléments, je pencherais plutôt pour une grosse intoxication alimentaire.
russian: Эйланд нашёл запись о старой чуме, но после изучения источников я склонна считать, что это было просто пищевое отравление.
bulgarian: Eiland found a record of an old plague, but after reviewing a few primary sources, I'm inclined to believe that it was just a bad case of food poisoning.

english: Adeline lent me a book from the manor. It outlines an outdated method of casting, but this formula for plaster is new to me.
french: Adeline m'a prêté un traité venant de la bibliothèque du manoir. On y décrit une ancienne méthode pour faire un plâtre, mais la composition de ce dernier m'est inconnue.
russian: Аделина одолжила мне книгу из особняка. Там устаревший метод литья, но вот формула для гипса — новая для меня.
bulgarian: Adeline lent me a book from the manor. It outlines an outdated method of casting, but this formula for plaster is new to me.

english: I hope you're getting proper sleep, [Ari]. It's the foundation of a good day.
french: J'espère que tu dors bien, [Ari]. C'est indispensable pour passer une bonne journée.
russian: Надеюсь, ты высыпаешься, [Ari]. Сон — основа хорошего дня.
bulgarian: I hope you're getting proper sleep, [Ari]. It's the foundation of a good day.

english: Be sure to have protein with your breakfast, [Ari]. You have a very active lifestyle.
french: [Ari], n'oublie pas les protéines au petit-déjeuner. Il t'en faut pour la vie que tu mènes.
russian: Обязательно ешь белок за завтраком, [Ari]. У тебя очень активный образ жизни.
bulgarian: Be sure to have protein with your breakfast, [Ari]. You have a very active lifestyle.

english: Hm, did it just get faster?
french: Mmm, c'est moi ou ton rythme cardiaque vient de s'accélérer ?
russian: Хм, почему он только что ускорился?
bulgarian: Hm, did it just get faster?

english: Give me your wrist, [Ari]. You have a strong pulse, that's good.
french: Donne ton poignet, [Ari]... Ton pouls est puissant, c'est bien.
russian: Дай-ка руку, [Ari]. Пульс в норме, это хорошо.
bulgarian: Give me your wrist, [Ari]. You have a strong pulse, that's good.

english: Oh, it's quite strong. Very good.
french: Oh, il est puissant, c'est parfait.
russian: О, он довольно стройный. Очень хорошо.
bulgarian: Oh, it's quite strong. Very good.

english: Come here so I can check your pulse.
french: Approche-toi que je prenne ton pouls.
russian: Подойди-ка, проверю твой пульс.
bulgarian: Come here so I can check your pulse.

english: Rain is nice for the folks in town with allergies. It washes all that pollen away.
french: La pluie est une bénédiction pour les habitants qui souffrent d'allergies. Elle emporte avec elle tout le pollen.
russian: Дождь полезен для тех, у кого аллергия. Он смывает всю пыльцу.
bulgarian: Rain is nice for the folks in town with allergies. It washes all that pollen away.

english: They're some of my favorite things to put in a hot drink on a rainy day.
french: J'adore en mettre dans mes infusions lorsqu'il pleut.
russian: Это мои любимые ингредиенты для горячего напитка в дождливый день.
bulgarian: They're some of my favorite things to put in a hot drink on a rainy day.

english: When the weather is dreary, I like to stock up on ginger and =Honey=.
french: Quand le temps devient maussade, je fais des provisions de gingembre et de =miel=.
russian: Когда погода пасмурная, люблю запасаться имбирём и =мёдом=.
bulgarian: When the weather is dreary, I like to stock up on ginger and =Honey=.

english: I'm reading about the rise of Caldosian medical techniques. It's... interesting.
french: Je suis en train de lire un ouvrage sur l'évolution des techniques médicales caldosiennes. C'est... intéressant.
russian: Читаю о развитии кальдосийских медицинских техник. Это... интересно.
bulgarian: I'm reading about the rise of Caldosian medical techniques. It's... interesting.

english: Hello, [Ari]. Here for a check-up?
french: Bonjour, [Ari]. Tu viens pour une consultation ?
russian: Привет, [Ari]. На осмотр?
bulgarian: Hello, [Ari]. Here for a check-up?

english: I'm teasing!
french: Je te taquine !
russian: Да я шучу!
bulgarian: I'm teasing!

english: Hello, [Ari]. Here for a check-up?
french: Bonjour, [Ari]. Tu viens pour une consultation ?
russian: Привет, [Ari]. Ты на обследование?
bulgarian: Hello, [Ari]. Here for a check-up?

english: Welcome to the Clinic, [Ari]. Now, let's have a look at you.
french: Bienvenue à la clinique, [Ari]. Laisse-moi t'ausculter.
russian: Добро пожаловать в клинику, [Ari]. Ну что ж, осмотрим тебя.
bulgarian: Welcome to the Clinic, [Ari]. Now, let's have a look at you.

english: Let me know if you're feeling unwell, [Ari]. I'm here to help.
french: Si jamais tu ne te sens pas bien, préviens-moi, [Ari]. Je suis là pour ça.
russian: Скажи, если почувствуешь себя плохо, [Ari]. Моя задача помогать с этим.
bulgarian: Let me know if you're feeling unwell, [Ari]. I'm here to help.

english: Oh, did you need syrups for your medicine cabinet? Have a look.
french: Oh, tu as besoin de sirops pour chez toi ? Regarde ce que j'ai.
russian: О, нужны сиропы для домашней аптечки? Посмотри.
bulgarian: Oh, did you need syrups for your medicine cabinet? Have a look.

english: Is your medicine cabinet looking empty? I've got plenty of syrups to stock it with.
french: Ton armoire à pharmacie est vide ? Si c'est le cas, j'ai de nombreux sirops à te proposer.
russian: В аптечке пусто? У меня много сиропов про запас.
bulgarian: Is your medicine cabinet looking empty? I've got plenty of syrups to stock it with.

english: [Ari]! Nice to see you. I was just restocking my cabinet of syrups... there are plenty, should you need them.
french: Je suis contente de te voir, [Ari] ! J'étais en train de refaire mes provisions de sirops... Si jamais tu en as besoin, ça n'est pas ce qui manque.
russian: [Ari]! Рада видеть тебя. Как раз пополняю свой шкафчик с сиропами... бери, если что-то нужно.
bulgarian: [Ari]! Nice to see you. I was just restocking my cabinet of syrups... there are plenty, should you need them.

english: Hello, [Ari]. Let me know if I can assist.
french: Bonjour, [Ari]. Dis-moi si je peux t'aider.
russian: Привет, [Ari]. Дай знать, если нужна помощь.
bulgarian: Hello, [Ari]. Let me know if I can assist.

english: Oh! I didn't see you there. Don't mind me, just reviewing some notes.
french: Oh, pardon ! Je ne t'avais pas vu<she>e</she><he></he><they>·e</they>. Excuse-moi, je relisais quelques notes.
russian: О! Не заметила тебя. Не обращай внимания, просто просматривала заметки.
bulgarian: Oh! I didn't see you there. Don't mind me, just reviewing some notes.

english: The serratus anterior and posterior connect to the shoulder and ribcage...
french: Le muscle dentelé postérieur et supérieur relie les épaules à la cage thoracique...
russian: Передняя и задняя зубчатые мышцы соединяют плечо и рёбра...
bulgarian: The serratus anterior and posterior connect to the shoulder and ribcage...

english: Rest brings longevity, and longevity means we'll be chatting like this for years to come.
french: Le repos permet de vivre longtemps, et une longue vie me permettra de discuter avec toi pendant encore des années.
russian: Отдых продлевает жизнь, чтобы мы еще долго могли вот так просто болтать.
bulgarian: Rest brings longevity, and longevity means we'll be chatting like this for years to come.

english: As far as sleep goes, I always get my hours in.
french: Je m'arrange toujours pour dormir suffisamment.
russian: Если говорить о сне, у меня он всегда полноценный.
bulgarian: As far as sleep goes, I always get my hours in.

english: The Saturday Market takes me back there.
french: Le marché du samedi me rappelle cette époque.
russian: Субботний базар здесь напоминает мне об этом.
bulgarian: The Saturday Market takes me back there.

english: In the Capital, I would find a nook on Main Street and read a book while people did their weekend shopping.
french: Quand j'étais à la capitale, j'arrivais souvent à me trouver un petit coin un peu en retrait de la rue principale. Je m'installais pour lire un livre pendant que tout le monde faisait son shopping.
russian: По выходным в столице я любила сидеть в уголке на Главной улице и читать, пока люди занимались покупками.
bulgarian: In the Capital, I would find a nook on Main Street and read a book while people did their weekend shopping.

english: The Saturday Market is great for the town's health. It gets everyone up and moving!
french: Le marché du samedi est très bon pour la santé des habitants de la ville. Ça force tout le monde à s'activer !
russian: Субботний базар полезен для здоровья города. Заставляет всех встать и размяться!
bulgarian: The Saturday Market is great for the town's health. It gets everyone up and moving!

english: Some of these crops come from your farm, don't they [Ari]? You've had a lovely harvest this year.
french: Certains de ces produits viennent de ta ferme, n'est-ce pas [Ari] ? La récolte a été bonne, cette année.
russian: Некоторые из этих овощей с твоей фермы, правда, [Ari]? У тебя отличный урожай в этом году.
bulgarian: Some of these crops come from your farm, don't they [Ari]? You've had a lovely harvest this year.

english: I like to annotate my mysteries with theories about the culprit's identity. I hope the ending isn't spoiled for her...
french: Mais j'aime bien noter mes idées sur l'identité du coupable, dans mes livres. J'espère que ça ne lui gâchera pas la fin...
russian: Я люблю писать на полях свои теории о том, кто может быть преступником. Надеюсь, это не раскроет ей концовку...
bulgarian: I like to annotate my mysteries with theories about the culprit's identity. I hope the ending isn't spoiled for her...

english: Celine was asking after reading recommendations, so I loaned her one of my favorite mystery novels.
french: Céline m'a demandé des conseils de lecture, alors je lui ai prêté un de mes romans policiers préférés.
russian: Селин приходила ко мне спросить совета что почитать. Я одолжила ей один из своих любимых детективов.
bulgarian: Celine was asking after reading recommendations, so I loaned her one of my favorite mystery novels.

english: I waited a little too long to get groceries this time... unfortunately, syrups don't make a meal.
french: Ce coup-ci, j'ai trop attendu pour faire mes courses... Malheureusement, un sirop pour la toux ne remplace pas un bon repas.
russian: Я долго откладывала поход за продуктами... А из сиропов, увы, обед не сваришь.
bulgarian: I waited a little too long to get groceries this time... unfortunately, syrups don't make a meal.

english: Landen's great-grandfather hand carved him, if you can believe it.
french: Aussi incroyable que ça puisse paraître, c'est l'arrière-grand-père de Landen qui l'a sculpté de ses mains.
russian: Прадед Ландена вырезал его вручную, представляешь?
bulgarian: Landen's great-grandfather hand carved him, if you can believe it.

english: That skeleton has been in the family a long time.
french: Ce squelette est dans ma famille depuis des lustres.
russian: Этот скелет давно в семье.
bulgarian: That skeleton has been in the family a long time.

english: And here I thought it was just me and the skeleton tonight. Evening, [Ari].
french: Tiens, moi qui pensais passer la soirée seule avec mon squelette. Bonsoir, [Ari].
russian: А я думала, что буду сегодня одна с этим скелетом. Добрый вечер, [Ari].
bulgarian: And here I thought it was just me and the skeleton tonight. Evening, [Ari].

english: Slow day today. I can't complain, it means everyone in town is healthy.
french: La journée a été calme. Je ne vais pas me plaindre, cela signifie que tout le monde en ville se porte bien.
russian: Сегодня тихо. Не жалуюсь: значит, все в городе здоровы.
bulgarian: Slow day today. I can't complain, it means everyone in town is healthy.

english: Slow down and have a drink, [Ari]. Mistria's not going anywhere.
french: Prends un moment et viens boire un verre, [Ari]. Mistria ne va pas s'écrouler si tu te poses un instant.
russian: Притормози и выпей, [Ari]. Мистрия никуда не денется.
bulgarian: Slow down and have a drink, [Ari]. Mistria's not going anywhere.

english: Stop by the Clinic if you get the sniffles.
french: Si jamais tu commences à avoir la goutte au nez, passe me voir à la clinique.
russian: Загляни в клинику, если схватит насморк.
bulgarian: Stop by the Clinic if you get the sniffles.

english: Spring is a time of renewal. And allergies.
french: Le printemps est synonyme de renaissance. Et d'allergies.
russian: Весна — время обновления. И аллергии.
bulgarian: Spring is a time of renewal. And allergies.

english: There's usually at least one poor soul who gets caught in the rain, so I like to be prepared at the Clinic.
french: Il y a toujours un ou deux pauvres hères qui se font surprendre par la pluie, donc je me tiens toujours prête à la clinique.
russian: Обычно кто-нибудь да попадёт под дождь, так что я всегда готова в клинике.
bulgarian: There's usually at least one poor soul who gets caught in the rain, so I like to be prepared at the Clinic.

english: Useful, don't you think?
french: Plutôt pratique, n'est-ce pas ?
russian: Удобно, правда?
bulgarian: Useful, don't you think?

english: The Fairy Syrup has a subtle strawberry flavor, which seems popular. And if you should collapse the same day you drink it, you'll be revived.
french: Le sirop des fées a un léger goût de fraise que tout le monde semble apprécier. Et si jamais tu t'évanouis le jour où tu l'as bu, tu reprendras instantanément connaissance.
russian: Сироп Фей имеет лёгкий клубничный вкус. Он довольно популярен. А еще помогает встать на ноги, если ты его выпьешь и свалишься от усталости в течение того же дня.
bulgarian: The Fairy Syrup has a subtle strawberry flavor, which seems popular. And if you should collapse the same day you drink it, you'll be revived.

english: The Heal Syrup restores some of your health. And it tastes like cherry! Some find it a bit cloying, but you wouldn't want to taste it otherwise.
french: Le sirop de soins te permet de récupérer de la santé. Il a un goût de cerise ! Certains trouvent ça un peu écœurant, mais c'est le goût qui fait tout !
russian: Сироп исцеления восстанавливает здоровье. На вкус вишнёвый! Кому-то он кажется приторным, но лучше так, чем невкусный.
bulgarian: The Heal Syrup restores some of your health. And it tastes like cherry! Some find it a bit cloying, but you wouldn't want to taste it otherwise.

english: The Speedy Syrup will increase your personal velocity for two hours. And it tastes like summer oranges!
french: Le sirop de punch te permet d'augmenter ta vitesse de déplacement pendant deux heures. Et il est parfumé aux oranges d'été !
russian: Сироп скорости повысит твою скорость на два часа. И вкус у него, как у летних апельсинов!
bulgarian: The Speedy Syrup will increase your personal velocity for two hours. And it tastes like summer oranges!

english: Have you tried the Stamina syrup? It restores some of your stamina, and the peppermint flavor will put some pep in your step.
french: Tu as déjà goûté au sirop reconstituant ? Il te permet de récupérer un peu d'endurance et son goût mentholé te redonne du tonus.
russian:
Ты

пробовали

пробовалапробовалпробовало сироп выносливости? Он восстанавливает силы, а мятный вкус придаёт бодрости.
bulgarian: Have you tried the Stamina syrup? It restores some of your stamina, and the peppermint flavor will put some pep in your step.

english: Have a look at the Syrups I have in stock. They're all medicinal, and have withstood rigorous testing. My father did the case studies himself.
french: Jette donc un œil à mes sirops. Ce sont des médicaments qui ont été testés dans les règles de l'art. Mon père s'est chargé lui-même des essais cliniques.
russian: Посмотри сиропы, что у меня есть. Все они проверены и испытаны. Мой отец лично вёл исследования.
bulgarian: Have a look at the Syrups I have in stock. They're all medicinal, and have withstood rigorous testing. My father did the case studies himself.

english: I've got quite a few syrups in stock, if you're looking for something in particular.
french: J'ai un certain nombre de sirops en réserve, si jamais tu cherches quelque chose en particulier.
russian: У меня хороший запас сиропов, если ищешь что-то конкретное.
bulgarian: I've got quite a few syrups in stock, if you're looking for something in particular.

english: I have plenty of syrups in stock.
french: Au besoin, j'ai de nombreux sirops en stock.
russian: У меня в наличии много разных сиропов.
bulgarian: I have plenty of syrups in stock.

english: How is your medicine cabinet looking?
french: Ton armoire à pharmacie est bien remplie ?
russian: Как твоя домашняя аптечка?
bulgarian: How is your medicine cabinet looking?

english: And he became especially incensed when I told him my salad would be better for his blood pressure.
french: Il s'est mis en colère quand je lui ai dit que ma salade serait très bonne pour faire baisser sa tension artérielle.
russian: А когда я сказала, что мой салат поможет ему от давления, он просто взбесился.
bulgarian: And he became especially incensed when I told him my salad would be better for his blood pressure.

english: Why does he cook if he finds it so stressful?
french: Pourquoi est-ce qu'il cuisine s'il trouve ça aussi stressant ?
russian: Зачем он тогда готовит, если для него это такой стресс?
bulgarian: Why does he cook if he finds it so stressful?

english: Taliferro seemed quite unhappy with my entry for the $Cooking Challenge$.
french: Taliferro ne semblait pas satisfait de ce que j'avais préparé pour le $défi gastronomique$.
russian: Талиферро, видимо, совершенно не понравилось, что я принесла на $смотр блюд$.
bulgarian: Taliferro seemed quite unhappy with my entry for the $Cooking Challenge$.

english: The last time I ran into Terithia she said she eats =Canned Sardines= for breakfast AND lunch every day. Do you know how much salt that is!?
french: Quand j'ai croisé Terithia, elle m'a dit qu'elle mangeait tous les jours des =sardines en boîte= pour le petit-déjeuner ET pour le déjeuner. Tu te rends compte de la dose de sel ?!
russian: В прошлый раз Теризия сказала, что ест =консервированные сардины= и на завтрак и на обед. Представляешь, сколько там соли?!
bulgarian: The last time I ran into Terithia she said she eats =Canned Sardines= for breakfast AND lunch every day. Do you know how much salt that is!?

english: Good, your tonsils look fine.
french: Tout est en ordre au niveau des amygdales, très bien.
russian: Хорошо, миндалины в порядке.
bulgarian: Good, your tonsils look fine.

english: Open your mouth and stick our your tongue, [Ari].
french: Ouvre la bouche et tire la langue, [Ari].
russian: Открой рот и высунь язык, [Ari].
bulgarian: Open your mouth and stick our your tongue, [Ari].

english: I always look forward to it.
french: J'attends toujours ce jour avec impatience.
russian: Я всегда с нетерпением его жду.
bulgarian: I always look forward to it.

english: The Saturday Market really transforms the town square.
french: Le marché du samedi transforme totalement la place principale.
russian: Субботний базар действительно преображает площадь.
bulgarian: The Saturday Market really transforms the town square.

english: Nothing like a walk to get the blood pumping.
french: Rien de tel qu'une bonne petite marche pour activer la circulation sanguine.
russian: Лёгкая прогулка помогает разогнать кровь.
bulgarian: Nothing like a walk to get the blood pumping.

english: I was thinking of going to Dozy's bathhouse soon.
french: Je songeais à aller faire un petit tour aux bains de Dozy.
russian: Я планирую зайти к Дреме в купальню.
bulgarian: I was thinking of going to Dozy's bathhouse soon.

english: Let's both make the most of it.
french: Qu'elle soit fructueuse pour toi comme pour moi.
russian: Пускай у нас с тобой день пройдёт хорошо.
bulgarian: Let's both make the most of it.

english: It's good to see you enjoying the day, [Ari].
french: Je suis contente de voir que tu profites bien de la journée, [Ari].
russian:
Рада видеть, что ты

вышли

вышлавышелвышло погулять, [Ari].
bulgarian: It's good to see you enjoying the day, [Ari].

english: Oh, they got pinker!
french: Oh, tu as rougi !
russian: Ой, а теперь ещё розовее!
bulgarian: Oh, they got pinker!

english: Nice to see you with a bit of pink in your cheeks.
french: Je vois que tu as bonne mine, ça me fait plaisir.
russian: У тебя такие розовые щёки — приятно смотреть.
bulgarian: Nice to see you with a bit of pink in your cheeks.

english: Working outdoors is good for the spirits, but I better get back to the Clinic.
french: Travailler en extérieur est très bon pour le moral, mais je ferais bien de retourner à la clinique.
russian: Работа на улице полезна для духа, но пора возвращаться в клинику.
bulgarian: Working outdoors is good for the spirits, but I better get back to the Clinic.

english: Taking a walk every day is healthy, especially if you spend most of your time indoors.
french: Faire une promenade tous les jours est très bon pour la santé, surtout quand on passe beaucoup de temps enfermé.
russian: Ежедневные прогулки полезны для здоровья: особенно, если большую часть времени проводишь в помещении.
bulgarian: Taking a walk every day is healthy, especially if you spend most of your time indoors.

english: Hayden and I grew up together. Did you know that I used to be taller than him?
french: Hayden et moi, on a grandi ensemble. Tu savais que je le dépassais en taille autrefois ?
russian: Мы с Хейденом вместе росли. Знаешь, что я раньше была выше его?
bulgarian: Hayden and I grew up together. Did you know that I used to be taller than him?

english: Be sure to visit the Beach, [Ari]. The sea air is good for your lungs. And the sun is a mood booster.
french: N'oublie pas d'aller à la plage de temps en temps, [Ari]. L'air marin est bon pour les poumons, et le soleil fait des merveilles pour le moral.
russian: Не забудь сходить на пляж, [Ari]. Морской воздух полезен для лёгких, а солнце поднимает настроение.
bulgarian: Be sure to visit the Beach, [Ari]. The sea air is good for your lungs. And the sun is a mood booster.

english: Keep out of the rain if you can help it, [Ari]. Just some friendly doctor's advice.
french: Essaie de ne pas trop traîner sous la pluie, si tu peux l'éviter, [Ari]. C'est juste un petit conseil de ton amie docteure.
russian: Старайся не попадать под дождь, [Ari]. Просто дружеский совет врача.
bulgarian: Keep out of the rain if you can help it, [Ari]. Just some friendly doctor's advice.

english: I worry about Adeline. She's so busy keeping an eye on this town, someone needs to keep an eye on her. And by "someone" I mean me, her doctor.
french: Je m'inquiète pour Adeline. Elle veille à ce que tout fonctionne bien en ville, mais il faut que quelqu'un veille sur elle à son tour. Ce quelqu'un, c'est moi, son médecin.
russian: Я беспокоюсь об Аделине. Она так занята заботой о городе, что о ней самой должен заботиться кто-то ещё. И этим «кем-то» буду я, её врач.
bulgarian: I worry about Adeline. She's so busy keeping an eye on this town, someone needs to keep an eye on her. And by "someone" I mean me, her doctor.

english: Not all time has to be spent productively... Leisure is good for you.
french: Il faut apprendre à ne pas toujours se donner à fond... Il faut aussi savoir prendre du temps libre.
russian: Не всё время должно быть продуктивным... Отдых полезен.
bulgarian: Not all time has to be spent productively... Leisure is good for you.

english: Ah, [Ari]. Hope you're not spending your early days here overworking yourself.
french: Ah, [Ari]. J'espère que tu ne te tues pas au travail dès tes premiers jours.
russian: А, [Ari]. Надеюсь, ты не тратишь свои первые дни здесь на чрезмерную работу.
bulgarian: Ah, [Ari]. Hope you're not spending your early days here overworking yourself.

english: We're not unreasonable here.
french: Nous avons un minimum de bon sens, ici.
russian: Мы здесь люди разумные.
bulgarian: We're not unreasonable here.

english: You're new in town... I'd like to give you your first checkup. Don't worry, it's free.
french: Comme tu viens d'arriver en ville, j'aimerais faire un petit bilan de santé. Ne t'en fais pas, c'est gratuit.
russian:
Ты

новенькие

новенькаяновенькийновенькое в городе... Хочу провести тебе первый осмотр. Не волнуйся, он бесплатный.
bulgarian: You're new in town... I'd like to give you your first checkup. Don't worry, it's free.

english: I do like white wine in the spring. It's light and refreshing.
french: Au printemps, je préfère boire du vin blanc. C'est léger et rafraîchissant.
russian: Весной я люблю белое вино. Оно лёгкое и освежающее.
bulgarian: I do like white wine in the spring. It's light and refreshing.

english: A bath is especially nice in the winter. It increases your circulation, and relaxes all those stiff muscles.
french: Un bain en hiver, c'est toujours agréable. Cela améliore la circulation et permet de décontracter les muscles.
russian: Ванна особенно хороша зимой. Улучшает кровообращение и расслабляет зажатые мышцы.
bulgarian: A bath is especially nice in the winter. It increases your circulation, and relaxes all those stiff muscles.

english: I'm always running out of =Honey= in the winter.
french: En hiver, je me retrouve toujours à court de =miel=.
russian: Зимой у меня постоянно заканчивается =мёд=.
bulgarian: I'm always running out of =Honey= in the winter.

english: Good morning. Thought I'd get a bit of fresh air with my work today.
french: Bonjour. J'ai eu envie de travailler dehors, aujourd'hui.
russian: Доброе утро. Решила немного поработать на свежем воздухе.
bulgarian: Good morning. Thought I'd get a bit of fresh air with my work today.

english: I love doing paperwork outside in the fall. Mistria is quite beautiful this time of year.
french: J'aime m'occuper de mes papiers à l'extérieur, en automne. Mistria est si belle à cette période de l'année.
russian: Осенью обожаю делать бумажную работу на улице. Мистрия в это время года очень красива.
bulgarian: I love doing paperwork outside in the fall. Mistria is quite beautiful this time of year.

english: Working late? You'll probably want this. But rest would be better!
french: Tu travailles tard, hein ? Tiens, ça devrait t'être utile. Mais un peu de repos te ferait le plus grand bien !
russian: Работаешь допоздна? Тебе это пригодится. Но отдых был бы лучше!
bulgarian: Working late? You'll probably want this. But rest would be better!

english: How would you feel about joining me at the $Bathhouse$ for a soak?
french: Tu serais d'accord pour passer un moment avec moi aux $bains$ ?
russian: Что ты думаешь насчёт того, чтобы вместе сходить в $купальню$?
bulgarian: How would you feel about joining me at the $Bathhouse$ for a soak?

english: I thought we could both use some time to relax, unwind, and-
french: Je me disais qu'on pourrait en profiter pour nous détendre, décompresser et...
russian: Я решила, что нам будет неплохо расслабиться, отдохнуть и...
bulgarian: I thought we could both use some time to relax, unwind, and-

english: Well, spend some time together!
french: Bref, passer du temps ensemble !
russian: Просто провести время вместе!
bulgarian: Well, spend some time together!

english: Oh, you'd love to?
french: Oh, cela te plairait ?
russian:
О, ты

согласны

согласнасогласенсогласно?
bulgarian: Oh, you'd love to?

english: I'm so glad.
french: Je suis ravie.
russian: Как я рада.
bulgarian: I'm so glad.

english: I'm ready to go when you are!
french: Tu n'as qu'un mot à dire, et nous y allons !
russian: Я готова, как только позовёшь!
bulgarian: I'm ready to go when you are!

english: I was wondering, [Ari]...
french: [Ari], je me demandais si...
russian: Я тут подумала, [Ari]...
bulgarian: I was wondering, [Ari]...

english: Of course, I'd love to come with you!
french: Bien sûr que je veux t'accompagner !
russian: Конечно, я с радостью с тобой схожу!
bulgarian: Of course, I'd love to come with you!

english: You'd like to go visit the $Bathhouse$, [Ari]?
french: Tu as envie d'aller aux $bains$, [Ari] ?
russian: Ты хочешь сходить в $купальню$, [Ari]?
bulgarian: You'd like to go visit the $Bathhouse$, [Ari]?

english: You feel the same way?
french: Tu ressens la même chose ?
russian: Ты тоже?
bulgarian: You feel the same way?

english: Well...
french: Eh bien...
russian: Что ж...
bulgarian: Well...

english: I guess it was just what the doctor ordered.
french: C'est exactement ce que préconisait la docteure.
russian: Выходит, купальня — то что доктор прописал!
bulgarian: I guess it was just what the doctor ordered.

english: Ah... My mind and body feel so refreshed.
french: Ah... Mon corps et mon esprit sont apaisés.
russian: Ах... Я чувствую, что отдохнула и телом и разумом.
bulgarian: Ah... My mind and body feel so refreshed.

english: The positive effects on the body are-
french: Les effets bénéfiques sur le corps sont...
russian: Тело получает оздоровительный эффект и...
bulgarian: The positive effects on the body are-

english: Ah, that is to say, I always feel good afterwards.
french: Ah, je veux dire que je me sens toujours bien, après.
russian: Ах, просто хочу сказать, что мне всегда приятно после купания.
bulgarian: Ah, that is to say, I always feel good afterwards.

english: Thank you for suggesting it!
french: Merci de me l'avoir proposé !
russian:
Спасибо, что

предложили

предложилапредложилпредложило!
bulgarian: Thank you for suggesting it!

english: I love our trips to the $Bathhouse$, [Ari].
french: J'aime beaucoup ces moments ensemble aux $bains$, [Ari].
russian: Мне так нравится ходить с тобой в $купальню$, [Ari].
bulgarian: I love our trips to the $Bathhouse$, [Ari].

english: I thought we could head over to the Beach for a while.
french: Je pensais passer un moment à la plage.
russian: Я подумала, можем пойти прогуляться по пляжу.
bulgarian: I thought we could head over to the Beach for a while.

english: Take in some fresh air!
french: Au grand air !
russian: Подышать морским воздухом!
bulgarian: Take in some fresh air!

english: Would you like to accompany me on a stroll, [Ari]?
french: Ça te dirait de m'accompagner pour une promenade, [Ari] ?
russian: Не хочешь сходить со мной на прогулку, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Would you like to accompany me on a stroll, [Ari]?

english: Sounds perfect, [Ari].
french: C'est une belle idée, [Ari].
russian: Звучит отлично, [Ari].
bulgarian: Sounds perfect, [Ari].

english: Let's go!
french: Allons-y !
russian: Пойдём!
bulgarian: Let's go!

english: A date at the Beach?
french: Un rendez-vous à la plage ?
russian: Свидание на пляже?
bulgarian: A date at the Beach?

russian: Ой, как славно, спасибо!
bulgarian: Oh wonderful, thank you!

english: Oh, I do like a dry =White Wine=. Thank you.
french: Oh, j'aime beaucoup le =vin blanc= sec. Je te remercie.
russian: О, я очень даже не против сухого =белого вина=. Спасибо.
bulgarian: Oh, I do like a dry =White Wine=. Thank you.

english: I generally recommend against stimulants, but the pleasure of =Coffee= is undeniable.
french: En général, je déconseille la consommation de produits stimulants, mais il faut avouer que le =café= procure un plaisir indéniable.
russian: Я обычно не советую стимуляторы, но удовольствие от =кофе= отрицать сложно.
bulgarian: I generally recommend against stimulants, but the pleasure of =Coffee= is undeniable.

english: Darcy's =Coffee= is a regular part of my schedule... hard to start the day without it.
french: Le =café= de Darcy fait partie de ma routine quotidienne... J'ai même du mal à commencer ma journée sans.
russian: =Кофе= Дарси — часть моего утреннего распорядка... день без него трудно начать.
bulgarian: Darcy's =Coffee= is a regular part of my schedule... hard to start the day without it.

english: How do I take my =Coffee=? Black as the night, [Ari]. Is there any other way?
french: Tu veux savoir comment je prends mon =café= ? Noir comme la nuit, [Ari]. Il y a une autre façon de le déguster ?
russian: Какой я пью =кофе=? Чёрный, как ночь, [Ari]. А как же иначе?
bulgarian: How do I take my =Coffee=? Black as the night, [Ari]. Is there any other way?

english: Darcy says Juniper likes her =Latte= a bit sweet. How interesting.
french: Darcy dit qu'elle aime boire son =café latte= légèrement sucré. Voilà qui est très intéressant...
russian: Дарси говорит, Джунипер любит =латте= послаще. Любопытно.
bulgarian: Darcy says Juniper likes her =Latte= a bit sweet. How interesting.

english: You can always rely on Louis for a good pair of slacks.
french: Tu peux acheter les pantalons de Louis les yeux fermés.
russian: На Луи всегда можно положиться, когда нужна хорошая пара брюк.
bulgarian: You can always rely on Louis for a good pair of slacks.

english: Every one of my coats is from Louis... he's managed to sell me one for every season.
french: Toutes mes blouses viennent de chez Louis... Il a réussi à m'en vendre une pour chaque saison.
russian: Все мои пальто — от Луи... он умудрился продать мне по одному на каждый сезон.
bulgarian: Every one of my coats is from Louis... he's managed to sell me one for every season.

english: I'm partial to a button-up, but Louis talked me into a turtleneck a few years ago. I have to admit, I liked it very much.
french: J'ai un faible pour les chemisiers, mais Louis m'a convaincue d'acheter un col roulé, il y a quelques années. Je dois admettre que je l'aime beaucoup.
russian: Я больше по классике: с пуговицами, — но Луи однажды уговорил меня на водолазку. Признаюсь, она мне понравилась.
bulgarian: I'm partial to a button-up, but Louis talked me into a turtleneck a few years ago. I have to admit, I liked it very much.

english: Louis really understands the art of a crisp lapel.
french: Louis sait très bien qu'un joli carré fait toute la différence.
russian: Луи отлично понимает, что значит идеальный отворот.
bulgarian: Louis really understands the art of a crisp lapel.

english: That big desk at the front of my clinic is from Merri's shop... Olric and Hayden were kind enough to carry it home for me.
french: Le grand bureau à l'entrée de ma clinique vient de chez Merri... Olric et Hayden ont eu la gentillesse de le transporter jusque chez moi.
russian: Тот большой стол у входа в мою клинику — из лавки Мэрри... Ольрик и Хейден любезно помогли мне донести его до дома.
bulgarian: That big desk at the front of my clinic is from Merri's shop... Olric and Hayden were kind enough to carry it home for me.

english: I tend to prefer a bit of simplicity and many of Merri's pieces are rather decorative, but I'm very fond of the fancy armchair I purchased from her...
french: Je suis plutôt adepte de ce qui est sobre et les meubles de Merri sont parfois chargés. Néanmoins, j'aime beaucoup le fauteuil que je lui ai acheté...
russian: Я предпочитаю что-то простое, а в лавке Мэрри много вычурных вещей. Но я однажды купила у нее одно изящное кресло...
bulgarian: I tend to prefer a bit of simplicity and many of Merri's pieces are rather decorative, but I'm very fond of the fancy armchair I purchased from her...

english: I fall asleep in it almost as often as my own bed.
french: Je dors dedans à peu près aussi souvent que dans mon propre lit.
russian: Я засыпаю в нём почти так же часто, как в своей кровати.
bulgarian: I fall asleep in it almost as often as my own bed.

english: Did Juniper get her throne of a chair from Merri's shop? Hm... it suits her.
french: Juniper a-t-elle acheté le trône qui lui sert de fauteuil chez Merri ? Dans tous les cas, il est parfait pour elle.
russian: Интересно, Джунипер купила свой «трон» у Мэрри? Хм... ей он подходит.
bulgarian: Did Juniper get her throne of a chair from Merri's shop? Hm... it suits her.

english: Hayden's got plenty of furniture from Merri... he and Olric help her set up her booth on the Saturdays she's at market.
french: La plupart des meubles d'Hayden viennent de chez Merri... Olric et lui l'aident à s'installer le samedi, quand elle vient au marché.
russian: У Хейдена полно мебели от Мэрри... он с Ольриком помогает ей устраивать лавку на базаре по субботам.
bulgarian: Hayden's got plenty of furniture from Merri... he and Olric help her set up her booth on the Saturdays she's at market.

english: I don't believe a word of Stillwell's fortunes, but his presentation is quite amusing.
bulgarian: I don't believe a word of Stillwell's fortunes, but his presentation is quite amusing.

english: When I first met Stillwell I thought he had a bit of a pale complexion, but he seems quite healthy. Is it makeup?
bulgarian: When I first met Stillwell I thought he had a bit of a pale complexion, but he seems quite healthy. Is it makeup?

english: Juniper insisted I get a fortune from Stillwell, but it seems like a waste of tesserae to me.
bulgarian: Juniper insisted I get a fortune from Stillwell, but it seems like a waste of tesserae to me.

english: Juniper bullied me into getting a life fortune... "You will live another day". I suppose it's not technically incorrect...
bulgarian: Juniper bullied me into getting a life fortune... "You will live another day". I suppose it's not technically incorrect...

english: The doctor in me would rather just eat the fruit...
french: La docteure que je suis n'aurait mangé que les fruits...
russian: Врач во мне говорит, что лучше было бы просто съесть фрукт...
bulgarian: The doctor in me would rather just eat the fruit...

english: Nice foam, though.
french: Mais la mousse était bonne.
russian: Но пенка была красивая.
bulgarian: Nice foam, though.

english: I ate at Taliferro's restaurant when I was in the Capital. He served me a dessert with foam infused with some exotic fruit.
french: J'ai mangé dans le restaurant de Taliferro, quand j'étais dans la capitale. Il m'avait servi une mousse aromatisée aux fruits exotiques.
russian: Я была в ресторане у Талиферро, когда жила в столице. Он подал мне десерт с пенкой из какого-то экзотического фрукта.
bulgarian: I ate at Taliferro's restaurant when I was in the Capital. He served me a dessert with foam infused with some exotic fruit.

english: I should refer him to a colleague in the Capital.
french: Je devrais l'envoyer consulter un de mes collègues, à la capitale.
russian: Надо направить его к моему столичному коллеге...
bulgarian: I should refer him to a colleague in the Capital.

english: Have you seen the way Taliferro grinds his teeth? And how the vein on his neck bulges? He seems to be under a great deal of stress.
french: Tu as remarqué la façon dont Taliferro grince des dents ? Et comment les veines de son cou enflent ? Ce garçon doit être soumis à un stress important.
russian:
Ты

видели

виделавиделвидело, как Талиферро сжимает челюсти? И как у него раздуваются вены на шее? Кажется, он очень напряжён.
bulgarian: Have you seen the way Taliferro grinds his teeth? And how the vein on his neck bulges? He seems to be under a great deal of stress.

english: He looks like any amount of stimulant might make him explode.
french: On dirait qu'une infime quantité de n'importe quel produit stimulant pourrait le faire exploser.
russian: По его виду кажется, что от любой дозы кофеина он взорвётся.
bulgarian: He looks like any amount of stimulant might make him explode.

english: Possibly literally.
french: Peut-être même littéralement.
russian: Возможно, даже буквально.
bulgarian: Possibly literally.

english: I don't recommend giving Taliferro any sort of caffeinated beverages...
french: Je déconseille de donner la moindre boisson contenant de la caféine à Taliferro...
russian: Талиферро я бы порекомендовала воздержаться от бодрящих напитков...
bulgarian: I don't recommend giving Taliferro any sort of caffeinated beverages...

english: But Taliferro looks like he could benefit from a visit to the Bathhouse.
french: Mais je pense qu'une petite visite aux bains ferait le plus grand bien à Taliferro.
russian: Талиферро, кажется, не помешало бы сходить в купальню.
bulgarian: But Taliferro looks like he could benefit from a visit to the Bathhouse.

english: That fellow needs to relax.
french: Ce garçon a grand besoin de se détendre.
russian: Ему надо расслабиться.
bulgarian: That fellow needs to relax.

english: I'm loath to give Juniper credit...
french: Ça me fait mal d'aller dans le sens de Juniper...
russian: Мне не в радость поощрять Джунипер, но...
bulgarian: I'm loath to give Juniper credit...

english: Vera's hair dye is all natural and has no adverse effects on your health. In case you were wondering, [Ari].
french: Si jamais tu te posais la question, sache que toutes les teintures de Vera sont naturelles et ne sont pas nocives, [Ari].
russian: Краска для волос Веры полностью натуральна и не вредит здоровью. Если тебе вдруг интересно, [Ari].
bulgarian: Vera's hair dye is all natural and has no adverse effects on your health. In case you were wondering, [Ari].

english: I like my hair short, so I come to Vera as often as I can.
french: Je préfère avoir les cheveux courts, c'est pour cela que je viens voir Vera aussi souvent que possible.
russian: Мне нравится короткая стрижка, так что я стараюсь бывать у Веры как можно чаще.
bulgarian: I like my hair short, so I come to Vera as often as I can.

english: Vera gives me the same cut every time and never badgers me to change it. I appreciate that.
french: Elle me fait à chaque fois la même coupe et n'essaie jamais de me convaincre d'en changer. J'apprécie vraiment.
russian: Вера делает мне одну и ту же стрижку каждый раз и никогда не уговаривает на перемены. Я благодарна ей за это.
bulgarian: Vera gives me the same cut every time and never badgers me to change it. I appreciate that.

english: Vera's doing a lot of cutting and dyeing today... I showed her some stretches to keep her hands nice and open. Why don't you take a minute and do the same?
french: Vera enchaîne les coupes et les colorations, aujourd'hui... Je lui ai enseigné quelques étirements pour soulager ses mains. Tu devrais essayer, toi aussi.
russian: Вера сегодня много стрижёт и красит... я показала ей пару упражнений, чтобы кисти оставались в порядке. Может, и тебе стоит сделать перерыв?
bulgarian: Vera's doing a lot of cutting and dyeing today... I showed her some stretches to keep her hands nice and open. Why don't you take a minute and do the same?

english: I'm certain that man has never received a single certificate in food safety.
french: Je suis convaincue que ce type n'a jamais eu la moindre formation en hygiène alimentaire.
russian: Я уверена, что у этого человека нет никаких сертификатов о продовольственной безопасности.
bulgarian: I'm certain that man has never received a single certificate in food safety.

english: As a doctor, I can't advise consuming anything Wheedle sells at his stall.
french: En tant que médecin, je te déconseille de manger quoi que ce soit acheté sur le stand de Wheedle.
russian: Как врач я не могу рекомендовать никакую продукцию из лавки Хлюста.
bulgarian: As a doctor, I can't advise consuming anything Wheedle sells at his stall.

english: Ah well. There's no accounting for taste.
french: Mais bon... Chacun ses goûts, comme on dit.
russian: Но что ж. О вкусах не спорят.
bulgarian: Ah well. There's no accounting for taste.

english: I can't imagine where Wheedle buys his suits, but it certainly isn't from any tailors I'm acquainted with.
french: J'ignore où Wheedle achète ses costumes, mais ça ne vient d'aucun tailleur que je connais.
russian: Даже не представляю, где Хлюст берёт свои костюмы. Точно не у кого-то, кого я знаю.
bulgarian: I can't imagine where Wheedle buys his suits, but it certainly isn't from any tailors I'm acquainted with.

english: I'm doubtful that anything in his inventory has undergone any clinical trials or stress-testing.
french: Cela me surprendrait qu'un seul de ses produits ait fait l'objet d'essais cliniques.
russian: Сомневаюсь, что его товары проходили хоть какие-то клинические испытания или тесты.
bulgarian: I'm doubtful that anything in his inventory has undergone any clinical trials or stress-testing.

english: If you buy anything from Wheedle's booth, please do so at your own discretion.
french: Si jamais tu achètes quoi que ce soit provenant du stand de Wheedle, ce sera à tes risques et périls.
russian: Если будешь покупать что-то у Хлюста, то только на свой страх и риск.
bulgarian: If you buy anything from Wheedle's booth, please do so at your own discretion.

english: Don't let it get around, but I'd trust Juniper over Wheedle any day of the week.
french: Ne le répète à personne, mais j'ai cent fois plus confiance en elle qu'en Wheedle.
russian: Джунипер я доверяю гораздо больше, чем Хлюсту. Только никому не говори.
bulgarian: Don't let it get around, but I'd trust Juniper over Wheedle any day of the week.

english: Do I think Wheedle's wares are more dangerous than those mystery salves Juniper peddles around town?
french: Pardon ? Si je pense que les produits de Wheedle sont plus nocifs que les remèdes de bonne femme de Juniper ?
russian: Опаснее ли товары Хлюста чудодейственных мазей, которые продаёт жителям Джунипер?
bulgarian: Do I think Wheedle's wares are more dangerous than those mystery salves Juniper peddles around town?

english: So I asked Zorel if she had any $Song Crystal$ that helped with concentration.
french: J'ai donc demandé à Zorel si elle avait un $cristal musical$ qui m'aiderait à me concentrer.
russian: Так что я спросила Зорель, нет ли у неё $поющих кристаллов$, которые помогают сконцентрироваться.
bulgarian: So I asked Zorel if she had any $Song Crystal$ that helped with concentration.

english: She didn't, but she was excited to try and come up with something!
french: Malheureusement non ! En revanche, elle semblait désireuse de composer quelque chose !
russian: Она не нашла, но загорелась идеей сочинить что-нибудь подходящее!
bulgarian: She didn't, but she was excited to try and come up with something!

english: I usually find music too distracting when I work.
french: La musique a tendance à trop me distraire, pendant que je travaille.
russian: Обычно музыка отвлекает меня от работы.
bulgarian: I usually find music too distracting when I work.

english: It seems a bit impractical, though.
french: Il n'a pas l'air très pratique, mais je suis sûre que quelqu'un que je connais saurait en faire bon usage.
russian: Не слишком практично, но я легко представляю себе одну личность, которая нашла бы ему применение.
bulgarian: It seems a bit impractical, though.

english: I spent my day off at the Museum, and got a bit fixated on the $Diamond-backed Mirror$.
french: J'ai passé mon jour de repos au musée, et ce $miroir diamantin$ m'a envoûtée.
russian: В выходной я заглянула в музей и почему-то зациклилась на $зеркале с алмазным покрытием$.
bulgarian: I spent my day off at the Museum, and got a bit fixated on the $Diamond-backed Mirror$.

english: I saw that $Emerald-Horned Charger$ at the Museum. That prominent, glittering horn of precious stone... what a curious adaptation.
french: J'ai pu admirer le $poisson à cornes émeraude$ au musée. Sa corne en pierre précieuse est impressionnante... Bizarre comme évolution.
russian: Я увидела $прыткого изумрудного рогача$ в музее. Этот сверкающий рог из драгоценного камня... любопытная адаптация.
bulgarian: I saw that $Emerald-Horned Charger$ at the Museum. That prominent, glittering horn of precious stone... what a curious adaptation.

english: It would be very interesting to study the physiology of such an unusual creature.
french: Étudier la physiologie d'une créature aussi inhabituelle serait très intéressant.
russian: Занимательно было бы исследовать физиологию столь необычного создания.
bulgarian: It would be very interesting to study the physiology of such an unusual creature.

english: I saw that $Firesail Fish$ at the Museum.
french: J'ai vu cette $caudale de feu$ au musée.
russian: Я видела в музее $огненный парусник$.
bulgarian: I saw that $Firesail Fish$ at the Museum.

english: The natural world challenges your assumptions at every turn. It truly is incredible.
french: Le monde naturel met à mal nos présupposés à chaque instant. C'est vraiment incroyable.
russian: Невероятно. Природа постоянно бросает вызов нашим представлениям.
bulgarian: The natural world challenges your assumptions at every turn. It truly is incredible.

english: That fish at the Museum, the $Gazer$... it's able to make complete sense of its environment without eyes.
french: Ce poisson, au musée, le $poisson albinos$... Il est capable de comprendre parfaitement son environnement, sans avoir d'yeux.
russian: Этот $глазун$ в музее... способен без глаз ориентироваться в пространстве.
bulgarian: That fish at the Museum, the $Gazer$... it's able to make complete sense of its environment without eyes.

english: A $Giant Fish Scale$. Very impressive! Makes you want to see the fish it came from.
french: Une $écaille de poisson géante$. C'était très impressionnant ! J'aimerais bien voir le poisson dont elle provient.
russian: $Гигантская рыбья чешуя$. Впечатляет. Захотелось взглянуть на саму рыбу.
bulgarian: A $Giant Fish Scale$. Very impressive! Makes you want to see the fish it came from.

english: I spent my day off at the Museum, and wouldn't you know it, there was a new exhibit.
french: Je suis allée au musée pendant mon jour de repos. Tu sais quoi ? Ils avaient une nouveauté en exposition.
russian: В выходной я снова была в музее, и, конечно, там уже был новый экспонат.
bulgarian: I spent my day off at the Museum, and wouldn't you know it, there was a new exhibit.

english: I can tell it's going to be a wonderful day.
french: Je peux d'ores et déjà dire que la journée s'annonce magnifique.
russian: Теперь точно знаю, что день сегодня будет хороший.
bulgarian: I can tell it's going to be a wonderful day.

english: Good morning, [Ari].
french: Bonjour, [Ari].
russian: Доброе утро, [Ari].
bulgarian: Good morning, [Ari].

english: If you like, I'd be happy to show you some.
french: Si tu veux, je serais ravie de te montrer des exercices.
russian: Я могу показать тебе пару упражнений, если хочешь.
bulgarian: If you like, I'd be happy to show you some.

english: Don't forget to do some light stretches after you wake up.
french: Pense à faire quelques étirements avant de lever.
russian: Не забывай делать зарядку, когда встаёшь утром.
bulgarian: Don't forget to do some light stretches after you wake up.

english: Anything fun planned today, [Ari]?
french: Tu as des trucs sympas prévus aujourd'hui, [Ari] ?
russian: Какие планы на сегодня, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Anything fun planned today, [Ari]?

english: Life isn't a race, take your time.
french: La vie n'est pas une course, il faut savoir prendre son temps.
russian: Спешка в жизни ни к чему.
bulgarian: Life isn't a race, take your time.

english: If you're feeling sleepy, there's nothing wrong with taking a midday nap.
french: Si tu as sommeil, il n'y a rien de mal à faire une petite sieste en milieu de journée.
russian: Не страшно чуть-чуть поспать днём, если клонит в сон.
bulgarian: If you're feeling sleepy, there's nothing wrong with taking a midday nap.

english: You know, there's a lot of research done that says spending time with friends is good for your health.
french: Tu sais, de nombreuses recherches indiquent que passer du temps avec ses amis est bon pour la santé.
russian: Ты знаешь, что много исследований подтверждают: совместный досуг с друзьями полезен для здоровья?
bulgarian: You know, there's a lot of research done that says spending time with friends is good for your health.

english: Keep it up!
french: Continue comme ça !
russian: Так держать!
bulgarian: Keep it up!

english: You're looking particularly energetic today, [Ari].
french: Tu as l'air particulièrement dynamique aujourd'hui, [Ari].
russian: Сегодня ты выглядишь особенно энергично, [Ari].
bulgarian: You're looking particularly energetic today, [Ari].

english: I'd love to hear all about it.
french: J'aimerais beaucoup que tu me la racontes.
russian: Мне интересно послушать.
bulgarian: I'd love to hear all about it.

english: Oh [Ari], good evening. How was your day?
french: [Ari], bonsoir. Comment s'est passée ta journée ?
russian: О, [Ari], добрый вечер. Как прошёл твой день?
bulgarian: Oh [Ari], good evening. How was your day?

english: I'd love to swap book recommendations with you, sometime.
french: Si c'est le cas, nous devrions échanger des conseils de lecture, à l'occasion.
russian: Можем как-нибудь собраться и порекомендовать друг другу книг, я буду рада.
bulgarian: I'd love to swap book recommendations with you, sometime.

english: Are you much of a reader, [Ari]?
french: Est-ce que tu aimes lire, [Ari] ?
russian: Ты много читаешь, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Are you much of a reader, [Ari]?

english: I'm glad I got to spend some of it with you.
french: Je suis heureuse de l'avoir passée en partie avec toi.
russian: Я рада, что часть его провела с тобой.
bulgarian: I'm glad I got to spend some of it with you.

english: Another pleasant day has passed.
french: Encore une belle journée qui s'achève.
russian: Вот и прошёл ещё один приятный день.
bulgarian: Another pleasant day has passed.

english: I can tell it's going to be a wonderful day.
french: Je peux d'ores et déjà dire que la journée s'annonce magnifique.
russian: Теперь точно знаю, что день сегодня будет хороший.
bulgarian: I can tell it's going to be a wonderful day.

english: Good morning, [Ari].
french: Bonjour, [Ari].
russian: Доброе утро, [Ari].
bulgarian: Good morning, [Ari].

bulgarian: What if I can't connect with our child? Or worse... what if they find me boring?

english: Don't worry, I know you'll do great!
french: Ne t'en fais pas, je sais que tu t'en sortiras très bien !
russian: Не волнуйся, я знаю, у тебя всё получится!

english: We'll figure it out together!

праваправправо.

russian: Ты не против, если я буду учиться у тебя? Я исключительно быстро учусь. Мне недостаёт опыта, но я освоюсь по ходу.
bulgarian: I hope you don't mind if I follow your lead? I'm an excellent study. Even if I'm inexperienced, I'll learn as I go.

english: I suppose that's what they mean when they say, "fake it until you make it."

russian: Видимо, как раз в таких случаях говорят: «притворяйся, пока это не станет правдой».
bulgarian: I suppose that's what they mean when they say, "fake it until you make it."

french: J'espère que ça ne te dérangera pas que je prenne exemple sur toi. Je suis très observatrice. Même si je n'ai aucune expérience, j'apprends sur le tas.
russian: В таком случае, я надеюсь, ты не против, если я буду учиться у тебя. Я исключительно быстро учусь. Мне недостаёт опыта, но я освоюсь по ходу.

english: [Ari]... you should know, I don't have a great deal of experience with children.

english: I suppose he's bottle-reared his share of calves and lambs. He probably has more experience with babies than the whole town combined.

english: Hayden has been showering me with all sorts of advice in anticipation of our baby's arrival...
french: Hayden m'a prodigué de nombreux conseils en vue de l'arrivée de notre bébé...

bulgarian: Still, I hope they take after you, [Ari].

english: It's often asked who the baby takes after more, but I think that's very fluid...
french: Les gens ont tendance à se demander auquel des deux parents un bébé ressemble le plus. Je crois que cela varie énormément...
russian: Многие задаются вопросом, в кого растёт малыш, но мне кажется, тут всё очень изменчиво...
bulgarian: It's often asked who the baby takes after more, but I think that's very fluid...

english: I know it's a bit sentimental, but... if we had a boy, would you be open to calling him "$Torin$"? It was my father's name.

bulgarian: I know it's a bit sentimental, but... if we had a boy, would you be open to calling him "$Torin$"? It was my father's name.

english: Of course, this isn't a demand... it's a decision for both of us to make together.
french: Bien évidemment, je ne t'oblige à rien... c'est une décision que nous devons prendre ensemble.
russian: Разумеется, я ничего не требую... Мы должны посоветоваться и вместе принять решение.
bulgarian: Of course, this isn't a demand... it's a decision for both of us to make together.

english: And there's no need for us to decide now.
french: Et nous n'avons pas à nous précipiter.
russian: И пока что решать ещё рано.
bulgarian: And there's no need for us to decide now.

english: [Ari]... I've been considering baby names.
french: [Ari], j'ai réfléchi à des prénoms pour le bébé.
russian: [Ari]... Я раздумывала над именем для малыша.
bulgarian: [Ari]... I've been considering baby names.

english: Everything is prepared... it's just a matter of time, now.
french: Tout est prêt... ce n'est plus qu'une question de temps, désormais.
russian: Я всё подготовила... Теперь остаётся только ждать.
bulgarian: Everything is prepared... it's just a matter of time, now.

english: I suspect the baby will be joining us soon, [Ari].
french: J'ai l'impression que le bébé sera bientôt parmi nous, [Ari].
russian: Подозреваю, что малыш скоро придёт к нам, [Ari].
bulgarian: I suspect the baby will be joining us soon, [Ari].

english: What an illuminating experiment... I mean, experience. Thank you for your help, [Ari].
french: Quelle expérience scientifique enrichissante ! Je veux dire, expérience personnelle. Merci pour ton aide, [Ari].
russian: Какой занимательный опыт я провела... Точнее, получила. Спасибо за помощь, [Ari].
bulgarian: What an illuminating experiment... I mean, experience. Thank you for your help, [Ari].

english: Perfect! This is exactly what I've been craving all day.
french: Parfait, c'est exactement ce dont j'avais envie pendant toute la journée !
russian: Прекрасно! Именно этого мне так хотелось весь день.
bulgarian: Perfect! This is exactly what I've been craving all day.

english: If you're planning on venturing into the Mines, I'd like to be mentally prepared.
french: Si tu comptes t'aventurer dans les mines, j'ai besoin de le savoir pour me préparer mentalement.
russian: Я хочу психологически подготовиться на случай, если ты собираешься в шахты.
bulgarian: If you're planning on venturing into the Mines, I'd like to be mentally prepared.

english: I'm going to take care of the farm for a bit.
french: Je vais m'occuper un peu de la ferme.
russian: Я планирую немного позаботиться о ферме.
bulgarian: I'm going to take care of the farm for a bit.

english: I was thinking of doing some foraging!
french: Je pensais aller faire de la cueillette !
russian: Я собираюсь отправиться за травами!

english: Yeah, I might go down into the Mines...

bulgarian: Yeah, I might go down into the Mines...

russian: Ну конечно. Это естественно, ведь ты живёшь с её плодов.

bulgarian: Do say hello to the animals for me.

english: The plants as well, if you're feeling whimsical.

russian: Замечательно. У тебя всегда получается находить на задворках нашей земли необычные растения.
bulgarian: Wonderful. You're ever adept at finding unusual plants on the outskirts of town.

english: If you do find anything interesting... well, you know what I like.

russian: Нам нужно что-нибудь купить? Я могу зайти в универмаг по дороге из клиники.

bulgarian: Remind me... was there something we planned on cooking tonight?

english: But if it frees up your day, I'm happy to take over the task.
french: Mais si cela peut te faire gagner du temps sur ta journée, je serais ravie de m'en occuper.
russian: Но если это освободит тебе время, я готова ей заняться.
bulgarian: But if it frees up your day, I'm happy to take over the task.

english: I'm ashamed to say I've never been particularly adept at laundry...
french: J'ai un peu honte d'avouer que la lessive n'a jamais été mon point fort...

russian: Пускай [pet_name] тебя не обманывает: корм я уже дала.

bulgarian: I admire the self-assurance of a creature who doesn't pay rent.

russian: В последнее время наш дом приобрёл приятно обжитой вид. И я рада, что у меня здесь есть рабочее место на случай, если я захочу погрузиться в работу.

russian: Так почему же меня до сих пор преследуют сны о том, как я опаздываю или забываю подготовиться к экзамену?
bulgarian: So why do I still have dreams about arriving late to class and forgetting to study for a test?

english: It's embarrassing, really.

english: I haven't been a student in years...
