french: C'est chaud, sucré et fruité, avec une petite pointe de... whisky, c'est ça ?
russian: Горячий, сладкий, фруктовый, с небольшой остротой... Подозреваю, там виски?
bulgarian: Hot, sweet and fruity, with a little bite... that's whiskey, I surmise?

english: It's like hot tea with a little something extra! More of that extra for me, please.
french: On dirait du thé chaud avec un petit truc en plus ! J'en veux bien encore un peu.
russian: Это как горячий чай с особыми добавками! Мне, пожалуйста, ещё этих добавок.
bulgarian: It's like hot tea with a little something extra! More of that extra for me, please.

english: I want to wrap myself up in this drink like a blanket, it's so cozy! What is it?
french: C'est tellement agréable à boire qu'on a l'impression de se blottir sous une couette ! C'est quoi ?
russian: Я хочу завернуться в этот напиток, как в тёплый плед: такой он уютный! Что это?
bulgarian: I want to wrap myself up in this drink like a blanket, it's so cozy! What is it?

english: Hot toddy. Hot water, lemon, honey, and a splash of whatever you like. Thought something simple after a complicated week was just the thing.
french: Un grog. Eau chaude, citron, miel et une lichette de ce que vous voulez. Je me suis dit que quelque chose de simple vous ferait du bien après une semaine éreintante.
russian: Горячий тодди. Горячая вода, лимон, мёд и немного чего душа пожелает. Я решил, что после трудной недели стоит попробовать что-нибудь простенькое.
bulgarian: Hot toddy. Hot water, lemon, honey, and a splash of whatever you like. Thought something simple after a complicated week was just the thing.

english: Maybe you're right. And you know, I think it's very important I quality control this drink.
french: Finalement, je crois que j'ai changé d'avis. C'est important que je contrôle la qualité de cette boisson aussi.
russian: Наверное, ты прав. И, знаешь, я думаю, мне надо провести контроль качества этого напитка.
bulgarian: Maybe you're right. And you know, I think it's very important I quality control this drink.

english: That'd be mighty helpful of you.
french: Je t'en serais très reconnaissant.
russian: Буду весьма благодарен.
bulgarian: That'd be mighty helpful of you.

english: Ohhh, I know that look, Adeline, you're thinking of going back to work! Keep your behind parked in that chair!
french: Oh, je connais ce regard, Adeline... Tu as envie de retourner travailler ! N'essaie même pas de te lever de cette chaise !
russian: О-о, узнаю это выражение лица, Аделина. Ты собираешься уйти работать! Может, не будешь пока слезать со стула?
bulgarian: Ohhh, I know that look, Adeline, you're thinking of going back to work! Keep your behind parked in that chair!

english: I'm overrun with mint this year! Hayden called it a bumper crop. I brought more, take it!
french: Cette année, j'ai de la menthe à ne plus savoir qu'en faire ! Hayden a dit que c'était une récolte exceptionnelle. Je t'en ai apporté plus, d'ailleurs !
russian: У меня в этом году просто заросли мяты! Хейден говорит, что это небывалый урожай. Я ещё принесла, возьмите.
bulgarian: I'm overrun with mint this year! Hayden called it a bumper crop. I brought more, take it!

english: Nice, I can pretty up drinks with the fresh stuff. And... there we are, mint gimlets all around. Give them a go!
french: Parfait, je pourrai décorer les verres avec les feuilles fraîches. Et... voilà des Gimlets menthe pour tout le monde. Allez-y, goûtez !
russian: Отлично, можно украсить напитки свежими веточками. Вот так... Всем мятный «буравчик». Попробуйте!
bulgarian: Nice, I can pretty up drinks with the fresh stuff. And... there we are, mint gimlets all around. Give them a go!

english: Oh! It's so cute! And green! And it tastes so minty! And herby!
french: Oh, comme c'est joli ! Et vert ! On sent bien la menthe et les herbes !
russian: Ой! Он такой милый! Зелёный! И такой мятный вкус! Очень травянистый!
bulgarian: Oh! It's so cute! And green! And it tastes so minty! And herby!

english: And fresh! And limey!
french: C'est frais ! Et citronné !
russian: И такая свежесть от лайма!
bulgarian: And fresh! And limey!

english: Hemlock used to mix me one of these after a long, hot day in the Mines. Oh, happy days... no matter the time of year, this is the taste of summer!
french: Hemlock me préparait ça après une longue journée dans la chaleur de la mine. C'était le bon vieux temps... Ça a un petit quelque chose d'estival, quelle que soit la saison !
russian: Хемлок раньше мне его делал после долгого жаркого дня в шахтах. Эх, славные были деньки... в любое время года он даёт вкус лета!
bulgarian: Hemlock used to mix me one of these after a long, hot day in the Mines. Oh, happy days... no matter the time of year, this is the taste of summer!

english: It's so refreshing! This drink and I were mint to be together.
french: C'est tellement rafraîchissant ! C'est le genre de boisson qui « t'aimenthe » les papilles.
russian: И так освежает! Самый аромятный напиток в моей жизни.
bulgarian: It's so refreshing! This drink and I were mint to be together.

english: Thanks to Celine, I've got it bottled up behind the counter now, so come back for the taste of summer any time. You too, [Ari]!
french: Grâce à Céline, j'en ai préparé quelques bouteilles, alors revenez quand vous voulez pour goûter à l'été. Toi aussi, [Ari] !
russian: Благодаря Селин у меня за стойкой ещё много бутылок, так что возвращайтесь за вкусом лета, когда захотите. И ты тоже, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Thanks to Celine, I've got it bottled up behind the counter now, so come back for the taste of summer any time. You too, [Ari]!

english: Thanks for bringing all that mint by earlier this week, Celine. Reina cooked it down and got a nice syrup out of it, so we've got something special today.
french: Merci de m'avoir apporté toute cette menthe cette semaine, Céline. Reina en a fait du sirop, alors je vous ai préparé une surprise pour aujourd'hui.
russian: Спасибо, что принесла столько мяты на неделе, Селин. Рейна сварила из неё отличный сироп, так что сегодня у нас кое-что необычное.
bulgarian: Thanks for bringing all that mint by earlier this week, Celine. Reina cooked it down and got a nice syrup out of it, so we've got something special today.

english: I know you're a coffee fan, so I've been experimenting since last time I saw Darcy at the Market. Took weeks to get the flavor right!
french: Je sais que tu adores le café, alors j'ai fait quelques essais après le dernier passage de Darcy au marché. Il m'a fallu des semaines pour obtenir ce goût !
russian: Я знаю, что ты фанат кофе, так что я встретился с Дарси на базаре и начал экспериментировать. Несколько недель ушло, чтобы сбалансировать вкус!
bulgarian: I know you're a coffee fan, so I've been experimenting since last time I saw Darcy at the Market. Took weeks to get the flavor right!

english: Not even a pun? Now that's a first.
french: Même pas un petit jeu de mots ? C'est bien la première fois.
russian: Даже без каламбура? Вот это редкость.
bulgarian: Not even a pun? Now that's a first.

english: Now, we've got two to one of our base liquor and the coffee liqueur, over ice. That's a nice molasses color, isn't it?
french: Alors, deux doses de liqueur de base pour une de café sur de la glace. Ça a une jolie couleur brune, non ?
russian: Теперь у нас базовый ликёр с кофейным ликёром два к одному, плюс лёд. Приятный оттенок патоки, да?
bulgarian: Now, we've got two to one of our base liquor and the coffee liqueur, over ice. That's a nice molasses color, isn't it?

english: It looks a bit... bitter. Unless...
french: Ça a l'air un peu... amer. À moins que...
russian: Слегка... горько. А может...
bulgarian: It looks a bit... bitter. Unless...

english: You know it. Reina whipped up some sweet heavy cream for us. Now, a big, generous ladle on top...
french: Tu as tout compris. Reina nous a préparé une petite chantilly maison. J'en ajoute une bonne couche sur le dessus...
russian: Конечно. Специально для нас Рейна приготовила густые взбитые сливки. Ложку побольше тебе в стакан, вот так...
bulgarian: You know it. Reina whipped up some sweet heavy cream for us. Now, a big, generous ladle on top...

english: Oh my gosh. It looks scrumptious!
french: Oh là là, mais c'est délicieux !
russian: Боже мой, выглядит восхитительно!
bulgarian: Oh my gosh. It looks scrumptious!

english: You're an artist, Hemlock. Cheers!
french: C'est du grand art, Hemlock. Santé !
russian: Ты просто художник, Хемлок. Твоё здоровье!
bulgarian: You're an artist, Hemlock. Cheers!

english: Look at the cream blend with the coffee! It looks like a heavy mist over the mountains...
french: Regardez la crème fondre dans le café ! Ça fait comme une brume ouatée qui tombe sur la montagne...
russian: Смотрите, как сливки ложатся на кофе! Как будто густой туман в горах...
bulgarian: Look at the cream blend with the coffee! It looks like a heavy mist over the mountains...

english: Now that's a pretty name. We'll call it a Heavy Mist! So, what do you think Holt?
french: C'est joli, ça. On va l'appeler Brume ouatée ! Et toi, tu trouves ça comment, Holt ?
russian: Вот и красивое название. Пускай будет «Плотный туман»! Ну, что думаешь, Хольт?
bulgarian: Now that's a pretty name. We'll call it a Heavy Mist! So, what do you think Holt?

english: Can't! Talk! Too... busy... drinking!
french: Peux ! Pas ! Parler ! Je... savoure !
russian: Не! Могу! Говорить! Занят... Пью!
bulgarian: Can't! Talk! Too... busy... drinking!

english: You absolute madman. You did it. Coffee liqueur!
french: Incroyable... Tu as réussi à préparer de la liqueur de café !
russian: Ну ты и безумец. Ты правда его сделал. Кофейный ликёр.
bulgarian: You absolute madman. You did it. Coffee liqueur!

english: This is something we used to make after a long day in the Mines. It went by many names! Rock Juice, the Mineshaft, Blood from the Stone, the Sinkhole...
french: C'est la boisson qu'on préparait après notre journée à la mine. Ce cocktail a plein de noms : Houille houille houille, Bonne pioche, Pella Colada, Haut-fourneau...
russian: Этот напиток мы делали после долгого дня в шахтах. У него много названий! «Каменный сок», «Скважина», «Кровь из камня», «Воронка»...
bulgarian: This is something we used to make after a long day in the Mines. It went by many names! Rock Juice, the Mineshaft, Blood from the Stone, the Sinkhole...

english: Oh, you're all giving up in favor a normal drink? That's how we did it in the old days, too.
french: Quoi ?! Vous préférez une boisson ordinaire plutôt que mon cocktail ? C'est ce qu'on faisait à l'époque aussi.
russian: О, вы отказываетесь в пользу обычного напитка? Мы так тоже делали в былые дни.
bulgarian: Oh, you're all giving up in favor a normal drink? That's how we did it in the old days, too.

english: What about you, [Ari]? You can have a beer, but someone's got to, ah, handle this Bucket Brew.
french: Et toi, [Ari] ? Tu peux prendre une bière, mais quelqu'un doit, euh... goûter mon Coup de grisou.
russian: Что насчёт тебя, [Ari]? Можешь взять пиво, но кому-то придётся, эмм, выдержать это «Шахтёрское пойло».
bulgarian: What about you, [Ari]? You can have a beer, but someone's got to, ah, handle this Bucket Brew.

english: Bucket Brew me!
french: OK, envoie !
russian: «Шахтёрского пойла» мне!
bulgarian: Bucket Brew me!

english: I'll stick with beer.
french: Je reste à la bière.
russian: Мне лучше пиво.
bulgarian: I'll stick with beer.

english: Hoho, you're an adventurous one! That's the spirit!
french: Ho ho, quel esprit aventureux ! J'adore !
russian: Хо-хо, вот она, страсть к приключениями! Авантюрный дух!
bulgarian: Hoho, you're an adventurous one! That's the spirit!

english: You've wisdom beyond your years, [Ari].
french: Visiblement, la sagesse n'attend pas le nombre des années, [Ari].
russian:
Ты

мудры

мудрамудрмудро не по годам, [Ari].
bulgarian: You've wisdom beyond your years, [Ari].

english: Helmet Hash, Miner's Mash, Bucket Brew...
french: Coup de grisou, Mine fizz, Hysterril...
russian: «Горняцкое месиво», «Шахтёрское пойло», «Колодезная брага»...
bulgarian: Helmet Hash, Miner's Mash, Bucket Brew...

english: So what was the recipe?
french: C'était quoi, la recette ?
russian: Так каков рецепт?
bulgarian: So what was the recipe?

english: Well, it wasn't a recipe so much as we all poured whatever dregs we had into a canteen and gave it a good shake!
french: Oh, rien de très élaboré. On mettait tout ce qui nous tombait sous la main dans un bidon et on secouait bien !
russian: Да нет особенного рецепта, мы просто сливали всё, что оставалось, в одну флягу и трясли как следует!
bulgarian: Well, it wasn't a recipe so much as we all poured whatever dregs we had into a canteen and gave it a good shake!

english: Errol, as the one responsible for the wellbeing of this town, I have to ask. What was safer, the Mines or this drink?
french: Errol, en tant que responsable de cette ville, je dois vous demander... Qu'est-ce qui était le moins dangereux : la mine ou ce mélange ?
russian: Эррол, как ответственная за благосостояние города, я обязана спросить. Что было опаснее: шахты или это пойло?
bulgarian: Errol, as the one responsible for the wellbeing of this town, I have to ask. What was safer, the Mines or this drink?

english: Hah! You're quite a card, Lady Adeline.
french: Ha ! Vous êtes perspicace, dame Adeline.
russian: Ха! У вас язык остёр, леди Аделина.
bulgarian: Hah! You're quite a card, Lady Adeline.

english: He didn't answer the question, did he?
french: Il n'a pas répondu à la question, si ?
russian: Разве он ответил на вопрос?
bulgarian: He didn't answer the question, did he?

english: He sure didn't...
french: Oh, non...
russian: Не ответил...
bulgarian: He sure didn't...

english: How about a round of beers instead?
french: Et si on buvait plutôt de la bière ce soir ?
russian: Может, лучше всем по пиву?
bulgarian: How about a round of beers instead?

english: Hemlock's been so generously mixing the drinks the past few weeks, I thought I'd share a recipe of my own!
french: Hemlock nous a tellement régalés avec ses cocktails que j'ai décidé de lui révéler une de mes spécialités cette semaine !
russian: Хемлок так расщедрился с коктейлями в последние недели, что я тоже решил предложить свой рецепт!
bulgarian: Hemlock's been so generously mixing the drinks the past few weeks, I thought I'd share a recipe of my own!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_1/drawing_1/1
english: I joined the drawing club because I want to start sketching my animals. They grow up so fast, you know?
french: Je me suis inscrit au club de dessin pour faire des portraits de mes animaux. Ils grandissent si vite, tu sais.
russian: Я вступил в кружок, потому что хочу делать зарисовки своих животных. Не замечаешь, как быстро они растут!
bulgarian: I joined the drawing club because I want to start sketching my animals. They grow up so fast, you know?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_1/drawing_1/2
english: Valen's the model this week! I thought she'd be quite stiff, but she actually seems very comfortable in her poses.
french: C'est Valen qui pose pour nous cette semaine ! Je pensais qu'elle serait tendue, mais elle est parfaitement à l'aise.
russian: На этой неделе наша модель — Вален! Я боялась, что она будет немного скованной, но оказалось, что она легко позирует.
bulgarian: Valen's the model this week! I thought she'd be quite stiff, but she actually seems very comfortable in her poses.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_1/drawing_1/3
english: An understanding of muscle groups is a must in my line of work. Now, are you ready? Next pose!
french: Comprendre les groupes musculaires est indispensable dans mon métier. Bien, vous êtes prêts pour la pose suivante ?
russian: Моя работа требует знания, как работают группы мышц. Итак, вы готовы? Меняю позу!
bulgarian: An understanding of muscle groups is a must in my line of work. Now, are you ready? Next pose!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_1/drawing_1/4
english: Wait, I'm still drawing! I can't create a masterpiece under these conditions.
french: Attends, je n'ai pas terminé ! Jamais je ne pourrai dessiner un chef-d'œuvre dans ces conditions.
russian: Погоди, я не дорисовал! С такими требованиями я не могу создать шедевр.
bulgarian: Wait, I'm still drawing! I can't create a masterpiece under these conditions.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_1/drawing_1/5
english: It's not about creating a masterpiece, March! It's about having fun and spending time with your big bro!
french: Ce n'est pas le but, March ! Tu es ici pour t'amuser et passer du temps avec ton grand frère !
russian: Тут не нужны шедевры, Март! Просто ты со старшим бро выбрался вместе хорошо провести время!
bulgarian: It's not about creating a masterpiece, March! It's about having fun and spending time with your big bro!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_1/drawing_1/6
english: It's not about being the best at drawing?
french: Le but, c'est pas d'être le meilleur en dessin ?
russian: То есть дело не в том, кто лучше всех рисует?
bulgarian: It's not about being the best at drawing?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_1/drawing_1/7
english: I see. So it's about being the best at having fun and hanging out.
french: J'ai compris. Je dois m'amuser encore plus que mon grand frère.
russian: Понятно. Значит, надо лучше всех отдыхать и общаться.
bulgarian: I see. So it's about being the best at having fun and hanging out.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_1/drawing_1/init
english: Welcome to the first drawing club session of the season, [Ari]! We've got all kinds of talents here.
french: Bienvenue pour cette première séance du club de dessin de la saison, [Ari] ! Les talents sont nombreux parmi nous.
russian: Добро пожаловать на первую встречу художественного кружка в этом сезоне, [Ari]! У нас тут собрание талантов!
bulgarian: Welcome to the first drawing club session of the season, [Ari]! We've got all kinds of talents here.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_2/drawing_2/1
english: Between you and me, my back seized up ten minutes ago and now I'm stuck like this.
french: Garde ça pour toi, mais je me suis coincé le dos il y a une dizaine de minutes. Je ne peux plus bouger depuis.
russian: Между нами говоря, у меня ещё десять минут назад заклинило спину, и я не могу выправиться.
bulgarian: Between you and me, my back seized up ten minutes ago and now I'm stuck like this.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_2/drawing_2/2
english: I heard that, and I'll take a look when we're done here. But for now, why don't we peek at everyone's drawings?
french: J'ai entendu, tu sais. Je m'occuperai de toi quand on en aura fini. En attendant, on va tous se montrer nos dessins.
russian: Я всё слышала и проведу осмотр, когда закончим. А пока давайте взглянем на рисунки.
bulgarian: I heard that, and I'll take a look when we're done here. But for now, why don't we peek at everyone's drawings?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_2/drawing_2/3
english: I like Landen's! You can see his carpenter's hand in it. Is it all those years of technical drawing, Landen?
french: J'aime beaucoup celui de Landen ! On sent la patte du menuisier. Est-ce parce que vous avez fait du dessin technique pendant des années, Landen ?
russian: Мне нравится рисунок Ландена! Сразу видно руку столяра. Долгие годы чертежей, да, Ланден?
bulgarian: I like Landen's! You can see his carpenter's hand in it. Is it all those years of technical drawing, Landen?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_2/drawing_2/4
english: You got me, lady. In case you're wondering, a clean line is all in the shoulder. Which I can see you've taken to heart, March! Big improvement!
french: Je plaide coupable. Si vous vous demandez, pour tracer un trait net, c'est au niveau des épaules que ça se joue. Je vois que tu as écouté, March ! C'est beaucoup mieux !
russian: Вы угадали, леди. Если вам интересно, ровная линия идёт от плеча. Я гляжу, Март это уже усвоил! Отличный прогресс!
bulgarian: You got me, lady. In case you're wondering, a clean line is all in the shoulder. Which I can see you've taken to heart, March! Big improvement!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_2/drawing_2/5
english: Th-thanks. I mean, it's only natural, right? And speaking of natural, Valen... your drawings are something else.
french: M-Merci. Mais c'est normal, non ? Eh bien, Valen... tes dessins sont incroyables.
russian: С-спасибо. В смысле естественно, я усвоил! К слову о естественности, Вален... твои рисунки как живые.
bulgarian: Th-thanks. I mean, it's only natural, right? And speaking of natural, Valen... your drawings are something else.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_2/drawing_2/6
english: Oh, thank you March. I was just thinking that Elsie's portraits are so striking. She really draws out the... charm points of her subject.
french: Oh, merci, March. Quant à moi, je trouve les portraits d'Elsie frappants. Elle arrive à faire ressortir... tout le charme de son sujet.
russian: Ой, спасибо, Март. А я как раз думала, как у Элси выходят такие эффектные портреты. Она хорошо выделяет... наиболее привлекательные черты модели.
bulgarian: Oh, thank you March. I was just thinking that Elsie's portraits are so striking. She really draws out the... charm points of her subject.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_2/drawing_2/7
english: Are my pecs really that big?
french: J'ai des pecs aussi développés ?
russian: У меня правда такая огромная грудь?
bulgarian: Are my pecs really that big?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_2/drawing_2/8
english: Did you do some drawing down on the farm, big guy? The baby animals in your sketchbook are WAY cute.
french: C'est des croquis que tu as dessinés à la ferme, Hayden ? Ces petits animaux sont vraiment adorables.
russian: Признавайся, силач, ты рисовал у себя дома на ферме? Детёныши животных в твоём альбоме СЛИШКОМ миленькие.
bulgarian: Did you do some drawing down on the farm, big guy? The baby animals in your sketchbook are WAY cute.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_2/drawing_2/9
english: I wanted a memento from when they're tiny! These drawings are nothing special... not as special as I'd like. Now, can someone get some ice for my back?
french: Je voulais avoir un souvenir d'eux quand ils étaient petits ! Ces dessins ne sont pas aussi réalistes que je le voudrais... Dites, quelqu'un aurait de la glace pour mon dos ?
russian: Я хотел запечатлеть их маленькими на память! Это просто обычные рисунки... Более обычные, чем мне бы хотелось. А теперь может кто-нибудь принести лёд мне для спины?
bulgarian: I wanted a memento from when they're tiny! These drawings are nothing special... not as special as I'd like. Now, can someone get some ice for my back?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_2/drawing_2/init
english: I'm the model this week! You might be wondering how can I hold this pose for so long...
french: C'est moi le modèle cette semaine ! Tu te demandes sûrement comment je fais pour tenir la pose aussi longtemps...
russian: На этой неделе я модель! Тебя может удивить, как мне так долго удаётся держать позу...
bulgarian: I'm the model this week! You might be wondering how can I hold this pose for so long...

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_3/drawing_3/1
english: My drawings are pretty bad, but I'll try to do you justice, Elsie!
french: Je ne dessine pas très bien, mais je vais essayer de vous faire honneur, Elsie !
russian: У меня так себе рисунки, но я постараюсь вас не обидеть, Элси!
bulgarian: My drawings are pretty bad, but I'll try to do you justice, Elsie!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_3/drawing_3/2
english: Hayden, if I could point something out. I noticed you've got a habit of putting your own drawings down.
french: Hayden, si je peux me permettre. J'ai remarqué que tu avais l'habitude de dénigrer tes propres dessins.
russian: Хейден, хочу тебе кое-что сообщить. Я заметил у тебя привычку принижать свои рисунки.
bulgarian: Hayden, if I could point something out. I noticed you've got a habit of putting your own drawings down.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_3/drawing_3/3
english: You avoid sharing them, too... It's important to take pride in what you do.
french: Et tu évites de les montrer aussi... C'est important d'être fier de ce qu'on fait.
russian: И ты никому их не показываешь... Всегда важно гордиться своей работой.
bulgarian: You avoid sharing them, too... It's important to take pride in what you do.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_3/drawing_3/4
english: Aaand?
russian: И-и-и?
bulgarian: Aaand?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_3/drawing_3/5
english: And to have fun, too. I guess.
french: Et de s'amuser aussi. Enfin... je crois.
russian: И получать удовольствие, да. Наверное.
bulgarian: And to have fun, too. I guess.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_3/drawing_3/6
english: My goodness, March. As a doctor, I'm afraid I have to diagnose you with a growth... of character.
french: Voyez-vous ça ! March, en tant que médecin, je crains de ne devoir te diagnostiquer... une poussée de maturité.
russian: Боже мой, Март. Как врач я вынуждена диагностировать у тебя аномальный рост... личности.
bulgarian: My goodness, March. As a doctor, I'm afraid I have to diagnose you with a growth... of character.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_3/drawing_3/7
english: What you're all saying is tough medicine, but don't think I'm not taking it to heart! If even stubborn young March can change, then your ol' friend Hayden can too.
french: C'est dur ce que vous me dites, mais j'y mets vraiment du mien ! Si même cette tête de mule de March est capable de changer, alors je peux y arriver.
russian: Трудно принять ваши слова, но не думайте, что я их забуду! Если даже упрямый Март меняет свои привычки, то ваш дружище Хейден точно сможет.
bulgarian: What you're all saying is tough medicine, but don't think I'm not taking it to heart! If even stubborn young March can change, then your ol' friend Hayden can too.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_3/drawing_3/8
english: Yeah, exactly!
french: Bien dit !
russian: Да, именно!
bulgarian: Yeah, exactly!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_3/drawing_3/9
english: Hey, wait a minute...
french: Euh, une petite minute...
russian: Стоп, погодите-ка...
bulgarian: Hey, wait a minute...

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_3/drawing_3/init
english: I'm having such fun being this week's model, [Ari]! Between performing in the opera and walking the red carpet, I'm no stranger to striking a pose!
french: Je m'amuse tellement à être le modèle de la semaine, [Ari] ! Entre les représentations à l'opéra et les tapis rouges, j'ai appris à poser, tu sais !
russian: Мне так нравится быть моделью на этой неделе, [Ari]! С опытом в опере и на красной дорожке я умею держать красивые позы!
bulgarian: I'm having such fun being this week's model, [Ari]! Between performing in the opera and walking the red carpet, I'm no stranger to striking a pose!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_4/drawing_4/1
english: Thanks, I put a lot of work into my traps! Okay, I better make way for this week's real model.
french: Merci, je travaille pas mal mes trapèzes ! Allez, je laisse la place au vrai modèle de la semaine.
russian: Ага, моя диета похожа на пост! Ладно, пора уступить место настоящей модели этой недели.
bulgarian: Thanks, I put a lot of work into my traps! Okay, I better make way for this week's real model.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_4/drawing_4/2
english: Cluck cluck!
french: Cot cot codet !
russian: Куд-кудах!
bulgarian: Cluck cluck!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_4/drawing_4/3
english: I like your attitude, young lady. And what a lovely pose... you're giving us so much wing!
french: J'aime ton assurance, jeune fille. Et quelle jolie pose... Tu ouvres si grand tes ailes !
russian: Мне нравятся ваши манеры, юная леди. И что за чудная поза... Вы так открываете нам крыло!
bulgarian: I like your attitude, young lady. And what a lovely pose... you're giving us so much wing!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_4/drawing_4/4
english: How is Henrietta such a dynamic model?
french: Comment se fait-il qu'Henrietta soit un modèle si dynamique ?
russian: Генриетта оказалась такой энергичной моделью!
bulgarian: How is Henrietta such a dynamic model?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_4/drawing_4/5
english: Thanks for sharing this with us, Hayden. Seems awful special to you.
french: Merci de partager ça avec nous, Hayden. Tu as l'air de tellement tenir à elle.
russian: Спасибо, что поделился, Хейден. Видно, что для тебя это личное.
bulgarian: Thanks for sharing this with us, Hayden. Seems awful special to you.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_4/drawing_4/6
english: I've seen so many animals grow up since I took the farm over. Thought it might be nice to start sketching up some memories.
french: J'ai vu beaucoup d'animaux grandir depuis que je suis arrivé à la ferme. À un moment je me suis dit qu'il était temps de coucher mes souvenirs sur le papier.
russian: Столько животных выросло на моих глазах с тех пор, как я получил ферму. Решил, пора делать зарисовки на память.
bulgarian: I've seen so many animals grow up since I took the farm over. Thought it might be nice to start sketching up some memories.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_4/drawing_4/7
english: Before I knew it, I was sketching all by myself and got in my own head about it.
french: Sans m'en rendre compte, je me suis mis à dessiner et c'est devenu une obsession.
russian: Я не заметил, как стал рисовать в одиночку, и сильно из-за этого распереживался.
bulgarian: Before I knew it, I was sketching all by myself and got in my own head about it.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_4/drawing_4/8
english: Thanks for talking some sense into me! You reminded me I'm the sharing type, and drawing's more fun with friends besides. Isn't that right, [Ari]?
french: Merci de m'avoir secoué les puces ! Vous m'avez rappelé que j'aime le partage et que c'est plus amusant de dessiner en compagnie de ses amis. Pas vrai, [Ari] ?
russian: Спасибо, что поговорили со мной! Вы помогли мне вспомнить, что я люблю делиться и что рисовать всегда веселее с друзьями. Правда, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Thanks for talking some sense into me! You reminded me I'm the sharing type, and drawing's more fun with friends besides. Isn't that right, [Ari]?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_4/drawing_4/9
english: GYA HA HA!
french: GAH HA HA !
russian: ГА-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: GYA HA HA!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Drawing Club/drawing_4/drawing_4/init
english: Excellent contrapposto, Olric!
french: Magnifique contrapposto, Olric !
russian: Отличный контрапост, Ольрик!
bulgarian: Excellent contrapposto, Olric!

english: Juniper and Terithia look thick as thieves up there on the balcony! What do you suppose they're talking about?
french: Regarde Juniper et Terithia là-haut. Elles ont l'air de manigancer quelque chose ! À ton avis, de quoi parlent-elles ?
russian: Джунипер и Теризия на балконе шепчутся, как друзья-подельники! Как думаешь, о чём они болтают?
bulgarian: Juniper and Terithia look thick as thieves up there on the balcony! What do you suppose they're talking about?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Inn Keepers/inn_keepers/inn_keepers_luc/init
english: Miss Terithia looks like a sailor when she leans over the balcony! It's like she's on a ship!
french: Madame Terithia a l'air d'un marin quand elle se penche à la rambarde ! On dirait qu'elle est sur un gros bateau !
russian: Мисс Теризия выглядит, как морячка, когда облокачивается на балкон! Как будто свешивается за борт!
bulgarian: Miss Terithia looks like a sailor when she leans over the balcony! It's like she's on a ship!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 2/Inn Keepers/inn_keepers/inn_keepers_maple/1
english: Anyway, that's how I know Miss Juniper and Miss Terithia are both up on the balcony.
french: C'est comme ça que je sais quand madame Juniper et madame Terithia sont toutes les deux sur le balcon.
russian: В любом случае я по смеху слышу, что мисс Джунипер и мисс Теризия на балконе.
bulgarian: Anyway, that's how I know Miss Juniper and Miss Terithia are both up on the balcony.

english: I once asked Mama why Miss Juniper and Miss Terithia laugh like that, and Mama told me to shush and be polite.
french: Un jour, j'ai demandé à maman pourquoi madame Juniper et madame Terithia rigolaient comme ça, mais elle l'a dit de me taire et de rester polie.
russian: Однажды я спросила маму, над чем мисс Джунипер и мисс Теризия так громко смеются, и мама сказала мне помолчать и быть повежливее.
bulgarian: I once asked Mama why Miss Juniper and Miss Terithia laugh like that, and Mama told me to shush and be polite.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_1/board_games_1/1
english: Lords of the Land... Hm. Can't say I'm familiar with it.
french: « Seigneurs des terres »... Mmm, ça ne me dit rien.
russian: «Владыки земель»... Хм. Не могу сказать, что знаю такую.
bulgarian: Lords of the Land... Hm. Can't say I'm familiar with it.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_1/board_games_1/2
english: It was locked in a chest, which was a bit odd. Anyway, all of the pieces were present and accounted for.
french: Étrangement, il était enfermé dans un coffre. J'ai vérifié et il y a toutes les pièces.
russian: Она хранилась в запертом сундуке, что немного странно. Но зато все компоненты на месте, я пересчитал.
bulgarian: It was locked in a chest, which was a bit odd. Anyway, all of the pieces were present and accounted for.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_1/board_games_1/3
english: Do you suppose we could play it? It might open up a whole new avenue of research.
french: Ça vous dirait d'y jouer ? Peut-être que ça m'ouvrira de tout nouveaux axes de recherche.
russian: Как думаете, мы можем сыграть? Может, это приоткроет целое направление новых исследований.
bulgarian: Do you suppose we could play it? It might open up a whole new avenue of research.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_1/board_games_1/4
english: So we each pick a game piece to represent us on the board? Oh, I want the flower!
french: Donc, on doit tous choisir un pion qui nous représente ? Moi, je prends la fleur !
russian: Каждый игрок выбирает фишку, обозначающую их на поле? О, я хочу цветочек!
bulgarian: So we each pick a game piece to represent us on the board? Oh, I want the flower!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_1/board_games_1/5
english: It's a daffodil, Mom. And really? That... that's my game piece! That's me!
french: C'est une jonquille, maman. Et puis franchement... c'est mon pion ! La fleur, c'est moi !
russian: Это нарцисс, мама. И ты серьёзно? Это... Это должна быть моя фишка! Это же я!
bulgarian: It's a daffodil, Mom. And really? That... that's my game piece! That's me!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_1/board_games_1/6
english: I suppose I'll be the jester's cap.
french: Moi, je prends le chapeau de bouffon.
russian: Ладно, видимо, я возьму шутовской колпак.
bulgarian: I suppose I'll be the jester's cap.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_1/board_games_1/7
english: Now Eiland, if there's a jester around these parts, it would be yours truly.
french: Eiland, s'il y a un bouffon ici, ça ne peut être que moi.
russian: Ну нет, Эйланд, если за нашим столом и есть шут, то это ваш покорный.
bulgarian: Now Eiland, if there's a jester around these parts, it would be yours truly.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_1/board_games_1/8
english: When was the last time you even cracked a joke?

russian: Когда ты в последний раз вообще шутил?
bulgarian: When was the last time you even cracked a joke?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_1/board_games_1/9
english: Hm. Perhaps there was a reason this game was locked up...
french: Mmm. Ce jeu était peut-être sous clé pour une bonne raison...

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_1/board_games_1/init
english: I found an old board game in the Museum archives! Look at this.
french: Regardez ! J'ai retrouvé un vieux jeu de société dans les archives du musée !
russian: Я нашёл в музейном архиве старую настольную игру! Смотрите.
bulgarian: I found an old board game in the Museum archives! Look at this.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_2/board_games_2/1
english: What's riveting is the fact that Eiland is buying up all this property and then sitting on it! Surely you can find a use for your empire?
french: Ce qui est fascinant, c'est qu'Eiland achète toutes ces propriétés et qu'il n'en fasse rien ! Ton empire doit bien pouvoir servir à quelque chose, non ?
russian: Меня лично впечатляет, что Эйланд скупает имущество и ничего с ним не делает! Наверняка в твоей империи можно найти ему применение?
bulgarian: What's riveting is the fact that Eiland is buying up all this property and then sitting on it! Surely you can find a use for your empire?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_2/board_games_2/10
english: I wonder if there's more to Lords of the Land than we think.
french: Je me demande si Seigneurs des terres ne cache pas autre chose...
russian: Любопытно. Возможно, «Владыки земель» скрывают больше, чем мы думали.
bulgarian: I wonder if there's more to Lords of the Land than we think.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_2/board_games_2/2
english: But I have, Nora! It's my duty to preserve these historical buildings. I'm leaving them intact.
french: Mais il sert à quelque chose, Nora ! Mon devoir moral est de préserver ces bâtiments historiques, alors je n'y touche pas.
russian: А я и нашёл, Нора! Мой долг — сохранить эти исторические здания. Я поддерживаю их первозданный вид.
bulgarian: But I have, Nora! It's my duty to preserve these historical buildings. I'm leaving them intact.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_2/board_games_2/3
english: But you had it all declared landmarks! No one has any place to live!
french: Mais tu les as tous déclarés monuments historiques ! Plus personne ne peut se loger !
russian: Ты все их назначил достопримечательностями! Людям просто негде жить!
bulgarian: But you had it all declared landmarks! No one has any place to live!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_2/board_games_2/4
english: That's why Celine and I pooled our black market bucks to get around the law. You see, Eiland may have bought the buildings, but I bought the deeds to the land.
french: C'est pour ça que Céline et moi avons mis en commun nos gains sur le marché noir pour contourner la loi. Eiland a acheté les bâtiments, mais c'est moi qui détiens les titres de propriété sur les terres.
russian: Поэтому мы с Селин объединили наши заработки с чёрного рынка и обошли закон. Видишь ли, Эйланд скупил все здания, но права на землю купил я.
bulgarian: That's why Celine and I pooled our black market bucks to get around the law. You see, Eiland may have bought the buildings, but I bought the deeds to the land.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_2/board_games_2/5
english: I'm going to level it to make room for my newest development... an amusement park!
french: Je vais tout raser pour réaliser mon projet de... parc d'attractions !
russian: Вот это я снесу, чтобы освободить место для новостройки... Тут будет парк развлечений!
bulgarian: I'm going to level it to make room for my newest development... an amusement park!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_2/board_games_2/6
english: Welcome... to Holtland.
french: Bienvenue à... Holtland.
russian: Добро пожаловать... в Хольтленд.
bulgarian: Welcome... to Holtland.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_2/board_games_2/7
english: You said we'd call it Celineland!
french: Tu avais dit que ça s'appellerait Célineland !
russian: Ты говорил, что это будет Селинленд!
bulgarian: You said we'd call it Celineland!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_2/board_games_2/8
english: For a silly little board game, it certainly induces people to act unlike themselves.
french: Ce jeu de société semble pousser les gens à se comporter différemment.
russian: Хотя это всего лишь настольная игра, она меняет поведение людей до неузнаваемости.
bulgarian: For a silly little board game, it certainly induces people to act unlike themselves.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_2/board_games_2/9
english: It raises the collective blood pressure of the table, too...

bulgarian: It raises the collective blood pressure of the table, too...

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_2/board_games_2/init
english: This game is riveting, Eiland. You said it's called Lords of the Land?
french: Je trouve ce jeu fascinant, Eiland. Tu as dit qu'il s'appelait « Seigneurs des terres » ?
russian: Впечатляющая игра, Эйланд. Говоришь, она называется «Владыки земель»?
bulgarian: This game is riveting, Eiland. You said it's called Lords of the Land?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_3/board_games_3/1

bulgarian: Apparently this game is outlawed in seven countries, four provinces and two city-states. It has a storied history of turning neighbor against neighbor.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_3/board_games_3/10
english: This has been simply fascinating. I wonder if I might take the game home with me?
french: C'est vraiment fascinant... Dites, je peux prendre le jeu chez moi pour la semaine ?
russian: Это просто завораживающий опыт. Никто не против, если я заберу эту игру домой?
bulgarian: This has been simply fascinating. I wonder if I might take the game home with me?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_3/board_games_3/11
english: I'd love to study it.
french: J'aimerais l'étudier de plus près.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_3/board_games_3/4

bulgarian: It only burned down because you were courting the reformed thieves guild in hopes of swindling them out of their property.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_3/board_games_3/5
english: Instead, they came after you! For revenge!
french: Finalement, ils se sont retournés contre toi pour se venger !
russian: А вместо этого они пришли за тобой! Чтобы отомстить!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_3/board_games_3/6
english: We don't take kindly to being tricked, Dad. You should have taken the deal. It was an honest offer.
french: On n'a pas apprécié que tu veuilles nous rouler dans la farine, papa. Tu aurais dû accepter le marché. C'était une offre plus que raisonnable.

bulgarian: We don't take kindly to being tricked, Dad. You should have taken the deal. It was an honest offer.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_3/board_games_3/7
english: Actually, it was a bit outrageous as offers go... you overvalued that real estate at least twice over.
french: Si je puis me permettre, ta proposition était un peu exagérée.... Ton estimation était au moins le double des prix du marché.

bulgarian: Actually, it was a bit outrageous as offers go... you overvalued that real estate at least twice over.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_3/board_games_3/8
english: We're a reformed thieves guild, Eiland... not fools.
french: On est une guilde de voleurs repentis, Eiland... Pas des imbéciles.

bulgarian: We're a reformed thieves guild, Eiland... not fools.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_3/board_games_3/9
english: Do you take us for fools, Eiland?
french: Tu nous prends pour des imbéciles, Eiland ?
russian: Или, по-твоему, мы дурачки, Эйланд?
bulgarian: Do you take us for fools, Eiland?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_3/board_games_3/init

french: J'ai découvert plusieurs anecdotes intéressantes sur Seigneurs des terres cette semaine !
russian: За эту неделю я узнал кое-какие любопытные факты про «Владык земель»!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_4/board_games_4/1
english: It's true! Reina really outdid herself. And Eiland, this tea is so lovely and floral! Thank you for sharing it with us.
french: Oui ! Reina s'est surpassée. Et Eiland, ce thé est si délicat et floral ! Merci de nous en faire profiter.

bulgarian: It's true! Reina really outdid herself. And Eiland, this tea is so lovely and floral! Thank you for sharing it with us.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_4/board_games_4/2
english: Of course! Good things are meant to be shared.
french: Oh, mais de rien ! Les bonnes choses sont faites pour être partagées.
russian: Ну разумеется! Хорошими вещами всегда нужно делиться.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_4/board_games_4/3
english: Weren't we playing a board game, though?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_4/board_games_4/4

french: Mais oui ! Aux Seigneurs des terres. Valen l'a emporté chez elle la dernière fois, non ?

bulgarian: That's right! Lords of the Land. Didn't Valen take it home last time?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_4/board_games_4/5
english: I threw it in the river.

bulgarian: I threw it in the river.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_4/board_games_4/6
english: You threw a historical artifact... in the river?
french: Tu as jeté un artéfact historique... dans la rivière ?
russian: Ты выбросила исторический артефакт... в реку?
bulgarian: You threw a historical artifact... in the river?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_4/board_games_4/7
english: It seemed the best place for it. And look at us! We're all getting along quite nicely.
french: C'était sa place. Et regardez le résultat ! Tout le monde s'entend bien, comme avant.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_4/board_games_4/8
english: But Valen... what happens when it washes up in the next town over?
french: Mais Valen... Que se passera-t-il s'il échoue entre les mains d'autres personnes ?

bulgarian: But Valen... what happens when it washes up in the next town over?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Board Games/board_games_4/board_games_4/9
english: It'll tear that village apart!
french: Ils s'entretueront !

english: These shortcakes are delicious, Celine.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_1/book_club_1/1
english: Now, let's introduce our first book! Terithia picked Tales of the Sea, a collection of fishy folktales. Tell me about your favorite story!
french: Bien, c'est le moment de présenter notre premier livre ! Terithia a choisi « Les Contes des mers », un recueil d'histoires populaires sur les océans. Dis-nous qu'elle est ta préférée !
russian: Давайте же представим нашу первую книгу! Теризия выбрала «Морские истории», сборник водянистых народных сказок. Расскажите, какая вам понравилась больше всего!
bulgarian: Now, let's introduce our first book! Terithia picked Tales of the Sea, a collection of fishy folktales. Tell me about your favorite story!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_1/book_club_1/2
english: I quite liked the Ballad of the Sea Cucumber. For a story with such an adorable premise, the sense of melancholy at the close is what made it stick out in my mind.
french: J'aime beaucoup « La Ballade du concombre de mer ». L'idée de départ est adorable, mais c'est le sentiment de mélancolie à la fin qui m'a marquée.
russian: Мне понравилась «Баллада о морском огурце». Учитывая её невинную завязку, чувство меланхолии в финале для меня выделяет её на фоне остальных.
bulgarian: I quite liked the Ballad of the Sea Cucumber. For a story with such an adorable premise, the sense of melancholy at the close is what made it stick out in my mind.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_1/book_club_1/3
english: Oh yeah, I liked that one. My favorite was the one about the three pirates. I had no idea who was going to end up captain in the end!
french: Oh oui, je l'ai beaucoup aimée. Ma préférée reste celle des trois pirates. Jusqu'à la fin, je me suis demandé qui allait devenir capitaine !
russian: О да, мне она тоже понравилась. Но моя любимая — про трёх пиратов. До самого конца не мог догадаться, кто из них станет капитаном!
bulgarian: Oh yeah, I liked that one. My favorite was the one about the three pirates. I had no idea who was going to end up captain in the end!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_1/book_club_1/4
english: To be frank, I've been on ships like that.
french: Si vous voulez tout savoir, j'ai déjà navigué sur des bateaux de ce genre.
russian: Честно говоря, мне приходилось бывать на таких кораблях.
bulgarian: To be frank, I've been on ships like that.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_1/book_club_1/5
english: KYA HA HA!

bulgarian: KYA HA HA!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_1/book_club_1/6
english: I was partial to the Siren's Song story! I could relate, I'm not immune to a charming face and a pretty ditty!
french: Moi, j'ai beaucoup aimé « Le Chant de la sirène » ! Car un beau visage et un joli brin de voix ne m'ont jamais laissé indifférent !
russian: Меня затронула «Песня сирены»! Могу понять их чувства, невозможно противостоять соблазну прелестного личика и милой песенки!
bulgarian: I was partial to the Siren's Song story! I could relate, I'm not immune to a charming face and a pretty ditty!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_1/book_club_1/7

bulgarian: You'd walk right into the ocean, I suspect.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_1/book_club_1/8
english: Lucky for me I'm such a strong swimmer!
french: Heureusement pour moi que je sais très bien nager !
russian: Мне повезло, что я такой хороший пловец!
bulgarian: Lucky for me I'm such a strong swimmer!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_1/book_club_1/init
english: Oh, it is so exciting to welcome you to book club! I ran one in the Capital, too... I find discussion helps stimulate my mind as I formulate my memoirs!
french: Je suis si heureuse de ce club de lecture ! J'en avais aussi créé un à la capitale... Ces discussions stimulantes me permettent de rédiger mes mémoires !
russian: Ох, с волнением приветствую вас в книжном клубе! Я уже проводила такой в столице... Я знаю, что обсуждения помогают мне размять ум и яснее формулировать свои мемуары.
bulgarian: Oh, it is so exciting to welcome you to book club! I ran one in the Capital, too... I find discussion helps stimulate my mind as I formulate my memoirs!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_2/book_club_2/1
english: I've been dying to talk about this book all week! I started reading right after our last session, and I couldn't put it down! The twists! The turns!
french: Ça fait une semaine que je veux vous en parler ! Je l'ai commencé après notre dernière réunion et je n'ai pas pu m'arrêter ! Tous ces rebondissements, ce suspense !
russian: Всю неделю хочу обсудить эту книгу! Я начала читать сразу после нашей прошлой встречи и не могла оторваться! Какие неожиданные повороты!
bulgarian: I've been dying to talk about this book all week! I started reading right after our last session, and I couldn't put it down! The twists! The turns!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_2/book_club_2/2
english: I love a closed room mystery, and setting it on a ship was so cool.
french: J'adore les huis clos et, là, j'ai beaucoup aimé que ça se passe sur un bateau.
russian: Я люблю убийства в закрытой комнате, и мне очень понравился выбор корабля как места действия.
bulgarian: I love a closed room mystery, and setting it on a ship was so cool.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_2/book_club_2/3
english: When they said the first murder happened on the deck, where it was impossible to hide... I was captivated. I started keeping a journal!
french: Quand ils ont dit que le premier meurtre avait eu lieu sur le pont alors qu'il était impossible de s'y cacher... je suis rentré dedans. J'ai même commencé à tenir un journal !
russian: Когда они сказали, что первое убийство произошло на палубе, где негде спрятаться... Это захватило моё внимание. Я стал вести заметки!
bulgarian: When they said the first murder happened on the deck, where it was impossible to hide... I was captivated. I started keeping a journal!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_2/book_club_2/4
english: Then Ryis and I got to talking about it, and we started pinning notes to the wall in my room. I woke up and went to sleep staring at that thing!
french: Ensuite, Ryis et moi, on en a parlé. On a commencé à épingler des notes sur un mur de ma chambre. Au réveil et au coucher, je les avais sous le nez !
russian: Затем мы с Ризом стали их обсуждать и вешать записи на стену в моей комнате. Я засыпал и просыпался, глядя на них!
bulgarian: Then Ryis and I got to talking about it, and we started pinning notes to the wall in my room. I woke up and went to sleep staring at that thing!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_2/book_club_2/5
english: I was a man possessed! I couldn't figure it out!
french: C'était devenu une obsession ! Je ne trouvais pas la solution !

english: The writer also had all the little nautical details down pat. The absentee pennant, the fake murder weapon hidden in the bilge, the landlubber knots being a clue...
french: L'auteur a vraiment utilisé l'univers marin à fond. Le pavillon d'absence, la fausse arme du crime cachée en fond de cale, les nœuds indignes d'un marin pour indice...
russian: А ещё писатель хорошо разбирается во флотских тонкостях. Отсутствие командирского вымпела, ложное орудие убийства в трюме, сухопутные узлы в качестве улик...
bulgarian: The writer also had all the little nautical details down pat. The absentee pennant, the fake murder weapon hidden in the bilge, the landlubber knots being a clue...

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_2/book_club_2/7
english: It was very convincing!
french: C'était très convaincant !
russian: Всё это было очень убедительно!
bulgarian: It was very convincing!

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_2/book_club_2/8
english: And who would have thought the butler was the murderer? Not me! But it all made sense...
french: Et qui aurait imaginé que le coupable était la majordome ? Pas moi, en tout cas ! Mais c'était logique, finalement...
russian: И кто бы мог подумать, что убийца — дворецкий? Точно не я! Но в итоге всё сошлось...
bulgarian: And who would have thought the butler was the murderer? Not me! But it all made sense...

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_2/book_club_2/init
english: Oh, I can't wait! Let's get this book club started! What did you think of Murder on the Grand Leviathan?
french: Il me tarde d'ouvrir cette session du club de lecture ! Alors, qu'avez-vous pensé de « Meurtre à bord du Léviathan » ?
russian: Ох, как я ждал! Давайте начнём книжный клуб! Что вы думаете про «Убийство на "Большом левиафане"»?
bulgarian: Oh, I can't wait! Let's get this book club started! What did you think of Murder on the Grand Leviathan?

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_3/book_club_3/1
english: Yes... unique... rarely have I seen a book written with such, ah... deliberate precision.
french: Oui, c'est le moins qu'on puisse dire. J'ai rarement lu un livre écrit avec un tel, euh... souci du détail.

french: J'ai trouvé le mot de l'auteur à la toute fin très romantique. Dans son cœur, il dédiait le bâtiment à sa femme bien-aimée.

bulgarian: I thought the author's note at the end was rather romantic. In his heart, he dedicated that building to his wife.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_3/book_club_3/4

bulgarian: Even if he was rather dry about it.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_3/book_club_3/5
english: See, Ryis? What'd I tell you? We spent a whole summer bonding over that book, and now they're appreciating it too!
french: Tu vois, Ryis ? Je te l'avais dit. Tout l'été, ce livre nous a permis de tisser du lien, et maintenant, ils l'apprécient aussi !
russian: Видишь, Риз? Что я говорил? Мы целое лето провели, обсуждая эту книгу, а теперь и они могут её оценить!
bulgarian: See, Ryis? What'd I tell you? We spent a whole summer bonding over that book, and now they're appreciating it too!

french: Oncle Landen, c'est un traité sur la reconstruction d'une cathédrale en bois... Elsie ne parlait pas de ce genre de livres. Désolé, les amis, j'ai essayé de l'en dissuader.

bulgarian: Uncle, it's a technical manual for reconstructing a wooden cathedral... I don't think this is the kind of book Elsie was talking about. Sorry guys, I tried to talk him out of it.

key: Conversations/Friday Night at the Inn/Group 3/Book Club/book_club_3/book_club_3/7
