russian: Надеюсь, ты планируешь выращивать побольше, [Ari]!
bulgarian: I hope you're planning to grow lots, [Ari]!

english: There's nothing more fun than getting to work with fresh fall produce!
french: Il n'y a rien de plus plaisant que de cuisiner des produits d'automne.
russian: Нет ничего лучше, чем работать с осенним урожаем!
bulgarian: There's nothing more fun than getting to work with fresh fall produce!

english: Keep an eye out for dig spots, [Ari]! Now that the snow has all melted, more artifacts are sure to surface!
french: Surveille les endroits à creuser, [Ari] ! Maintenant que la neige a fondu, de nombreux artéfacts vont certainement faire surface.
russian: Обрати внимание на места раскопок, [Ari]! Теперь снег оттаял, так что на поверхности наверняка можно найти больше артефактов!
bulgarian: Keep an eye out for dig spots, [Ari]! Now that the snow has all melted, more artifacts are sure to surface!

english: Lots to do on the farm now that springtime is here! I couldn't be happier!
french: J'ai beaucoup de travail à la ferme avec l'arrivée du printemps. Je suis si content !
russian: Теперь, когда пришла весна, на ферме столько всего можно делать! Не могу нарадоваться!
bulgarian: Lots to do on the farm now that springtime is here! I couldn't be happier!

english: The warmer weather means the birds are coming back! I've been keeping an eye out for nests.
french: Avec les températures qui s'adoucissent, les oiseaux reviennent. Je surveille la présence des nids.
russian: Начало потепления означает, что скоро вернутся птицы! Я уже смотрю, не появились ли где гнёзда.
bulgarian: The warmer weather means the birds are coming back! I've been keeping an eye out for nests.

english: I miss the quiet beauty of winter, but at least it means we're out of flu season.
french: La beauté paisible de l'hiver me manque, mais, au moins, la vague de grippes est derrière nous.
russian: Я скучаю по зимним красотам, но зато мы, наконец, выбрались из простудного сезона.
bulgarian: I miss the quiet beauty of winter, but at least it means we're out of flu season.

english: Is there a better time of year than summer? You can really feel how alive Mistria is.
french: Existe-t-il une plus belle saison que l'été ? C'est là qu'on sent toute la vie qui anime Mistria.
russian: Нет сезона лучше лета! Так и чувствуешь, как Мистрия вся оживает.
bulgarian: Is there a better time of year than summer? You can really feel how alive Mistria is.

english: Ah, summertime! Be sure to get out and enjoy all the Mistria has to offer.
french: Ah, l'été ! Sors profiter de tout ce que Mistria offre en cette saison.
russian: Ах, летняя пора! Гуляй почаще, любуйся мистрийскими красотами.
bulgarian: Ah, summertime! Be sure to get out and enjoy all the Mistria has to offer.

english: (Something about Henrietta's bearing suggests that she's hoping you grow lots of =Corn= this summer)
french: (Henrietta semble dire qu'elle espère que vous allez faire pousser beaucoup de =maïs= cet été.)
russian: (По позе Генриетты угадывается: она рассчитывает, что этим летом вы вырастите много =кукурузы=.)
bulgarian: (Something about Henrietta's bearing suggests that she's hoping you grow lots of =Corn= this summer)

english: Imagine shorts... but like... even shorter.
french: Peut-être en portant un short... mais... vraiment très court.
russian: Представь себе шорты, но... короче, чем шорты.
bulgarian: Imagine shorts... but like... even shorter.

english: Short shorts! I gotta talk to Balor.
french: Un microshort ! Faut que j'en parle à Balor.
russian: Укороченные шорты! Мне надо подать идею Балору.
bulgarian: Short shorts! I gotta talk to Balor.

english: Another hot one! I've been thinking about how to beat the heat.
french: C'est la canicule ! Je me demande comment lutter contre la chaleur...
russian: Снова жаркое лето! Я раздумывал, как справиться с жарой.
bulgarian: Another hot one! I've been thinking about how to beat the heat.

english: Right after he left, March came by, gave me some money, and told me to forget about it.
french: Juste après son départ, March est venu me voir et m'a donné de l'argent en me disant d'oublier ça.
russian: Как только он ушёл, ко мне подошёл Март и дал мне денег, чтобы я забыл об этой истории.
bulgarian: Right after he left, March came by, gave me some money, and told me to forget about it.

english: It's a shame. I bet they'd be a real money-maker.
french: C'est dommage. Je suis sûr que ça se serait vendu comme des petits pains.
russian: А жалко. Наверняка был бы ходовой товар.
bulgarian: It's a shame. I bet they'd be a real money-maker.

english: Did Olric tell you about his short shorts idea too?
french: Olric t'a parlé de son idée de microshort ?
russian: Ольрик и тебе рассказывал про свою идею укороченных шортов?
bulgarian: Did Olric tell you about his short shorts idea too?

english: We're so lucky plants still grow in the winter, here in Mistria! I don't know how I'd keep myself busy otherwise.
french: Heureusement que les plantes continuent à pousser l'hiver ici, à Mistria. Sinon, je ne sais pas ce que je ferais pour m'occuper.
russian: Как нам повезло, что здесь, в Мистрии, зимой тоже растут растения! Не знаю даже, чем бы я без них занималась.
bulgarian: We're so lucky plants still grow in the winter, here in Mistria! I don't know how I'd keep myself busy otherwise.

english: Just smell that winter air! Invigorating, isn't it?
french: Sens-moi ce bon air hivernal ! Ça revigore, hein ?
russian: Чуешь зимний воздух? Бодрит, правда?
bulgarian: Just smell that winter air! Invigorating, isn't it?

english: And then I'll have to keep any I find a secret. Not everyone likes bugs as much as we do, [Ari]!
french: Et je ne parlerai à personne de ceux que je vais trouver. Contrairement à nous, tout le monde n'aime pas les insectes, [Ari] !
russian: А потом ещё и надо будет держать свои находки втайне. Не все любят жучков, как мы с тобой, [Ari]!
bulgarian: And then I'll have to keep any I find a secret. Not everyone likes bugs as much as we do, [Ari]!

english: There's not nearly as many bugs to find in the winter, I'll have to start doing a more thorough search indoors.
french: Il n'y a presque pas d'insectes dehors l'hiver, alors je vais devoir me mettre à plus chercher en intérieur.
russian: Зимой на улице гораздо меньше насекомых. Мне придётся вести тщательные поиски дома.
bulgarian: There's not nearly as many bugs to find in the winter, I'll have to start doing a more thorough search indoors.

english: Isn't winter lovely? It's my favorite season, you know.
french: Ah, l'hiver... C'est ma saison préférée, tu sais.
russian: Какая прекрасная зима! Знаешь, это моё любимое время года.
bulgarian: Isn't winter lovely? It's my favorite season, you know.

english: Oh ho ho!
french: Oh ho ho ho !
russian: О-хо-хо!
bulgarian: Oh ho ho!

english: I do love fall, but I suspect winter will be the Bathhouse's busy season.
french: J'aime bien l'automne, mais c'est en hiver que les bains font le plein.
russian: Я люблю осень, но подозреваю, что для купальни самый сезон наступит зимой.
bulgarian: I do love fall, but I suspect winter will be the Bathhouse's busy season.

english: Another season about to end. Time to start working on the General Store's winter restock...
french: Une nouvelle saison s'achève. Il est temps que je m'occupe du réassort du magasin général pour l'hiver...
russian: Ещё один сезон подходит к концу. Пора готовиться к закупкам зимнего ассортимента...
bulgarian: Another season about to end. Time to start working on the General Store's winter restock...

english: Birds are all heading south now that winter is nearly here. It'd be fun to follow them one day, wouldn't it?
french: Les oiseaux migrent tous vers le sud avec l'arrivée de l'hiver. Ce serait sympa de les suivre un jour, non ?
russian: Зима уже на носу, и птицы улетают на юг. Хорошо было бы однажды отправиться вместе с ними, да?
bulgarian: Birds are all heading south now that winter is nearly here. It'd be fun to follow them one day, wouldn't it?

english: The water doesn't tend to freeze over, and thank goodness for that!
french: Heureusement pour nous, les rivières ne gèlent pas dans cette région !
russian: Вода здесь обычно не замерзает — к нашему счастью!
bulgarian: The water doesn't tend to freeze over, and thank goodness for that!

english: Now [Ari], you don't have to say a word. I know what you're worrying about, but there'll still be plenty of fishing here in winter.
french: Ne dis rien, [Ari]. Je sais ce qui te tracasse, mais il y aura encore plein de poissons à pêcher ici, en hiver.
russian: Не нужно ничего говорить, [Ari]. Я знаю, что тебя волнует. Уверяю тебя, зимой тоже можно будет порыбачить.
bulgarian: Now [Ari], you don't have to say a word. I know what you're worrying about, but there'll still be plenty of fishing here in winter.

english: It'd be a big seller, but it's not very practical.
french: Tout le monde se les arracherait, mais ce n'est pas pratique à conserver.
russian: Продавался бы он на ура, но это не очень практично.
bulgarian: It'd be a big seller, but it's not very practical.

english: With summer around the corner, I've been daydreaming ways of getting blocks of ice to Mistria.
french: Avec l'été qui pointe le bout de son nez, je rêve de pouvoir transporter d'immenses blocs de glace à Mistria.
russian: Приближается лето. Меня весь день не отпускает идея организовать доставку блоков льда в Мистрию.
bulgarian: With summer around the corner, I've been daydreaming ways of getting blocks of ice to Mistria.

english: It's tough being a big sister, sometimes!
french: Des fois, c'est fatigant d'être une grande sœur !
russian: Трудно иногда быть старшей сестрой!
bulgarian: It's tough being a big sister, sometimes!

english: Luc won't stop talking about summer being almost here. He's gonna want to go bug hunting every day...
french: Luc ne tient plus en place avec l'arrivée de l'été. Je suis sûre qu'il va aller à la chasse aux insectes tous les jours...
russian: Люк постоянно говорит, что приближается лето. Он тогда каждый день захочет ходить ловить насекомых...
bulgarian: Luc won't stop talking about summer being almost here. He's gonna want to go bug hunting every day...

english: Summer's nearly here. Time to tear the sleeves off another old shirt...
french: C'est bientôt l'été. Je vais pouvoir couper les manches d'une vieille chemise...
russian: Лето уже на носу. Пора отрезать рукава от старой рубашки...
bulgarian: Summer's nearly here. Time to tear the sleeves off another old shirt...

english: I can't wait for summer! The Beach is calling to me.
french: J'ai hâte d'être en été ! Pour pouvoir profiter de la plage.
russian: Жду не дождусь, когда наступит лето! Пляж уже зовёт меня.
bulgarian: I can't wait for summer! The Beach is calling to me.

english: (You get the impression that Dozy is looking forward to summer being over)
french: (Vous avez l'impression que Dozy a hâte que l'été se termine au plus vite.)
russian: (Кажется, Дрёма с нетерпением ждёт, когда закончится лето.)
bulgarian: (You get the impression that Dozy is looking forward to summer being over)

english: I've been meaning to ask Dozy about what that means for him.
french: J'imagine que Dozy va être soulagé, le pauvre.
russian: Я собираюсь спросить у Дрёмы, что это для него значит.
bulgarian: I've been meaning to ask Dozy about what that means for him.

english: The dog days of summer are nearly over...
french: Les grandes chaleurs seront bien terminées...
russian: Летний дремотный зной почти закончился...
bulgarian: The dog days of summer are nearly over...

english: Feels like summer just started, and now it's just about over! When I was Maple's age, summers felt much longer.
french: J'ai l'impression que l'été vient à peine de commencer, alors qu'il s'achève bientôt. Les étés me paraissaient tellement longs quand j'avais l'âge de Maple.
russian: Лето, кажется, только началось, а уже почти закончилось! Когда я была маленькой, как сейчас Мэйпл, лето казалось длиннее.
bulgarian: Feels like summer just started, and now it's just about over! When I was Maple's age, summers felt much longer.

english: It's time to dig out the sweaters, fall is just around the corner!
french: Avec l'arrivée de l'automne, c'est le moment de ressortir les pulls.
russian: Пора доставать свитера: приближается осень!
bulgarian: It's time to dig out the sweaters, fall is just around the corner!

english: Spring is almost here! The sooner this snow is gone, the happier I'll be. The road to the Capital has been trial.
french: C'est bientôt le printemps. Vivement que toute la neige ait fondu ! Le trajet jusqu'à la capitale était un enfer.
russian: Весна почти пришла! Чем быстрее растает снег, тем лучше для меня. Дорога в столицу — сплошная череда препятствий.
bulgarian: Spring is almost here! The sooner this snow is gone, the happier I'll be. The road to the Capital has been trial.

english: I'm going to miss winter. Mom never gets mad when I play in the snow, but she always gets mad when I play in the mud.
french: L'hiver va me manquer. Maman ne me gronde jamais quand je joue dans la neige, mais elle se met en rogne si je joue dans la boue.
russian: Я буду скучать по зиме. Мама никогда не ругается, когда я играю в снегу. А когда играю в грязи, ругается всегда.
bulgarian: I'm going to miss winter. Mom never gets mad when I play in the snow, but she always gets mad when I play in the mud.

english: Now those were REAL winters!
french: À l'époque, c'était vraiment des hivers !
russian: Вот это были НАСТОЯЩИЕ зимы!
bulgarian: Now those were REAL winters!

english: Winter's almost over, and it wasn't too bad. Remind me to tell you about the winters when I was a lad sometime.
french: L'hiver touche à sa fin, il n'a pas été trop rude. Un jour, tu me feras penser à te raconter les hivers quand j'étais enfant.
russian: Зима почти прошла — и прошла неплохо. Напомни мне как-нибудь рассказать тебе, какие зимы бывали в моём детстве.
bulgarian: Winter's almost over, and it wasn't too bad. Remind me to tell you about the winters when I was a lad sometime.

english: Winter is ending, time to start thinking about my spring workout routine!
french: L'hiver se termine. Il est temps que je réfléchisse à mon programme d'entraînement du printemps.
russian: Зима заканчивается, так что пора придумать схему тренировок на весну!
bulgarian: Winter is ending, time to start thinking about my spring workout routine!

english: Good morning!
bulgarian: Good morning!

english: Nice to see another early riser up and about!
bulgarian: Nice to see another early riser up and about!

english: Just smell that fresh morning air!
bulgarian: Just smell that fresh morning air!

english: Another new day, let's make the most of it!
bulgarian: Another new day, let's make the most of it!

english: Ah, another day in Mistria.
bulgarian: Ah, another day in Mistria.

english: Good morning! Hope you slept as well as I did last night.
french: Bonjour ! J'espère que tu as aussi bien dormi que moi la nuit dernière.
russian: Доброе утро! Мне спалось просто замечательно. Надеюсь, тебе тоже.
bulgarian: Good morning! Hope you slept as well as I did last night.

english: It's a fine morning, isn't it? The older I get the more I appreciate them.
french: C'est une belle matinée, hein ? Plus j'avance dans la vie, plus j'apprécie le lever du jour.
russian: Хорошее сегодня утречко! Чем дольше живу, тем больше мне нравится эта пора.
bulgarian: It's a fine morning, isn't it? The older I get the more I appreciate them.

english: You can really feel that winter's on its way in the early morning, huh? Brr!
bulgarian: You can really feel that winter's on its way in the early morning, huh? Brr!

english: Everyone's so... cheery. Like they're about to break into song.
french: Les gens sont tous de bonne humeur. On dirait qu'ils vont se mettre à chanter.
russian: Все такие... жизнерадостные. Как будто вот-вот начнут петь.
bulgarian: Everyone's so... cheery. Like they're about to break into song.

english: Early mornings are my least favorite time in Mistria.
french: Le petit matin, c'est le moment de la journée que j'aime le moins à Mistria.
russian: Раннее утро — моё самое нелюбимое время в Мистрии.
bulgarian: Early mornings are my least favorite time in Mistria.

english: Good morning.
french: Bonjour.
russian: Доброе утро.
bulgarian: Good morning.

english: Morning...
french: Bonjour...
russian: Доброе...
bulgarian: Morning...

english: I'm not sleepy!
french: Non, pas du tout !
russian: Я не соня!
bulgarian: I'm not sleepy!

english: Goooood morning!
french: Bonjouuur !
russian: До-о-оброе утречко!
bulgarian: Goooood morning!

english: Looks like someone's still sleepy!
french: Je connais quelqu'un qui dort encore !
russian: Вижу, кое-кто у нас соня!
bulgarian: Looks like someone's still sleepy!

english: Morning.
french: Bonjour.
russian: Утро.
bulgarian: Morning.

english: It's a great way to get yourself fired up!
french: C'est l'idéal pour être en pleine forme !
russian: По-моему, отличный способ разогреться с утра!
bulgarian: It's a great way to get yourself fired up!

english: Bet it's easy to start your day with some early morning exercise on your farm, right, [Ari]?
french: Dans une ferme, c'est facile de commencer la journée en faisant un peu d'exercice, pas vrai, [Ari] ?
russian: Наверняка тебе на ферме легко начинать день с утренней зарядки, да, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Bet it's easy to start your day with some early morning exercise on your farm, right, [Ari]?

english: And if not, I hope you order one at the Inn!
french: Si ce n'est pas le cas, viens à l'auberge !
russian: А если нет, то заходи позавтракать в трактир!
bulgarian: And if not, I hope you order one at the Inn!

english: Good morning! Hope you've had breakfast, [Ari]!
french: Bonjour ! J'espère que tu as pris ton petit-déjeuner, [Ari].
russian:
Доброе утро! Надеюсь, ты уже

позавтракали

позавтракалапозавтракалпозавтракало, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Good morning! Hope you've had breakfast, [Ari]!

english: Oh, did you just wake up? For one such as I, sleep is more... optional.
french: Oh, tu viens de te réveiller ? Pour moi, le sommeil n'a rien d'obligatoire.
russian:
О, ты только

проснулись

проснуласьпроснулсяпроснулось? Для таких, как я, сон... необязателен.
bulgarian: Oh, did you just wake up? For one such as I, sleep is more... optional.

english: Looks like another scorcher! Best to get anything urgent done in the morning when it's cooler.
bulgarian: Looks like another scorcher! Best to get anything urgent done in the morning when it's cooler.

english: Morning, [Ari]! Let's both find some time to do a little fishing today, eh?
french: Bonjour, [Ari] ! On essaie d'aller pêcher ensemble aujourd'hui, d'accord ?
russian: Утро, [Ari]! Надеюсь, и у меня и у тебя сегодня найдётся минутка порыбачить.
bulgarian: Morning, [Ari]! Let's both find some time to do a little fishing today, eh?

english: Is there anything better than a winter morning? Mistria feels so fresh and clean!
bulgarian: Is there anything better than a winter morning? Mistria feels so fresh and clean!

english: Good evening!
bulgarian: Good evening!

english: Isn't Mistria peaceful after the sun sets?
bulgarian: Isn't Mistria peaceful after the sun sets?

english: Out for a late night stroll? It's a great way to relax before bed.
bulgarian: Out for a late night stroll? It's a great way to relax before bed.

english: Another full day! Here's hoping you had a good one, [Ari].
bulgarian: Another full day! Here's hoping you had a good one, [Ari].

english: Doubt I'll see you again before bed, so good night [Ari]!
bulgarian: Doubt I'll see you again before bed, so good night [Ari]!

english: I suppose I should think about heading to bed, lots to do tomorrow.
french: Je ferais mieux d'aller me coucher, j'ai beaucoup de travail demain.
russian: Полагаю, пора начинать готовиться ко сну. Завтра предстоит много дел.
bulgarian: I suppose I should think about heading to bed, lots to do tomorrow.

english: I guess I should give it a rest.
french: Je vais dormir dessus.
russian: Что ж, утро вечера мудренее!
bulgarian: I guess I should give it a rest.

english: I've been trying to think of a good sleep pun, but it's getting late.
french: J'essaie de trouver un jeu de mots sur le soir, mais il commence à se faire tard.
russian: Я пытался придумать хорошую шутку про сон, но уже поздно.
bulgarian: I've been trying to think of a good sleep pun, but it's getting late.

english: Look how late it is! Time sure does fly these days.
french: Tu as vu l'heure ? Le temps passe à une vitesse folle en ce moment.
russian: Смотри-ка, уже так темно! Как время-то летит.
bulgarian: Look how late it is! Time sure does fly these days.

english: I don't think the day really starts until the sun sets.
french: Pour moi, la journée commence vraiment quand le soleil se couche.
russian: Я считаю, с заходом солнца день только начинается.
bulgarian: I don't think the day really starts until the sun sets.

english: Ahh.
french: Ah...
bulgarian: Ahh.

english: Nice thing about retiring is you can stay up as late you want!
french: Ce qui est bien à la retraite, c'est qu'on peut se coucher à l'heure qu'on veut.
russian: Хорошо быть пенсионером: можно ложиться спать, когда захочешь!
bulgarian: Nice thing about retiring is you can stay up as late you want!

english: Evening...
french: Bonsoir...
russian: Ночи...
bulgarian: Evening...

english: It's interesting to see how quiet Mistria becomes at night. Those poor human eyes of yours aren't much for night vision, are they?
french: C'est surprenant comme Mistria est paisible à la nuit tombée. Les humains ne sont donc pas nyctalopes, les pauvres ?
russian: Любопытно наблюдать, как в Мистрии ночью становится тихо. Ваши бедные людские глаза едва ли приспособлены видеть в темноте, да?
bulgarian: It's interesting to see how quiet Mistria becomes at night. Those poor human eyes of yours aren't much for night vision, are they?

english: Hope it cools off a bit, now that the sun is down...
bulgarian: Hope it cools off a bit, now that the sun is down...

english: Up a bit late, aren't we? Be sure to let me know if you're having trouble sleeping.
french: Tu ne vas pas te coucher ? Viens me voir si tu as des problèmes d'insomnie.

english: $White flowers$? Yes... blossoms like the pinpricks of stars. A fine choice.
french: Des $fleurs blanches$ ? Oui... Des bourgeons de la même couleur que les étoiles. C'est un choix.
bulgarian: $White flowers$? Yes... blossoms like the pinpricks of stars. A fine choice.

english: Let us have white flowers, then. I will make the necessary arrangements.
french: Nous partirons donc sur des fleurs blanches. Je vais prendre les dispositions nécessaires.
bulgarian: Let us have white flowers, then. I will make the necessary arrangements.

english: $Ebony Flowers$? Like the absence of light in the infinite void?
french: Des $fleurs noires$ ? Pour rappeler l'absence de lumière dans le vide infini ?
bulgarian: $Ebony Flowers$? Like the absence of light in the infinite void?

english: You know my tastes... as well as my heart.
french: Tu connais mes goûts... Et mon cœur.
bulgarian: You know my tastes... as well as my heart.

english: Yes. Ebony flowers would suit us. I will make the necessary arrangements.
french: Oui, des fleurs noires nous correspondent bien. Je vais prendre les dispositions nécessaires.
bulgarian: Yes. Ebony flowers would suit us. I will make the necessary arrangements.

english: [Ari]. It has been an age since I have attended a mortal wedding, let alone participated in one... I require your wisdom.
french: [Ari], cela fait une éternité que je n'ai pas assisté à un mariage de mortels, sans même parler d'y participer... J'ai besoin de tes lumières.
bulgarian: [Ari]. It has been an age since I have attended a mortal wedding, let alone participated in one... I require your wisdom.

english: What flavor of $cake$ shall we serve at our reception?
french: Quel $gâteau$ veux-tu servir à notre repas de mariage ?
bulgarian: What flavor of $cake$ shall we serve at our reception?

english: Vanilla!
french: Un gâteau à la vanille !
bulgarian: Vanilla!

english: Chocolate!
french: Un gâteau au chocolat !
bulgarian: Chocolate!

english: Spellfruit!
french: Un gâteau à l'ensorcelle !
bulgarian: Spellfruit!

english: I will inform Darcy we are to have a =Spellfruit= cake. Surely she will rise to the occasion.
french: Je vais informer Darcy que nous servirons un gâteau à l'=ensorcelle=. Je ne doute pas qu'elle sera à la hauteur.
bulgarian: I will inform Darcy we are to have a =Spellfruit= cake. Surely she will rise to the occasion.

english: $Vanilla Cake$? With buttercream frosting? And little buttercream florets?
french: Un $gâteau à la vanille$ ? Avec un glaçage au beurre ? Et des décorations faites à la poche à douille ?
bulgarian: $Vanilla Cake$? With buttercream frosting? And little buttercream florets?

english: How classic. Such a confection sounds delightful.
french: C'est un grand classique, mais ce choix me convient parfaitement.
bulgarian: How classic. Such a confection sounds delightful.

english: Yes... we shall have $Vanilla Cake$ for our celebration. Darcy will be made aware.
french: Oui, fêtons notre union avec un $gâteau à la vanille$. Je vais en informer Darcy.
bulgarian: Yes... we shall have $Vanilla Cake$ for our celebration. Darcy will be made aware.

english: $Chocolate Cake$? With chocolate ganache frosting? And edible flowers adorning it?
french: Un $gâteau au chocolat$ ? Recouvert d'une ganache au chocolat ? Et orné de fleurs comestibles ?
bulgarian: $Chocolate Cake$? With chocolate ganache frosting? And edible flowers adorning it?

english: Such a confection will surely thrill and delight.
french: Une telle pâtisserie ravira sans nul doute nos convives.
bulgarian: Such a confection will surely thrill and delight.

english: Yes... we shall have $Chocolate Cake$ for our celebration. Darcy will be made aware.
french: Oui, fêtons notre union avec un $gâteau au chocolat$. Je vais en informer Darcy.
bulgarian: Yes... we shall have $Chocolate Cake$ for our celebration. Darcy will be made aware.

english: =Spellfruit= cake? What a fine suggestion...
french: Un gâteau à l'=ensorcelle= ? Quel raffinement !
bulgarian: =Spellfruit= cake? What a fine suggestion...

english: Such a cake is sure to be delicious, as well as auspicious.
french: Ce gâteau sera certainement délicieux et de bon augure.
bulgarian: Such a cake is sure to be delicious, as well as auspicious.

english: [Ari]. The time has come to make a gravely important decision...
french: [Ari], l'heure est venue de prendre une décision de la plus haute importance...
bulgarian: [Ari]. The time has come to make a gravely important decision...

english: As such... what sort of $meal$ shall we serve at our reception?
french: Ainsi, quel $plat$ veux-tu que nous servions lors de la réception ?
bulgarian: As such... what sort of $meal$ shall we serve at our reception?

english: Harvest Plate!
french: Une assiette des récoltes !
bulgarian: Harvest Plate!

english: Mushroom Steak Dinner!
french: Un plat de pleurotes !
bulgarian: Mushroom Steak Dinner!

english: Monster Mash!
french: De la bouillie de monstre !
bulgarian: Monster Mash!

english: Yes, we shall serve $Monster Mash$. Reina will be made aware of our decision.
french: C'est décidé, nous servirons de la $bouillie de monstre$. Reina sera tenue informée de notre choix.
bulgarian: Yes, we shall serve $Monster Mash$. Reina will be made aware of our decision.

english: $Harvest Plate$? Yes, this is a good choice.
french: Une $assiette des récoltes$ ? Oui, c'est un très bon choix.
bulgarian: $Harvest Plate$? Yes, this is a good choice.

english: Such a dish showcases the finest that Mistria has to offer. It is sure to impress.
french: Un tel plat offre tout ce que Mistria a de meilleur. Il devrait impressionner nos convives.
bulgarian: Such a dish showcases the finest that Mistria has to offer. It is sure to impress.

english: Yes, we shall serve $Harvest plate$. Reina will be made aware of our decision.
french: C'est décidé, nous servirons une $assiette des récoltes$. Reina sera tenue informée de notre choix.
bulgarian: Yes, we shall serve $Harvest plate$. Reina will be made aware of our decision.

english: $Mushroom Steak Dinner$? Yes, this is a fine choice.
french: Un $plat de pleurotes$ ? Oui, c'est un choix très raffiné.
bulgarian: $Mushroom Steak Dinner$? Yes, this is a fine choice.

english: Such a plate is both impressive and elegant. A meal fit for a queen.
french: Un mets à la fois impressionnant et élégant. Un repas digne d'une reine.
bulgarian: Such a plate is both impressive and elegant. A meal fit for a queen.

english: Yes, we shall serve $Mushroom Steak Dinner$. Reina will be made aware of our decision.
french: C'est décidé, nous servirons un $plat de pleurotes$. Reina sera tenue informée de notre choix.
bulgarian: Yes, we shall serve $Mushroom Steak Dinner$. Reina will be made aware of our decision.

english: [Ari]! You are also a connoisseur of the subtleties of $Monster Mash$?
french: [Ari] ! Ainsi, toi aussi, tu as le palais assez fin pour apprécier la finesse de la $bouillie de monstre$ ?
bulgarian: [Ari]! You are also a connoisseur of the subtleties of $Monster Mash$?

english: We are truly well-matched.
french: Nous sommes vraiment des âmes sœurs.
bulgarian: We are truly well-matched.

english: [Ari]. Any decision about our wedding must be made as a united front. Strong and resolute.
french: [Ari], chacune des décisions portant sur ce mariage doit être faite d'une seule voix, une voix ferme et commune.
bulgarian: [Ari]. Any decision about our wedding must be made as a united front. Strong and resolute.

english: Are you nervous?
french: Appréhendes-tu ?
bulgarian: Are you nervous?

english: Are you?
french: Et toi ?
bulgarian: Are you?

english: A little bit. I want everything to go smoothly.
french: Un peu. Je veux que tout se passe bien.
bulgarian: A little bit. I want everything to go smoothly.

english: About joining with you in matrimony? Never.
french: D'être unie à toi par les liens du mariage ? Jamais.
bulgarian: About joining with you in matrimony? Never.

english: I do not hesitate to pursue the things I desire.
french: Je ne renonce jamais quand je désire quelque chose.
bulgarian: I do not hesitate to pursue the things I desire.

english: No, it is not nervousness I feel...
french: Non, je ne ressens aucune appréhension...
bulgarian: No, it is not nervousness I feel...

english: It is exhilaration.
french: Plutôt une certaine exaltation.
bulgarian: It is exhilaration.

english: As do I. But [Ari]...
french: Moi aussi. Mais [Ari]...
bulgarian: As do I. But [Ari]...

english: Even if things do not go smoothly, we will be together.
french: Même si tout ne se passe pas comme prévu, nous serons ensemble.
bulgarian: Even if things do not go smoothly, we will be together.

english: No matter what happens, I will take your hand in mine, and we will join our light...
french: Quoi qu'il advienne, je te prendrai la main et nous unirons nos lumières...
bulgarian: No matter what happens, I will take your hand in mine, and we will join our light...

english: And if chaos comes, we will revel in it together.
french: Et si le chaos se répandait, nous l'affronterions ensemble.
bulgarian: And if chaos comes, we will revel in it together.

english: It is the eve of our ceremony, [Ari].
french: C'est la veille de notre union, [Ari].
bulgarian: It is the eve of our ceremony, [Ari].

english: I'm so distracted that I can barely get any work done.
french: J'ai tellement la tête ailleurs que j'arrive à peine à travailler.
bulgarian: I'm so distracted that I can barely get any work done.

english: Perhaps I can treat wedding planning as a research project...
french: Je devrais peut-être considérer les préparatifs du mariage comme des travaux de recherche...
bulgarian: Perhaps I can treat wedding planning as a research project...

english: Yes! I'll begin compiling notes.
french: Oui ! Je vais commencer à rassembler des notes.
bulgarian: Yes! I'll begin compiling notes.

english: I can't find words to express how excited I am for our wedding...
french: Les mots me manquent pour dire à quel point je suis heureuse de ce mariage...
bulgarian: I can't find words to express how excited I am for our wedding...

english: What color $flowers$ should we have at our ceremony?
french: Que devons-nous choisir comme couleur de $fleurs$ pour la cérémonie ?
bulgarian: What color $flowers$ should we have at our ceremony?

english: Red flowers!
french: Des fleurs rouges !
bulgarian: Red flowers!

english: White flowers!
french: Des fleurs blanches !
bulgarian: White flowers!

english: Lavender flowers!
french: Des fleurs violettes !
bulgarian: Lavender flowers!

english: $Red flowers$? How romantic... the color of both the metaphorical and literal heart.
french: Des $fleurs rouges$ ? C'est si romantique... La couleur du cœur, tant dans la littérature qu'en médecine.
bulgarian: $Red flowers$? How romantic... the color of both the metaphorical and literal heart.

english: A pragmatic choice. I'll make sure Celine knows we've chosen $red$.
french: C'est un choix avisé. Je vais dire à Céline que nous voulons du $rouge$.
bulgarian: A pragmatic choice. I'll make sure Celine knows we've chosen $red$.

english: $White flowers$? How elegant... there's something so classic about it.
french: Des $fleurs blanches$ ? C'est très élégant... Et il y a aussi une touche classique.
bulgarian: $White flowers$? How elegant... there's something so classic about it.

english: A pragmatic choice. I'll make sure Celine knows we've chosen $white$.
french: C'est un choix avisé. Je vais dire à Céline que nous voulons du $blanc$.
bulgarian: A pragmatic choice. I'll make sure Celine knows we've chosen $white$.

english: $Lavender flowers$? What a lovely suggestion...
french: Des $fleurs violettes$ ? Quelle merveilleuse idée !
bulgarian: $Lavender flowers$? What a lovely suggestion...

english: Ah. Did you choose that color because you know I'm partial to it?
french: Ah, as-tu choisi cette couleur parce que tu sais que je l'adore ?
bulgarian: Ah. Did you choose that color because you know I'm partial to it?

english: I'm touched. I'll make sure Celine knows we've chosen $lavender$.
french: Je suis touchée. Je vais dire à Céline que nous voulons des $fleurs violettes$.
bulgarian: I'm touched. I'll make sure Celine knows we've chosen $lavender$.

english: [Ari]! There's an important issue that I can't possibly decide alone...
french: [Ari] ! J'ai absolument besoin de ton avis pour une décision capitale...
bulgarian: [Ari]! There's an important issue that I can't possibly decide alone...

english: What sort of $cake$ should we serve at the reception?
french: Quel genre de $gâteau$ veux-tu servir en dessert ?
bulgarian: What sort of $cake$ should we serve at the reception?

english: Vanilla!
french: Un gâteau à la vanille !
bulgarian: Vanilla!

english: Chocolate!
french: Un gâteau au chocolat !
bulgarian: Chocolate!

english: Rose Hip cake!
french: Un gâteau à l'églantine !
bulgarian: Rose Hip cake!

english: It sounds wonderful. I'll make certain Darcy knows we've decided on =Rose Hip= cake.
french: C'est une merveilleuse idée. Je vais prévenir Darcy que nous avons choisi le gâteau à l'=églantine=.
bulgarian: It sounds wonderful. I'll make certain Darcy knows we've decided on =Rose Hip= cake.

english: $Vanilla Cake$? With buttercream frosting?
french: Un $gâteau à la vanille$ ? Avec un glaçage au beurre ?
bulgarian: $Vanilla Cake$? With buttercream frosting?

english: Yes, that sounds lovely. Traditions exist for a reason, after all... I'm certain everyone will love it.
french: Oui, ça me paraît bien. Les traditions n'existent pas pour rien, après tout... Je suis sûre que ça plaira à tout le monde.
bulgarian: Yes, that sounds lovely. Traditions exist for a reason, after all... I'm certain everyone will love it.

english: Perfect. I'll make certain Darcy knows we've decided on $Vanilla Cake$.
french: Parfait. Je vais prévenir Darcy que nous avons choisi le $gâteau à la vanille$.
bulgarian: Perfect. I'll make certain Darcy knows we've decided on $Vanilla Cake$.

english: $Chocolate Cake$? The type with a ganache coating?
french: Un $gâteau au chocolat$ ? Recouvert d'une sorte de ganache ?
bulgarian: $Chocolate Cake$? The type with a ganache coating?

english: Yes, that's certain to be a crowd-pleaser. I doubt we'll have any leftovers to bring home.
french: Oui, ça devrait faire plaisir au plus grand nombre. À mon avis, il n'en restera pas une miette à la fin de la réception.
bulgarian: Yes, that's certain to be a crowd-pleaser. I doubt we'll have any leftovers to bring home.

english: Perfect. I'll make certain Darcy knows we've decided on $Chocolate Cake$.
french: Parfait. Je vais prévenir Darcy que nous avons choisi le $gâteau au chocolat$.
bulgarian: Perfect. I'll make certain Darcy knows we've decided on $Chocolate Cake$.

english: Oh! =Rose Hip= cake?
french: Oh ! Un gâteau à l'=églantine= ?
bulgarian: Oh! =Rose Hip= cake?

english: How did you know that's one of my very favorite flavors? That type of cake isn't so common here... I haven't had it in ages.
french: Comment sais-tu que c'est un de mes parfums préférés ? Ce n'est pas un gâteau très répandu par ici... Je n'en ai pas mangé depuis des lustres.
bulgarian: How did you know that's one of my very favorite flavors? That type of cake isn't so common here... I haven't had it in ages.

english: [Ari], I have a confession to make. My knowledge of desserts is actually quite poor... I'm in need of your expertise.
french: [Ari], j'ai une confession à te faire. Je n'y connais pas grand-chose en desserts, alors j'ai besoin de ton aide.
bulgarian: [Ari], I have a confession to make. My knowledge of desserts is actually quite poor... I'm in need of your expertise.

english: What sort of $meal$ would you like to serve at the reception?
french: Quel $plat$ aimerais-tu servir à nos convives ?
bulgarian: What sort of $meal$ would you like to serve at the reception?

english: Harvest Plate!
french: Une assiette des récoltes !
bulgarian: Harvest Plate!

english: Mushroom Steak Dinner!
french: Un plat de pleurotes !
bulgarian: Mushroom Steak Dinner!

english: Rosemary Garlic Noodles!
french: Des nouilles à l'ail et au romarin !
bulgarian: Rosemary Garlic Noodles!

english: Wonderful. I'll pass on to Reina that we've selected the =Rosemary Garlic Noodles=.
french: Merveilleux. Je vais dire à Reina que nous servirons des =nouilles à l'ail et au romarin=.
bulgarian: Wonderful. I'll pass on to Reina that we've selected the =Rosemary Garlic Noodles=.

english: Ah, one of my favorites! I enjoy a nice =Harvest Plate=.
french: Ah, c'est un de mes plats préférés ! J'adore l'=assiette des récoltes=.
bulgarian: Ah, one of my favorites! I enjoy a nice =Harvest Plate=.

english: It's festive, and it shows off the best Mistria has to offer. Perfect for a celebration.
french: C'est un plat de fête qui met en valeur ce que Mistria offre de mieux. C'est parfait pour un mariage.
bulgarian: It's festive, and it shows off the best Mistria has to offer. Perfect for a celebration.

english: Wonderful. I'll pass on to Reina that we've selected the =Harvest Plate=.
french: Merveilleux. Je vais dire à Reina que nous servirons une =assiette des récoltes=.
bulgarian: Wonderful. I'll pass on to Reina that we've selected the =Harvest Plate=.

english: $Mushroom Steak Dinner$? Yes, an excellent choice.
french: Un $plat de pleurotes$ ? C'est un excellent choix, oui.
bulgarian: $Mushroom Steak Dinner$? Yes, an excellent choice.

english: It's the kind of dish that's as lovely to look at as it is to eat.
french: C'est le genre de plat aussi agréable à regarder qu'à déguster.
bulgarian: It's the kind of dish that's as lovely to look at as it is to eat.

english: Wonderful. I'll pass on to Reina that we've selected the $Mushroom Steak Dinner$.
french: Merveilleux. Je vais dire à Reina que nous servirons un $plat de pleurotes$.
bulgarian: Wonderful. I'll pass on to Reina that we've selected the $Mushroom Steak Dinner$.

english: Oh! You'd like to serve =Rosemary Garlic Noodles=?
french: Oh ! Tu veux qu'on serve des =nouilles à l'ail et au romarin= ?
bulgarian: Oh! You'd like to serve =Rosemary Garlic Noodles=?

english: It's one of my favorite dishes from childhood... I think it's something everyone can enjoy.
french: C'était l'un de mes plats préférés quand j'étais enfant... Je crois que ça plaira à tout le monde.
bulgarian: It's one of my favorite dishes from childhood... I think it's something everyone can enjoy.

english: There are so many steps to planning a wedding, aren't there? We have another decision to make...
french: Il y a beaucoup de choses à préparer pour un mariage, pas vrai ? D'ailleurs, nous avons un dernier choix à faire...
bulgarian: There are so many steps to planning a wedding, aren't there? We have another decision to make...

english: Everything's in order, and yet... I'm a little nervous.
french: Tout est prêt, et pourtant... j'appréhende un peu.
bulgarian: Everything's in order, and yet... I'm a little nervous.

english: Nervous? Why?
french: Tu appréhendes ? Pourquoi ?
bulgarian: Nervous? Why?

english: Don't worry... it takes two to get married.
french: Ne t'inquiète pas... Moi aussi, je me marie.
bulgarian: Don't worry... it takes two to get married.

english: I suppose it's a matter of circumstance and biology.
french: J'imagine que c'est une réaction corporelle normale.
bulgarian: I suppose it's a matter of circumstance and biology.

english: But telling you what I'm feeling soothes me. Thank you for asking.
french: Mais je me sens déjà soulagée de t'en avoir parlé. Merci de m'avoir posé la question.
bulgarian: But telling you what I'm feeling soothes me. Thank you for asking.

english: Looking at you soothes me too... and tomorrow, you'll be the only thing I see.
french: Te regarder m'aide à me détendre... et demain, je ne verrai que toi.
bulgarian: Looking at you soothes me too... and tomorrow, you'll be the only thing I see.

english: I can't wait.
french: J'ai tellement hâte.
bulgarian: I can't wait.

english: Is that your way of saying you'll be right next to me?
french: Est-ce ta façon de me dire que tu seras là pour m'épauler ?
bulgarian: Is that your way of saying you'll be right next to me?

english: It is... logical. And thus, reassuring.
french: C'est... logique. Et donc, rassurant.
bulgarian: It is... logical. And thus, reassuring.

english: Thank you, [Ari]. You're right. Tomorrow, we'll get married...
french: Merci, [Ari]. Tu as raison. Demain, c'est le grand jour...
bulgarian: Thank you, [Ari]. You're right. Tomorrow, we'll get married...

english: Together.
french: Pour nous deux.
bulgarian: Together.

english: Our wedding is tomorrow...
french: C'est demain que nous nous marions...
bulgarian: Our wedding is tomorrow...

english: Not at all! I'll make arrangements so they all arrive at their proper destinations.
french: Non, pas du tout ! Je veillerai à ce qu'elles arrivent toutes à bon port.
russian: Вовсе нет! Я позабочусь, чтобы каждое письмо нашло своего адресата.
bulgarian: Not at all! I'll make arrangements so they all arrive at their proper destinations.

english: I have some letters here for various people in the Capital. I hope this isn't too many!
french: J'ai plusieurs lettres pour des habitants de la capitale. J'espère que ça n'en fait pas trop !
russian: Я тут приготовила письма для разных людей в столице. Это же не слишком много?
bulgarian: I have some letters here for various people in the Capital. I hope this isn't too many!

english: It's great for the local economy, and the entire town really looks forward to it!
french: C'est très bon pour l'économie locale, et les habitants adorent y flâner.
russian: Во-первых, он поднимает местную экономику. Во-вторых, все горожане каждую неделю его ждут!
bulgarian: It's great for the local economy, and the entire town really looks forward to it!

english: I know I sure do! I don't know how I got through the week without Darcy's =Coffee=!
french: Oui, et moi aussi ! Je ne sais pas comment j'ai réussi à tenir toute la semaine sans le =café= de Darcy !
russian: Да, я точно жду! Не знаю, как бы я протянула неделю без =кофе= Дарси!
bulgarian: I know I sure do! I don't know how I got through the week without Darcy's =Coffee=!

english: After a few seasons, it's fair to say that the Saturday Market is better than ever.
french: Après quelques saisons, on peut dire que le marché du samedi est un vrai succès.
russian: Субботний базар пережил уже несколько сезонов, и можно точно сказать, что дела у него идут отлично.
bulgarian: After a few seasons, it's fair to say that the Saturday Market is better than ever.

english: Got it. I'll let March know...
french: Entendu. Je préviendrai March...
russian: Понятно. Тогда я попрошу Марта...
bulgarian: Got it. I'll let March know...

english: I've got another shipment coming in, but I'm afraid nails aren't on the manifest.
french: J'attends un autre arrivage, mais je ne vois pas de clous sur le bon de commande.
russian: Новый заказ скоро приедет, но, к сожалению, гвоздей в этой поставке нет.
bulgarian: I've got another shipment coming in, but I'm afraid nails aren't on the manifest.

english: I'm attached to my wagon, Adeline. That's four walls, a roof, and wheels!
french: Je suis habitué à mon chariot, Adeline. Il a quatre murs, un toit et, pour ne rien gâcher, des roues !
russian: Мне по душе мой фургон, Аделина. Тут тоже отдельная крыша и ещё четыре колеса в придачу!
bulgarian: I'm attached to my wagon, Adeline. That's four walls, a roof, and wheels!

english: You really don't want a permanent storefront here? With four walls and a roof?
french: Ça ne te dirait vraiment pas d'avoir une boutique en dur ? Avec quatre murs et un toit ?
russian: Уверен, что не хочешь открыть у нас постоянную лавку? Будешь торговать под отдельной крышей.
bulgarian: You really don't want a permanent storefront here? With four walls and a roof?

english: Glad I folded early. My merchant's instinct was whispering to me.
french: Heureusement que je m'étais couché avant. Mon flair de marchand ne m'a pas trompé.
russian: Хорошо, что я рано ушёл в пас. Чутьё торговца не обмануло.
bulgarian: Glad I folded early. My merchant's instinct was whispering to me.

english: I really thought Adeline was going to take it! How did you know, Celine?
french: Je pensais vraiment que c'était Adeline qui allait gagner ! Comment tu as fait, Céline ?
russian: Я была уверена, что Аделина заберёт банк! Как ты догадалась, Селин?
bulgarian: I really thought Adeline was going to take it! How did you know, Celine?

english: I kind of got the feeling Adeline was keeping her cards in order, but she didn't rearrange them when she got her last card!
french: J'ai eu l'impression que les cartes d'Adeline étaient rangées dans l'ordre, et elle ne les a pas réorganisées quand elle a eu la dernière !
russian: У меня было чувство, что Аделина держит карты по порядку. Но она не меняла порядок, когда взяла последнюю карту!
bulgarian: I kind of got the feeling Adeline was keeping her cards in order, but she didn't rearrange them when she got her last card!

english: Oh gosh... am I too organized?
french: Mince... Serais-je trop bien organisée ?
russian: Ну и ну! Выходит, я слишком аккуратная...
bulgarian: Oh gosh... am I too organized?

english: Celine wins! Wow, that was a nail-biter.
french: Et c'est Céline qui gagne ! La partie était drôlement tendue.
russian: Селин выиграла! Ух, напряжённая была партия!
bulgarian: Celine wins! Wow, that was a nail-biter.

english: I've got a silk scarf from the Capital.
french: Moi, je joue une écharpe en soie de la capitale.
russian: С меня столичный шёлковый платок.
bulgarian: I've got a silk scarf from the Capital.

english: I'll see that and bet you the first flush tea from my own garden.
french: Je suis, et je parie le thé de printemps de mon jardin.
russian: Ну, раз так, я поставлю чай из первого урожая в моём садике.
bulgarian: I'll see that and bet you the first flush tea from my own garden.

english: I'll put up a free breakfast!
french: Moi, je renchéris d'un petit-déjeuner gratuit !
russian: Ставлю бесплатный завтрак!
bulgarian: I'll put up a free breakfast!

english: And I'll take the whole pot! Read 'em and weep, guys and gals.
french: Et moi, je repars avec le pot ! Vous pouvez pleurer, mesdames et messieurs.
russian: А я заберу этот чудный банк! Кусайте локти, дамы и господа!
bulgarian: And I'll take the whole pot! Read 'em and weep, guys and gals.

english: Okay, so to review, I'm betting a dozen roses from the manor garden.
french: Bien, récapitulons. Je parie un bouquet de roses des jardins de manoir.
russian: Итак, повторим ещё раз. Я ставлю дюжину роз из сада особняка.
bulgarian: Okay, so to review, I'm betting a dozen roses from the manor garden.

english: I think it's high time for me to fold.
french: Moi, je me couche.
russian: Я думаю, самое время мне пасовать.
bulgarian: I think it's high time for me to fold.

english: Hmm. I think Celine's got a winning hand.
french: Mmm. Je crois que Céline a une bonne main.
russian: Хмм, кажется, у Селин сильная рука.
bulgarian: Hmm. I think Celine's got a winning hand.

english: Why would you think that!
french: Pourquoi dis-tu ça ?
russian: Почему ты так думаешь?
bulgarian: Why would you think that!

english: My cards are so bad! The worst!
french: J'ai un jeu horrible ! Vraiment !
russian: У меня просто ужасные карты! Хуже не бывает!
bulgarian: My cards are so bad! The worst!

english: Ummm... yeah, I'm out too.
french: Euh... OK, je me couche aussi.
russian: Ууу... пожалуй, я тоже пас.
bulgarian: Ummm... yeah, I'm out too.

english: So, how're we feeling? Any raises?
french: Alors, vous le sentez comment ? Quelqu'un relance ?
russian: Что думаете? Кто-то будет повышать?
bulgarian: So, how're we feeling? Any raises?

english: That was so exciting!
french: C'était fantastique !
russian: Какой потрясающий рассказ!
bulgarian: That was so exciting!

english: And stressful.
french: Et stressant.
russian: И тревожный.
bulgarian: And stressful.

english: So stressful!
french: Oui, vraiment stressant !
russian: Ещё какой тревожный!
bulgarian: So stressful!

english: What a tale! We should have you over for dinner more often, Balor.
french: Quelle histoire ! Nous devrions t'inviter à dîner plus souvent, Balor.
russian: Вот это история! Надо почаще приглашать тебя на ужин, Балор.
bulgarian: What a tale! We should have you over for dinner more often, Balor.

english: And that's the story of how I won a most dangerous game of cards, with my very life on the line.
french: Et c'est ainsi que j'ai gagné une partie de cartes déterminante. J'ai presque joué ma vie.
russian: Вот так я выиграл самую опасную партию в карты, поставив на кон свою жизнь.
bulgarian: And that's the story of how I won a most dangerous game of cards, with my very life on the line.

english: Is there one on the board that might suit my abilities?
french: Y en a-t-il une sur le panneau qui serait à la hauteur de mes facultés ?
russian: Найдётся ли на доске прошений задача мне по способностям?
bulgarian: Is there one on the board that might suit my abilities?

english: Let me see... how are you at smelting?
french: Voyons voir... Vous savez fondre du métal ?
russian: Давай посмотрим... Как ты относишься к плавлению металла?
bulgarian: Let me see... how are you at smelting?

english: The best word for it would likely be... incapable.
french: Je crains que mes compétences en ce domaine soient... nulles.
russian: Вернее всего будет сказать... не способен.
bulgarian: The best word for it would likely be... incapable.

english: And how is your logging ability?
french: Et couper du bois, vous savez faire ?
russian: А умеешь ли ты рубить дрова?
bulgarian: And how is your logging ability?

english: One could say... poor.
french: Je... n'excelle pas dans cette activité.
russian: Я бы сказал... едва ли.
bulgarian: One could say... poor.

english: In that case... I'll keep you in the loop when something else comes up!
french: Dans ce cas... dès que j'aurai une requête qui vous convient, je vous la réserverai !
russian: В таком случае... Я тебе сообщу, если понадобится что-нибудь ещё!
bulgarian: In that case... I'll keep you in the loop when something else comes up!

english: Lady Adeline... I would like to fulfill a request, if you are amenable.
french: Dame Adeline... Je souhaite répondre à une requête, si cela vous sied.
russian: Леди Аделина... Я бы хотел выполнить прошение, если вы не против.
bulgarian: Lady Adeline... I would like to fulfill a request, if you are amenable.

english: You... do?
french: M'avouer... quelque chose ?
russian: И... в чём же?
bulgarian: You... do?

english: Yes. As I understand it, all requests must go through the request board, and you.
french: Oui. D'après ce que je comprends, vous devez valider toutes les requêtes, puis elles doivent être publiées sur le panneau.
russian: Насколько мне известно, все прошения должны подаваться через доску прошений и через вас.
bulgarian: Yes. As I understand it, all requests must go through the request board, and you.

english: During my time recovering in the Deep Woods, I confess that I bypassed the board and sent my requests directly to Balor.
french: Lorsque j'étais en convalescence à Boissombre, je reconnais que j'envoyais toutes mes demandes directement à Balor, sans passer par le panneau.
russian: Признаюсь, что во время моего выздоровления в Глубокой чаще я отправлял прошения Балору напрямую, минуя доску.
bulgarian: During my time recovering in the Deep Woods, I confess that I bypassed the board and sent my requests directly to Balor.

english: Oh. That's totally fine, Caldarus! I'm just glad you got what you needed.
french: Oh. Ne vous en faites pas pour ça, Caldarus ! Je suis juste contente de savoir que vous avez reçu ce dont vous aviez besoin.
russian: О, Кальдарус, это не страшно! Я рада, что тебе удалось добыть, что ты просил.
bulgarian: Oh. That's totally fine, Caldarus! I'm just glad you got what you needed.

english: I am prepared to accept whatever punishment you decide.
french: Je suis prêt à accepter n'importe quel châtiment qui vous semblera juste.
russian: Я готов принять любое наказание, что вы пожелаете.
bulgarian: I am prepared to accept whatever punishment you decide.

english: That's not really how I do things...
french: Ce n'est pas vraiment ma façon de procéder...
russian: Это совсем не мой подход...
bulgarian: That's not really how I do things...

english: Adeline, I have a confession to make.
french: Adeline, il faut que je vous avoue quelque chose.
russian: Аделина, я должен вам признаться.
bulgarian: Adeline, I have a confession to make.

english: It is like a well-tended garden.
french: C'est comme un jardin bien entretenu.
russian: С вами город напоминает ухоженный сад.
bulgarian: It is like a well-tended garden.

english: Oh! No one's ever put it like that before...
french: Oh ! Je n'avais encore jamais entendu cette métaphore...
russian: Ой! Никто ещё не делал таких сравнений...
bulgarian: Oh! No one's ever put it like that before...

english: Thank you, Caldarus!
french: Merci, Caldarus !
russian: Спасибо, Кальдарус!
bulgarian: Thank you, Caldarus!

english: Lady Adeline, I have great admiration for your diligence in caring for the town and the people who reside within.
french: Dame Adeline, j'admire profondément votre dévouement, la façon dont vous prenez soin de la ville et de ses habitants.
russian: Леди Аделина, я глубоко восхищаюсь вашей усердной заботой о городе и всех его обитателях.
bulgarian: Lady Adeline, I have great admiration for your diligence in caring for the town and the people who reside within.

english: Just because it's not happening, doesn't mean we can't hang out!
french: Ce n'est pas parce qu'il n'a plus lieu qu'on ne peut pas se promener sur la place !
russian: Ну и что, что его больше нет? Мы можем выбраться поболтать и без Рынка.
bulgarian: Just because it's not happening, doesn't mean we can't hang out!

english: I miss getting my hair done by a pro... Olric gets a little too excited with the scissors.
french: Ça me manque de me faire couper les cheveux par une professionnelle... Olric a le coup de ciseaux facile.
russian: Я соскучился по профессиональной стрижке... Ольрик слишком резво орудует ножницами.
bulgarian: I miss getting my hair done by a pro... Olric gets a little too excited with the scissors.

english: [Ari] and I are working on it!
french: [Ari] et moi allons remédier à cela !
russian: [Ari] и я уже работаем над этим!
bulgarian: [Ari] and I are working on it!

english: Can't wait!
french: J'ai hâte !
russian: Жду не дождусь!
bulgarian: Can't wait!

english: Hi [Ari]! We were just reminiscing about the Saturday Market!
french: Bonjour, [Ari] ! Nous étions en train de parler du marché du samedi !
russian: Привет, [Ari]! Мы тут вспоминаем, что было на Субботнем базаре.
bulgarian: Hi [Ari]! We were just reminiscing about the Saturday Market!

english: It's my pleasure! I'm already planning next season's arrangement.
french: Avec plaisir ! Je suis déjà en train de réfléchir aux fleurs que je planterai la saison prochaine.
russian: Не за что! Мне это только в радость. Я уже планирую рассадку цветов на следующий сезон.
bulgarian: It's my pleasure! I'm already planning next season's arrangement.

english: Nice. I'll have to come take a look.
french: Bien, il faudra que je vienne voir ça.
russian: Отлично, я зайду посмотреть.
bulgarian: Nice. I'll have to come take a look.

english: March likes flowers? I wouldn't have guessed that.
french: March aime les fleurs ? Je n'aurais pas cru.
russian: Март любит цветы? Никогда бы не подумала.
bulgarian: March likes flowers? I wouldn't have guessed that.

english: He makes them out of metal, actually.
french: En fait, il en fait des reproductions en métal.
russian: На самом деле он куёт металлические.
bulgarian: He makes them out of metal, actually.

english: Ah, so they never wilt. That's rather practical, isn't it?
french: Ah, elles ne fanent jamais, alors ? C'est une bonne idée.
russian: О, зато они не завянут. Весьма практично, правда?
bulgarian: Ah, so they never wilt. That's rather practical, isn't it?

english: The manor garden's lovely this season, Celine! Thank you so much for looking after it.
french: Les jardins du manoir sont magnifiques cette saison, Céline ! Merci beaucoup de t'en occuper.
russian: Наш семейный сад выглядит просто чудесно! Спасибо, Селин, что ухаживаешь за ним.
bulgarian: The manor garden's lovely this season, Celine! Thank you so much for looking after it.

english: [Ari] always stops by my cottage, so polite...
french: Et aimable ! [Ari] s'arrête toujours pour un petit coucou à la maison...
russian:
[Ari]

такие внимательные

такая внимательнаятакой внимательныйтакое внимательное, часто

навещаетнавещаетнавещает меня дома...
bulgarian: [Ari] always stops by my cottage, so polite...

english: [Ari]'s always helping with my postings on the quest board... so helpful...

помогаетпомогаетпомогает мне с прошениями, которые я оставляю на доске...

english: You're both so shy, it's just between us!
french: Arrêtez de faire les timides, on est entre nous !
russian: Вы такие застенчивые, пускай это будет между нами!
bulgarian: You're both so shy, it's just between us!

english: Hee hee!
french: Hi hi !
russian: Хи-хи!
bulgarian: Hee hee!

english: OH HELLO [ARI]. WE WERE JUST TALKING ABOUT. THE REQUEST BOARD.
french: OH, C'EST TOI, [ARI] ! ON PARLAIT JUSTEMENT... DU PANNEAU DES QUÊTES.
russian: О, ПРИВЕТ, [Ari]. МЫ КАК РАЗ ОБСУЖДАЛИ ДОСКУ ПРОШЕНИЙ.
bulgarian: OH HELLO [ARI]. WE WERE JUST TALKING ABOUT. THE REQUEST BOARD.

english: -is pretty cute, right?

russian:
...очень

приятные
