russian: Ольрик, я и сам могу добыть руду. Не понимаю, зачем нам ещё [Ari].
bulgarian: I can get the ore myself, Olric. I don't see why we have to let [Ari] do it.

english: Shush, bro. I forget how this one ends.
french: Chut. Je ne me rappelle plus comment elle finit.

english: You don't have to repeat that to everyone!

russian: Незачем всюду об этом кричать!
bulgarian: You don't have to repeat that to everyone!

english: A tidy shop is the key to a tidy profit! That's the wisdom of my lil bro!
french: Une boutique bien rangée, ce sont des bénéfices assurés ! C'est un dicton de mon petit frère !
russian: В чистой лавке — чистая прибыль! Вот мудрые слова от моего братишки!
bulgarian: A tidy shop is the key to a tidy profit! That's the wisdom of my lil bro!

english: Old habits, I guess!
french: C'est l'habitude, que veux-tu ?!
russian: Эх, старая привычка!
bulgarian: Old habits, I guess!

english: You still swing your hammer like a pickaxe, Olric.
french: Tu continues de manier le marteau comme une pioche, Olric.
russian: Ты до сих пор машешь молотом, будто киркой, Ольрик.
bulgarian: You still swing your hammer like a pickaxe, Olric.

english: They show up super hungry and order half the menu.
french: Ils ont une faim de loup et ils commandent la moitié de la carte.
russian: Приходят голодные как звери и заказывают полменю.
bulgarian: They show up super hungry and order half the menu.

english: Pass the salt, Olric!
french: Passe-moi le sel, Olric !
russian: Передай соль, Ольрик!
bulgarian: Pass the salt, Olric!

english: Trade you for the pepper!
french: D'accord, mais contre le poivre !
russian: Меняю на перец!
bulgarian: Trade you for the pepper!

english: I can always tell when March and Olric have been working the forge.
french: J'arrive toujours à savoir quand March et Olric ont travaillé à la forge.
russian: Я всегда сразу понимаю, когда Март и Ольрик работали в кузнице.
bulgarian: I can always tell when March and Olric have been working the forge.

english: Glad to hear it.
french: Ah, tant mieux.
russian: Рад слышать!
bulgarian: Glad to hear it.

english: If you need a melon baller or a lemon zester, we've got ideas!
french: Si tu as besoin d'une cuillère à melon ou d'une râpe zesteur, on a quelques idées !
russian: Если тебе понадобится ложка для дыни или нож для цедры — обращайся!
bulgarian: If you need a melon baller or a lemon zester, we've got ideas!

english: The silverware you guys made for the Inn has really held up!
french: Les couverts que vous avez fabriqués pour l'auberge sont vraiment solides !
russian: Посуда, которую вы сделали для трактира, до сих пор отлично служит!
bulgarian: The silverware you guys made for the Inn has really held up!

english: Is that so? Well, YOUR work seems nonexistent.
french: Ah oui ? Et on en parle de VOTRE travail !
russian: Ах вот как? А ТВОИ работы вообще не существуют.
bulgarian: Is that so? Well, YOUR work seems nonexistent.

english: Do you even have a job?
french: Vous avez un métier, oui ou non ?
russian: У тебя вообще есть работа?
bulgarian: Do you even have a job?

english: Olric... your brother is an impudent whelp.
french: Olric... votre frère n'est qu'un blanc-bec imprudent.
russian: Ольрик... Твой брат — нахальный щенок.
bulgarian: Olric... your brother is an impudent whelp.

english: He is lucky you are his blood relation.
french: Il a de la chance que vous soyez parents.
russian: Ему повезло, что вы родня по крови.
bulgarian: He is lucky you are his blood relation.

english: Hahaha! People are always saying that!
french: Ha ha ha ! Tout le monde dit la même chose !
russian: Ха-ха-ха! Да все так говорят!
bulgarian: Hahaha! People are always saying that!

english: March. Your personality is wanting, but your work is impressive.
french: March. Votre personnalité laisse à désirer, mais votre travail est impressionnant.
russian: Март. У тебя недостойный характер, но твои работы меня впечатляют.
bulgarian: March. Your personality is wanting, but your work is impressive.

english: Oh yes. Maintaining the body is important when one takes on a mortal form.
french: En effet. Lorsqu'on a une enveloppe charnelle, il est important de prendre soin de son corps.
russian: О, да. Находясь в смертном обличье, очень важно поддерживать тело в форме.
bulgarian: Oh yes. Maintaining the body is important when one takes on a mortal form.

english: You sound... surprisingly like Olric.
french: Vous parlez... comme Olric.
russian: Удивительно... Ты говоришь, почти как Ольрик.
bulgarian: You sound... surprisingly like Olric.

english: Right? We're like twins!
french: Tu as vu ? On fait la paire !
russian: Скажи? Мы просто близнецы!
bulgarian: Right? We're like twins!

english: Olric tells me you two work out together.
french: Olric m'a dit que vous vous entraîniez ensemble, tous les deux.
russian: Ольрик говорит, что вы тренируетесь вместе.
bulgarian: Olric tells me you two work out together.

english: Thank you, Olric. I am merely enjoying the sight of sparks flying.
french: Merci, Olric. Je ne fais qu'admirer la beauté des étincelles virevoltantes.
russian: Спасибо, Ольрик. Я просто любуюсь, как летят искры.
bulgarian: Thank you, Olric. I am merely enjoying the sight of sparks flying.

english: Do you want to try your hand at it, Seri? I have an extra hammer.
french: Vous voulez essayer, Seri ? J'ai un autre marteau.
russian: Хочешь попробовать сама, Сери? У меня есть ещё один молот.
bulgarian: Do you want to try your hand at it, Seri? I have an extra hammer.

english: If you call me Seri again... it will be you on the anvil, young March.
french: Appelez-moi Seri encore une fois et c'est vous qui vous retrouverez sur cette enclume, jeune March.
russian: Если ещё раз назовёшь меня Сери... На наковальне окажется твоя голова, юный Март.
bulgarian: If you call me Seri again... it will be you on the anvil, young March.

english: Let me know if I can help with anything, Seri!
french: Dites-moi si je peux vous aider en quoi que ce soit, Seri !
russian: Скажи, если будет нужна помощь, Сери!
bulgarian: Let me know if I can help with anything, Seri!

english: Why not hold the molten metal in your bare hands and feel its primal energies mingling with your own?
french: Pourquoi ne pas prendre le métal à rouge à mains nues afin de ressentir ses énergies primaires faire corps avec les vôtres ?
russian: Разве не лучше держать раскалённый металл голыми руками, ощущая, как его первобытная энергия смешивается с твоей?
bulgarian: Why not hold the molten metal in your bare hands and feel its primal energies mingling with your own?

english: Oh! That sounds cool!
french: Oh ! Bonne idée !
russian: О! Звучит очень круто!
bulgarian: Oh! That sounds cool!

english: Olric, no!
french: Olric, non !
russian: Ольрик, нет!
bulgarian: Olric, no!

english: When metalworking, why do you wear those gloves?
french: Lorsque vous travaillez le métal, pourquoi portez-vous des gants ?
russian: Зачем вы надеваете эти варежки, когда работаете с металлом?
bulgarian: When metalworking, why do you wear those gloves?

english: Glad to hear it. Just let me know if it stops heating evenly.
french: Ah, tant mieux. Dis-moi si jamais tu trouves que la chaleur ne se diffuse plus uniformément.
russian: Рад слышать. Скажи, если вдруг он перестанет равномерно нагреваться.
bulgarian: Glad to hear it. Just let me know if it stops heating evenly.

english: The big soup cauldron you made for the Inn is holding up great, March!
french: La grosse marmite à soupe que tu as fabriquée pour l'auberge est très résistante, March !
russian: Чан для супа, который ты сделал, просто замечательный, Март!
bulgarian: The big soup cauldron you made for the Inn is holding up great, March!

english: I told Nora I'd just make Dell a sword, but she shut that down so fast.
french: J'avais proposé à Nora de fabriquer une épée pour Dell, mais elle n'avait rien voulu savoir.
russian: Я говорил Норе, что могу просто сделать для Делл меч. Но она наотрез отказалась.
bulgarian: I told Nora I'd just make Dell a sword, but she shut that down so fast.

english: Tch. Look where that got us now.
french: Pfft. Regarde le résultat.
russian: Вот и смотрите, к чему это привело.
bulgarian: Tch. Look where that got us now.

english: March, we need more spoons at the Inn... I think Dell and Maple and Luc keep running off with the utensils to fill their Dragonguard armory.
french: March, on est à court de cuillères à l'auberge. Je crois que Dell, Maple et Luc utilisent nos couverts pour l'armurerie de la Garde des dragons...
russian: Март, нам для трактира нужны ещё ложки... По-моему, Делл, Мэйпл и Люк утаскивают приборы с собой, чтобы собрать оружейную для Драконьей стражи.
bulgarian: March, we need more spoons at the Inn... I think Dell and Maple and Luc keep running off with the utensils to fill their Dragonguard armory.

english: Uh, March...
french: Euh, March...
russian: Ээ, Март...
bulgarian: Uh, March...

french: Je parlais d'un<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they> autre [Ari] !
russian:

другаядругойдругое [Ari]!

english: Why's everyone always talking about [Ari] anyway?
french: Pourquoi est-ce que tout le monde n'en a que pour [Ari] ?
russian: Почему у всех вечно только [Ari] на уме?
bulgarian: Why's everyone always talking about [Ari] anyway?

english: Really? That's cool. He's got a lot of stuff I've never seen when I went thrifting in the Capital.
french: Ah oui ? Super. Il vend plein de vêtements que je n'ai jamais vus dans les friperies de la capitale.
russian: Правда? Круто. В столице я бегал по барахолкам и никогда не видел таких вещей, как у него.
bulgarian: Really? That's cool. He's got a lot of stuff I've never seen when I went thrifting in the Capital.

english: You always stop by his booth when he's in town, don't you? Huh.

english: Louis complimented your style the last time I talked to him at the Saturday Market, Ryis.

russian: Луи хорошо отзывался о твоём стиле, Риз, когда я с ним беседовала на последнем Субботнем базаре.

english: Ugh, you're right.

bulgarian: Ugh, you're right.

english: Let's try it again.

english: For sure.
french: De rien.
russian: Не за что.
bulgarian: For sure.

english: I think we're on the right track, Ryis. Nice work on the calculations.
french: Je crois qu'on est sur la bonne voie, Ryis. Bravo pour les calculs.
russian: Мне кажется, мы на верном пути, Риз. Спасибо за помощь с расчётами.
bulgarian: I think we're on the right track, Ryis. Nice work on the calculations.

english: Not bad...
french: Pas trop mal...
russian: Неплохо...
bulgarian: Not bad...

english: Uncle Landen's still leading most of our projects, despite his "retirement".
french: Oncle Landen continue de diriger la plupart de nos projets, bien qu'il soit « à la retraite ».
russian: Дядя Ланден всё ещё ведёт большинство наших проектов, несмотря на свою «пенсию».
bulgarian: Uncle Landen's still leading most of our projects, despite his "retirement".

english: I wish he'd relax more. Give me a chance to prove I can handle things.
french: J'aimerais qu'il se repose un peu. Ça serait l'occasion pour moi de prouver que je suis capable de gérer les choses.
russian: Хотелось бы, чтобы он побольше отдыхал. Дал мне шанс доказать, что я справлюсь.
bulgarian: I wish he'd relax more. Give me a chance to prove I can handle things.

english: Yeah...
french: Ouais...
russian: Да...
bulgarian: Yeah...

russian: В смысле разве не поэтому он вообще позвал тебя сюда переехать?

english: How are things going at the shop, Ryis?

bulgarian: How are things going at the shop, Ryis?

english: Really good! The bakery's always busy in the winter.
french: À merveille ! La boulangerie est toujours remplie l'hiver.
russian: Замечательно! Зимой в пекарне всегда есть работа.
bulgarian: Really good! The bakery's always busy in the winter.

english: How's your family doing back in the Capital?
french: Comment va ta famille à la capitale ?
russian: Как твоя семья поживает в столице?
bulgarian: How's your family doing back in the Capital?

english: A worn hammer is no good. Come over as soon as you need to replace it.
french: On ne travaille pas bien avec du matériel en mauvais état. Viens me voir et je te le remplacerai.
russian: Старый молот никуда не годится. Зайди ко мне, когда надо будет заменить.
bulgarian: A worn hammer is no good. Come over as soon as you need to replace it.

english: I'll put it at the top of my list.
french: Ça sera en haut de ma liste.
russian: Первым делом займусь.
bulgarian: I'll put it at the top of my list.

english: I might need to replace my hammer soon... it's been putting in a lot of work.
french: Je vais bientôt devoir changer de marteau... Le mien a beaucoup servi.
russian: Возможно, мне скоро будет пора менять молот... Этот уже многое повидал.
bulgarian: I might need to replace my hammer soon... it's been putting in a lot of work.

english: Leaves me in a tough spot.
french: C'est moi qui dois rectifier le tir.
russian: А мне за него отдуваться.
bulgarian: Leaves me in a tough spot.

english: Not a problem, it's my job. Now stand back. You too, [Ari].
french: Ne t'en fais pas, c'est mon boulot. Maintenant, recule. Et toi aussi, [Ari].
russian: Без проблем, это же моя работа. А теперь отойдите. [Ari], тебя тоже касается.
bulgarian: Not a problem, it's my job. Now stand back. You too, [Ari].

english: Thanks for the assist, March. Uncle Landen always starts in on projects without taking inventory.
french: Merci pour ton aide, March. Oncle Landen lance toujours des projets sans savoir si on a tout.
russian: Спасибо, что согласился помочь, Март. Дядя Ланден вечно берётся за работу, не проверив инвентарь.

english: Gonna be okay with all that?

english: No worries. I can handle it.
french: Ne t'en fais pas, je gère.
russian: Я вывезу, не переживай.
bulgarian: No worries. I can handle it.

english: You collected a lot of orders from around town, March.
french: Tu as reçu beaucoup de commandes des habitants de Mistria, March.
russian: Ты по всему городу набрал заказов, Март.
bulgarian: You collected a lot of orders from around town, March.

english: Yeah! Like something adjustable.
french: C'est ça ! Quelque chose qui serait réglable.
russian: Да! С разными регулировками.
bulgarian: Yeah! Like something adjustable.

english: So it's got to have moving parts. Interesting. Let me think on it.

french: Tu as besoin de bois pour des outils ? Pour les manches, par exemple ?

bulgarian: You need wood for tools? Like the handles?

bulgarian: You'll want your hooks to be made with a sturdy metal, but I think blending ores might get you a more flexible fishing rod.

english: I respect the skill it takes to prepare it.

bulgarian: I respect the skill it takes to prepare it.

russian: И на вкус очень даже хорошо.
bulgarian: And it tastes pretty good too.

bulgarian: I didn't take you for the type to enjoy sashimi, March!

russian: Да, но если дело в чихании, то пусть для начала попробует подрезать усы.
bulgarian: I do, but if it's mostly sneezing he might try trimming that mustache first.

english: Holt thinks he might have allergies. Do you have anything for that?
french: Holt pense qu'il est peut-être allergique. Ça se soigne ?
russian: Хольт считает, что у него аллергия. У тебя есть что-то от аллергии?
bulgarian: Holt thinks he might have allergies. Do you have anything for that?

english: Thanks, Valen. You're a lifesaver, as always.
french: Merci, Valen. Tu me sauves la mise, comme toujours.
russian: Спасибо, Вален. Ты, как всегда, выручаешь.
bulgarian: Thanks, Valen. You're a lifesaver, as always.

english: Your ankle doesn't look swollen, but send Dell over to fetch me if you have trouble tomorrow morning.
french: Ta cheville n'a pas l'air enflée, mais si ça ne va pas demain matin, envoie Dell me chercher.
russian: Лодыжка у тебя вроде не распухла, но если завтра утром будет болеть, можешь прислать за мной Делл.
bulgarian: Your ankle doesn't look swollen, but send Dell over to fetch me if you have trouble tomorrow morning.

english: Hah! You know, it IS nice. It's always an adventure, too!
french: Ha ! En effet, et c'est aussi une véritable aventure.
russian: Ха! Знаешь, правда хорошо. И вечно случаются какие-то приключения.
bulgarian: Hah! You know, it IS nice. It's always an adventure, too!

english: It must be nice, running the business with your family.
french: Ce doit être sympathique de gérer un commerce en famille.
russian: Хорошо, наверное, когда бизнес семейный.
bulgarian: It must be nice, running the business with your family.

english: Nice and quiet. Which means people in town are well, so I don't mind it at all.
french: Oui, c'est plutôt calme. Ce qui veut dire que les habitants sont en bonne santé et c'est tant mieux.
russian: Тихо и спокойно. А значит, в городе все здоровы, так что я не желуюсь.
bulgarian: Nice and quiet. Which means people in town are well, so I don't mind it at all.

english: How's the Clinic, Valen?
french: Tout se passe bien à la clinique, Valen ?
russian: Как дела в клинике, Вален?
bulgarian: How's the Clinic, Valen?

english: I'll ask him! I'm sure he'll say something like, "Sounds like skele-tons of fun!"
french: Je vais lui demander ! Je suis sûre qu'il va me répondre « Je m'y mets d'os suite ! »
russian: Я у него спрошу! Наверняка ответит что-ниудь вроде: «С лёг-костью помогу!».
bulgarian: I'll ask him! I'm sure he'll say something like, "Sounds like skele-tons of fun!"

english: I'll leave it to you, then.
french: Euh... d'accord, merci.
russian: Тогда точно лучше спроси ты.
bulgarian: I'll leave it to you, then.

english: Do you think Holt could whittle a medical model of a femur? I'd like one for a demonstration.
french: Tu crois que Holt pourrait me sculpter un fémur ? C'est pour montrer à mes patients.
russian: Как ты думаешь, Хольт может вырезать медицинскую модель бедренной кости? Мне нужно для демонстрации.
bulgarian: Do you think Holt could whittle a medical model of a femur? I'd like one for a demonstration.

english: It was pure bliss. I read every murder mystery in the house, and then my father trudged out into the snow to get me some more!
french: C'était le bonheur ! J'avais lu tous les romans policiers de la maison et mon père avait bravé la neige pour m'en apporter d'autres !
russian: Чудное было время. Я прочитала все детективы в доме, а потом отец пробирался сквозь снег, чтобы добыть мне ещё!
bulgarian: It was pure bliss. I read every murder mystery in the house, and then my father trudged out into the snow to get me some more!

english: Do you remember the Year of the Two Week Blizzard? That was really something. I don't think it's snowed like that since.
french: Tu te souviens de l'année où la tempête de neige a duré deux semaines ? C'était quelque chose... Je ne crois pas qu'il ait neigé comme ça depuis.
russian: Помнишь год двухнедельной пурги? Вот это была погода! Не припомню с тех пор такого снегопада.
bulgarian: Do you remember the Year of the Two Week Blizzard? That was really something. I don't think it's snowed like that since.

english: Wow, you and March are quick! Thank you!
french: Waouh, vous ne traînez pas, March et toi ! Merci !
russian: Ничего себе, как вы с Мартом быстро управились! Спасибо!
bulgarian: Wow, you and March are quick! Thank you!

english: Here's those brackets you needed for your shelving! Ryis says he'll come by and install them the next time he's doing rounds around town.
french: Voilà les crochets pour tes étagères ! Ryis dit qu'il passera les installer lors de sa prochaine inspection en ville.
russian: У нас уже готовы твои уголки для полок! Риз сказал, что зайдёт и поставит их тебе, когда будет по пути.
bulgarian: Here's those brackets you needed for your shelving! Ryis says he'll come by and install them the next time he's doing rounds around town.

english: This one's a pudding stone! You're a long way from home, little fella!
french: C'est du poudingue ! Tu en as parcouru du chemin, mon coco !
russian: Это пудинговый камень! Далеко тебя занесло, да, малыш?
bulgarian: This one's a pudding stone! You're a long way from home, little fella!

english: I found this cool rock when I was wandering around the Narrows. Think you could identify it for me?
french: J'ai trouvé cette jolie pierre en me baladant du côté des Terrasses. Tu saurais me dire ce que c'est ?
russian: Смотри, какой крутой камень я нашёл на прогулке в Ущелье. Поможешь его опознать?
bulgarian: I found this cool rock when I was wandering around the Narrows. Think you could identify it for me?

english: Pretty good. I made the rounds and oiled some hinges earlier. Should make time to check some of the town's older stone foundations.
french: Rien à signaler. J'ai fait un tour et j'en ai profité pour huiler quelques gonds. Il faudrait que j'aille examiner les vieilles fondations en pierre un de ces jours.
russian: Неплохо. Я прошёлся по городу и смазал петли. Надо ещё найти время осмотреть старые городские фундаменты.
bulgarian: Pretty good. I made the rounds and oiled some hinges earlier. Should make time to check some of the town's older stone foundations.

english: Ooh, exciting!
french: Oh, trop cool !
russian: Ого, звучит увлекательно!
bulgarian: Ooh, exciting!

english: How's the town looking, Ryis?
french: Tout va bien en ville, Ryis ?
russian: Ну что, Риз, осмотрел дома?
bulgarian: How's the town looking, Ryis?

english: It was not my choice, Olric... I was imprisoned down there.
french: Je n'ai pas eu le choix, Olric... J'étais emprisonnée dans les profondeurs de ce lieu.
russian: Я была там не по своей воле, Ольрик... Меня держали в заточении.
bulgarian: It was not my choice, Olric... I was imprisoned down there.

english: I get that, but Errol is super strict about this stuff... he'll be so mad if he finds out.
french: Je comprends, mais Errol est super strict là-dessus... Il va se mettre en rogne quand il saura.
russian: Понимаю, но у Эррола всё очень строго... Он будет ужасно ругаться, если узнает.
bulgarian: I get that, but Errol is super strict about this stuff... he'll be so mad if he finds out.

english: Really?
french: Vraiment ?
russian: Правда?
bulgarian: Really?

english: Then perhaps I will tell him myself.
french: Dans ce cas, je lui dirai en personne.
russian: Тогда, возможно, я расскажу ему лично.
bulgarian: Then perhaps I will tell him myself.

english: Seridia, only [Ari] is allowed in the Mines!
french: Seridia, seul<she>e</she><he></he><they>·e</they> [Ari] a le droit d'entrer dans les mines !
russian:
Серидия, [Ari] —

единственные

единственнаяединственныйединственное, кому можно в шахты!
bulgarian: Seridia, only [Ari] is allowed in the Mines!

english: You used to hang out down there, right? Ever see anything scary?
french: Vous, vous y avez passé pas mal de temps, non ? Vous avez vu des trucs effrayants ?
russian: Ты же долго там была, да? Видела что-нибудь жуткое?
bulgarian: You used to hang out down there, right? Ever see anything scary?

english: Hah! Ahaha!
french: Ha ! Ha ha !
russian: Ха! А-ха-ха!
bulgarian: Hah! Ahaha!

english: Hahaha!
french: Ha ha ha !
russian: Ха-ха-ха!
bulgarian: Hahaha!

english: Hahaha!
french: Ha ha ha !
russian: Ха-ха-ха!
bulgarian: Hahaha!

english: Haha! Wait, why are we laughing again?
french: Ha ha ! Mais attendez, pourquoi on rigole comme ça ?
russian: Ха-ха! Погоди, а что тут смешного?
bulgarian: Haha! Wait, why are we laughing again?

english: Errol says these mines are haunted...
french: Errol dit que ces mines sont hantées...
russian: Эррол говорит, в этих шахтах призраки...
bulgarian: Errol says these mines are haunted...

english: But sometimes you like to visit the entrance so you can... "remember the good times".
french: Mais vous aimez toutefois venir à l'entrée, car cela vous... « rappelle de bons souvenirs ».
russian: Но иногда ты приходишь ко входу, чтобы... «вспомнить старые-добрые деньки»?
bulgarian: But sometimes you like to visit the entrance so you can... "remember the good times".

english: Yeah! Don't you ever do that?
french: C'est ça ! Vous ne le faites jamais ?
russian: Ага! А ты разве так не делаешь?
bulgarian: Yeah! Don't you ever do that?

english: The places I remember are long gone... so no, I do not.
french: Les endroits dont je me souviens n'existent plus depuis bien longtemps, donc... non, je ne le fais pas.
russian: Мест, которые я могу помнить, уже давно нет на свете... Так что, нет, не делаю.
bulgarian: The places I remember are long gone... so no, I do not.

english: Sounds like you need to go to some new places and make some new memories!
french: Ça veut dire que vous devez découvrir de nouveaux lieux et créer de nouveaux souvenirs !
russian: Наверное, тебе пора сходить в новые места и наполучать новых воспоминаний!
bulgarian: Sounds like you need to go to some new places and make some new memories!

english: Hm. I suppose I am working on it.
french: Mmm. Je suppose que c'est ce à quoi je m'attelle, ces temps-ci.
russian: Хм. Наверное, этим я и занимаюсь.
bulgarian: Hm. I suppose I am working on it.

english: You are very wise for one so muscular, Olric.
french: Vous êtes très sage pour quelqu'un d'aussi musclé, Olric.
russian: Неожиданная мудрость от такого бугая, как ты, Ольрик.
bulgarian: You are very wise for one so muscular, Olric.

english: So I am to understand that the Mines are condemned, and therefore you cannot go inside.
french: Je dois donc comprendre que les mines sont condamnées et que vous ne pouvez par conséquent pas y pénétrer ?
russian: Выходит, по твоим словам, шахты — проклятое место, и туда нельзя заходить.
bulgarian: So I am to understand that the Mines are condemned, and therefore you cannot go inside.

english: I've learned my lesson about bestowing unimaginable power.
french: Pour ce qui est d'octroyer des pouvoirs incommensurables, j'ai appris la leçon.
russian: Я усвоила свой урок и больше не дарую невероятные силы.
bulgarian: I've learned my lesson about bestowing unimaginable power.

english: Aw, I don't need to get paid to help out a bud, Seri!
french: Oh, je ne m'attends pas à me faire payer pour aider une amie, Seri !
russian: Ой, да за помощь в дружбу не нужно платить, Сери!
bulgarian: Aw, I don't need to get paid to help out a bud, Seri!

english: ... I mean, a cool gem would be pretty sweet... if you've got one lying around.
french: Enfin, même si une jolie pierre, ça ne serait pas de refus... si jamais vous en avez une sous la main.
russian: То есть... Крутой камешек было бы
bulgarian: ... I mean, a cool gem would be pretty sweet... if you've got one lying around.

english: I must warn you Olric, I can only pay for your services with gold or gems.
french: Olric, je dois vous avertir que je ne peux m'acquitter de vos services qu'en or et en pierres précieuses.
russian: Должна предупредить, Ольрик, я могу оплатить твои услуги лишь золотом или драгоценными камнями.
bulgarian: I must warn you Olric, I can only pay for your services with gold or gems.

english: Wow, that's so nice of you!
french: Waouh, c'est très sympa de votre part !
russian: Ух ты, мне очень приятно!
bulgarian: Wow, that's so nice of you!

english: But... it's kinda...
french: Mais... c'est un peu...
russian: Вот только....
bulgarian: But... it's kinda...

english: The title displeases you. What is your preference?
french: Ce titre ne vous plaît pas. Quelle serait votre préférence ?
russian: Этот титул тебе не по нраву? Какой бы ты предпочёл?
bulgarian: The title displeases you. What is your preference?

english: Lord of Leg Day!
french: Le Seigneur des abdos !
russian: Владыка мышц!
bulgarian: Lord of Leg Day!

english: Olric, in another life, I would have made you my Grand Minister of Calisthenics.
french: Olric, dans une autre vie, j'aurais fait de vous mon Ministre suprême à la callisthénie.
russian: Ольрик, в иной жизни я бы сделала тебя главным министром физкультуры.
bulgarian: Olric, in another life, I would have made you my Grand Minister of Calisthenics.

english: Such a subtle touch of leather... but I find it pleasantly understated.
french: Cette touche de cuir est... subtilement discrète.
russian: Такие тонкие кожаные акценты... Мне нравится их неожиданная скромность.
bulgarian: Such a subtle touch of leather... but I find it pleasantly understated.

english: Aw, thanks Seri! I like how understated your outfits are, too!
french: Ah, merci Seri ! Moi aussi, j'aime le côté subtilement discret de vos vêtements !
russian: Ой, спасибо, Сери! Мне тоже нравятся твои скромные наряды!
bulgarian: Aw, thanks Seri! I like how understated your outfits are, too!

english: I find myself appreciating your ensembles, Olric.
french: Vos tenues sont tout à fait à mon goût, Olric.
russian: Твой выбор костюма мне по нраву, Ольрик.
bulgarian: I find myself appreciating your ensembles, Olric.

english: Four thousand four hundred ninety... four thousand four hundred ninety one... four thousand four hundred ninety two...
french: Quatre mille quatre cent quatre-vingt-dix... Quatre mille quatre cent quatre-vingt-onze... Quatre mille quatre cent quatre-vingt-douze...
russian: Четыре тысячи четыреста девяносто... Четыре тысячи четыреста девяносто один... Четыре тысячи четыреста девяносто два...
bulgarian: Four thousand four hundred ninety... four thousand four hundred ninety one... four thousand four hundred ninety two...

english: Fifty three... fifty four... fifty five...
french: Cinquante-trois... Cinquante-quatre... Cinquante-cinq...
russian: Пятьдесят три... пятьдесят четыре... пятьдесят пять...
bulgarian: Fifty three... fifty four... fifty five...

english: Oh, he's a lifesaver. My ol' fishing rod jams a lot these days, and that's how the fish get away!
french: Oh, c'est génial. Ma vieille canne à pêche n'arrête pas de se gripper ces temps-ci et les poissons en profitent pour s'échapper !
russian: Как он меня выручает! Последнее время моя старая удочка часто заедает — так рыба и ускользает от меня!
bulgarian: Oh, he's a lifesaver. My ol' fishing rod jams a lot these days, and that's how the fish get away!

english: March has the pieces of your reel all finished. He's just gotta put them together.
french: March a terminé les différentes pièces de ton moulinet. Il ne lui reste plus qu'à les assembler.
russian: Март уже доделал тебе катушку. Осталось только собрать все детали.
bulgarian: March has the pieces of your reel all finished. He's just gotta put them together.

english: Wonderful!
french: Parfait !
russian: Чудно!
bulgarian: Wonderful!

english: Hm. Olric, I'm afraid that "bummer vibes" is not the kind of medical terminology I'm looking for. Good effort, though.
french: Euh, Olric. Je préfère éviter le terme « coup de mou » dans mes dossiers, mais merci quand même.
russian: Хмм. Ольрик, «везде колбасит» это не совсем те медицинские термины, которые мне нужны. Но я ценю твоё старание.
bulgarian: Hm. Olric, I'm afraid that "bummer vibes" is not the kind of medical terminology I'm looking for. Good effort, though.

english: Thanks, boss!
french: De rien, patronne !
russian: Спасибо, босс!
bulgarian: Thanks, boss!

english: Valen, I recorded the last patient's symptoms for you! Just like you asked!
french: Valen, j'ai noté les symptômes du dernier patient pour toi ! Comme tu me l'avais demandé !
russian: Вален, я записал симптомы последнего пациента, как ты просила!
bulgarian: Valen, I recorded the last patient's symptoms for you! Just like you asked!

english: Aw...
french: Mais...
russian: Эх...
bulgarian: Aw...

english: However, this is the biggest deltoid I've ever recorded in all my years practicing.
french: En tout cas, c'est le plus gros deltoïde que j'aie jamais vu de ma vie.
russian: Но это самая большая дельта, что я видела в своей практике.
bulgarian: However, this is the biggest deltoid I've ever recorded in all my years practicing.

english: Whoa!
french: Hé hé !
russian: Ух ты!
bulgarian: Whoa!

english: I don't know that you discovered a new muscle, Olric.
french: Je ne suis pas sûre que tu aies découvert un nouveau muscle, Olric.
russian: Не уверена, что ты правда открыл новую мышцу, Ольрик...
bulgarian: I don't know that you discovered a new muscle, Olric.

english: Fascinating, the way the human body can surpass its own limits.
french: C'est fou comme le corps humain est capable de dépasser ses limites.
russian: Удивительно, как широки пределы человеческих возможностей.
bulgarian: Fascinating, the way the human body can surpass its own limits.

english: Want me to pick it up right now?
french: Tu veux que je la soulève, là ?
russian: Хочешь, сейчас возьму и подниму?
bulgarian: Want me to pick it up right now?

english: That's alright. I'm not interested in surpassing the limits of March's temper.
french: Non, ça ira. On risquerait de dépasser les limites de March en termes de patience.
russian: Не нужно. Испытывать пределы терпения Марта мне точно не хочется.
bulgarian: That's alright. I'm not interested in surpassing the limits of March's temper.

english: And you say you can pick up the whole anvil? By yourself?
french: Tu dis que tu peux soulever cette enclume ? Tout seul ?
russian: Ты правда можешь поднять наковальню целиком? В одиночку?
bulgarian: And you say you can pick up the whole anvil? By yourself?

english: Well, you're in luck! I've just restocked.
french: Ça tombe bien, je viens d'en recevoir.
russian: Тебе повезло! У меня как раз готова свежая партия.
bulgarian: Well, you're in luck! I've just restocked.

english: Our medicine cabinet was looking a little empty, so mom sent me over to pick up some syrups.
french: Notre armoire à pharmacie est un peu vide, alors maman m'a envoyée chercher du sirop.
russian: Наша домашняя аптечка слегка растратилась, так что мама послала меня за сиропами.
bulgarian: Our medicine cabinet was looking a little empty, so mom sent me over to pick up some syrups.

english: You'll be fine, Ryis, it looks worse than it is. But that's good advice, [Ari].
french: Ça va aller, Ryis, c'est moins grave qu'il n'y paraît. Mais suis son conseil, [Ari].
russian: Да всё в порядке, Риз, выглядит хуже, чем на самом деле. Но совет хороший, [Ari].
bulgarian: You'll be fine, Ryis, it looks worse than it is. But that's good advice, [Ari].

english: Hey, [Ari]. Friendly piece of advice? Don't get to hammering before you're totally awake.
french: Salut, [Ari]. Tu veux un conseil ? Ne te sers pas de ton marteau avant d'être bien réveillé<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they>.
russian: Вот тебе дружеский совет, [Ari]: не становись за станок поутру, пока не проснёшься как следует.
bulgarian: Hey, [Ari]. Friendly piece of advice? Don't get to hammering before you're totally awake.

english: That's a relief. Thanks, Valen.
french: Ah, tant mieux. Merci, Valen.
russian: Спасибо, Вален. Ты меня успокоила.
bulgarian: That's a relief. Thanks, Valen.

english: It's good that you came to check it out, but I don't think it's sprained. Keep it elevated when you sleep tonight and you should be fine.
french: C'est bien que tu sois venu me montrer ça, mais ça n'a pas l'air d'être une entorse. Surélève ta cheville en dormant ce soir et ça devrait aller.
russian: Я думаю, растяжения нет, но ты молодец, что пришёл показать. Держи её повыше, когда будешь спать, — и всё пройдёт.
bulgarian: It's good that you came to check it out, but I don't think it's sprained. Keep it elevated when you sleep tonight and you should be fine.

english: That explains why I'm such a genius!
french: C'est pour ça que je suis si intelligente !
russian: Вот в чём секрет моей гениальности!
bulgarian: That explains why I'm such a genius!

english: KYA HA HA!
french: HÉ HÉ HÉ !
russian: КЯ-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: KYA HA HA!

english: Did you know? Fish oil is very good for the brain, [Ari].
french: Savais-tu que l'huile de poisson était très bonne pour le cerveau, [Ari] ?
russian:
Рыбий жир очень полезен для мозга. Ты

знали

зналазналзнало, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Did you know? Fish oil is very good for the brain, [Ari].

english: We've got a flatterer here!
french: C'est Holt qui te l'a soufflée, celle-là ?
russian: Вы гляньте, ну что за подлиза!
bulgarian: We've got a flatterer here!

english: KYA HA HA!
french: HÉ HÉ HÉ !
russian: КЯ-ХА-ХА!
bulgarian: KYA HA HA!

english: You're the picture of health, Terithia. Fishing keeps you young!
french: Tu es en parfaite santé, Terithia. Il n'y a pas à dire, manger du poisson, ça conserve !
russian: Вы просто образец здоровья, Теризия. Остаётесь молодой благодаря рыбалке!
bulgarian: You're the picture of health, Terithia. Fishing keeps you young!

bulgarian: Father had to come all the way back to Mistria to win her over, haha!

english: Why did she reject him?
french: Pourquoi avait-elle rompu ?
russian: А почему она его отвергла?
bulgarian: Why did she reject him?

english: Sounds like they were in love...
french: Ils avaient l'air amoureux...
russian: Видимо, это была настоящая любовь...
bulgarian: Sounds like they were in love...

english: She wanted nothing to do with titles or royalty, but Father showed her that a title couldn't change him. He asked her to elope!
french: Elle ne voulait pas entendre parler de titres ou de nobles, mais papa lui a démontré que ce n'était pas un titre qui le ferait changer. Il lui a proposé de s'enfuir !
russian: Она была против всяческих титулов и знати. Но отец показал ей, что титул его не изменил. И предложил ей сбежать!
bulgarian: She wanted nothing to do with titles or royalty, but Father showed her that a title couldn't change him. He asked her to elope!

english: Very much so. My mother and father married purely for love, a rarity in the world of nobles.
french: Oui, vraiment. Mon père et ma mère se sont mariés par amour, ce qui est rare à la cour.
russian: Ещё какая! Мать с отцом поженились исключительно по любви — а это редко бывает в дворянских кругах.
bulgarian: Very much so. My mother and father married purely for love, a rarity in the world of nobles.

english: My parents exchanged letters before they were married, after my father was sent to the front. But Mother rejected him after he was raised to peerage by King Kelinien!
french: Mes parents s'échangeaient des lettres avant de se marier, quand mon père a été envoyé au front. Mais maman a rompu quand il a été anobli par le roi Kelinien !
russian: До брака они вели переписку, пока отец был на военной службе. А потом король Келиниэн пожаловал ему дворянский титул, и мама его отвергла!
bulgarian: My parents exchanged letters before they were married, after my father was sent to the front. But Mother rejected him after he was raised to peerage by King Kelinien!

english: They say my father saved King Kel's life back when he was still Prince Kelinien, and that's the basis of their friendship, but really it's the pranks...
french: Apparemment, mon père aurait sauvé le roi Kelinien quand il n'était encore que prince. C'est de là que serait née leur amitié, mais ce qui les lient vraiment, ce sont leurs canulars...
russian: Говорят, король Кел дружит с моим отцом, потому что тот спас ему жизнь, ещё когда он был принц Келиниэн. Но, по правде говоря, всё дело в шуточках...
bulgarian: They say my father saved King Kel's life back when he was still Prince Kelinien, and that's the basis of their friendship, but really it's the pranks...

english: They're friends with the King?
french: Ils sont amis avec le roi ?
russian: Он дружит с самим королём?
bulgarian: They're friends with the King?

english: Pranks?
french: Leurs canulars ?
russian: Шуточки?
bulgarian: Pranks?

english: Oh, yes! My father is King Kelinien's trusted adviser, and my mother his bodyguard.
french: Oh oui ! Mon père est le fidèle conseiller du roi Kelinien, et ma mère est sa garde du corps.
russian: О, да! Мой отец — доверенный советник короля Келиниэна, а моя мать — его телохранительница.
bulgarian: Oh, yes! My father is King Kelinien's trusted adviser, and my mother his bodyguard.

english: They're among few who can speak so um... candidly with him.
french: Ils font partie des rares personnes qui peuvent, euh... lui dire ce qu'ils pensent.
russian: Одни из немногих людей, которым позволено разговаривать с ним... настолько искренне.
bulgarian: They're among few who can speak so um... candidly with him.

english: Oh yes... they like to keep those stuffy ministers on their toes, I think.
french: Oh oui... Je crois que l'objectif de ces canulars est que ces barbons de ministres restent vigilants.
russian: О, да... Они любят подшучивать над напыщенными придворными.
bulgarian: Oh yes... they like to keep those stuffy ministers on their toes, I think.

english: I got a letter from my mother! It's mostly fond grumbling about my father and the King getting into trouble together...
french: J'ai reçu une lettre de ma mère ! Elle râle parce que mon père et le roi n'arrêtent pas de se fourrer dans des guêpiers.
russian: Мама прислала мне письмо! В основном она беззлобно ворчит о том, как проказничают отец с королём...
bulgarian: I got a letter from my mother! It's mostly fond grumbling about my father and the King getting into trouble together...

english: Even you?
french: Toi aussi ?
russian: Даже ты?
bulgarian: Even you?

english: Thanks, [Ari]... that means a lot.
french: Merci, [Ari]... Ça me touche énormément.
russian: Спасибо, [Ari]... Мне важно это слышать.
bulgarian: Thanks, [Ari]... that means a lot.

english: Thank you, [Ari]... that means a lot.
french: Merci, [Ari]... Ça me touche beaucoup.
russian: Спасибо, [Ari]... Мне важно это слышать.
bulgarian: Thank you, [Ari]... that means a lot.

english: I hope I'm doing a good job, [Ari]... Mother and Father are in the Capital with the King, so it's up to me to keep Mistria running.
french: J'espère que je fais du bon travail, [Ari]... Comme papa et maman sont à la capitale, auprès du roi, c'est à moi de veiller à ce que tout se passe bien à Mistria.
russian: Надеюсь, что я здесь неплохо справляюсь, [Ari]... С тех пор, как мама с папой уехали к королю в столицу, управление Мистрией легло на меня.
bulgarian: I hope I'm doing a good job, [Ari]... Mother and Father are in the Capital with the King, so it's up to me to keep Mistria running.

english: Everyone smiles when they see you, Adeline... You're doing great!
french: Tout le monde a le sourire en te voyant, Adeline... Tu te débrouilles comme une cheffe !
russian: Все улыбаются, когда встречают тебя, Аделина... Ты отлично справляешься!
bulgarian: Everyone smiles when they see you, Adeline... You're doing great!

english: I'm sure your parents are really proud of you, Adeline.
french: Tes parents doivent être fiers de toi, Adeline, c'est sûr.
russian:
Аделина, я

уверены

уверенауверенуверено, что родители бы тобой гордились.
bulgarian: I'm sure your parents are really proud of you, Adeline.

english: I've got a line on a good deal... I'm meeting my contact tonight, and if everything goes well then yours truly will be rolling in it by the time the deal is done.
french: Je suis sur une belle affaire... J'ai rendez-vous avec mon contact ce soir, et si tout se passe comme prévu, je roulerai sur l'or une fois le marché conclu.
russian: Я получил выход на хорошую сделку... Сегодня я встречаюсь со связным. Если всё пройдёт хорошо, ваш покорный слуга озолотится на этой сделке.
bulgarian: I've got a line on a good deal... I'm meeting my contact tonight, and if everything goes well then yours truly will be rolling in it by the time the deal is done.

english: Sounds kind of shady...
french: Ça sent l'entourloupe...
russian: Как-то скользко звучит...
bulgarian: Sounds kind of shady...

english: Good luck!
french: Bonne chance !
russian: Удачи!
bulgarian: Good luck!

english: Don't worry, I'll be careful.
french: Ne t'en fais pas, je serai prudent.
russian: Не волнуйся, я буду осторожен.
bulgarian: Don't worry, I'll be careful.

english: Thanks, [Ari]. Luck is the one thing money can't buy...
french: Merci, [Ari]. Mais la chance est la seule chose qui ne s'achète pas...
russian: Спасибо, [Ari]. Удачу за деньги не купишь...
bulgarian: Thanks, [Ari]. Luck is the one thing money can't buy...

english: Or was that love...?
french: Ou est-ce que c'est l'amour...?
russian: Так же говорят? Или это про любовь...
bulgarian: Or was that love...?

english: Want to hear a secret, [Ari]?
french: Tu veux que je te dise un secret, [Ari] ?
russian: Хочешь, расскажу секрет, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Want to hear a secret, [Ari]?

english: He sounds eccentric... and just how much milk are we talking here?
french: Il a l'air bizarre. Et puis, de combien de litres de lait fraise on parle ?
russian: Должно быть, это весьма эксцентричный человек... И какой же объём молока его устроит?
bulgarian: He sounds eccentric... and just how much milk are we talking here?

english: That deal I was chasing took an odd turn... my contact says their client is crazy for strawberry milk? In exchange for raw, uncut gems?
french: Ce contrat que je voulais signer... je ne le sens plus. Mon contact dit que son client veut du lait fraise en échange de pierres brutes et non taillées...
russian: Сделка, за которой я погнался, приняла странный оборот... Мой связной говорит, что клиент без ума от клубничного молока. Но чтобы менять на неогранённые драгоценности?
bulgarian: That deal I was chasing took an odd turn... my contact says their client is crazy for strawberry milk? In exchange for raw, uncut gems?

english: Even 50 gallons of strawberry milk isn't worth what we're trading for. What do you think?
french: Même si je livrais 200 litres de lait fraise, je serais encore loin de la valeur de ces pierres. Tu en penses quoi, toi ?
russian: Даже 200 литров клубничного молока не стоит того, за что мы торгуемся. Что думаешь?
bulgarian: Even 50 gallons of strawberry milk isn't worth what we're trading for. What do you think?

english: It definitely seems suspicious...
french: Ça me paraît suspect...
russian: Звучит определённо очень подозрительно...
bulgarian: It definitely seems suspicious...

english: Sounds like an easy deal... go for it!
french: C'est une affaire vite fait bien fait... Accepte !
russian: Звучит как лёгкие деньги... Попробуй!
bulgarian: Sounds like an easy deal... go for it!

english: You think so too, eh? Hmm... I'll have to look into it.
french: Tu trouves aussi, hein ? Hmm... Il va falloir que je creuse la question.
russian: Тебе тоже так кажется? Хмм... Попробую изучить этот вопрос получше.
bulgarian: You think so too, eh? Hmm... I'll have to look into it.

english: That's what I don't like about it. It's too easy... I'll have to look into it.
french: C'est ce qui me dérange justement... Il va falloir que je creuse la question.
russian: Это мне и не нравится: даже слишком лёгкие... Надо изучить этот вопрос получше.
bulgarian: That's what I don't like about it. It's too easy... I'll have to look into it.

english: [Ari], I could use your advice... this deal I've been working on is puzzling. Raw gems for strawberry milk?
french: [Ari], j'aurais besoin de tes conseils... Ce contrat sur lequel je suis me perturbe un peu. Des pierres brutes contre du lait fraise ?
russian: [Ari], мне бы не помешал твой совет... Эта сделка просто ставит меня в тупик. Драгоценные камни в обмен на клубничное молоко?
bulgarian: [Ari], I could use your advice... this deal I've been working on is puzzling. Raw gems for strawberry milk?

english: I trailed my contact, and it turns out he was trying to trick a kid into parting with the find of a lifetime.
french: J'ai suivi mon contact, et je me suis rendu compte qu'il essayait de convaincre un enfant de se séparer d'une très belle trouvaille.
russian: Я копнул глубже и выяснил, что мой связной хотел облапошить ребёнка. Думал, что убедит его разменять самую удачную находку в жизни на молоко.
bulgarian: I trailed my contact, and it turns out he was trying to trick a kid into parting with the find of a lifetime.

english: Some people don't have a heart.
french: Certaines personnes n'ont pas de cœur.
russian: Какие бывают бессердечные люди.
bulgarian: Some people don't have a heart.

english: Sounds like you've got a heart.
french: Mais toi, tu en as un.
russian: Значит, ты сам не бессердечный.
bulgarian: Sounds like you've got a heart.

english: How did things turn out?
french: Comment ça s'est fini ?
russian: И что же было дальше?
bulgarian: How did things turn out?

english: Haha, is that wishful thinking, [Ari]?
french: Ha ha, tu ne crois pas si bien dire, [Ari] !
russian: Ха-ха, откуда такой оптимизм, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Haha, is that wishful thinking, [Ari]?

english: I sent my contact packing and I introduced the kid's parents to an appraiser I trust. Came out empty-handed, but it's not about money ALL the time...
french: J'ai envoyé mon contact bouler et j'ai conduit les parents du gamin chez un commissaire priseur de confiance. Je n'ai rien gagné, mais on ne peut pas penser tout le temps qu'à l'argent.
russian: Я попрощался с этим связным и подсказал родителям ребёнка хорошего оценщика, которому я доверяю. Ничего не этом не выручил, но не всегда в деньгах дело.
bulgarian: I sent my contact packing and I introduced the kid's parents to an appraiser I trust. Came out empty-handed, but it's not about money ALL the time...

english: Just most of it.
french: Juste la plupart du temps.
russian: Только ПОЧТИ всегда.
bulgarian: Just most of it.

english: You know that deal I was working on? The gems for the milk?
french: Tu te souviens de ce contrat que je voulais signer ? Les pierres contre du lait fraise ?
russian: Помнишь ту сделку, о которой я говорил? Молоко на драгоценности?
bulgarian: You know that deal I was working on? The gems for the milk?

english: Do you think it would be fun if the hero comes across a fantastic creature? She could even befriend it!
french: Tu crois que ce serait intéressant si l'héroïne croisait une créature fantastique ? Elle pourrait même devenir amie avec !
russian: Как ты думаешь, может, героине попадётся волшебное существо? Может, она даже с ним подружится!
bulgarian: Do you think it would be fun if the hero comes across a fantastic creature? She could even befriend it!

english: How about a kobold?
french: Que dirais-tu d'un kobold ?
russian: Как насчёт кобольда?
bulgarian: How about a kobold?

english: Maybe a dragon?
french: Que dirais-tu d'un dragon ?
russian: Может быть, дракон?
bulgarian: Maybe a dragon?

english: Good idea, maybe the kobold steals something of the hero's and leads her somewhere mysterious and new?
french: Bonne idée. Le kobold pourrait voler quelque chose à l'héroïne et la conduire vers un endroit étrange et nouveau ?
russian: Отличная идея. Может, кобольд у неё что-нибудь украл и теперь ведёт её в какое-то таинтсвенное место...
bulgarian: Good idea, maybe the kobold steals something of the hero's and leads her somewhere mysterious and new?

english: That's the obvious choice, isn't it? Dell WOULD go crazy for a dragon, all the best stories have one! Thanks, [Ari]!
french: Mais oui, évidemment. Dell aura des étoiles plein les yeux s'il y a un dragon, comme dans ses histoires préférées ! Merci, [Ari] !
russian: Самый очевидный выбор, да ведь? Делл ТОЧНО понравится дракон, лучшие сказки всегда с драконами! Спасибо, [Ari]!
bulgarian: That's the obvious choice, isn't it? Dell WOULD go crazy for a dragon, all the best stories have one! Thanks, [Ari]!

english: Dell always asks me to tell her stories, but I've been running out of ideas lately...
french: Dell me demande de lui raconter des histoires avant de dormir, mais je suis à court d'idées en ce moment...
russian: Делл вечно просит меня рассказывать ей сказки, но у меня кончаются идеи...
bulgarian: Dell always asks me to tell her stories, but I've been running out of ideas lately...

english: The hero discovered the tomb of an ancient king... and the story ended just as she opened a treasure chest. What do you think should be inside?
french: L'héroïne a découvert la tombe d'un ancien roi... et l'histoire s'est terminée au moment où elle ouvrait le coffre au trésor. Qu'est-ce qu'il pourrait contenir ?
russian: Героиня нашла гробницу древнего короля, открыла сундук с сокровищами... и на этом рассказ закончился. Как ты думаешь, что должно лежать в сундуке?
bulgarian: The hero discovered the tomb of an ancient king... and the story ended just as she opened a treasure chest. What do you think should be inside?

english: A haunted sword!
french: Une épée hantée !
russian: Зловещий проклятый меч!
bulgarian: A haunted sword!

english: A draconic spell!
french: Un sort draconique !
russian: Драконье заклинание!
bulgarian: A draconic spell!

english: A sword... maybe with a mysterious inscription... and imbued with the spirit of an ancient dragon! That's perfect! Thank you, [Ari]!
french: Une épée... gravée d'une inscription mystérieuse... et renfermant l'esprit d'un ancien dragon ! C'est parfait ! Merci, [Ari] !
russian: Меч... Может, с загадочной надписью... и хранящий в себе дух древнего дракона! Идеально! Спасибо, [Ari]!
bulgarian: A sword... maybe with a mysterious inscription... and imbued with the spirit of an ancient dragon! That's perfect! Thank you, [Ari]!

english: Oh, that's so much fun! I'll let Dell choose what the spell does... Though she'll probably just scream #FIRE#...
french: Oh, mais c'est génial ! Je laisserai Dell choisir ce que fait ce sort... même si je suis sûre qu'elle va crier #DU FEU#...
russian: О, это было бы весело! Пускай Делл сама решит, что оно делает... Хотя она наверняка просто закричит: #ОГОНЬ#...
bulgarian: Oh, that's so much fun! I'll let Dell choose what the spell does... Though she'll probably just scream #FIRE#...

english: Thanks, [Ari]! She'll really love this!
french: Merci, [Ari] ! Elle va adorer !
russian: Спасибо, [Ari]! Это ей точно понравится!
bulgarian: Thanks, [Ari]! She'll really love this!

english: [Ari], there you are! Dell loved the last story I told her, but now I'm out of ideas again!
french: Te voilà, [Ari] ! Dell a adoré la dernière histoire que je lui ai racontée, mais je suis de nouveau à court d'idées !
russian: [Ari], вот ты где! Делл очень понравилась прошлая сказка, но у меня снова кончились идеи!
bulgarian: [Ari], there you are! Dell loved the last story I told her, but now I'm out of ideas again!

english: The hero broke the curse on the dragons, and now she can befriend them or return them to their world. What do you think?
french: L'héroïne a brisé la malédiction qui pesait sur les dragons. Maintenant, elle peut devenir amie avec eux ou les renvoyer dans leur monde. Qu'est-ce que tu en penses ?
russian: Героине удалось снять проклятие с драконов, и теперь она может подружиться с ними или отпустить их в свой мир. Как ты думаешь, что лучше?
bulgarian: The hero broke the curse on the dragons, and now she can befriend them or return them to their world. What do you think?

english: Friendship!
french: Je choisis l'amitié !
russian: Лучше дружба!
bulgarian: Friendship!

english: Help get them home!
french: Elle les aide à rentrer chez eux !
russian: Надо помочь им вернуться домой!
bulgarian: Help get them home!

english: Right? I think Dell would like that the most. You wouldn't believe how obsessed she is with dragons... actually, I think you would! Thank you so much, [Ari]!
french: Oui ? Je pense que c'est ce qui plaira le plus à Dell. Si tu savais à quel point elle est obnubilée par les dragons... Enfin si, tu le sais déjà ! Merci beaucoup, [Ari] !
russian: Правда? Думаю, Делл это больше понравится. Ты не представляешь, как она обожает драконов... Хотя нет, ты, наверное, представляешь. Спасибо большое, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Right? I think Dell would like that the most. You wouldn't believe how obsessed she is with dragons... actually, I think you would! Thank you so much, [Ari]!

english: Interesting... maybe the hero could join them in their journey as well? It would be a fun setup for a sequel, in the Land of the Dragons! Thank you so much, [Ari]!
french: Intéressant... Peut-être que l'héroïne pourrait les accompagner ? Ça ferait un bon point de départ pour une suite au pays des dragons ! Merci beaucoup, [Ari] !
russian: Интересно... Может, героиня отправится вместе с ними? Это была бы хорошая зацепка на продолжение в Мире драконов! Спасибо большое, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Interesting... maybe the hero could join them in their journey as well? It would be a fun setup for a sequel, in the Land of the Dragons! Thank you so much, [Ari]!

english: [Ari], Dell's been loving your story suggestions! I'm stumped on how to end it, though.
french: [Ari], Dell adore tes suggestions pour son histoire du soir ! Le problème, c'est que je n'arrive pas à la terminer.
russian: [Ari], Делл нравятся все твои сказочные идеи! Но я без понятия, чем теперь закончить.
bulgarian: [Ari], Dell's been loving your story suggestions! I'm stumped on how to end it, though.

english: [Ari], [Ari]! If you ever have trouble falling asleep, you should ask Celine for a bedtime story! She tells the #BEST# stories, they were so exciting I stayed up all night thinking about them!
french: [Ari] ! Si tu as du mal à t'endormir, demande à Céline de te raconter une histoire ! C'est #la meilleure#. Ses histoires sont trop géniales ! J'y repense toute la nuit après !
russian: [Ari], [Ari]! Если не можешь заснуть, попроси Селин рассказать тебе сказку на ночь! У неё #САМЫЕ КРУТЫЕ# сказки! Такие интересные, что я всю ночь не сплю.
bulgarian: [Ari], [Ari]! If you ever have trouble falling asleep, you should ask Celine for a bedtime story! She tells the #BEST# stories, they were so exciting I stayed up all night thinking about them!

english: [Ari], you'll never believe it. We pulled off the heist of the century! But maybe we bit off more than we could chew...
french: [Ari], tu ne me croiras jamais. On a réussi le casse du siècle ! Mais on s'est peut-être attaqués à un trop gros poisson...
russian: [Ari], ты не поверишь! Мы совершили ограбление века! Правда, такой большой куш нам не съесть...
bulgarian: [Ari], you'll never believe it. We pulled off the heist of the century! But maybe we bit off more than we could chew...

english: Of course, here you are!
french: Et voilà pour toi !
russian: Не вопрос, держи!
bulgarian: Of course, here you are!

english: I've got the budget review meeting, that could work! We could all use a little extra treat for THAT meeting.
french: Mais oui, on a la réunion du budget demain ! On aura bien besoin d'une petite douceur pour se donner du courage.
russian: Точно, мне как раз предстоит собрание по анализу бюджета! Для ТАКОГО дела нам всем не помешает угощение.
