french: Non, non, je ne dois pas me laisser influencer par tous les caprices du public.
russian: Нет-нет, нельзя поддаваться мелким прихотям нашей публики.
bulgarian: No no, I shouldn't let myself be swayed by every whim of the public.

english: [Ari]... what do you think about the Museum adding an amphibian wing?
french: [Ari]... Que penses-tu de l'ajout d'une aile dédiée aux amphibiens dans le musée ?
russian: [Ari]... Как ты думаешь, нашему музею нужен отдел земноводных?
bulgarian: [Ari]... what do you think about the Museum adding an amphibian wing?

english: What! No! It's... [Ari]...right...? Of course it is! Don't do that!
french: Quoi ?! Non ! C'est... [Ari]... c'est ça...? Je le sais parfaitement !
russian: Что? Нет! Ты же... [Ari]... верно?.. Да я и так знаю! Не надо так шутить!
bulgarian: What! No! It's... [Ari]...right...? Of course it is! Don't do that!

english: Oh dear, is that what passes for humor among the yokels?
french: Ah, c'est ce que la plèbe appelle l'humour, c'est ça ?
russian: Ах, боже мой, это у провинциалов нынче такой юмор?
bulgarian: Oh dear, is that what passes for humor among the yokels?

english: Please try and focus.
french: Concentre-toi, je te prie.
russian: Пожалуйста, повнимательнее.
bulgarian: Please try and focus.

english: While tracking ley line shifts early this morning east of town, I noticed... a frog.
french: Je scrutais les changements des lignes telluriques tôt ce matin, à l'est de la ville, quand j'ai remarqué... une grenouille.
russian: Сегодня с раннего утра я отслеживала сдвиги магических жил к востоку от города и заметила... лягушку.
bulgarian: While tracking ley line shifts early this morning east of town, I noticed... a frog.

english: Okay, and...?
french: Oui... et ?
russian: Хорошо, и что?..
bulgarian: Okay, and...?

english: Wow, amazing. Listen, I have to go.
french: Waouh, super génial. Bon, je dois y aller, moi.
russian: Невероятно. Послушай, мне пора идти.
bulgarian: Wow, amazing. Listen, I have to go.

english: Judging by your tone you haven't noticed any unusual amphibian behavior.
french: À t'entendre, tu n'as rien remarqué d'inhabituel chez les amphibiens.
russian: Судя по твоему выражению, тебе пока не попадались необычные амфибии.
bulgarian: Judging by your tone you haven't noticed any unusual amphibian behavior.

english: This frog seemed much more intelligent then his fellows, I sense a deeper mystery at work here.
french: Cette grenouille avait l'air plus intelligente que ses congénères. Je sens que ce n'est que la pointe de l'iceberg.
russian: Эта лягушка выглядела гораздо умнее остальных. Я чувствую, за этим скрывается какая-то тайна.
bulgarian: This frog seemed much more intelligent then his fellows, I sense a deeper mystery at work here.

english: It's a shame you weren't more help, but I suppose that's not a particular surprise. Let me know if you DO see anything, [Ari].
french: Dommage que tu ne me sois pas d'une plus grande aide, mais je ne suis pas vraiment surprise. Tiens-moi au courant si jamais tu remarques quelque chose, [Ari].
russian: Жаль, что от тебя не добиться помощи. Впрочем, я особенно и не рассчитывала. Если всё-таки УВИДИШЬ что-нибудь, сообщи мне, [Ari].
bulgarian: It's a shame you weren't more help, but I suppose that's not a particular surprise. Let me know if you DO see anything, [Ari].

english: You there! Have you noticed any strange phenomena lately?
french: Toi là ! As-tu remarqué de drôles de phénomènes dernièrement ?
russian:
Эй, ты! Не

замечали

замечалазамечалзамечало в последнее время каких-нибудь странностей?
bulgarian: You there! Have you noticed any strange phenomena lately?

english: Juniper, did you forget my name?
french: Tu as oublié mon nom, Juniper ?
russian: Джунипер, ты забыла, как меня зовут?
bulgarian: Juniper, did you forget my name?

english: Do you mean, like, other than you?
french: Euh... à part toi ?
russian: Ты имеешь в виду, кроме тебя?
bulgarian: Do you mean, like, other than you?

english: My own efforts have been less than fruitful as well. We are rather in the hinterlands, aren't we?
french: Moi-même, je n'ai rien trouvé. C'est vraiment dans un trou paumé ici, hein ?
russian: Мои собственные поиски также безрезультатны. Какая же тут глухомань!
bulgarian: My own efforts have been less than fruitful as well. We are rather in the hinterlands, aren't we?

english: OH HO HO!
french: OH HO HO HO !
russian: О-ХО-ХО!
bulgarian: OH HO HO!

english: I suppose I shouldn't be surprised at the poor quality of assistants out here in the sticks.
french: J'imagine que je ne devrais pas être surprise par le niveau médiocre des assistants dans ce trou paumé.
russian: Видимо, не стоит удивляться, что в этом захолустье такие никудышные ассистенты.
bulgarian: I suppose I shouldn't be surprised at the poor quality of assistants out here in the sticks.

english: I managed to talk my way into Errol's good graces and obtain access to the Museum's archives.
french: J'ai réussi à me mettre Errol dans la poche pour avoir accès aux archives du musée.
russian: Мне удалось добиться расположения Эррола и получить доступ к архивам музея.
bulgarian: I managed to talk my way into Errol's good graces and obtain access to the Museum's archives.

english: Unfortunately it's a mess! You'd think a curator could quickly identify all books and artifacts that are related to frogs, but frankly he looked bewildered.
french: Mais c'est le bazar là-dedans ! Un conservateur digne de ce nom doit être capable de retrouver tous les livres et artéfacts liés aux grenouilles. Là, il avait l'air perdu !
russian: К несчастью, там полный бардак! Я ожидала, что куратор сможет быстро указать книги и артефакты, имеющие отношение к лягушкам. Но он выглядел озадаченно.
bulgarian: Unfortunately it's a mess! You'd think a curator could quickly identify all books and artifacts that are related to frogs, but frankly he looked bewildered.

english: The man is clearly out of his depth.
french: Ce pauvre homme n'a clairement pas les compétences.
russian: Этот мужчина явно не разбирается в своём деле.
bulgarian: The man is clearly out of his depth.

english: I'm afraid I'll have to resort to careful experimentation to tease out the secrets of this frog. Local folk tales suggest some ideas...
french: Je crois que je vais devoir me lancer dans quelques expériences pour percer les secrets de cette grenouille. Les histoires populaires nous donnent quelques pistes...
russian: Придётся прибегнуть к осторожным экспериментам, чтобы выведать у этой лягушки её тайны. Из местных сказок можно почерпнуть кое-какие идеи...
bulgarian: I'm afraid I'll have to resort to careful experimentation to tease out the secrets of this frog. Local folk tales suggest some ideas...

english: Do you need any help?
french: Tu as besoin d'aide ?
russian: Тебе нужна помощь?
bulgarian: Do you need any help?

english: You're uh, not thinking of kissing that frog are you?
french: Euh... Tu ne vas quand même pas embrasser cette grenouille ?
russian: Ты же не думаешь, эм... целовать эту лягушку?
bulgarian: You're uh, not thinking of kissing that frog are you?

english: Oh I see how it is! NOW you want to be involved when the research is getting somewhere. No no, you had your chance.
french: Oh, je vois le genre ! On a envie de s'investir maintenant que les recherches aboutissent. Eh bien, non, trop tard.
russian: А, вот, значит, как! ТЕПЕРЬ, значит, когда исследование сдвинулось с мёртвой точки, ты хочешь присоединиться. Нет уж, шанс упущен.
bulgarian: Oh I see how it is! NOW you want to be involved when the research is getting somewhere. No no, you had your chance.

english: Well I am surprised! And here I thought I was the only one who had read that particular legend!
french: Tiens, en voilà une surprise ! Moi qui pensais être la seule à connaître cette légende !
russian:
Наконец-то ты меня

удивили

удивилаудивилудивило! А я-то думала, что, кроме меня, с этой легендой никто не знаком.
bulgarian: Well I am surprised! And here I thought I was the only one who had read that particular legend!

english: Just you wait, [Ari]. I think I'm onto something positively... ribbiting!
french: Tu vas voir, [Ari]. Je sens que je tiens quelque chose... d'in-croâ-yable !
russian: Вот увидишь, [Ari]. Мне кажется, я на пороге... пре-ква-сного открытия!
bulgarian: Just you wait, [Ari]. I think I'm onto something positively... ribbiting!

english: There you are! Have you gleaned anything from your amphibian research?
french: Te voilà ! As-tu découvert quelque chose en observant les amphibiens ?
russian: Вот ты где! Есть какой-нибудь прогресс в исследовании амфибий?
bulgarian: There you are! Have you gleaned anything from your amphibian research?

english: Ah, no...
french: Bah, non...
russian: А, нет...
bulgarian: Ah, no...

english: What are you talking about?
french: Qu'est-ce que tu racontes ?
russian: О чём ты?
bulgarian: What are you talking about?

english: I SAID I have misplaced the specimen.
french: J'ai dit que je ne trouvais plus le spécimen.
russian: Я ГОВОРЮ, что я не знаю, где сейчас мой подопытный.
bulgarian: I SAID I have misplaced the specimen.

english: It was important to leave the frog in his natural habitat, and with his unusual behavior, I assumed he would be simple to track down again.
french: C'était important de laisser la grenouille dans son habitat naturel, et vu son comportement inhabituel, je pensais la retrouver facilement.
russian: Лягушку было необходимо оставить в естественной среде обитания. Учитывая его необычное поведения, я полагала, что отыскать его не составит труда.
bulgarian: It was important to leave the frog in his natural habitat, and with his unusual behavior, I assumed he would be simple to track down again.

english: And now he's gone! Vanished! A potentially monumental magical research subject has slipped through my fingers!
french: Mais elle n'est plus là ! Elle a disparu ! Un sujet de recherche potentiellement monumental sur la magie m'a filé entre les doigts !
russian: И вот он исчез! Растворился! Возможно, это был ключ к монументальным магическим открытиям — и я его упустила!
bulgarian: And now he's gone! Vanished! A potentially monumental magical research subject has slipped through my fingers!

english: Aww, I'm sorry Juniper. Do you want me to bring you any frogs I find?
french: Ça m'embête pour toi, Juniper. Tu veux que je t'apporte des grenouilles ?
russian: Ой, бедная Джунипер. Хочешь, я буду приносить тебе всех лягушек, которых найду?
bulgarian: Aww, I'm sorry Juniper. Do you want me to bring you any frogs I find?

english: Looks like you need my help after all, huh?
french: Tu aurais peut-être besoin de mon aide finalement ?
russian: Выходит, без моей помощи тебе всё-таки не обойтись, да?
bulgarian: Looks like you need my help after all, huh?

english: I don't need your pity! I-
french: Garde ta pitié ! Je...
russian: Оставь свою жалость при себе! Я...
bulgarian: I don't need your pity! I-

english: The gall! Why I oughta turn YOU into a frog-
french: Quelle insolence ! Tu vas voir, c'est toi que je vais transformer en grenou...
russian: Какая наглость! Да я за такое ТЕБЯ превращу в лягушку...
bulgarian: The gall! Why I oughta turn YOU into a frog-

english: No, that's not fair. You've been more helpful than most.
french: Non, ce serait injuste. Tu m'as été plus utile que bien d'autres.
russian: Ладно, это несправедливо. Ты помогаешь гораздо больше, чем все остальные.
bulgarian: No, that's not fair. You've been more helpful than most.

english: Yes [Ari], I'd appreciate any frogs you come across.
french: Oui, [Ari], merci de m'apporter celles que tu trouveras.
russian: Да, [Ari], я буду рада, если ты будешь приносить мне лягушек.
bulgarian: Yes [Ari], I'd appreciate any frogs you come across.

english: I can't find him.
french: Je ne la trouve nulle part.
russian: Я его потеряла.
bulgarian: I can't find him.

english: So how did your research with the frog go?
french: Comment avancent tes recherches sur cette grenouille ?
russian: Так как прошли твои опыты с лягушкой?
bulgarian: So how did your research with the frog go?

english: Sorry, what?
french: De quoi tu parles ?
russian: Что, прости?
bulgarian: Sorry, what?

english: Did you know that bees have six legs and five eyes? It's true!
french: Tu sais qu'elles ont six pattes et cinq yeux ? C'est vrai !
russian: Ты знаешь, что у пчёл шесть лапок и пять глаз? Представляешь!
bulgarian: Did you know that bees have six legs and five eyes? It's true!

english: They have two big eyes, and three tiny eyes in the middle of their forehead!
french: Elles ont deux grands yeux et trois petits en plein milieu du front.
russian: Два больших глаза и ещё три малюсеньких посередине лба!
bulgarian: They have two big eyes, and three tiny eyes in the middle of their forehead!

english: Okay, bye!
french: Allez, je te laisse !
russian: Всё, пока!
bulgarian: Okay, bye!

english: [Ari]! I've enrolled you in my bee facts!
french: [Ari] ! Tu vas avoir la chance d'entendre mes anecdotes sur les abeilles.
russian: [Ari]! Ты получаешь подписку на факты о пчёлах!
bulgarian: [Ari]! I've enrolled you in my bee facts!

english: A queen bee can lay over three thousand eggs per day! Worker bees come from eggs fertilized by the queen.
french: La reine peut pondre plus de trois mille œufs chaque jour. Et les ouvrières viennent des œufs fécondés par la reine.
russian: Королева пчёл может откладывать больше трёх тысяч яиц в день! Из оплодотворённых яиц получаются рабочие пчёлы.
bulgarian: A queen bee can lay over three thousand eggs per day! Worker bees come from eggs fertilized by the queen.

english: Drones come from unfertilized eggs! And that's the end of today's bee fact!
french: Les faux bourdons, eux, naissent des œufs non fécondés. Et voilà pour l'anecdote du jour !
russian: А из неоплодотворённых — трутни! На сегодня хватит фактов о пчёлах!
bulgarian: Drones come from unfertilized eggs! And that's the end of today's bee fact!

english: It's time for another bee fact, [Ari]!
french: C'est l'heure d'une nouvelle anecdote sur les abeilles, [Ari] !
russian: Ещё один занимательный факт о пчёлах, [Ari]!
bulgarian: It's time for another bee fact, [Ari]!

english: Dad said it was a "real thinker"! Here it is:
french: Papa a dit qu'elle faisait vraiment réfléchir, celle-là ! Écoute !
russian: Папа сказал, что это «заставляет задуматься»! Так вот:
bulgarian: Dad said it was a "real thinker"! Here it is:

english: Our entire ecosystem would collapse without pollinators like bees.
french: Tout notre écosystème s'effondrerait sans les pollinisateurs comme les abeilles.
russian: Вся наша экосистема бы рухнула, если бы не было опылителей: таких, как пчёлы.
bulgarian: Our entire ecosystem would collapse without pollinators like bees.

english: Okay, bye!
french: Allez, je te laisse.
russian: Всё, пока!
bulgarian: Okay, bye!

english: [Ari]! New bee fact alert! It's super cool!
french: [Ari] ! J'ai une nouvelle anecdote sur les abeilles. Tu vas voir, c'est trop cool.
russian: [Ari], внимание: новый факт о пчёлах! Очень-очень крутой!
bulgarian: [Ari]! New bee fact alert! It's super cool!

english: Did you hear Luc's latest bee fact? Bit of a barnburner, that one.
french: Tu as entendu la dernière anecdote de Luc sur les abeilles ? Il en a dans la caboche, le petit.
russian:
Слышали

СлышалаСлышалСлышало последний факт о пчёлах от Люка? Довольно впечатляюще.
bulgarian: Did you hear Luc's latest bee fact? Bit of a barnburner, that one.

english: Now they're my favorite!
french: Maintenant, je les adore !
russian: Теперь я их люблю!
bulgarian: Now they're my favorite!

english: I didn't care much about bees until Luc told me there was a queen.
french: Je ne m'intéressais pas trop aux abeilles jusqu'à ce que Luc me dise qu'elles avaient une reine.
russian: Я не особенно интересовалась пчёлами, пока Люк не рассказал, что у них есть королева.
bulgarian: I didn't care much about bees until Luc told me there was a queen.

english: Did Luc tell you his bee fact? He worked so hard on it!
french: Luc t'a raconté son anecdote sur les abeilles ? Il y a passé du temps !
russian: Люк тебе рассказал свой пчелиный факт? Он очень старался!
bulgarian: Did Luc tell you his bee fact? He worked so hard on it!

english: Like, he showed me how to get copper ore out of seams in the rock! It's all in the wrist, [Ari].
french: Il m'a montré comment extraire le minerai de cuivre présent dans les veines ! Tout est dans le poignet, [Ari].
russian: Например, он показывал мне, как добывать медную руду из прожилок в камне! Главное — ловкость рук, [Ari].
bulgarian: Like, he showed me how to get copper ore out of seams in the rock! It's all in the wrist, [Ari].

english: When I was learning the ropes, it was Errol who walked me through the ins and outs of mining. He's super nice!
french: Jeune apprenti, c'est Errol qui m'a tout expliqué sur le travail dans les mines. Il est vraiment sympa.
russian: Когда я только учился шахтёрскому делу, именно Эррол показал мне, как что работает. Он очень добрый человек!
bulgarian: When I was learning the ropes, it was Errol who walked me through the ins and outs of mining. He's super nice!

english: Nature combined a bath and a shortcut. What's better than that?
french: La nature a créé un bain qui sert aussi de raccourci. Que rêver de mieux ?
russian: Сразу и ванну принял и путь срезал — хорошо природа предусмотрела!
bulgarian: Nature combined a bath and a shortcut. What's better than that?

english: I was thinking about the old days in the Mines, back before the quake... I loved jumping into those whirlpools in the underground springs.
french: Je repensais aux mines avant le tremblement de terre... J'adorais plonger dans les siphons des sources chaudes souterraines.
russian: Помню, как я раньше, до землетрясения, ходил в шахты... Я обожал нырять в водовороты в подземных источниках.
bulgarian: I was thinking about the old days in the Mines, back before the quake... I loved jumping into those whirlpools in the underground springs.

english: But it always made me feel good to leave them my coolest rocks.
french: Mais ça me faisait toujours plaisir d'y déposer mes plus belles pierres.
russian: Но мне всегда было приятно оставлять там самые крутые камни.
bulgarian: But it always made me feel good to leave them my coolest rocks.

english: There were these shrines down in the Mines, and I don't know who they were for or who made them...
french: Il y avait des autels tout au fond des mines. Je ne sais pas à qui ils étaient dédiés ni qui les a construits...
russian: Там, в шахтах, были странные алтари. Не знаю, для кого они были и кто их сделал...
bulgarian: There were these shrines down in the Mines, and I don't know who they were for or who made them...

english: She said ants are cute and strong... I'm so glad!
french: Elle a dit que les fourmis étaient adorables et super fortes... Je suis trop content !
russian: Она сказала, что муравьи милые и сильные... Я очень доволен!
bulgarian: She said ants are cute and strong... I'm so glad!

english: I thought my big sister wasn't listening when I told her about ants, but she totally was!
french: Je pensais que ma grande sœur n'écoutait pas quand je lui parlais des fourmis, mais si !
russian: Когда я рассказывал старшей сестре про муравьёв, я думал, она не слушает. А она ещё как слушала!
bulgarian: I thought my big sister wasn't listening when I told her about ants, but she totally was!

english: Reina made my favorite snack while we talked about insects! I've got a great big sister.
french: Reina m'a préparé mon encas préféré pendant qu'on parlait des insectes ! J'ai la meilleure grande sœur du monde.
russian: Рейна готовила мне мою любимую закуску, а в это время мы говорили о насекомых! У меня отличная старшая сестра!
bulgarian: Reina made my favorite snack while we talked about insects! I've got a great big sister.

english: She said they glow to attract a mate, which I verified in the latest Royal Society of Entomology Almanac.
french: Elle a dit qu'elles luisaient pour attirer leurs partenaires, ce que j'ai vérifié dans le catalogue de la Société royale d'entomologie.
russian: Она сказала, что светом они привлекают партнёра. Я потом перепроверил по последнему «Справочнику Королевского энтомологического общества».
bulgarian: She said they glow to attract a mate, which I verified in the latest Royal Society of Entomology Almanac.

english: I wonder how humans find mates. Reina said Pa would tell me when I'm older? I don't get it!
french: Je me demande quel est le mode de séduction des humains... Reina m'a dit que papa m'expliquerait quand je serai plus grand. Je ne vois pas pourquoi !
russian: Интересно, а как люди находят партнёров? Рейна говорит, папа мне расскажет, когда буду постарше. Не знаю, почему!
bulgarian: I wonder how humans find mates. Reina said Pa would tell me when I'm older? I don't get it!

english: Reina taught me something about fireflies. That's so cool!
french: Reina m'a appris quelque chose sur les lucioles. C'est trop cool !
russian: Рейна рассказала мне кое-что про светлячков. Представляешь, как круто!
bulgarian: Reina taught me something about fireflies. That's so cool!

english: But bugs aren't really my thing, you know? Help me review, [Ari]?
french: Mais ce n'est pas trop mon truc, tu sais ? Tu pourrais m'aider à réviser, [Ari] ?
russian: Но жуки — это совсем не моё, понимаешь? Можешь меня проверить?
bulgarian: But bugs aren't really my thing, you know? Help me review, [Ari]?

english: Ants are really strong right?
french: Les fourmis sont très fortes, c'est ça ?
russian: Муравьи же очень сильные, да?

english: The Eastern Road dig sites seem to turn up Caldosian artifacts. They share similarities with Aldarian artifacts, but feature more filigree and silver accents.
bulgarian: The Eastern Road dig sites seem to turn up Caldosian artifacts. They share similarities with Aldarian artifacts, but feature more filigree and silver accents.

english: The Eastern Road dig sites seem to turn up Caldosian artifacts. They share similarities with Aldarian artifacts, but feature more filigree and silver accents.
french: On trouve des artéfacts caldosiens aux sites de fouilles de la route de l'est. Ils ont des similitudes avec les aldariens, mais en plus filigranés et avec des touches argentées.
russian: На Восточной дороге, кажется, чаще встречаются кальдосийские артефакты. У них есть сходства с альдарийскими, но больше филигранных и серебряных элементов.
bulgarian: The Eastern Road dig sites seem to turn up Caldosian artifacts. They share similarities with Aldarian artifacts, but feature more filigree and silver accents.

english: The Eastern Road dig sites seem to turn up Caldosian artifacts. They share similarities with Aldarian artifacts, but feature more filigree and silver accents.
french: On trouve des artéfacts caldosiens aux sites de fouilles de la route de l'est. Ils ont des similitudes avec les aldariens, mais en plus filigranés et avec des touches argentées.
russian: На Восточной дороге, кажется, чаще встречаются кальдосийские артефакты. У них есть сходства с альдарийскими, но больше филигранных и серебряных элементов.
bulgarian: The Eastern Road dig sites seem to turn up Caldosian artifacts. They share similarities with Aldarian artifacts, but feature more filigree and silver accents.

english: How exciting that you're beginning your archaeological journey! We're in it together, so don't hesitate to rely on me!
french: Tes pérégrinations archéologiques commencent seulement, c'est fantastique ! Je serai à tes côtés, alors n'hésite pas à me demander des conseils.
russian: Рад видеть, что ты начинаешь свой путь археолога! Это наше общее дело, так что можешь положиться на меня!
bulgarian: How exciting that you're beginning your archaeological journey! We're in it together, so don't hesitate to rely on me!

english: Keep it up, and one day you'll be a master archaeologist! I'm sure of it!
french: Continue comme ça et tu deviendras très vite un<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they> archéologue confirmé<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they> ! J'en suis convaincu !
russian: Если будешь так продолжать, когда-нибудь станешь специалистом в археологии! Я в тебя верю!
bulgarian: Keep it up, and one day you'll be a master archaeologist! I'm sure of it!

english: Your excavation techniques are becoming more refined, [Ari]. I can tell by the artifacts you're bringing in.
french: Ta technique de fouille commence à s'améliorer [Ari]. Je le vois aux artéfacts que tu apportes.
russian:
Ты заметно

отточили

отточилаотточилотточило свою технику раскопок, [Ari]. Я вижу по артефактам, которые ты приносишь в последнее время.
bulgarian: Your excavation techniques are becoming more refined, [Ari]. I can tell by the artifacts you're bringing in.

english: To say I'm impressed would understate it. Good work!
french: Tu m'en vois très impressionné, et c'est peu de le dire. Beau travail !
russian: Сказать, что я впечатлён, — это ничего не сказать! Отличная работа!
bulgarian: To say I'm impressed would understate it. Good work!

english: You've become very skilled with archaeological fieldwork, [Ari].
french: Tu es devenu<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they> vraiment très doué<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they> dans le domaine de l'archéologie, [Ari].
russian: [Ari], у тебя просто превосходный навык полевой археологической работы!
bulgarian: You've become very skilled with archaeological fieldwork, [Ari].

english: It's an honor working to discover the secrets of Mistria's history with you.
french: C'est un honneur de découvrir les secrets de l'histoire de Mistria avec toi.
russian: Открывать тайны мистрийской истории вместе с тобой — это честь для меня.
bulgarian: It's an honor working to discover the secrets of Mistria's history with you.

english: With your ability and time in the field, you've surpassed many of the premier archaeologists of the Capital, [Ari].
french: Vu tes compétences et le temps passé sur le terrain, tu en sais déjà plus que bon nombre d'archéologues de renom de la capitale, [Ari].
russian:
По навыкам и опыту работы в поле ты

превзошли

превзошлапревзошёлпревзошло уже многих ведущих археологов из столицы, [Ari].
bulgarian: With your ability and time in the field, you've surpassed many of the premier archaeologists of the Capital, [Ari].

english: The breadth of your discoveries have opened so many lines of research.
french: L'abondance de tes découvertes a ouvert tant de nouvelles pistes de recherche.
russian: Твои находки позволили открыть широкие горизонты для самых разнообразных исследований.
bulgarian: The breadth of your discoveries have opened so many lines of research.

english: They'll be singing your praises for generations to come!
french: Les générations à venir loueront tes exploits.
russian: Многие поколения потомков будут петь тебе дифирамбы!
bulgarian: They'll be singing your praises for generations to come!

english: Never in Mistria's history has there been an archaeologist so prolific as you, [Ari].
french: Mistria n'avait jamais connu d'archéologue aussi efficace que toi, [Ari].
russian: В истории Мистрии никогда не было таких выдающихся археологов, как ты, [Ari].
bulgarian: Never in Mistria's history has there been an archaeologist so prolific as you, [Ari].

english: Many insects live in trees. If you give the trunk a little shake, sometimes they'll come out to say hello!
french: Il y a plein d'insectes qui vivent dans les arbres. En secouant un peu le tronc, ils viennent parfois faire un petit coucou.
russian: Многие насекомые живут на деревьях. Если слегка потрясти ствол, они иногда выйдут поздороваться!
bulgarian: Many insects live in trees. If you give the trunk a little shake, sometimes they'll come out to say hello!

english: Did you know that you can shake bugs out of trees and you won't get in trouble even if they land in your mom's hair?
french: Tu savais que tu pouvais secouer les arbres pour en faire tomber des insectes ? En plus, même s'ils terminent dans les cheveux de ta mère, ce n'est pas ta faute.
russian: Ты знаешь, что с деревьев можно стряхивать жучков? И тебя никто не накажет, даже если они упадут маме в волосы!
bulgarian: Did you know that you can shake bugs out of trees and you won't get in trouble even if they land in your mom's hair?

english: Young Luc informed me that you can find many new insect specimens by shaking trees. I'll, ah, leave that to you, [Ari].
french: Le jeune Luc m'a dit que l'on pouvait trouver de nombreuses espèces d'insectes en secouant les arbres. Je, euh... Je te laisse le soin de vérifier cela, [Ari].
russian: Юный Люк сообщил мне, что многих насекомых можно найти, если трясти деревья. Просто, эм, решил сообщить, [Ari].
bulgarian: Young Luc informed me that you can find many new insect specimens by shaking trees. I'll, ah, leave that to you, [Ari].

english: I'm debuting my latest Dragons and Drama campaign, it's a little historical learning tool and fun game that I cooked up!
french: Je viens de lancer ma dernière campagne de Dangers & Dragons. C'est un petit jeu amusant de mon invention qui mêle aventure et découverte de l'histoire.
russian: Я начну свою новую кампанию в «Перепалки & Драконы». Это познавательная историческая игра, которую я сам придумал!
bulgarian: I'm debuting my latest Dragons and Drama campaign, it's a little historical learning tool and fun game that I cooked up!

english: I do hope you'll make it to the Inn tonight, [Ari].
french: J'espère que tu pourras venir à l'auberge ce soir, [Ari].
russian: Надеюсь, у тебя получится заглянуть в трактир сегодня вечером, [Ari].
bulgarian: I do hope you'll make it to the Inn tonight, [Ari].

english: Everyone's going to be there, I hope you can make it too!
french: Tout le monde sera là, j'espère qu'on t'y verra aussi !
russian: Там все собираются. Надеюсь, ты тоже придёшь!
bulgarian: Everyone's going to be there, I hope you can make it too!

english: [Ari]! Are you coming to the Sleeping Dragon Inn tonight?
french: [Ari] ! Tu viens à l'auberge du Dragon qui dort ce soir ?
russian: [Ari]! Пойдёшь сегодня вечером в трактир «Спящий дракон»?
bulgarian: [Ari]! Are you coming to the Sleeping Dragon Inn tonight?

english: Oh don't mind me, I'm just getting ready for tonight's gathering at the Inn. You'll be there, right?
french: Oh, ne fais pas attention à moi, je m'occupe des préparatifs pour la soirée de ce soir. Tu viendras, hein ?
russian: А, не обращай внимания, я тут готовлюсь к вечернему собранию в трактире. Ты же придёшь, правда?
bulgarian: Oh don't mind me, I'm just getting ready for tonight's gathering at the Inn. You'll be there, right?

english: Don't miss tonight's get-together at the Inn, [Ari]. That's when I break out the good stuff.
french: Ne manque pas la fête de ce soir avec tout le monde, [Ari]. C'est là que j'ouvre mes meilleures bouteilles.
russian: Не пропусти сегодняшнюю встречу в трактире, [Ari]. Самые лучшие штучки я припасаю до пятницы.
bulgarian: Don't miss tonight's get-together at the Inn, [Ari]. That's when I break out the good stuff.

english: It's the only night grown-ups get to have fun... poor grown-ups.
french: C'est le seul soir où les adultes peuvent s'amuser... Les pauvres.
russian: Это единственный вечер, когда взрослым тоже можно поиграть... Бедные взрослые.
bulgarian: It's the only night grown-ups get to have fun... poor grown-ups.

english: Will you come play at the Inn tonight, [Ari]?
french: Tu viendras jouer avec moi à l'auberge ce soir, [Ari] ?
russian: Ты придёшь играть вечером в трактир, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Will you come play at the Inn tonight, [Ari]?

english: The whole town will be at the Inn tonight. I hope to see you there!
french: Toute la ville sera réunie à l'auberge ce soir. J'espère que tu viendras aussi.
russian: Сегодня в трактире соберётся весь город. Надеюсь, тебя я там тоже увижу!
bulgarian: The whole town will be at the Inn tonight. I hope to see you there!

english: I love Friday nights at the Inn! It was so nice to see everyone relaxing.
bulgarian: I love Friday nights at the Inn! It was so nice to see everyone relaxing.

english: I love Friday nights at the Inn! It was so nice to see everyone relaxing.
french: J'adore les soirées du vendredi à l'auberge. C'est agréable de voir tout le monde si détendu !
russian: Обожаю встречи в трактире по пятницам! Так хорошо, когда все отдыхают.

russian: О-ох, вчера вечером в трактире было не протолкнуться! Я так рада, что всем всё понравилось!

english: A beautifully carved wooden chicken. It looks very snug in its basket.
french: Magnifique poule en bois sculpté. Elle a l'air douillettement installée dans son panier.
russian: Изящно вырезанная деревянная курица. Она так уютно устроилась в корзине!

english: A large clothing trunk. It smells like grain, warm and sweet.
french: Grand coffre à vêtements. Il s'en dégage l'odeur douce et réconfortante du grain.

english: Pictures of animals are prominently displayed on the wall.

english: A well sealed crate. It smells faintly of oak and rum.

russian: Крепко запечатанный ящик. Слегка пахнет дубом и ромом.

bulgarian: A family portrait depicting young Adeline and Eiland with their parents, the Baron and Baroness.

bulgarian: A dog-eared pile of history books. Eiland must reference them often.

english: History books and board games clutter the shelves.
french: Des livres d'histoire et des jeux de plateau encombrent les étagères.
russian: В шкафу свалены книги по истории и настольные игры.
bulgarian: History books and board games clutter the shelves.

english: It's full of sweet-smelling strawberry candy.

french: La reproduction d'une amphore aldarienne est posée sur le haut de l'étagère...

bulgarian: "Bringing the Dark Ages to a close, the fractured Alda tribes united to found the Kingdom of Aldaria."

english: A stately book sits prominently on the shelf...
french: Un ouvrage imposant trône sur l'étagère...

french: L'entrée des mines a été condamnée avec des planches.
russian: Кажется, вход в шахты заколочен.
bulgarian: The entrance to the $Mines$ appears to be boarded up...

english: The doorway has been resealed after your and March's incident.
french: L'accès a été de nouveau condamné après l'incident vous impliquant, March et vous.
russian: После вашего с Мартом происшествия проход снова запечатали.
bulgarian: The doorway has been resealed after your and March's incident.

english: "Do not enter."
french: « Entrée interdite. »
russian: «Не входить».
bulgarian: "Do not enter."

english: "Do not enter."
french: « Entrée interdite. »
russian: «Не входить».
bulgarian: "Do not enter."

english: The stairs look too dangerous to climb in this state. They were probably destroyed in the earthquake.
french: Il est trop dangereux d'emprunter l'escalier dans son état actuel. Il a sans doute été détruit par le tremblement de terre.
russian: При нынешнем состоянии ступеней забираться по ним опасно. Вероятно, они обрушились от землетрясения.
bulgarian: The stairs look too dangerous to climb in this state. They were probably destroyed in the earthquake.

english: Rubble blocks what appears to be a cave entrance.
french: Des gravats obstruent ce qui ressemble à l'entrée d'une grotte.
russian: Видимо, это вход в пещеру, заваленный обломками.
bulgarian: Rubble blocks what appears to be a cave entrance.

english: An ancient stone gryphon. They seem to be a common feature in the Narrows.
french: Ancien griffon de pierre. Il n'est pas rare d'en trouver, sur les Terrasses.
russian: Древний каменный грифон. Кажется, они часто встречаются в ущелье.
bulgarian: An ancient stone gryphon. They seem to be a common feature in the Narrows.

english: An ancient stone gryphon. They seem to be a common feature in the Narrows.
french: Ancien griffon de pierre. Il n'est pas rare d'en trouver, sur les Terrasses.
russian: Древний каменный грифон. Кажется, они часто встречаются в ущелье.
bulgarian: An ancient stone gryphon. They seem to be a common feature in the Narrows.

english: An ancient stone gryphon. They seem to be a common feature in the Narrows.
french: Ancien griffon de pierre. Il n'est pas rare d'en trouver, sur les Terrasses.
russian: Древний каменный грифон. Кажется, они часто встречаются в ущелье.
bulgarian: An ancient stone gryphon. They seem to be a common feature in the Narrows.

english: ^"Her Highness has given her order."^
french: ^« Sa Majesté a parlé. »^
russian: ^«Её величество дала приказ».^
bulgarian: ^"Her Highness has given her order."^

english: ^"The $Dragon Forge$ shall remain burning, day and night."^
french: ^« La $forge-dragon$ doit fonctionner de jour comme de nuit, sans interruption. »^
russian: ^«$Драконья кузня$ должна пылать днём и ночью».^
bulgarian: ^"The $Dragon Forge$ shall remain burning, day and night."^

english: A scroll lays open on the ancient workbench...
french: Un parchemin est ouvert sur le vieil établi...
russian: На древнем рабочем столе лежит раскрытый свиток...
bulgarian: A scroll lays open on the ancient workbench...

english: ^"The sun and moon govern heaven and earth."^
french: ^« Le soleil et la lune régissent le firmament et la terre. »^
russian: ^«Солнце и луна правят на небесах и на земле».^
bulgarian: ^"The sun and moon govern heaven and earth."^

english: ^"Their lights shine down-"^
french: ^« Nous sommes baignés de leur lumière... »^
russian: ^«Их свет сияет нам...»^
bulgarian: ^"Their lights shine down-"^

english: ^"Yet I fear darkness is rising."^
french: ^« Or, je crains que les ténèbres ne grandissent. »^
russian: ^«Но я боюсь, что тьма растёт».^
bulgarian: ^"Yet I fear darkness is rising."^

english: An ornate scroll lays open on the crumbling workbench...
french: Un parchemin enluminé est ouvert sur l'établi en mauvais état...
russian: На осыпающемся рабочем столе лежит раскрытый свиток...
bulgarian: An ornate scroll lays open on the crumbling workbench...

english: The dragon-fire stove in its base was likely used for cooking and ambient warmth.
french: Le brasier en forme de dragon devait servir à cuisiner et à réchauffer la pièce.
russian: Плита с драконьим пламенем, вероятно, использовалась для готовки и обогрева помещения.
bulgarian: Печката с драконов огън в основата му вероятно е служила за готвене и за топлина.

english: An ancient stone bedstead.
french: C'est un ancien sommier en pierre.
russian: Древняя каменная кровать.
bulgarian: Древно каменно легло.

english: ^"His Lordship grows increasingly wary with the waxing of the moon."^
french: ^« La fatigue gagne de plus en plus Son Excellence à mesure que la lune entre dans sa phase croissante. »^
russian: ^«Его милость всё более обеспокоен растущей луной».^
bulgarian: ^„Негово благородие става все по-предпазлив с нарастването на луната.“^

english: ^"We must continue to perform the sacred rituals, despite events above ground."^
french: ^« Nous devons poursuivre les rituels sacrés malgré les événements qui se produisent à la surface. »^
russian: ^«Мы обязаны продолжать священные ритуалы, невзирая на события на поверхности».^
bulgarian: ^„Трябва да продължим да изпълняваме свещените ритуали въпреки събитията на повърхността.“^

english: ^"The flow of $Magic$ remains steady, for now."^
french: ^« Le flux de $magie$ demeure stable, pour l'instant. »^
russian: ^«Поток $магии$ пока стабилен».^
bulgarian: ^„Потокът на $магията$ засега остава стабилен.“^

english: ^"Yet I wonder..."^
french: ^« Pourtant, je ne peux pas m'empêcher de me poser la question... »^
russian: ^«Но я переживаю...»^
bulgarian: ^„Но се питам…“^

english: ^"Will we be able to weather the gathering storm?"^
french: ^« Parviendrons-nous à résister à la tempête qui s'annonce ? »^
russian: ^«Сможем ли мы выдержать надвигающаюся бурю?»^
bulgarian: ^„Ще успеем ли да устоим на задаващата се буря?“^

english: An ornate scroll lays open on the dusty shelf...
french: Un parchemin enluminé est ouvert sur l'étagère poussiéreuse...
russian: На пыльной полке лежит раскрытый свиток...
bulgarian: Украсен свитък лежи разгънат върху прашния рафт…

english: An ancient statue depicting a Dragon Priestess. They must have worshipped at this temple long ago.
french: Statue ancienne représentant une prêtresse dragon. Ce temple devait être un lieu de culte, il y a fort longtemps.
russian: Древняя статуя, изображающая жрицу дракона. Видимо, давным-давно это был их храм.
bulgarian: An ancient statue depicting a Dragon Priestess. They must have worshipped at this temple long ago.

english: The side of the sand castle is engraved with the name "Fort Dangerous II".
french: Sur le côté du château de sable est inscrit le nom « Fort Redoutable II ».
russian: На боку песочного замка написано название «Форт Опасный II».
bulgarian: The side of the sand castle is engraved with the name "Fort Dangerous II".

english: The shelves are piled high with scrolls and strange objects.
french: Les étagères sont remplies de parchemins et d'objets insolites.
russian: Эти полки доверху набиты свитками и непонятными предметами.
bulgarian: The shelves are piled high with scrolls and strange objects.

english: A mysterious fire burns. You might be able to use this for something later...
french: Un feu d'une nature mystérieuse brûle. Cela pourrait bien vous servir plus tard...
russian: Здесь горит мистический огонь. Возможно, он пригодится вам позже...
bulgarian: A mysterious fire burns. You might be able to use this for something later...

english: A planter full of spring flowers. They smell nice!
french: Un bac rempli de fleurs de printemps. Elles sentent bon !
russian: Клумба с весенними цветами. Они так приятно пахнут!
bulgarian: A planter full of spring flowers. They smell nice!

english: Freshly dried fish.
french: Poisson fraîchement séché.
russian: Свежезасушенная рыба.
bulgarian: Freshly dried fish.

english: A shelf of nautical trinkets.
french: Étagère remplie de petits objets en lien avec la mer.
russian: Шкаф с морскими безделушками.
bulgarian: A shelf of nautical trinkets.

english: A model of an impressively large fish.
french: Maquette d'un poisson de taille impressionnante.
russian: Макет необычайно большой рыбы.
bulgarian: A model of an impressively large fish.

english: The fountain adds a peaceful atmosphere to the upper town square.
french: La fontaine confère à la place principale une atmosphère apaisante.
russian: Фонтан придаёт верхней городской площади атмосферу спокойствия.
bulgarian: The fountain adds a peaceful atmosphere to the upper town square.

english: Seridia's treasure hoard is very impressive!
french: La collection de trésors de Seridia est très impressionnante !
russian: Поистине впечатляющая груда сокровищ Серидии!
bulgarian: Seridia's treasure hoard is very impressive!

english: Seridia's treasure hoard is very impressive!
french: La collection de trésors de Seridia est très impressionnante !
russian: Поистине впечатляющая груда сокровищ Серидии!
bulgarian: Seridia's treasure hoard is very impressive!

english: The stairs look too dangerous to climb in this state. They were probably destroyed in the earthquake.
french: Il est trop dangereux d'emprunter l'escalier dans son état actuel. Il a sans doute été détruit par le tremblement de terre.
russian: При нынешнем состоянии ступеней забираться по ним опасно. Вероятно, они обрушились от землетрясения.
bulgarian: The stairs look too dangerous to climb in this state. They were probably destroyed in the earthquake.

english: A variety of tools and pottery fragments are laid out on the tarp.
french: Divers outils et fragments de poteries sont dispersés sur la bâche.
russian: На тенте разложены разнообразные инструменты и фрагменты керамики.
bulgarian: A variety of tools and pottery fragments are laid out on the tarp.

english: Archaeology equipment sits at the edge of the dig site.
french: Du matériel archéologique est posé aux abords du site de fouilles.
russian: На краю раскопа сложено археологическое снаряжение.
bulgarian: Archaeology equipment sits at the edge of the dig site.

english: You want to know about the history of the Mines?
french: Tu veux que je te raconte l'histoire des mines ?
russian: Ты хочешь послушать историю шахт?
bulgarian: Искаш да разбереш историята на Мините?

english: We don't know too much, but there is evidence a pre-Aldarian society once utilized underground chambers for cultural and religious activities.
french: Nous avons peu d'informations, mais nous savons qu'une civilisation pré-aldarienne utilisait jadis les salles souterraines pour des activités culturelles et des rites religieux.
russian: Нам мало что известно. Однако, по сохранившимся свидетельствам, в некоем доальдарийском обществе подземные залы использовали для религиозных и культурных практик.
bulgarian: Не знаем много, но има доказателства, че предалдарийско общество някога е използвало подземните зали за културни и религиозни дейности.

english: Pre-Aldarian, Pre-Alda, its origins likely predate even the rule of the Witch Queens.
french: Pré-aldarienne ou pré-aldéenne, ses origines sont sûrement antérieures au règne des Reines-sorcières.
russian: До Альдарии и до Альды. Вероятно, они зародились даже до Эпохи королев-ведьм.
bulgarian: Предалдарийско, преди Алда — произходът му вероятно предхожда дори управлението на Вещерските кралици.

english: There are surely artifacts yet to be discovered that will reveal more about them.
french: Il doit y avoir des artéfacts qui s'ils étaient mis à jour nous en révéleraient plus sur eux.
russian: Где-то точно скрываются артефакты, которые могут рассказать нам больше об этом обществе.
bulgarian: Сигурно още има неоткрити артефакти, които ще разкрият повече за тях.

english: Hi [Ari], what's on your mind? I don't have any updates on that second dragon statue yet.
french: Bonjour [Ari], qu'y a-t-il ? Je n'ai pas plus d'info sur la deuxième statue de dragon.
russian: Привет, [Ari]. О чём думаешь? Насчёт второй статуи дракона у меня нет новостей.
bulgarian: Здравей, [Ari], какво те води насам? Още нямам новини за онази втора драконова статуя.

english: I'm telling you, eerie things have been happening there since the earthquake.
french: C'est bien ce que je disais, il se passe des choses étranges depuis le tremblement de terre.
russian: Я же говорил. С тех пор, как прошло землетрясение, там творится что-то неладное.
bulgarian: Казвам ти, от земетресението насам там се случват зловещи неща.

english: I'm glad we've got someone brave to look into it.
french: Je suis content que nous ayons quelqu'un d'assez courageux pour se pencher sur la question.
russian: Хорошо, что у нас нашёлся смельчак, готовый это исследовать.
bulgarian: Радвам се, че има някой смел, който да проучи това.

english: A voice... in the Mines?
french: Une voix... dans les mines ?
russian: Голос... в шахтах?
bulgarian: Глас... в Мините?

english: ^Hero... Help...^
french: ^<she>Héroïne</she><he>Héros</he><they>Être héroïque</they>... À l'aide...^
russian: ^Герой... Помоги...^
bulgarian: ^<he>Герою</he><she>Героиньо</she><they>Герои</they>... Помогни...^

english: A faint whisper breaks the silence...
french: Un murmure à peine audible vient briser le silence...
russian: В тишине слышится едва уловимый шёпот...
bulgarian: Тих шепот разкъсва тишината...

english: Looking at your $Lifetime Planner$ fills you with hope for the future. You feel $your energy renewed$.
french: Regarder votre $agenda$ vous emplit d'espoir pour l'avenir. Cela vous donne un $regain d'énergie$.
bulgarian: Looking at your $Lifetime Planner$ fills you with hope for the future. You feel $your energy renewed$.

english: The Animal Festival is today!
french: La fête des animaux a lieu aujourd'hui !
russian: Сегодня Фестиваль животных!
bulgarian: The Animal Festival is today!

english: $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ already has a baby on the way!
french: $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ attend déjà un bébé !
russian: $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ уже ожидает потомство!
bulgarian: $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ already has a baby on the way!

english: $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ has already eaten a treat!
french: $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ a déjà mangé une friandise !
russian: Вы уже давали сердечко этому животному!
bulgarian: $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ has already eaten a treat!

english: [ANIMAL_PAIR], $[BREEDING_PARTNER]$, has already eaten a =[TREAT_ITEM]=, so $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ cannot!
french: $[BREEDING_PARTNER]$, [ANIMAL_PAIR], a déjà mangé un =[TREAT_ITEM]=, donc $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ n'y a pas droit !
russian: Но [ANIMAL_PAIR] по имени $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ не может съесть =[TREAT_ITEM]=, потому что другое сердечко хранит $[BREEDING_PARTNER]$!
bulgarian: [ANIMAL_PAIR], $[BREEDING_PARTNER]$, has already eaten a =[TREAT_ITEM]=, so $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ cannot!

english: $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ can't eat this until they've grown up!
french: $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ n'y a pas droit avant d'avoir grandi un peu plus !
russian: $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ надо вырасти постарше, чтобы это есть!
bulgarian: $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ can't eat this until they've grown up!

english: $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ cannot breed until they've reached $2 Hearts$!
french: $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ ne peut pas se reproduire avant d'avoir atteint un niveau de $2 cœurs$.
russian: $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ не может скрещиваться, пока привязанность ниже $2 сердечек$!
bulgarian: $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ cannot breed until they've reached $2 Hearts$!

english: Give $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ a Heart Treat? If you give $[ANIMAL_PAIR]$ a Heart Treat, they'll mate.
french: Donner un cœur à croquer à $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ ? Si vous donnez aussi un cœur à croquer à $[ANIMAL_PAIR]$, ils se reproduiront.
russian: $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ получит сердечко. Когда второе сердечко получит $[ANIMAL_PAIR]$, они скрестятся. Продолжить?
bulgarian: Give $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ a Heart Treat? If you give $[ANIMAL_PAIR]$ a Heart Treat, they'll mate.

english: Yes
french: Oui
russian: Да
bulgarian: Yes

english: No
french: Non
russian: Нет
bulgarian: No

english: There are no incubators available in $[ANIMAL_NAME]'s$ building!
french: Il n’y a pas de couveuse libre dans le bâtiment où se trouve $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ !
russian: В здании, где живёт $[ANIMAL_NAME]'s$, нет свободных инкубаторов!
bulgarian: There are no incubators available in $[ANIMAL_NAME]'s$ building!

english: There isn't enough room in $[ANIMAL_NAME]'s$ building for a baby!
french: Il n'y a pas assez de place dans le bâtiment où se trouve $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ pour accueillir un petit !
russian: В здании, где живёт $[ANIMAL_NAME]'s$, нет места для детёныша!
bulgarian: There isn't enough room in $[ANIMAL_NAME]'s$ building for a baby!

english: Give $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ a Heart Treat? If you do, they'll mate with $[BREEDING_PARTNER]$.
french: Donner un cœur à croquer à $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ ? Si vous lui donnez, $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ et $[BREEDING_PARTNER]$ se reproduiront.
russian: $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ получит сердечко. Второе сердечко хранит $[BREEDING_PARTNER]$. Вы хотите скрестить их?
bulgarian: Give $[ANIMAL_NAME]$ a Heart Treat? If you do, they'll mate with $[BREEDING_PARTNER]$.

english: Yes
french: Oui
russian: Да
bulgarian: Yes

english: No
french: Non
russian: Нет
bulgarian: No

english: Looking at the sea glass gem reminds you of how far you've come. You feel $your energy renewed$.
french: Contempler ce joyau en verre poli vous rappelle tout le chemin parcouru. Cela vous donne un $regain d'énergie$.
bulgarian: Looking at the sea glass gem reminds you of how far you've come. You feel $your energy renewed$.

english: Zzz...
french: Zzz...
russian: *храпит*
bulgarian: Zzz...

english: The statue of Caldarus looks peaceful. You sense that he awaits you in the $Deep Woods$...
french: La statue de Caldarus a un air serein. Vous sentez qu'il vous attend à $Boissombre$...
russian: У статуи Кальдаруса спокойный вид. Вы чувствуете, что он ожидает вас в $Глубокой чаще$...
bulgarian: The statue of Caldarus looks peaceful. You sense that he awaits you in the $Deep Woods$...

english: Upon closer inspection, it appears that Caldarus has been making offerings to your statue. You receive some $Essence$.
french: En y regardant de plus près, il semble que Caldarus ait fait des offrandes à votre statue. Vous recevez de l'$essence$.
bulgarian: При по-внимателен оглед изглежда, че Калдаръс е оставял дарове пред статуята ти. Получаваш малко $Есенция$.

english: The timing isn't right to propose, with $Caldarus still bound to the Deep Woods$. For now it would be best to focus on $breaking the Final Seal$.
bulgarian: The timing isn't right to propose, with $Caldarus still bound to the Deep Woods$. For now it would be best to focus on $breaking the Final Seal$.

english: Teleport to the Deep Woods.\n(10 Essence)
french: Se téléporter à Boissombre.\n(Coût : 10 points d'essence)
russian: Телепорт до пункта: Глубокая чаща.\n(10 эссенции)
bulgarian: Teleport to the Deep Woods.\n(10 Essence)

english: Maybe later.
french: Peut-être plus tard.
russian: В другой раз.
bulgarian: Maybe later.

english: The statue of Caldarus looks peaceful.
french: La statue de Caldarus a un air serein.
russian: У статуи Кальдаруса спокойный вид.
bulgarian: The statue of Caldarus looks peaceful.

english: You do not have the 10 essence needed to teleport.
french: Vous n'avez pas les 10 points d'essence nécessaires pour vous téléporter.
russian: У вас не хватает эссенции для телепорта.
bulgarian: You do not have the 10 essence needed to teleport.

english: Would you like to teleport to [farm_name]?
french: Voulez-vous vous téléporter à [farm_name] ?
russian: Хотите телепортироваться на ферму «[farm_name]»?
bulgarian: Would you like to teleport to [farm_name]?

english: Teleport to [farm_name].\n(10 Essence)
french: Se téléporter à [farm_name].\n(Coût : 10 points d'essence)
russian: Телепорт до пункта: «[farm_name]».\n(10 эссенции)
bulgarian: Teleport to [farm_name].\n(10 Essence)

english: Maybe later.
french: Peut-être plus tard.
russian: В другой раз.
bulgarian: Maybe later.

english: Casting $Dragon's Breath$ here should clear the way...
french: Employer le $Souffle du dragon$ permettrait de dégager le chemin...
russian: Возможно, $Дыхание дракона$ поможет расчистить путь...
bulgarian: Casting $Dragon's Breath$ here should clear the way...

english: The door is sealed with impassable rocks and debris.
french: La porte est bloquée par des pierres et des décombres.
russian: Проход завален камнями и обломками.
bulgarian: The door is sealed with impassable rocks and debris.

english: The stairs to the Deep Woods are covered in giant, impassable vines.
french: Les escaliers menant à Boissombre sont couverts d'immenses ronces infranchissables.
russian: Ступени, ведущие в Глубокую чащу, застилают огромные непроходимые заросли.
bulgarian: The stairs to the Deep Woods are covered in giant, impassable vines.

bulgarian: Ah, good morning [Ari]!

english: You will encounter many souls on the journey through this life.
french: Tu croiseras de nombreuses âmes tout au long de cette vie.
russian: На своём жизненном пути тебе встретится множество душ.
bulgarian: You will encounter many souls on the journey through this life.

english: Some will slip by the edges without much notice.
french: Pour certaines, tu ne les remarqueras pas.
russian: Какие-то проскочат мимо почти незамеченными.
bulgarian: Some will slip by the edges without much notice.

english: And others... others will stand out to you, like a beacon of light.
french: Mais d'autres... s'imposeront à toi comme un phare dans la nuit.
russian: А иные... иные будут светить тебе, как путеводный маяк.
bulgarian: And others... others will stand out to you, like a beacon of light.

english: When that light is shared, a connection is formed.
french: Quand on partage cette lumière, un lien se forme.
russian: Когда душа делится своим светом, возникает связь.
bulgarian: When that light is shared, a connection is formed.

english: Mind you, that is not to say that every connection is a joyful one.
french: Cela ne signifie pas pour autant que tous ces liens apportent la félicité.
russian: Заметь, я не говорю, что каждая связь бывает приятной.
bulgarian: Mind you, that is not to say that every connection is a joyful one.

english: Every hero's story needs a villain, after all.
french: Après tout, dans toutes les histoires, il y a un méchant.
russian: В конце концов, каждому герою нужен свой злодей.
bulgarian: Every hero's story needs a villain, after all.

english: And of course, some souls you encounter are unable or unwilling to see your light.
french: Bien sûr, certaines des âmes que tu croiseras seront incapables de voir ta lumière, ou s'y refuseront.
russian: И, разумеется, не все души, что ты встречаешь, могут или хотят увидеть твой свет.
bulgarian: And of course, some souls you encounter are unable or unwilling to see your light.

english: But the ones that are meant to always do.
french: Mais celles dont c'est la destinée la verront toujours.
russian: Но те, кому это суждено, всегда увидят.
bulgarian: But the ones that are meant to always do.

english: I suppose that is where this tradition comes into play.
french: J'imagine que c'est là que cette tradition se reflète.
russian: Полагаю, здесь и помогает эта традиция.
bulgarian: I suppose that is where this tradition comes into play.

english: Two souls, each casting their light with intention. Combined with the starlight above...
french: Deux âmes qui se renvoient leur lumière. Ce à quoi s'ajoutent les étoiles au firmament...
russian: Две души собираются, и каждая направляет свой свет. Вместе со светом звёзд с небес...
bulgarian: Two souls, each casting their light with intention. Combined with the starlight above...

english: It has been a long time...
bulgarian: It has been a long time...

english: I wonder...
french: Une question m'est venue...
russian: Я задумываюсь...
bulgarian: I wonder...

english: It creates quite the beacon, you see...
french: C'est un véritable phare, vois-tu...
russian: Получается весьма заметный маяк...
bulgarian: It creates quite the beacon, you see...

english: Guiding us to each other across many lifetimes.
french: Qui nous guide l'un vers l'autre à travers plusieurs vies.
russian: Ведущий нас друг к другу сквозь многие жизни.
bulgarian: Guiding us to each other across many lifetimes.

english: It is no coincidence that it was your light that awakened me, [Ari].
bulgarian: It is no coincidence that it was your light that awakened me, [Ari].

english: Forgive me...
french: Pardonne-moi...
russian: Прости меня...
bulgarian: Forgive me...

english: Regardless of what we have been to each other in lifetimes past...
bulgarian: Regardless of what we have been to each other in lifetimes past...

english: I wish that my memory was clearer.
french: J'aimerais que mes souvenirs soient plus limpides.
russian: Я бы хотел, чтобы моя память была яснее.
bulgarian: I wish that my memory was clearer.

english: Our bond in this one is special, and ours to create.
bulgarian: Our bond in this one is special, and ours to create.

english: I'm glad we've chosen to share this fate!
bulgarian: I'm glad we've chosen to share this fate!

english: Being here with you... It feels like destiny.
bulgarian: Being here with you... It feels like destiny.

english: I cannot recall if we stood here together once, in another life...
french: Je ne me rappelle pas si nous avons déjà été ici, ensemble, dans une autre vie...
russian: Не могу вспомнить: возможно, мы уже были здесь вместе, в прошлой жизни...
bulgarian: I cannot recall if we stood here together once, in another life...

english: It's okay. I don't recall either!
french: Ne t'en fais pas. Moi non plus !
russian: Всё хорошо. Я тоже не помню!
bulgarian: It's okay. I don't recall either!

english: I'd like to think that we have.
french: J'aime à penser que c'est le cas.
russian: Мне хочется думать, что были.
bulgarian: I'd like to think that we have.

english: I am glad as well.
bulgarian: I am glad as well.

english: Aha... ahaha!
french: Ha ha... ha ha ha !
russian: А-ха... а-ха-ха!
bulgarian: Aha... ahaha!

english: It is strange. Even destiny feels different to me in this $Mortal Form$.
bulgarian: It is strange. Even destiny feels different to me in this $Mortal Form$.

english: I suppose this kind of uncertainty is to be expected from a mortal-
french: Je suppose que ce genre d'incertitude est normal chez les mortels...
russian: Полагаю, подобная неопределённость характерна для смертного...
bulgarian: I suppose this kind of uncertainty is to be expected from a mortal-

english: Since I last saw this particular view...
bulgarian: Since I last saw this particular view...

english: How long has it been since I last saw this particular view...?
french: Depuis quand n'avais-je pas admiré ce point de vue...?
russian: О том, сколько времени прошло с тех пор, как я наблюдал этот вид в прошлый раз?..
bulgarian: How long has it been since I last saw this particular view...?

english: Thank you for inviting me out here this evening, [Ari].
french: Merci de m'avoir invité ici ce soir, [Ari].
russian:
Спасибо, что

пригласили

пригласилапригласилпригласило меня сюда сегодня, [Ari].
bulgarian: Thank you for inviting me out here this evening, [Ari].

english: Our dreams, our choices... It feels as though we chart a course and the tides of fate rise to meet us.
bulgarian: Our dreams, our choices... It feels as though we chart a course and the tides of fate rise to meet us.

english: F-from a mortal perspective.
french: D-Du point de vue d'un être humain.
russian: С-смертного взгляда на жизнь.
bulgarian: F-from a mortal perspective.

english: And so I choose to believe...
bulgarian: And so I choose to believe...

english: In that case, I will choose to believe-
french: Dans ce cas, je vais choisir de penser...
russian: В таком случае, я хочу думать...
bulgarian: In that case, I will choose to believe-

english: That we, like the stars, have simply returned at the appointed time.
french: Qu'à l'instar des étoiles, nous nous sommes retrouvés à point nommé !
russian: Что мы, подобно звёздам, лишь вернулись сюда в уготованный час.
bulgarian: That we, like the stars, have simply returned at the appointed time.

english: Ah...
bulgarian: Ah...

english: Ah...
french: Ah...
russian: Ах...
bulgarian: Ah...

english: I hope that I am not rambling on too long, [Ari].
bulgarian: I hope that I am not rambling on too long, [Ari].

english: My body-
french: Mon corps...
russian: Моё тело...
bulgarian: My body-

english: I am beginning to feel somewhat fatigued.
french: Je commence à sentir la fatigue.
russian: Я начинаю ощущать некоторую усталость.
bulgarian: I am beginning to feel somewhat fatigued.

english: Truth be told, I find myself losing track of time when we are together.
bulgarian: Truth be told, I find myself losing track of time when we are together.

english: Do not worry. I am not yet accustomed to leaving the protection of the woods.
french: Ne t'en fais pas. Je ne suis simplement pas encore habitué à m'éloigner de la forêt et de sa protection.
russian: Не волнуйся. Я ещё не приспособился покидать защиту Чащи.
bulgarian: Do not worry. I am not yet accustomed to leaving the protection of the woods.

english: It is getting rather late, is it not?
bulgarian: It is getting rather late, is it not?

english: Should we call it a night?
bulgarian: Should we call it a night?

english: Why don't we head back to your place?
bulgarian: Why don't we head back to your place?

english: I- I just need a moment.
french: Ç-Ça va aller.
russian: Я... Погоди минутку.
bulgarian: I- I just need a moment.

english: Are you sure that you're okay?
french: Tu es sûr que ça va ?
russian: С тобой точно всё хорошо?
bulgarian: Are you sure that you're okay?

english: Why don't we get you home?
french: Et si on rentrait ?
russian: Давай отведём тебя домой?
bulgarian: Why don't we get you home?

english: Well... perhaps we should retire to my place for the rest of the evening...?
french: Je... Je crois que nous devrions retourner à ma demeure pour la soirée...
russian: Что ж... возможно, нам лучше отступить в моё жилище на остаток вечера?..
bulgarian: Well... perhaps we should retire to my place for the rest of the evening...?

english: I- I would like that.
bulgarian: I- I would like that.

english: I would like that.
french: Oui, merci.
russian: Да, я был бы рад.
bulgarian: I would like that.

english: I am glad to see that this custom continues to withstand the passage of time.
french: Je suis ravi de voir que cette coutume a perduré en dépit du temps qui passe.
russian: Приятно видеть, что этот обычай выдержал испытание временем.
bulgarian: I am glad to see that this custom continues to withstand the passage of time.

english: I can prepare us some tea and we can watch the last of the stars through the canopy.
french: Je nous préparerai une tisane et nous observerons les dernières étoiles à travers la canopée.
russian: Я могу приготовить чай, и мы посмотрим звёзды вместе через листву.
bulgarian: I can prepare us some tea and we can watch the last of the stars through the canopy.

english: Come, take my hand. I shall walk you back.
bulgarian: Come, take my hand. I shall walk you back.

english: Come, take my hand. I will guide you back.
french: Prends ma main et laisse-toi guider.
russian: Возьми меня за руку. Я выведу тебя назад.
bulgarian: Come, take my hand. I will guide you back.

english: Mistrians once referred to the practice as $Starbinding$, you know. An apt name, indeed.
french: Jadis, les Mistriens appelaient cela le $lien céleste$. Un nom tout à fait approprié.
russian: Знаешь, когда-то мистрийцы называли его $Сплетение звёздами$. Очень меткое название.
bulgarian: Mistrians once referred to the practice as $Starbinding$, you know. An apt name, indeed.

english: Humans, despite being mortal-
french: Les humains, bien que mortels...
russian: Люди, хотя они и смертны...
bulgarian: Humans, despite being mortal-

english: Or perhaps because they are mortal-
french: Ou justement parce qu'ils le sont...
russian: А может, именно потому, что смертны...
bulgarian: Or perhaps because they are mortal-

english: Tend to be particularly sensitive to the bonds that their souls form throughout their lifetimes.
french: Ils tendent à être particulièrement sensibles aux liens que leurs âmes tissent tout au long de leur vie.
russian: С особым трепетом относятся к связям, которые формируют за жизнь их души.
bulgarian: Tend to be particularly sensitive to the bonds that their souls form throughout their lifetimes.

english: The bonds that their souls form...?
french: Aux liens que leurs âmes tissent...?
russian: Души формируют связи?..
bulgarian: The bonds that their souls form...?

english: So it really binds people together...?
french: Cela relie vraiment les gens...?
russian: Значит, звёзды и правда связывают людей?..
bulgarian: So it really binds people together...?

english: Well, think of it this way...
french: Eh bien, vois-le de cette manière...
russian: Можешь представить это так:
bulgarian: Well, think of it this way...

english: They really are clear from up here, aren't they?
french: On les voit vraiment bien d'ici, pas vrai ?
russian: Их отсюда так ясно видно, правда?
bulgarian: They really are clear from up here, aren't they?

english: My parents already know that I don't want to take it over, but at the same time... it's not like I have anything else lined up yet.
french: Mes parents savent déjà que je ne veux pas reprendre l'affaire, mais d'un autre côté... je n'ai pas vraiment d'autre perspective en vue.
russian: Родители давно знают, что я не хочу им заниматься, но с другой стороны... ничего больше я до сих пор не придумала.
bulgarian: My parents already know that I don't want to take it over, but at the same time... it's not like I have anything else lined up yet.

english: I want to pursue my love of gardening. I'm sure that I'm onto something with the Codex and the seed that we found...
french: J'ai envie de continuer dans le jardinage. Je suis sûre que je tiens quelque chose avec le Codex et le semis qu'on a trouvé...
russian: Я хочу развивать своё увлечение цветами. Я уверена, что история с «Кодексом» и семечком, которое мы нашли, куда-то приведёт...
bulgarian: I want to pursue my love of gardening. I'm sure that I'm onto something with the Codex and the seed that we found...

english: But... am I just being selfish?
french: Mais... est-ce que c'est égoïste de ma part ?
russian: Но... почему я всё про себя?
bulgarian: But... am I just being selfish?

english: Ahh... I'm sorry, [Ari]! I didn't mean to derail our evening together.
french: Ah... Désolée, [Ari] ! Je ne voulais pas gâcher notre soirée ensemble.
russian: Ах... Прости, [Ari]! Я не хотела портить наш совместный вечер.
bulgarian: Ahh... I'm sorry, [Ari]! I didn't mean to derail our evening together.

english: You'll find your own path, don't worry.
french: Tu trouveras ta voie, ne t'en fais pas.
russian: Не волнуйся, ты найдёшь свой путь.
bulgarian: You'll find your own path, don't worry.

english: I'll support you, no matter what.
french: Je te soutiendrai, quoi qu'il advienne.
russian: Я поддержу тебя, что бы ни случилось.
bulgarian: I'll support you, no matter what.

english: D-do you really think so?
french: T-Tu le penses vraiment ?
russian: Ты... Ты правда так думаешь?
bulgarian: D-do you really think so?

english: Thank you, [Ari].
french: Merci, [Ari].
russian: Спасибо, [Ari].
bulgarian: Thank you, [Ari].

english: I promise I'll do my best!
french: Je te promets de tout donner !
russian: Обещаю, что буду стараться!
bulgarian: I promise I'll do my best!

english: [Ari]... thank you.
french: [Ari]... merci.
russian: [Ari]... спасибо
bulgarian: [Ari]... thank you.

english: It means a lot to hear you say that.
french: Ça me touche vraiment de t'entendre dire ça.
russian: Я очень ценю, что ты это говоришь.
bulgarian: It means a lot to hear you say that.

english: I'll do my best to find my own path!
french: Je ferai de mon mieux pour trouver ma voie !
russian: Я буду стараться найти свой путь!
bulgarian: I'll do my best to find my own path!

english: To be honest, I was a little nervous about watching them from the summit.
french: Tu sais, j'avais un peu peur de venir les observer depuis le sommet.
russian: Честно говоря, я слегка побаивалась идти смотреть на Вершину.
bulgarian: To be honest, I was a little nervous about watching them from the summit.

english: Thank you again for asking me out tonight.
french: Merci encore de m'avoir invitée ce soir.
russian:
Спасибо ещё раз, что

пригласили

пригласилапригласилпригласило меня сегодня.
bulgarian: Thank you again for asking me out tonight.

english: I had a really nice time!
french: J'ai passé un très bon moment !
russian: Мне очень понравилось!
bulgarian: I had a really nice time!

english: It's getting a little bit cold though, isn't it?
french: Il commence à faire un peu froid, tu ne trouves pas ?
russian: Но уже становится прохладно, правда?
bulgarian: It's getting a little bit cold though, isn't it?

english: Um, if you want to... we could stop by my cottage on the way back.
french: Euh, si tu veux... on peut s'arrêter chez moi sur le chemin du retour.
russian: Эм, если хочешь... Можем зайти ко мне в домик, когда пойдём назад.
bulgarian: Um, if you want to... we could stop by my cottage on the way back.

english: I'll put some wood on the fire and we can warm ourselves up!
french: J'allumerai un feu dans la cheminée et on pourra se réchauffer !
russian: Я растоплю камин, так что мы сможем согреться!
bulgarian: I'll put some wood on the fire and we can warm ourselves up!

english: Last time I was up here I was reminded that I'm not so good with heights!
french: La dernière fois que je suis venue ici, j'ai eu le vertige !
russian: В прошлый раз, когда я здесь была, я сразу вспомнила, что боюсь высоты!
bulgarian: Last time I was up here I was reminded that I'm not so good with heights!

english: But somehow, I don't feel scared this time...
french: Mais, bizarrement, je n'ai pas peur ce soir...
russian: Но сейчас мне почему-то не страшно.
bulgarian: But somehow, I don't feel scared this time...

english: I'm glad you invited me, [Ari]. I was hoping you would.
french: Je suis contente que tu m'aies invitée, [Ari]. J'espérais que tu le ferais.
russian:
Спасибо, что

пригласили

пригласилапригласилпригласило меня, [Ari]. Я надеялась, что ты это сделаешь.
bulgarian: I'm glad you invited me, [Ari]. I was hoping you would.

english: Is everything okay?
french: Tout va bien ?
russian: Всё в порядке?
bulgarian: Is everything okay?

english: Are you sure you're not scared?
french: Tu es sûre que tu n'as pas peur ?
russian: Ты уверена, что не боишься?
bulgarian: Are you sure you're not scared?

english: O-oh. I'm okay!
french: O-Oh. Oui, ça va !
russian: О-ой. Я в порядке!
bulgarian: O-oh. I'm okay!

english: It's not that I'm scared, I was just... lost in thought.
french: Je n'ai pas peur du tout, je suis juste... perdue dans mes pensées.
russian: Дело не в том, что я боюсь, просто я... ушла в раздумья.
bulgarian: It's not that I'm scared, I was just... lost in thought.

english: I was talking with my mom earlier, and it got me thinking about the future of the store...
french: J'ai parlé à ma mère cet après-midi et ça m'a fait réfléchir à l'avenir du magasin...
russian: Я недавно говорила с мамой и теперь думаю о будущем нашего магазина...
bulgarian: I was talking with my mom earlier, and it got me thinking about the future of the store...

english: Ah... the stars are so beautiful!
french: Oh... ce que les étoiles sont belles !
russian: Ах... какие красивые звёзды!
bulgarian: Ah... the stars are so beautiful!

english: I'm so glad to have the opportunity to experience this firsthand.
french: Je suis vraiment content d'avoir pu voir ça de mes propres yeux.
russian: Я так рад, что могу лично его созерцать.
bulgarian: I'm so glad to have the opportunity to experience this firsthand.

english: To be honest, it often feels like it's easier for me to look back at the paths carved behind us than to forge a new one ahead.
french: En réalité, j'ai souvent l'impression qu'il m'est plus facile de regarder en arrière et d'analyser le passé, que d'envisager le futur.
russian: Честно говоря, мне часто проще рассматривать пути, проложенные до нас, а не выстраивать свой путь вперёд.
bulgarian: To be honest, it often feels like it's easier for me to look back at the paths carved behind us than to forge a new one ahead.

english: Adeline has always been so hardworking and focused on the future.
french: Adeline a toujours été très travailleuse et tournée vers l'avenir.
russian: Аделина всё время трудится и думает о будущем.
bulgarian: Adeline has always been so hardworking and focused on the future.

english: There was never any question about her becoming the heir. It's a role I never wanted for myself.
french: Il n'y a jamais eu aucun doute sur le fait qu'elle prendrait la succession. Personnellement, c'est un rôle dont je n'ai jamais voulu.
russian: Ни у кого не было сомнений, что главой семьи станет она. А я никогда и не желал этой позиции.
bulgarian: There was never any question about her becoming the heir. It's a role I never wanted for myself.

english: And my father... His forward thinking and accomplishments saw him raised to peerage when he was my age.
french: Et mon père... Son progressisme et ses réalisations lui ont valu d'être anobli à l'âge que j'ai aujourd'hui.
russian: Но мой отец... Благодаря своей дальновидности и заслугам он уже получил титул барона в моём возрасте.
bulgarian: And my father... His forward thinking and accomplishments saw him raised to peerage when he was my age.

english: I know that I'm always focusing on the past, but I can't shake the feeling that IS what I'm supposed to be doing.
french: Je sais que je me focalise sur le passé, mais j'ai le sentiment que c'est ce que je dois faire.
russian: Я знаю, что слишком много думаю о прошлом, но я чувствую, что ЭТО и есть моё дело.
bulgarian: I know that I'm always focusing on the past, but I can't shake the feeling that IS what I'm supposed to be doing.

english: But sometimes I wonder if I'm just shying away from the future.
french: Ceci dit, j'ai parfois l'impression de me détourner de l'avenir.
russian: И всё же иногда я сомневаюсь: а вдруг я просто боюсь смотреть в будущее?
bulgarian: But sometimes I wonder if I'm just shying away from the future.

english: Understanding Mistria's past is important to its future!
french: Comprendre le passé de Mistria est important pour son futur !
russian: Чтобы смотреть в будущее Мистрии, важно понимать её прошлое!
bulgarian: Understanding Mistria's past is important to its future!

english: Don't worry, Eiland. Let's continue discovering both!
french: Ne t'en fais pas, Eiland. Continuons à découvrir des choses ensemble !
russian: Не переживай, Эйланд. Давай будем исследовать и будущее и прошлое!
bulgarian: Don't worry, Eiland. Let's continue discovering both!
