russian: По маме с папой за прилавком пекарни...
bulgarian: Mom and Dad running the bakery counter...

english: It was lively, you know?
french: C'était très animé.
russian: Знаешь, там было так оживлённо.
bulgarian: It was lively, you know?

english: What an incredible view... thanks for inviting me, [Ari].
french: La vue est incroyable... Merci de m'avoir invité, [Ari].
russian:
Какой невероятный вид... Спасибо, что

пригласили

пригласилапригласилпригласило, [Ari].
bulgarian: What an incredible view... thanks for inviting me, [Ari].

english: It pleases me to be here with you. To see these stars once more.
french: Je suis ravie d'être ici avec toi. D'admirer à nouveau les étoiles.
russian: Мне приятно пребывать здесь с тобой. И снова видеть эти звёзды.
bulgarian: It pleases me to be here with you. To see these stars once more.

english: But an immortal's power is so vast, one risks losing sight of that which lies beyond one's sphere of control.
french: Mais le pouvoir d'un être immortel est si grand qu'il risque de perdre de vue ce qui se trouve hors de sa sphère de contrôle.
russian: Сила бессмертных созданий столь велика, что легко забыть о пределах своих возможностей.
bulgarian: But an immortal's power is so vast, one risks losing sight of that which lies beyond one's sphere of control.

english: Immortals who fall to this complacency limit themselves. Believing they know all there is to know, and control all there is to control...
french: Les immortels qui succombent à cette complaisance se limitent eux-mêmes. Ils croient tout connaître et tout contrôler...
russian: Бессмертные, пребывающие в благостном самодовольстве, ограничивают себя. Они полагают, что уже узнали всё, что могли, и управляют всем, чем можно править...
bulgarian: Immortals who fall to this complacency limit themselves. Believing they know all there is to know, and control all there is to control...

english: How short-sighted.
french: Quelle vision limitée !
russian: Печальная недальновидность.
bulgarian: How short-sighted.

english: Those who dare to seek will always find. After all, the pleasure is in the hunt, [Ari].
french: Ceux qui osent chercher découvriront toujours quelque chose. Dans le fond, c'est là tout le plaisir de la chasse, [Ari].
russian: Те, кто отважится на поиск, всегда что-то найдут. В конце концов, охота — и есть главное удовольствие, [Ari].
bulgarian: Those who dare to seek will always find. After all, the pleasure is in the hunt, [Ari].

english: That is why I so enjoy this mortal life.
french: Voilà pourquoi j'apprécie tant cette existence mortelle.
russian: Поэтому я так наслаждаюсь жизнью в смертном теле.
bulgarian: That is why I so enjoy this mortal life.

english: In exchange for certain benefits...
french: En renonçant à certains avantages...
russian: Взамен на некоторые неудобства...
bulgarian: In exchange for certain benefits...

english: I am able to remove various... limitations.
french: Je suis capable d'abolir certaines... limites.
russian: Я избавляю себя от различных... ограничений.
bulgarian: I am able to remove various... limitations.

english: To see the world through a different lens.
french: Capable de voir le monde à travers un prisme différent.
russian: Могу видеть мир другими глазами.
bulgarian: To see the world through a different lens.

english: To relish new challenges and reap new rewards.
french: Capable de relever de nouveaux défis, d'obtenir de nouvelles récompenses.
russian: Находить новые вызовы и вкушать новые награды.
bulgarian: To relish new challenges and reap new rewards.

english: You understand, do you not? The joy of the game... the drive for progression?
french: Tu le comprends, n'est-ce pas ? Le plaisir du jeu... l'envie d'avancer ?
russian: Ты ведь меня понимаешь? Ты чувствуешь радость игры... желание совершенствоваться?
bulgarian: You understand, do you not? The joy of the game... the drive for progression?

english: I completely understand!
french: Je comprends parfaitement !
russian: Я отлично понимаю!
bulgarian: I completely understand!

english: (laughs nervously)
french: (Rire nerveux)
russian: (нервно смеётся)
bulgarian: (laughs nervously)

english: I find this to be a most excellent vantage point.
french: Je trouve que c'est là un excellent poste d'observation.
russian: К тому же это превосходная точка для наблюдения.
bulgarian: I find this to be a most excellent vantage point.

english: Yes, of course you do.
french: Oui, bien sûr que tu comprends.
russian: Да, конечно, ты понимаешь.
bulgarian: Yes, of course you do.

english: There is no need to be shy about it. Of course you do.
french: Inutile d'être timide. Bien sûr que tu comprends.
russian: Не нужно стесняться. Конечно, ты понимаешь.
bulgarian: There is no need to be shy about it. Of course you do.

english: That is what I like about you, [Ari].
french: C'est ce que j'apprécie chez toi, [Ari].
russian: Этим ты мне и нравишься, [Ari].
bulgarian: That is what I like about you, [Ari].

english: You understand what it is to pursue that which you desire.
french: Tu comprends ce que c'est que de suivre ses aspirations.
russian: Ты знаешь, каково это — следовать за мечтой.
bulgarian: You understand what it is to pursue that which you desire.

english: To carve out paths that others do not believe possible.
french: De tracer des chemins que d'autres n'imaginaient pas possibles.
russian: Пробивать себе путь, который другие считали невозможным.
bulgarian: To carve out paths that others do not believe possible.

english: Take this night, for example. The tradition of $Starbinding$.
french: Cette nuit, par exemple, la tradition du $lien céleste$.
russian: Возьмём, к примеру, эту ночь. И обычай $сплетения звёздами$.
bulgarian: Take this night, for example. The tradition of $Starbinding$.

english: It is true that we are like these stars, returning to this world again and again.
french: Il est vrai que nous sommes semblables à ces étoiles, revenant dans ce monde, encore et encore.
russian: Правда, что мы снова и снова возвращаемся в этот мир, подобно звёздам.
bulgarian: It is true that we are like these stars, returning to this world again and again.

english: But you and I... we are not simply fireflies caught in a web.
french: Mais toi et moi... Nous ne sommes pas que des lucioles prises dans une toile d'araignée.
russian: Но мы с тобой... не просто светлячки, застрявшие в паутине...
bulgarian: But you and I... we are not simply fireflies caught in a web.

english: We chose to be here, [Ari].
french: Nous avons choisi d'être ici, [Ari].
russian: Мы здесь по собственному выбору, [Ari].
bulgarian: We chose to be here, [Ari].

english: We are not just the points of light, but also weavers of the darkness that binds us together.
french: Nous ne sommes pas que des points lumineux, mais aussi les tisseurs de l'obscurité qui nous lie.
russian: Мы не просто точки света. Мы сами плетём ту тьму, что нас связывает.
bulgarian: We are not just the points of light, but also weavers of the darkness that binds us together.

english: The view from the summit? Oh yes, that too.
french: La vue depuis le sommet ? Oh oui, aussi.
russian: Вид с Вершины? Ах, да, и это тоже.
bulgarian: The view from the summit? Oh yes, that too.

english: Twisting and bending the threads of fate to our will.
french: Tordant et pliant les fils du destin selon notre volonté.
russian: Из нитей судьбы мы сплетаем узлы по нашей собственной воле.
bulgarian: Twisting and bending the threads of fate to our will.

english: At least, that is how I see it.
french: C'est du moins comme cela que je vois les choses.
russian: По крайней мере, таким образом я смотрю на вещи.
bulgarian: At least, that is how I see it.

english: Tell me, [Ari]... what is your perspective?
french: Dis-moi, [Ari]... Quel est ton point de vue ?
russian: Скажи мне, [Ari]... А как это выглядит для тебя?
bulgarian: Tell me, [Ari]... what is your perspective?

english: I never let a little thing like destiny stand between me and my goals.
french: Je ne laisserai jamais une chose aussi insignifiante que le destin se mettre entre moi et mes objectifs.
russian: Я никогда не позволю такой мелочи, как судьба, помешать моим планам.
bulgarian: I never let a little thing like destiny stand between me and my goals.

english: All I know is that nothing could have kept me from freeing you, Seridia.
french: Tout ce que je sais, c'est que rien n'aurait pu m'empêcher de te libérer, Seridia.
russian: Я знаю только одно: никакая сила не помешала бы мне освободить тебя, Серидия.
bulgarian: All I know is that nothing could have kept me from freeing you, Seridia.

english: Ah hahahaha!
french: Ah ha ha ha ha !
russian: А-ха-ха-ха-ха!
bulgarian: Ah hahahaha!

english: Yes... how like you to say so.
french: Oui... C'est tout toi de dire ça.
russian: Да... Как это похоже на тебя.
bulgarian: Yes... how like you to say so.

english: Oh!
french: Oh !
russian: О!
bulgarian: Oh!

english: Yes... I have no doubt about that.
french: Oui... Je n'en doute pas.
russian: Да... В этом у меня нет сомнений.
bulgarian: Yes... I have no doubt about that.

english: I see it, [Ari]. Your point of view. The world through your lens...
french: Je le vois, [Ari]. Ton point de vue. Le monde à travers ton prisme...
russian: Я увидела её, [Ari]. Твою точку зрения. Увидела мир твоими глазами...
bulgarian: I see it, [Ari]. Your point of view. The world through your lens...

english: Your light.
french: Ta lumière.
russian: Твой свет.
bulgarian: Your light.

english: Now, I am curious...
french: À présent, j'aimerais savoir...
russian: А теперь мне интересно...
bulgarian: Now, I am curious...

english: However, I was referring to the view from this mortal body.
french: Cependant, je faisais référence au point de vue que l'on a depuis ce corps mortel.
russian: Но я говорила о виде из моего смертного тела.
bulgarian: However, I was referring to the view from this mortal body.

english: How else does one celebrate the Shooting Star Festival in this age?
french: Comment célèbre-t-on aussi la fête des étoiles filantes, à l'époque actuelle ?
russian: Что ещё полагается делать на Фестиваль падающих звёзд в эту эпоху?
bulgarian: How else does one celebrate the Shooting Star Festival in this age?

english: Should we perhaps ignite a bonfire? Make an offering of some sort?
french: Devrions-nous peut-être allumer un feu de joie ? Faire une offrande quelconque ?
russian: Возможно, нам необходимо разжечь костёр? Приготовить ритуальное подношение?
bulgarian: Should we perhaps ignite a bonfire? Make an offering of some sort?

english: Sounds fun!
french: Ça serait amusant !
russian: Отличная идея!
bulgarian: Sounds fun!

english: How about we take a walk back to my place?
french: Et si on rentrait tranquillement jusque chez moi ?
russian: Как насчёт прогулки до моего дома?
bulgarian: How about we take a walk back to my place?

english: Excellent!
french: Parfait !
russian: Превосходно!
bulgarian: Excellent!

english: Come, let us return to my temple.
french: Viens, retournons jusqu'à mon temple.
russian: Пойдём, возвратимся в моё святилище.
bulgarian: Come, let us return to my temple.

english: Oh? That does sound fun.
french: Oh ? Ça a l'air amusant.
russian: Вот как? Звучит вполне увлекательно.
bulgarian: Oh? That does sound fun.

english: Come. Perhaps we can create some new festival traditions of our own.
french: Viens. peut-être pourrons-nous créer de nouvelles traditions rien qu'à nous.
russian: Пойдём. Возможно, мы сами создадим новые фестивальные традиции.
bulgarian: Come. Perhaps we can create some new festival traditions of our own.

english: For the night is still young...
french: Car la nuit ne fait que commencer...
russian: Ночь ещё так молода...
bulgarian: For the night is still young...

english: Of course, my draconic form has its advantages...
french: Bien sûr, ma forme de dragon a certains avantages...
russian: У моего драконьего обличья, разумеется, много преимуществ...
bulgarian: Of course, my draconic form has its advantages...

english: But a mortal existence is so perfectly suited to such experiences.
french: Mais une existence mortelle convient à la perfection à ce type d'expériences.
russian: Но такие моменты, как этот, идеально проживать в смертной жизни.
bulgarian: But a mortal existence is so perfectly suited to such experiences.

english: Gazing into the great black veil above, as it is pierced by a shower of stars...
french: Contempler le grand voile noir au-dessus de nous, piqué d'une pluie d'étoiles...
russian: Я всматриваюсь в звёздные потоки, пронзающие бескрайний океан тьмы над головой...
bulgarian: Gazing into the great black veil above, as it is pierced by a shower of stars...

english: It reminds one that there are new heights still to reach, unknown powers yet to discover... even for one as long-lived as I.
french: Cela rappelle qu'il existe de nouveaux confins à atteindre, des pouvoirs inconnus à découvrir... même pour quelqu'un d'aussi vieux que moi.
russian: И вспоминаю, что ещё остаются новые высоты и неоткрытые доселе силы... даже для таких древних созданий, как я.
bulgarian: It reminds one that there are new heights still to reach, unknown powers yet to discover... even for one as long-lived as I.

english: New heights to reach?
french: De nouveaux confins à atteindre ?
russian: Новые высоты?
bulgarian: New heights to reach?

english: Powers yet to discover?
french: Des pouvoirs inconnus à découvrir ?
russian: Неоткрытые силы?
bulgarian: Powers yet to discover?

english: Certainly. It may sound strange to you...
french: Absolument. Cela peut te sembler étrange...
russian: Безусловно. Для тебя это может прозвучать странно...
bulgarian: Certainly. It may sound strange to you...

english: Thank you for inviting me to join you this evening, [Ari].
french: Merci de m'avoir invitée à te rejoindre ce soir, [Ari].
russian:
Спасибо, что

пригласили

пригласилапригласилпригласило меня на этот вечер, [Ari].
bulgarian: Thank you for inviting me to join you this evening, [Ari].

english: It's getting cold... you'd better head home.
french: Il commence à faire froid... Vous feriez mieux de rentrer.
russian: Начинает холодать... Вам лучше пойти домой.
bulgarian: It's getting cold... you'd better head home.

english: It's important to take the time to relax like this when you can.
french: C'est important de prendre le temps de se détendre.
russian: Иногда важно уделить себе время и просто вот так расслабиться, когда есть возможность.
bulgarian: It's important to take the time to relax like this when you can.

english: It's an arduous task, trying to reverse engineer it...
french: Ce n'est pas évident d'essayer de retrouver la formule...
russian: Выяснить, как она была приготовлена, — очень трудоёмкая задача.
bulgarian: It's an arduous task, trying to reverse engineer it...

english: But I refuse to allow the panacea to end with me. It's my responsibility to make sure it isn't lost to time.
french: Mais je refuse que la panacée disparaisse avec moi. Il en va de ma responsabilité de m'assurer qu'elle ne soit pas perdue pour toujours.
russian: Но я не позволю панацее закончиться на мне. Мой долг — не дать ей исчезнуть в веках.
bulgarian: But I refuse to allow the panacea to end with me. It's my responsibility to make sure it isn't lost to time.

english: It's not your fault though...
french: Mais ce n'est pas de ta faute...
russian: Это ведь не твоя вина...
bulgarian: It's not your fault though...

english: You're not the one who lost the recipe...
french: Ce n'est pas toi qui as perdu la formule...
russian: Но ведь не ты потеряла рецепт...
bulgarian: You're not the one who lost the recipe...

english: While it's true that the recipe was lost over the generations preceding me...
french: C'est vrai que ce sont mes aïeux qui ont oublié comment la faire.
russian: Это правда, рецепт был утрачен ещё в предыдущих поколениях...
bulgarian: While it's true that the recipe was lost over the generations preceding me...

english: I'm now the last person to have held the panacea in my hands, to remember firsthand its physical qualities.
french: Je suis désormais la seule personne à avoir eu de la panacée et à me souvenir de ses propriétés physiques.
russian: Но я последняя держала панацею в руках и только я могу помнить её физические свойства.
bulgarian: I'm now the last person to have held the panacea in my hands, to remember firsthand its physical qualities.

english: It's up to me to recreate it, before even that knowledge is lost...
french: C'est à moi de la recréer, avant que son existence même ne tombe dans l'oubli...
russian: Я должна восстановить её, пока это знание не утрачено...
bulgarian: It's up to me to recreate it, before even that knowledge is lost...

english: I believe in you, Valen.
french: Je crois en toi, Valen.
russian: Я верю в тебя, Вален.
bulgarian: I believe in you, Valen.

english: We'll do it together, Valen.
french: On va y arriver ensemble, Valen.
russian: Мы восстановим её вместе, Вален.
bulgarian: We'll do it together, Valen.

english: Thank you for putting your faith in me, [Ari].
french: Merci de croire en moi, [Ari].
russian: Спасибо за эту веру, [Ari].
bulgarian: Thank you for putting your faith in me, [Ari].

english: [Ari]... Thank you...
french: [Ari]... Merci...
russian: [Ari]... Спасибо...
bulgarian: [Ari]... Thank you...

english: Hearing you say it like that, I really believe it's possible.
french: Quand j'entends tes paroles, je me dis que c'est possible.
russian: Когда ты так говоришь, мне начинает казаться, что у нас правда получится.
bulgarian: Hearing you say it like that, I really believe it's possible.

english: You know... you certainly have a knack for making people feel better.
french: Tu sais, tu as le don pour remonter le moral des gens.
russian: Знаешь... У тебя отлично получается улучшать людям самочувствие.
bulgarian: You know... you certainly have a knack for making people feel better.

english: And for helping them when they need it, too.
french: Et pour les aider quand ils en ont besoin.
russian: И помогать, когда им нужна помощь.
bulgarian: And for helping them when they need it, too.

english: It's good for the body, mind, and spirit!
french: C'est bon pour le corps et l'esprit !
russian: Это полезно и для тела, и для разума, и для души!
bulgarian: It's good for the body, mind, and spirit!

english: It's one of my favorite things about you.
french: C'est ce que j'aime chez toi.
russian: Это одна из моих любимых твоих черт.
bulgarian: It's one of my favorite things about you.

english: Well, it's getting kind of late...
french: Bon, il commence à se faire tard...
russian: Что ж, становится уже поздно...
bulgarian: Well, it's getting kind of late...

english: But you know...
french: Cela dit...
russian: Но, знаешь...
bulgarian: But you know...

english: I don't mind staying out a little bit longer, how about you?
french: Ça ne me dérange pas de rester un peu plus longtemps, et toi ?
russian: Я не против задержаться ещё чуть-чуть, а ты?
bulgarian: I don't mind staying out a little bit longer, how about you?

english: It's definitely starting to get colder with the season turning, though. Are you feeling warm enough?
french: Mais il commence à faire froid avec le changement de saison. Tu as assez chaud ?
russian: Хотя осень уже на носу, так что наступают холода. Тебе достаточно тепло?
bulgarian: It's definitely starting to get colder with the season turning, though. Are you feeling warm enough?

english: I'm feeling pretty cozy, actually.
french: Ça va, je me sens bien.
russian: На самом деле, мне сейчас вполне уютно.
bulgarian: I'm feeling pretty cozy, actually.

english: I'm sweating a little, to be honest.
french: Je sue un peu, à vrai dire.
russian: Честно, мне даже слегка жарко.
bulgarian: I'm sweating a little, to be honest.

english: Hmmm, you're looking a little flushed...
french: Mmm, tu as les joues un peu rouges...
russian: Хмм... а вид у тебя слегка покрасневший...
bulgarian: Hmmm, you're looking a little flushed...

english: Now that you mention it, you are looking a little flushed...
french: Maintenant que tu le dis, tu as les joues un peu rouges...
russian:
Хорошо, что

сказали

сказаласказалсказало, вид у тебя слегка покрасневший...
bulgarian: Now that you mention it, you are looking a little flushed...

english: Are you feeling okay?
french: Tu te sens bien ?
russian: С тобой всё в порядке?
bulgarian: Are you feeling okay?

english: You're not getting sick...?
french: Tu n'es pas malade, hein...?
russian: Ты точно не заболеваешь?..
bulgarian: You're not getting sick...?

english: I feel fine, Valen.
french: Je vais bien, Valen.
russian: Я в порядке, Вален.
bulgarian: I feel fine, Valen.

english: I feel great, actually.
french: Je suis en pleine forme.
russian: Наоборот, отлично себя чувствую.
bulgarian: I feel great, actually.

english: R-right, sorry about that.
french: B-Bon, désolée.
russian: Л-ладно, прости, что беспокоюсь.
bulgarian: R-right, sorry about that.

english: I guess I've been a little bit on edge since the panacea ran out.
french: Je suis un peu à cran depuis qu'on est à court de panacée.
russian: Видимо, я стала слегка нервничать, когда закончилась панацея.
bulgarian: I guess I've been a little bit on edge since the panacea ran out.

english: Ah... how lovely...
french: Oh... C'est beau...
russian: Ах... как прекрасно...
bulgarian: Ah... how lovely...

english: In third place...
french: La troisième place revient à...
russian: На третьем месте...
bulgarian: In third place...

english: And for our second choice, heavily supported by my brother Eiland...
french: L'autre possibilité qui nous est offerte, et celle qui a les faveurs de mon frère Eiland...
russian: А наш второй вариант, который яро поддерживает мой брат Эйланд...
bulgarian: And for our second choice, heavily supported by my brother Eiland...

english: A cookie care package from the "Really Big Cookie" Bakery in the Capital.
french: Ce sont des réserves de biscuits mis à notre disposition par la pâtisserie « Coucou cookies » de la capitale.
russian: Пакет продовольствия из столичной пекарни «Правда большое печенье».
bulgarian: A cookie care package from the "Really Big Cookie" Bakery in the Capital.

english: Eiland argues that it would give people the morale boost and energy they need to face up to the challenges of rebuilding.
french: D'après Eiland, cela mettrait du baume au cœur de tous les habitants et leur donnerait l'énergie nécessaire pour surmonter les défis de la reconstruction.
russian: Эйланд утверждает, что это поднимет людям настрой и даст энергию, необходимую для трудного восстановления.
bulgarian: Eiland argues that it would give people the morale boost and energy they need to face up to the challenges of rebuilding.

english: But... I think he just really likes sweets...
french: Mais... je crois surtout que c'est parce que c'est un bec sucré...
russian: Но... Я подозреваю, он просто очень любит сладкое...
bulgarian: But... I think he just really likes sweets...

english: Still, his proposal has enough merit that I thought it would be worth presenting to you, [Ari].
french: Quoi qu'il en soit, cette alternative vaut quand même le coup d'être étudiée, c'est pourquoi je me permets de te la soumettre, [Ari].
russian: Однако у этого варианта достаточно плюсов, чтобы я тоже решила его тебе предложить, [Ari].
bulgarian: Still, his proposal has enough merit that I thought it would be worth presenting to you, [Ari].

english: There's no "wrong" answer! What do you, as a typical Mistrian, think the townsfolk would benefit from most?
french: Il n'y a pas de « mauvais » choix ! Toi qui connais bien Mistria désormais, quelle est d'après toi la meilleure option pour les habitants ?
russian: Тут нет «правильного» ответа! Как ты думаешь, как типичный обитатель Мистрии, что больше поможет нашим жителям?
bulgarian: There's no "wrong" answer! What do you, as a typical Mistrian, think the townsfolk would benefit from most?

english: That extra stone and wood would go a long way!
french: Les réserves de pierre et de bois seraient très utiles !
russian: Дополнительные запасы камня и дерева всем очень помогут!
bulgarian: That extra stone and wood would go a long way!

english: Big cookie! Big cookie, big cookie!
french: Des biscuits ! Tout plein de biscuits !
russian: Большое печенье! Большое печенье, большое печенье!
bulgarian: Big cookie! Big cookie, big cookie!

english: Ooh, I think so too!
french: Oooh, c'est ce que je pense aussi !
russian: О-о, я тоже так думаю!
bulgarian: Ooh, I think so too!

english: Haha, well the idea certainly seems to have raised your morale, at least!
french: Ha ha ! Eh bien, l'idée t'a effectivement mis du baume au cœur !
russian: Ха-ха, вижу, твой настрой эта идея уже точно подняла!
bulgarian: Haha, well the idea certainly seems to have raised your morale, at least!

english: Thank you, [Ari]! I knew you were the right person for the job!
french: Merci, [Ari] ! Je savais que je pouvais compter sur toi !
russian: Спасибо, [Ari]! Я знала, что ты можешь дать хороший совет!
bulgarian: Thank you, [Ari]! I knew you were the right person for the job!

english: Thank you! We couldn't have done it without your help as well, [Ari].
french: Merci ! Nous n'aurions pas pu y parvenir sans toi, [Ari].
russian: Спасибо! Без твоей помощи мы бы не справились, [Ari].
bulgarian: Thank you! We couldn't have done it without your help as well, [Ari].

english: I'll get these forms filled out, with any luck we can expect a delivery soon!
french: Je remplis ces formulaires, et avec un peu de chance, les livraisons ne tarderont pas à arriver.
russian: Тогда я заполню эти формы, и, если нам повезёт, уже скоро придёт поставка!
bulgarian: I'll get these forms filled out, with any luck we can expect a delivery soon!

english: Well, it's not a financial fund per say. But I still think it's quite generous!
french: En réalité, il ne s'agit pas tout à fait d'une indemnité financière, mais cela reste tout de même assez généreux !
russian: Ну, это не совсем финансовый фонд. Но, по-моему, это всё равно большая щедрость!
bulgarian: Well, it's not a financial fund per say. But I still think it's quite generous!

english: We've been given a list of relief options to select from. Obviously liquid assets are rather tight in Aldaria at the moment, but we've narrowed it down to two options.
french: Nous devons choisir entre différents types d'aide. À l'évidence, Aldaria est un peu à court de liquidités. Après les avoir étudiées de plus près, nous avons deux alternatives.
russian: Нам дали список вариантов помощи на выбор. Очевидно, свободных средств в Альдарии сейчас не так много, но два варианта нам подходят.
bulgarian: We've been given a list of relief options to select from. Obviously liquid assets are rather tight in Aldaria at the moment, but we've narrowed it down to two options.

english: For our first choice...
french: En premier lieu...
russian: Первый вариант...
bulgarian: For our first choice...

english: A stockpile of stone and wood for everyone in town!
french: Nous pouvons demander des réserves de pierre et de bois pour tous les habitants !
russian: Запас камня и дерева для каждого жителя!
bulgarian: A stockpile of stone and wood for everyone in town!

english: I'm sure you can see the obvious value here. Ryis is working hard, but there isn't anyone in town who couldn't make good use of extra materials!
french: Tu comprends sans doute l'importance d'un tel choix. Ryis travaille d'arrache-pied, mais tout le monde pourrait profiter de matériaux supplémentaires !
russian: Уверена, ты понимаешь, почему это ценно. Ризу это важно для работы, но и все остальные найдут, куда применить новые материалы!
bulgarian: I'm sure you can see the obvious value here. Ryis is working hard, but there isn't anyone in town who couldn't make good use of extra materials!

english: Why I'm sure you yourself have some projects these supplies would help speed along!
french: Et toi aussi, tu as sûrement besoin de fournitures pour mener à bien tes propres projets !
russian: Да, я думаю, и у тебя есть проекты, которые эта поставка ресурсов может ускорить!
bulgarian: Why I'm sure you yourself have some projects these supplies would help speed along!

english: Fences! Barns! Coops!
french: À moi les clôtures, les granges et les poulaillers !
russian: Заборы! Сараи! Вольеры!
bulgarian: Fences! Barns! Coops!

english: Finally, I can start mass producing chicken statues!
french: Je vais enfin pouvoir fabriquer des statues de poule en série !
russian: Наконец-то поставлю на поток производство статуй куриц!
bulgarian: Finally, I can start mass producing chicken statues!

english: That's the spirit!
french: Ça me plaît bien !
russian: Так держать!
bulgarian: That's the spirit!

english: [Ari], I have wonderful news! Our careful budgeting efforts and appeals for grants to the Capital have borne fruit!
french: J'ai une grande nouvelle, [Ari] ! Notre rigueur budgétaire et nos demandes auprès de la capitale ont porté leurs fruits !
russian: [Ari], у меня отличные новости! Наше аккуратное планирование бюджета и заявки на гранты принесли плоды!
bulgarian: [Ari], I have wonderful news! Our careful budgeting efforts and appeals for grants to the Capital have borne fruit!

english: [Ari]! Adeline tells me you were instrumental in arranging the stone and wood delivery today. Thank you so much!
french: [Ari] ! Adeline m'a dit que tu avais fait pencher la balance pour la livraison de pierre et de bois, aujourd'hui. Merci infiniment !
russian: [Ari]! Аделина говорит, что поставка камня и дерева состоялась благодаря тебе. Большое тебе спасибо!
bulgarian: [Ari]! Adeline tells me you were instrumental in arranging the stone and wood delivery today. Thank you so much!

english: Those supplies you and Adeline got us were just what I needed, [Ari]! Henrietta says thank you too.
french: Les matériaux qu'on va recevoir grâce à Adeline et toi seront bien utiles, [Ari] ! Henrietta tient également à te remercier.
russian: Мне как раз не хватало ресурсов, которые вы с Аделиной добыли, [Ari]! Генриетта тоже передаёт спасибо.
bulgarian: Those supplies you and Adeline got us were just what I needed, [Ari]! Henrietta says thank you too.

english: Well, at least in some circles...
french: En tout cas, dans certains milieux...
russian: По крайней мере, в определённых кругах...
bulgarian: Well, at least in some circles...

english: Ah, [Ari]! So glad you saw the merit in my proposal! The Really Big Cookie bakery is quite famous, you know.
french: Ah, [Ari] ! Je suis très heureux que tu aies tenu compte de ma proposition ! Tu sais, la pâtisserie « Coucou cookies » est très renommée.
russian: А, [Ari]! Я рад, что моё предложение пришлось тебе по вкусу! «Правда большое печенье» — весьма известная пекарня.
bulgarian: Ah, [Ari]! So glad you saw the merit in my proposal! The Really Big Cookie bakery is quite famous, you know.

english: Hey, [Ari]! My mom gave me the BIGGEST cookie and she says it was all your fault! Thank you!
french: Hé, [Ari] ! Maman m'a donné le biscuit le plus GROS que j'aie jamais vu et elle m'a dit que c'était grâce à toi ! Merci !
russian: Эй, [Ari]! Мама дала мне БОЛЬШУЩУЮ печенюху и сказала, что это всё из-за тебя! Спасибо!
bulgarian: Hey, [Ari]! My mom gave me the BIGGEST cookie and she says it was all your fault! Thank you!

english: I don't know if I've ever properly thanked you for handling so many of the requests from the board, it's certainly been a weight off my mind.
french: Je ne sais pas si je t'ai suffisamment remercié<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they> de t'être occupé<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they> de toutes ces requêtes publiées sur le panneau. Tu m'as retiré une sacrée épine du pied.
russian: Не помню, выражала ли я тебе благодарность за выполнение задач с доски прошений. Это очень облегчает мне работу.
bulgarian: I don't know if I've ever properly thanked you for handling so many of the requests from the board, it's certainly been a weight off my mind.

english: True, but I want to make sure it stays that way, you know?
french: Tu as raison, mais je tiens à ce que ça reste ainsi.
russian: Это правда, но я хочу удостовериться, чтобы так было и дальше, понимаешь?
bulgarian: True, but I want to make sure it stays that way, you know?

english: We'll hike out to the Western Ruins next, then down to the Bay...
french: Après, nous grimperons jusqu'aux ruines de l'ouest, puis nous irons à la baie...
russian: Дальше мы поднимемся к Западным руинам, а потом спустимся к бухте...
bulgarian: We'll hike out to the Western Ruins next, then down to the Bay...

english: Um, if you're up for more, that is. I won't keep you if you'd rather call it a day.
french: Enfin, si tu as envie de continuer. Si tu préfères t'arrêter, je ne t'obligerai pas.
russian: Эмм, если ты хочешь ходить дальше, конечно. Если считаешь, что пора закончить, я не буду тебя задерживать.
bulgarian: Um, if you're up for more, that is. I won't keep you if you'd rather call it a day.

english: I-I've really been enjoying your company, though.
french: Mais je... j'apprécie beaucoup ta compagnie.
russian: Н-но мне очень приятно в твоей компании!
bulgarian: I-I've really been enjoying your company, though.

english: Well, look at that! I'm getting my second wind!
french: Eh bien, il se trouve justement que j'ai trouvé mon second souffle !
russian: Смотрите-ка! У меня открылось второе дыхание!
bulgarian: Well, look at that! I'm getting my second wind!

english: Okay, but let's try not to overdo it.
french: D'accord, mais tâchons de ne pas en faire trop.
russian: Хорошо, но на износ работать не будем.
bulgarian: Okay, but let's try not to overdo it.

english: Are you sure? Okay... let's do it!
french: Vraiment ? Entendu, alors... en route !
russian:
Ты

уверены

уверенауверенуверено? Ладно... Тогда пойдём!
bulgarian: Are you sure? Okay... let's do it!

english: O-okay. I'll try not to.
french: O-OK. Je vais y aller doucement.
russian: Л-ладно. Я постараюсь.
bulgarian: O-okay. I'll try not to.

english: I hereby pronounce this inspection... completed!
french: Je déclare notre inspection officiellement... terminée !
russian: Итак, я объявляю эту инспекцию... завершённой!
bulgarian: I hereby pronounce this inspection... completed!

english: Thank you again for coming with me, [Ari].
french: Encore merci de m'avoir accompagnée, [Ari].
russian:
Спасибо ещё раз, что

пошли

пошлапошёлпошло со мной, [Ari].
bulgarian: Thank you again for coming with me, [Ari].

english: I suppose I shouldn't keep you any longer, huh?
french: Je ne veux pas te retenir plus longtemps.
russian: Думаю, не стоит тебя ещё больше задерживать?
bulgarian: I suppose I shouldn't keep you any longer, huh?

english: And there's still some work to take care of on my desk when I get back...
french: De mon côté, j'ai encore de la paperasse qui m'attend sur mon bureau...
russian: К тому же меня дома на столе ещё ждут бумаги...
bulgarian: And there's still some work to take care of on my desk when I get back...

english: The work can wait, let's get something to eat and recharge.
french: Le travail peut attendre, allons manger un morceau pour reprendre des forces.
russian: Работа подождёт, давай сходим подкрепиться и восстановить силы.
bulgarian: The work can wait, let's get something to eat and recharge.

english: Can I interest you in a meal at the Inn first?
french: Ça te dirait d'aller manger quelque chose à l'auberge, avant ?
russian: Может, перед этим пообедаем вместе в трактире?
bulgarian: Can I interest you in a meal at the Inn first?

english: Still, those are just the things people bring to me. It's important to take a more direct approach when it comes to assessing how the town is doing.
french: Toutefois, il s'agit seulement de ce que les gens me demandent. Il est très important d'avoir une approche directe pour bien savoir comment se porte la ville.
russian: И всё же это только те заботы, о которых люди мне сообщают. Для оценки благополучия города следует использовать более непосредственный подход.
bulgarian: Still, those are just the things people bring to me. It's important to take a more direct approach when it comes to assessing how the town is doing.

english: Oh! Well... that does sound nice.
french: Oh ! Eh bien... c'est une bonne idée.
russian: О! Что ж... это правда звучит неплохо.
bulgarian: Oh! Well... that does sound nice.

english: Oh! Um...
french: Oh ! Hum...
russian: О! Эм...
bulgarian: Oh! Um...

english: I think I'd like that.
french: Ça me dit bien.
russian: Да, думаю, мне понравится.
bulgarian: I think I'd like that.

english: Let's go... my treat!
french: Allons-y... C'est moi qui régale !
russian: Пойдём... Я угощаю!
bulgarian: Let's go... my treat!

english: And that's where this inspection comes in! We'll tour Mistria and make sure everyone has what they need.
french: Nous allons donc mener une inspection ! Nous ferons le tour de Mistria pour nous assurer que personne ne manque de quoi que ce soit.
russian: В этом деле нам поможет инспекция! Мы пройдёмся по Мистрии и узнаем, всем ли всего хватает.
bulgarian: And that's where this inspection comes in! We'll tour Mistria and make sure everyone has what they need.

english: After you, Adeline!
french: Je te suis, Adeline !
russian: После вас, Аделина!
bulgarian: After you, Adeline!

english: A walk around Mistria sounds nice!
french: Une petite balade dans Mistria, génial !
russian: Не откажусь от прогулки по Мистрии!
bulgarian: A walk around Mistria sounds nice!

english: Why thank you, [Ari]!
french: Merci, [Ari] !
russian: Ой, ну что ты, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Why thank you, [Ari]!

english: I think so too!
french: Ça me plaît aussi !
russian: Я тоже так думаю!
bulgarian: I think so too!

english: Really Adeline, things have been going swimmingly in Mistria with you at the helm. Although...
french: Adeline, depuis que tu gères la ville, tout se passe très bien à Mistria, c'est indéniable, mais...
russian: Аделина, под твоим руководством дела в Мистрии правда идут как по маслу. Вот только...
bulgarian: Really Adeline, things have been going swimmingly in Mistria with you at the helm. Although...

english: Try not to push yourself so hard, you hear? You must be exhausted with all that running around.
french: Tâche de te ménager, d'accord ? Tu dois être épuisée avec tout ce que tu fais pour tout le monde.
russian: Попробуй не напрягаться так сильно, слышишь? Вся эта беготня наверняка ужасно изматывает.
bulgarian: Try not to push yourself so hard, you hear? You must be exhausted with all that running around.

english: Don't forget that taking care of Mistria includes taking care of yourself. Right [Ari]?
french: N'oublie pas que bien s'occuper de la ville implique de bien s'occuper de toi-même. Tu ne crois pas, [Ari] ?
russian: Не забывай: чтобы следить за Мистрией, надо следить за собой. Правда, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Don't forget that taking care of Mistria includes taking care of yourself. Right [Ari]?

english: Ah... but there's still a lot of ground to cover.
french: Ah... Mais il nous reste encore pas mal de choses à faire.
russian: Ах... но нам ещё столько мест надо обойти.
bulgarian: Ah... but there's still a lot of ground to cover.

english: It's sweet of Landen to look out for me, but really... I'm okay!
french: C'est gentil de la part de Landen de se préoccuper de moi, mais tout va bien, vraiment !
russian: Мне приятно, что Ланден за меня переживает, но я... правда в порядке!
bulgarian: It's sweet of Landen to look out for me, but really... I'm okay!

english: I just need to make sure I'm keeping on top of everything.
french: Je dois juste veiller à ne rien oublier.
russian: Мне просто надо быть в курсе всего происходящего.
bulgarian: I just need to make sure I'm keeping on top of everything.

english: Maybe we should take a break?
french: On devrait peut-être faire une pause ?
russian: Может, нам сделать перерыв?
bulgarian: Maybe we should take a break?

english: Really, the town is doing great!
french: Tout va super bien en ville !
russian: У нас в городе всё отлично!
bulgarian: Really, the town is doing great!

english: There you are, [Ari]. I'm so glad you could make it!
french: Ah, [Ari], je suis ravie de te voir !
russian:
Вот ты где, [Ari]. Рада, что ты

пришли

пришлапришёлпришло.
bulgarian: There you are, [Ari]. I'm so glad you could make it!

english: And look, we have a view of the whole town from up here!
french: Et regarde, on a un panorama magnifique sur toute la ville, depuis cette hauteur !
bulgarian: And look, we have a view of the whole town from up here!

english: It feels strange to think there was a time not long ago that I would have felt guilty about going on an unscheduled excursion like this.
french: C'est étrange de réaliser qu'à une époque, pas si lointaine, j'aurais culpabilisé de partir pour une excursion impromptue comme celle-ci.
bulgarian: It feels strange to think there was a time not long ago that I would have felt guilty about going on an unscheduled excursion like this.

english: I was so preoccupied with work, making sure I wouldn't let down my parents or the village...
french: J'étais tellement préoccupée par le travail, afin d'être à la hauteur pour mes parents, pour la ville...
bulgarian: I was so preoccupied with work, making sure I wouldn't let down my parents or the village...

english: At some point, I found that I couldn't take time for myself anymore without feeling like I was being selfish.
french: À un moment donné, je ne pouvais même plus prendre de temps pour moi sans avoir l'impression d'être égoïste.
bulgarian: At some point, I found that I couldn't take time for myself anymore without feeling like I was being selfish.

english: But you know, [Ari], I don't feel that way anymore.
french: Mais tu sais, [Ari], ce n'est plus le cas aujourd'hui.
bulgarian: But you know, [Ari], I don't feel that way anymore.

english: You helped me to remember that there's so much more to life.
french: Tu m'as aidée à me souvenir que la vie, c'était bien plus que cela.
bulgarian: You helped me to remember that there's so much more to life.

english: I've rediscovered so many things I enjoy doing, and discovered a bunch of new ones as well.
french: J'ai retrouvé le plaisir de faire plein de choses que j'aimais, et j'ai aussi découvert de nouvelles activités.
bulgarian: I've rediscovered so many things I enjoy doing, and discovered a bunch of new ones as well.

english: Like all the fun new things we've been doing on our dates together...
french: Comme toutes les nouveautés dont on a profité lors de nos rendez-vous ensemble...
bulgarian: Like all the fun new things we've been doing on our dates together...

english: If this joy isn't what life's all about, then what is?
french: Si la vie, ce n'est pas justement tous ces moments de bonheur, qu'est-ce que c'est, alors ?
bulgarian: If this joy isn't what life's all about, then what is?

english: For me, it's all about seeing you smile like this.
french: Pour moi, c'est te voir sourire comme en ce moment.
bulgarian: For me, it's all about seeing you smile like this.

english: You've taught me that same lesson, Adeline.
french: Tu m'as appris la même chose, Adeline.
bulgarian: You've taught me that same lesson, Adeline.

english: We're lucky, aren't we?
french: Nous avons de la chance, n'est-ce pas ?
bulgarian: We're lucky, aren't we?

english: It's days like this that make you feel glad just to be alive.
french: C'est lors de journées comme celle-là qu'on se sent simplement heureux d'être en vie.
bulgarian: It's days like this that make you feel glad just to be alive.

english: That we found each other.
french: De nous <he>être trouvés</he><she>être trouvées</she><they>avoir mutuellement</they>.
bulgarian: That we found each other.

english: I used to think I couldn't live with myself unless I could meet others' expectations of me.
french: Je pensais autrefois que pour m'accepter, je devais absolument être à la hauteur de ce que les autres attendaient de moi.
bulgarian: I used to think I couldn't live with myself unless I could meet others' expectations of me.

english: And while my responsibilities are still important to me...
french: Et même s'il est toujours important pour moi d'avoir ces responsabilités...
bulgarian: And while my responsibilities are still important to me...

english: There's only one thing-
french: Il n'y a qu'une seule chose...
bulgarian: There's only one thing-

english: One person that I just couldn't live without.
french: Une seule personne sans laquelle je ne pourrais pas vivre.
bulgarian: One person that I just couldn't live without.

english: As long as you're here with me, I know that everything else will fall into place.
french: Tant que tu es là avec moi, je sais que tout le reste trouvera naturellement sa place.
bulgarian: As long as you're here with me, I know that everything else will fall into place.

english: Oh, that reminds me! I made something for you. It's one of the new crafts I've been trying lately...
french: Oh, ça me rappelle que j'ai fabriqué quelque chose pour toi. C'est un nouveau loisir créatif auquel je m'essaie depuis quelque temps...
bulgarian: Oh, that reminds me! I made something for you. It's one of the new crafts I've been trying lately...

english: I guess that's why I made that $Lifetime Planner$ for you.
french: C'est sans doute pour cela que j'ai fabriqué cet $agenda$ pour toi.
bulgarian: I guess that's why I made that $Lifetime Planner$ for you.

english: I put the whole thing together myself. I even cut out and colored all the little tabs! It's a $Lifetime Planner$.
french: J'ai tout assemblé moi-même. J'ai même découpé et coloré tous les petits onglets ! C'est un $agenda$.
bulgarian: I put the whole thing together myself. I even cut out and colored all the little tabs! It's a $Lifetime Planner$.

english: In my own silly way, I wanted to give you some semblance of that same feeling.
french: À ma manière, un peu légère, je voulais partager avec toi quelque chose qui évoque ce sentiment.
bulgarian: In my own silly way, I wanted to give you some semblance of that same feeling.

english: I guess it's my way of saying... I'll always be here for you, [Ari].
french: Je crois que c'est ma façon à moi de te dire que... je serai toujours là pour toi, [Ari].
bulgarian: I guess it's my way of saying... I'll always be here for you, [Ari].

english: To let you know that I'll always be here for you, to help you figure things out as they come.
french: Te faire savoir que je serai toujours là pour toi, pour t'aider à résoudre tout ce qui se présentera à toi.
bulgarian: To let you know that I'll always be here for you, to help you figure things out as they come.

english: Whatever life may bring, I promise we'll figure it out together.
french: Quoi que la vie nous réserve, je te promets que nous trouverons des solutions ensemble.
bulgarian: Whatever life may bring, I promise we'll figure it out together.

english: To be for you, what you are to me.
french: Que je serai pour toi ce que tu es pour moi.
bulgarian: To be for you, what you are to me.

english: The clouds drifting in the wide open sky...
french: Les nuages qui glissent dans le ciel immense...
bulgarian: The clouds drifting in the wide open sky...

english: Even if the whole world were to suddenly fall apart...
french: Même si le monde entier devait brusquement s'écrouler...
bulgarian: Even if the whole world were to suddenly fall apart...

english: I know I'd get through it with you by my side.
french: Je sais que je m'en sortirais, avec toi à mes côtés.
bulgarian: I know I'd get through it with you by my side.

english: Plus, you'd probably put it back together for me better than it was before! Hehe!
french: Et en plus, tu réussirais sans doute à le reconstruire pour moi, et bien mieux qu'il ne l'était avant ! Hi hi !
bulgarian: Plus, you'd probably put it back together for me better than it was before! Hehe!

english: You know, [Ari]... there's been something I've been wanting to ask you.
french: Tu sais, [Ari]... Je voulais te demander quelque chose.
bulgarian: You know, [Ari]... there's been something I've been wanting to ask you.

english: But now that I have the opportunity, I can't seem to find the words.
french: Sauf que maintenant que l'occasion se présente, je n'arrive pas à trouver les mots.
bulgarian: But now that I have the opportunity, I can't seem to find the words.

english: And um. Anyway... wasn't there something you wanted to talk to me about, too?
french: Et hum. Bref... Tu ne voulais pas me parler de quelque chose, toi aussi ?
bulgarian: And um. Anyway... wasn't there something you wanted to talk to me about, too?

english: I wanted to talk to you about our future together...
french: Je voulais te parler de notre avenir ensemble...
bulgarian: I wanted to talk to you about our future together...

english: Let's talk about it another time...
french: Parlons-en une autre fois...
bulgarian: Let's talk about it another time...

english: W-wait-
french: A-Attends...
bulgarian: W-wait-

english: You don't mean....?
french: Tu n'es pas en train de me dire que...?
bulgarian: You don't mean....?

english: I love you, Adeline. Will you marry me?
french: Je t'aime, Adeline. Veux-tu m'épouser ?
bulgarian: I love you, Adeline. Will you marry me?

english: Actually, let's talk about it more another day.
french: Mais parlons-en plus longuement une autre fois, plutôt.
bulgarian: Actually, let's talk about it more another day.

english: [Ari]!
french: [Ari] !
bulgarian: [Ari]!

english: You were planning to ask me the same thing?
french: Tu voulais me poser la même question ?
bulgarian: You were planning to ask me the same thing?

english: The play of light and shadow on the land below...
french: La lumière et l'ombre qui jouent sur le sol en contrebas...
bulgarian: The play of light and shadow on the land below...

english: My answer is yes! YES!
french: Ma réponse est oui ! OUI !
bulgarian: My answer is yes! YES!

english: I want to be your wife, [Ari]! I want to spend the rest of our lives together!
french: Je veux être ta femme, [Ari] ! Je veux que nous passions le reste de notre vie ensemble !
bulgarian: I want to be your wife, [Ari]! I want to spend the rest of our lives together!

english: My heart is beating so fast...
french: J'ai le cœur qui bat la chamade...
bulgarian: My heart is beating so fast...

english: Oh, [Ari], I'm so happy!
french: Oh, [Ari], je suis tellement heureuse !
bulgarian: Oh, [Ari], I'm so happy!

english: I love you so much!
french: Je t'aime tellement !
bulgarian: I love you so much!

english: I can't wait to start planning our wedding...
french: J'ai hâte de commencer les préparatifs du mariage...
bulgarian: I can't wait to start planning our wedding...

english: I think I'm going to need to make myself another planner and color in some more tabs!
french: Je crois qu'il va falloir que je me trouve un nouveau classeur et que je prépare de nouveaux intercalaires !
bulgarian: I think I'm going to need to make myself another planner and color in some more tabs!

english: Oh? Of course, [Ari]. Whatever it is, we don't have to talk about it now if you're not ready.
french: Oh ? Bien sûr, [Ari]. Quoi que ce soit, rien ne nous oblige à en parler maintenant si <he>tu n'es pas prêt</he><she>tu n'es pas prête</she><they>ce n'est pas le bon moment pour toi</they>.
bulgarian: Oh? Of course, [Ari]. Whatever it is, we don't have to talk about it now if you're not ready.

english: Just let me know if you want to talk again. I'm always up for a walk to the Summit!
french: Dis-moi seulement quand tu auras envie de rediscuter. Je suis toujours partante pour une balade jusqu'au sommet !
bulgarian: Just let me know if you want to talk again. I'm always up for a walk to the Summit!

english: Being able to share this moment with you.
french: Pouvoir partager ce moment avec toi.
bulgarian: Being able to share this moment with you.

english: You make me glad just to be alive, too.
french: Ce bonheur d'exister, c'est aussi grâce à toi.
bulgarian: You make me glad just to be alive, too.

english: It does my heart good to see you so relaxed.
french: Mon cœur se réjouit de te voir si détendue.
bulgarian: It does my heart good to see you so relaxed.

english: Are you teasing me, [Ari]?
french: Tu me taquines, [Ari] ?
bulgarian: Are you teasing me, [Ari]?

english: I'm being serious, you know!
french: Je parle sérieusement, tu sais !
bulgarian: I'm being serious, you know!

english: Aww, [Ari]!
french: Oooh, [Ari] !
bulgarian: Aww, [Ari]!

english: Being with you always makes my stress melt away.
french: Quand je suis avec toi, toutes mes tensions s'envolent.
bulgarian: Being with you always makes my stress melt away.

english: Ahhh that breeze is so nice, isn't it?
french: Ahhh, cette brise est tellement agréable, tu ne trouves pas ?
bulgarian: Ahhh that breeze is so nice, isn't it?

english: You want to go somewhere to talk...?
french: Tu veux que nous allions quelque part pour discuter...?
bulgarian: You want to go somewhere to talk...?

english: Of course! Why don't we go for a walk up to the $Summit$?
french: Bien sûr ! Pourquoi ne pas faire une balade jusqu'au $sommet$ ?
bulgarian: Of course! Why don't we go for a walk up to the $Summit$?

english: What's on your mind, [Ari]?
french: À quoi penses-tu, [Ari] ?
bulgarian: What's on your mind, [Ari]?

english: Welcome to the party, dear!
french: Bienvenue, mon chou !
russian: Добро пожаловать в команду, дорогуша!
bulgarian: Welcome to the party, dear!

english: And I'm handling our tax documents for the season! Sorry to hog the really fun work, everyone!
french: Quant à moi, je m'occupe de tout ce qui a trait aux impôts de l'année ! Je m'excuse de me garder la partie la plus sympa du travail.
russian: А я занимаюсь налоговой отчётностью за этот сезон! Уж простите, что забрала самую весёлую работу!
bulgarian: And I'm handling our tax documents for the season! Sorry to hog the really fun work, everyone!

english: [Ari], I'd like you to come over here and review the work we've already done. It'll give you a good overview and make sure we haven't made any mistakes!
french: [Ari], j'aimerais que tu contrôles tout ce que nous avons déjà fait. Cela te donnera une vue d'ensemble et te permettra de corriger nos éventuelles erreurs !
russian: [Ari], можешь подойти и посмотреть, что уже сделано. Так быстрее поймёшь, что к чему, а заодно и нас проверишь.
bulgarian: [Ari], I'd like you to come over here and review the work we've already done. It'll give you a good overview and make sure we haven't made any mistakes!

english: But you've already double checked everything, Adeline.
french: Mais tu as déjà tout revérifié, Adeline.
russian: Ты же уже всё перепроверила, Аделина.
bulgarian: But you've already double checked everything, Adeline.

english: Nothing better than a triple check, it's so satisfying!
french: Une troisième vérification ne fait jamais de mal à personne !
russian: Никогда не помешает ещё раз проверить, это же приятно!
bulgarian: Nothing better than a triple check, it's so satisfying!

english: Wow, thanks Adeline!
french: Waouh, merci Adeline !
russian: Ух ты, спасибо, Аделина!
bulgarian: Wow, thanks Adeline!

english: Wow, uh, thanks Adeline...
french: Waouh, euh, merci Adeline...
russian: Ух, э-э, спасибо, Аделина...
bulgarian: Wow, uh, thanks Adeline...

english: Oh, [Ari]! You're very welcome!
french: Oh, mais je t'en prie [Ari] !
russian: Ой, [Ari]! Пожалуйста!
bulgarian: Oh, [Ari]! You're very welcome!

english: Haha, well, I appreciate that you're willing to give it a try.
french: Ha ha, en tout cas, je suis heureuse de voir que tu as au moins envie d'essayer.
russian: Ха-ха, что ж, я ценю твоё стремление попробовать.
bulgarian: Haha, well, I appreciate that you're willing to give it a try.

english: And when we're done, I've ordered up a special tray of treats from the Inn to celebrate! Whoever finishes first gets first pick!
french: Et j'ai commandé un tas de choses délicieuses à l'auberge pour après ! Le premier qui termine aura le droit de se servir avant les autres !
russian: Я заказала специальный набор угощений из трактира, чтобы отметить, когда закончим! Кто первый справится — тот и выбирает первым.
bulgarian: And when we're done, I've ordered up a special tray of treats from the Inn to celebrate! Whoever finishes first gets first pick!

english: Well, why didn't you say so earlier!
french: Mais, pourquoi tu ne l'as pas dit plus tôt ?
russian: Ну что же ты сразу не сказала!
bulgarian: Well, why didn't you say so earlier!

english: Oh no, I hope Adeline didn't bully you into this, [Ari].
french: Oh non, j'espère qu'Adeline ne t'a pas forcé la main pour venir, [Ari].
russian: О нет, надеюсь, Аделина тебя не затащила силой, [Ari].
bulgarian: Oh no, I hope Adeline didn't bully you into this, [Ari].

english: Nonsense! Not all of us are as averse to paperwork as you, Eiland. Right, [Ari]?
french: N'importe quoi ! Tout le monde n'est pas allergique aux tâches administratives, Eiland. Hein, [Ari] ?
russian: Чушь! В отличие от тебя, Эйланд, у нас нет отвращения к бумажной работе. Да, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Nonsense! Not all of us are as averse to paperwork as you, Eiland. Right, [Ari]?

english: I love the smell of drying ink!
french: J'adore l'odeur de l'encre en train de sécher !
russian: Обожаю, как пахнут сохнущие чернила!
bulgarian: I love the smell of drying ink!

english: Well, I guess I'm about to find out!
french: Eh bien, je te dirai ça après !
russian: Что ж, вот сейчас я и узнаю!
bulgarian: Well, I guess I'm about to find out!

english: Oh! Me too!
french: Oh, moi aussi !
russian: О, я тоже!
bulgarian: Oh! Me too!

english: I'm sure you'll have a great time!
french: Je suis certaine que tu vas bien t'amuser !
russian: Уверена, тебе очень понравится!
bulgarian: I'm sure you'll have a great time!

english: Let me take you around the room. Great Aunt Elsie is working on applying for grants from the Capital...
french: Laisse-moi t'expliquer comment ça fonctionne ici. Grand-tante Elsie s'occupe des demandes d'aides auprès de la capitale...
russian: Давай я покажу тебе комнату. Здесь тётушка Элси пишет заявки на гранты из столицы...
bulgarian: Let me take you around the room. Great Aunt Elsie is working on applying for grants from the Capital...

english: There's certainly a trick to getting what you want out of those nobles. Unfortunately for them, I've had plenty of practice!
french: Il faut un certain savoir-faire pour obtenir quoi que ce soit de la noblesse. Et malheureusement pour eux, j'ai beaucoup d'expérience en la matière !
russian: У этих дворян без хитростей ничего не допросишься. К несчастью для них, у меня богатый опыт!
bulgarian: There's certainly a trick to getting what you want out of those nobles. Unfortunately for them, I've had plenty of practice!

english: My dear brother is taking care of large excavation site procedural paperwork...
french: Mon cher frère gère les autorisations pour les grands chantiers de fouilles...
russian: Мой дорогой брат разбирается со служебными документами, которые относятся к раскопкам...
bulgarian: My dear brother is taking care of large excavation site procedural paperwork...

english: Honestly, with the archaic way these forms have been written, you'd think they were historical artifacts themselves!
french: Et franchement, vu les libellés archaïques de ces formulaires, ils seraient eux-mêmes à classer parmi les artéfacts anciens !
russian: Честно говоря, эти формы написаны таким архаичным языком, что их тоже стоит считать историческими артефактами!
bulgarian: Honestly, with the archaic way these forms have been written, you'd think they were historical artifacts themselves!

english: [Ari], you came!
french: [Ari], te voilà !
russian:
[Ari], ты

пришли

пришлапришёлпришло!
bulgarian: [Ari], you came!

english: Do you like it? I had a bit of help from Hemlock and Jo getting everything set up.
french: Ça te plaît ? Hemlock et Jo m'ont un peu aidé à tout préparer.
russian: Ну как тебе? Я попросил Хемлока и Джо помочь мне всё обставить получше.
bulgarian: Do you like it? I had a bit of help from Hemlock and Jo getting everything set up.

english: Shall we discuss our drink options before we tuck in?
french: Si on choisissait à boire, avant de se mettre à manger ?
russian: Давай обсудим напитки, прежде чем приступать к еде?
bulgarian: Shall we discuss our drink options before we tuck in?

english: Actually, Balor...
french: Excuse-moi, Balor...
russian: Кстати, Балор...
bulgarian: Actually, Balor...

english: I'm so sorry to interrupt, but can I talk to you outside?
french: Je suis désolée de vous interrompre, mais je pourrais te parler à l'extérieur ?
russian: Прошу прощения, что прерываю. Мы можем выйти поговорить?
bulgarian: I'm so sorry to interrupt, but can I talk to you outside?

english: E-excuse me, [Ari]. Feel free to get started. I'm sure I'll only be gone a moment.
french: E-Excuse-moi, [Ari]. Commence sans moi, si tu veux. Je n'en ai que pour une seconde.
russian: П-прости, [Ari]. Начинай без меня, если хочешь. Обещаю, что я ненадолго.
bulgarian: E-excuse me, [Ari]. Feel free to get started. I'm sure I'll only be gone a moment.

english: Wheedle is downstairs, and he's demanding to see you.
french: Wheedle est en bas et il demande à te voir.
russian: Там внизу Хлюст, и он настаивает, что должен с тобой поговорить.
bulgarian: Wheedle is downstairs, and he's demanding to see you.

english: He said something about picking up your contract.
french: Il a dit quelque chose à propos de ton contrat qu'il devait récupérer.
russian: Говорит что-то про передачу твоего контракта.
bulgarian: He said something about picking up your contract.

english: Balor, surely you're not...?
french: Balor, tu ne vas pas sérieusement...?
russian: Балор, ты же не станешь?..
bulgarian: Balor, surely you're not...?

english: I see. This is not the timing I'd hoped for.
french: Je vois. J'espérais que ça arrive à un autre moment.
russian: Понятно. Крайне неудачный момент для этого разговора.
bulgarian: I see. This is not the timing I'd hoped for.

english: Jo... I need to talk to [Ari] first. Can you delay him?
french: Jo... Je dois d'abord parler à [Ari]. Tu peux le faire patienter ?
russian: Джо... Я хочу сперва поговорить с [Ari]. Ты можешь его задержать?
bulgarian: Jo... I need to talk to [Ari] first. Can you delay him?

english: Maple, Luc and Dell tried to pitch in too... but it was easy enough to clean up their mess afterwards.
french: Maple, Luc et Dell ont aussi essayé de mettre leur grain de sel... Mais ça n'a pas été trop difficile de nettoyer leur bazar après coup.
russian: Мэйпл, Люк и Делл тоже влезали помочь... Но за ними было несложно прибраться.
bulgarian: Maple, Luc and Dell tried to pitch in too... but it was easy enough to clean up their mess afterwards.

english: For you Balor, Hemlock and I will try to keep him busy. But you owe us one!
french: Hemlock et moi allons tenter de l'occuper, mais c'est bien parce que c'est toi, Balor. À charge de revanche !
russian: Только для тебя, Балор. Мы с Хемлоком постараемся его занять. Но за тобой должок!
bulgarian: For you Balor, Hemlock and I will try to keep him busy. But you owe us one!

english: I'm in your debt. Thank you.
french: Je vous en suis redevable. Merci.
russian: Я вам бесконечно обязан. Спасибо.
bulgarian: I'm in your debt. Thank you.

english: Sorry about that...
french: Désolé...
russian: Прости, пожалуйста...
bulgarian: Sorry about that...

english: Everything alright?
french: Tout va bien ?
russian: Всё в порядке?
bulgarian: Everything alright?

english: If you're busy, we could reschedule...
french: Si tu es occupé, on peut repousser...
russian: Если ты занят, мы можем перенести...
bulgarian: If you're busy, we could reschedule...

english: It's... nothing. It can wait.
french: Ce... Ce n'est rien. Ça peut attendre.
russian: Нет, ничего... Подождёт.
bulgarian: It's... nothing. It can wait.

english: It's... nothing. It can wait.
french: Ce... Ce n'est rien. Ça peut attendre.
russian: Нет, ничего... Подождёт.
bulgarian: It's... nothing. It can wait.

english: No, no... It's nothing. It can wait.
french: Non, non... Ce n'est rien. Ça peut attendre.
russian: Нет-нет, ничего... Подождёт.
bulgarian: No, no... It's nothing. It can wait.

english: No, no... It's nothing. It can wait.
french: Non, non... Ce n'est rien. Ça peut attendre.
russian: Нет-нет, ничего... Подождёт.
bulgarian: No, no... It's nothing. It can wait.

english: [Ari], there's something I've been meaning to ask you.
french: [Ari], je voulais te demander quelque chose.
russian: [Ari], я кое о чём хотел тебя спросить.
bulgarian: [Ari], there's something I've been meaning to ask you.

english: There's something I've been meaning to ask you.
french: Je voulais te demander quelque chose.
russian: Я кое о чём хотел тебя спросить.
bulgarian: There's something I've been meaning to ask you.

english: About Mistria... would it matter to you if I stayed? Your business would continue to be successful, regardless. You don't really need-
french: À propos de Mistria... Est-ce que cela aurait de l'importance pour toi que je reste ? Tes affaires resteraient florissantes, même dans ce cas. Tu n'as pas vraiment besoin...
russian: Насчёт Мистрии... Насколько тебе важно, чтобы я остался? Твои дела в любом случае будут идти успешно. Тебе ведь на самом деле не нужен...
bulgarian: About Mistria... would it matter to you if I stayed? Your business would continue to be successful, regardless. You don't really need-

english: What are you saying, Balor? You're one of my best friends!
french: Qu'est-ce que tu racontes, Balor ? Tu es l'un de mes meilleurs amis !
russian: О чём ты говоришь, Балор? Ты один из моих лучших друзей!
bulgarian: What are you saying, Balor? You're one of my best friends!

english: What are you saying, Balor? It matters to me more than anything.
french: Qu'est-ce que tu racontes, Balor ? Cela m'importe plus que tout.
russian: О чём ты говоришь, Балор? Для меня это важнее всего на свете.
bulgarian: What are you saying, Balor? It matters to me more than anything.

english: Since the Shooting Star Festival, I've been wondering... what am I to you, [Ari]? We're more than just business partners... right?
french: Depuis la fête des étoiles filantes, je me pose la question... Qu'est-ce que je représente pour toi, [Ari] ? Nous sommes plus que des partenaires en affaires... non ?
russian: С тех пор, как мы смотрели на звездопад вместе, я размышлял... кто я такой для тебя, [Ari]? Мы же не просто деловые партнёры... правда?
bulgarian: Since the Shooting Star Festival, I've been wondering... what am I to you, [Ari]? We're more than just business partners... right?

english: You're one of my best friends, Balor!
french: Tu es l'un de mes meilleurs amis, Balor !
russian: Ты один из моих лучших друзей, Балор!
bulgarian: You're one of my best friends, Balor!

english: You're more to me than anyone, Balor.
french: Tu comptes plus que quiconque, Balor.
russian: Ты для меня важнее всех на свете, Балор!
bulgarian: You're more to me than anyone, Balor.

english: Do you mean it, [Ari]? I feel the same way.
