bulgarian: Do you have insight that you'd care to share, or is this just your usual badmouthing?

english: This whole thing is such a rat's nest.
french: Tout ça n'a vraiment ni queue ni tête.
russian: Тут очень запутанная проблема.
bulgarian: This whole thing is such a rat's nest.

english: You would have better luck focusing on a smaller problem, something more suited to your skill level. Wart removal, perhaps?
french: Tu ferais mieux de te concentrer sur des problèmes plus simples, quelque chose à ta portée. Une façon de faire disparaître les verrues, par exemple ?
russian: Тебе бы лучше взять задачу попроще: что-то более близкое к твоему уровню. Может, удаление бородавок?
bulgarian: You would have better luck focusing on a smaller problem, something more suited to your skill level. Wart removal, perhaps?

english: Valen's worked hard and made a lot of progress.
french: Valen a travaillé d'arrache-pied et elle a fait beaucoup de progrès.
russian: Вален много работала и достигла больших результатов.
bulgarian: Valen's worked hard and made a lot of progress.

english: Hey, don't be a jerk.
french: Hé, ne sois pas si infecte.
russian: Эй, не надо хамить.
bulgarian: Hey, don't be a jerk.

english: Juniper, thank you for agreeing to this meeting.
french: Juniper, je te remercie d'avoir accepté de me recevoir.
russian: Джунипер, спасибо, что согласилась на эту встречу.
bulgarian: Juniper, thank you for agreeing to this meeting.

english: (You're not quite sure, but Dozy seems to be giving the impression that Juniper really enjoyed having Valen and you over.)
french: (Vous n'en mettriez pas votre main à couper, mais Dozy semble vouloir dire que Juniper était très contente de vous recevoir, Valen et vous.)
russian: (Вы не совсем уверены, но, кажется, Дрёма выражает, что Джунипер понравился ваш с Вален визит.)
bulgarian: (You're not quite sure, but Dozy seems to be giving the impression that Juniper really enjoyed having Valen and you over.)

english: Well, I don't think I did anything that needs to be forgiven.
french: En réalité, je n'ai pas été désagréable au point de devoir demander pardon.
russian: Не думаю, что мне есть, за что извиняться.
bulgarian: Well, I don't think I did anything that needs to be forgiven.

english: Oh ho ho!
french: Ho ho ho !
russian: О-хо-хо!
bulgarian: Oh ho ho!

english: I'd ask you to forgive my behavior with the town "doctor" but...
french: Je m'excuserai volontiers pour mon attitude envers notre chère « docteure », mais...
russian: Я бы попросила у тебя прощения за своё поведение с местной «докторшей», но...
bulgarian: I'd ask you to forgive my behavior with the town "doctor" but...

english: It goes by several different regional names, and is regarded as a weed with no medicinal properties.
french: Son nom diffère selon les régions et elle est considérée comme une adventice dénuée de tout intérêt médical.
russian: У него много региональных названий, и обычно его считают сорняком без медицинских свойств.
bulgarian: It goes by several different regional names, and is regarded as a weed with no medicinal properties.

english: If only Juniper would use her knowledge for the general good.
french: Si seulement Juniper pouvait utiliser ses talents pour le bien de tous.
russian: Вот бы Джунипер обратила свои познания на общее благо.
bulgarian: If only Juniper would use her knowledge for the general good.

english: As much as I hate to admit it, I can see why I missed Cliffblossom as a lead.
french: Même si ça me fait mal de le reconnaître, je crois avoir compris pourquoi je suis passée à côté de la fleur de roche.
russian: Мне неприятно это признавать, но я понимаю, почему я упустила из виду скалоцвет.
bulgarian: As much as I hate to admit it, I can see why I missed Cliffblossom as a lead.

english: Would you like to talk?
french: Tu veux que nous parlions ?
bulgarian: Would you like to talk?

english: I have time, and I wouldn't mind a walk in the $Western Ruins$.
french: J'ai le temps, et je ne serais pas contre une petite promenade vers les $ruines de l'ouest$.
bulgarian: I have time, and I wouldn't mind a walk in the $Western Ruins$.

english: You have a pensive look, [Ari].
french: Tu as un air pensif, [Ari].
bulgarian: You have a pensive look, [Ari].

english: Walking around these ruins always reminds me of you, and the time we went searching for the Cliffblossom together.
french: À chaque fois que je me promène vers ces ruines, ça me fait penser à toi et à cette fois où nous avons cherché la fleur de roche ensemble.
bulgarian: Walking around these ruins always reminds me of you, and the time we went searching for the Cliffblossom together.

english: Me too.
french: Moi de même.
bulgarian: Me too.

english: When we first met, rediscovering the formula for the $Panacea$ was weighing on me every day.
french: Lors de notre rencontre, j'étais totalement obnubilée par le fait de retrouver la formule de la $panacée$.
bulgarian: When we first met, rediscovering the formula for the $Panacea$ was weighing on me every day.

english: My research was a secret. My own burden to bear.
french: Mes recherches étaient secrètes. C'était un fardeau que je me devais de porter.
bulgarian: My research was a secret. My own burden to bear.

english: But you surprised me. You assisted me with Hayden, helped me handle Juniper, and joined me in the search for the elusive Cliffblossom.
french: Mais tu m'as surprise. Tu m'as apporté ton aide pour Hayden, tu m'as aidée à gérer Juniper et tu m'as accompagnée pour chercher cette fleur de roche si difficile à dénicher.
bulgarian: But you surprised me. You assisted me with Hayden, helped me handle Juniper, and joined me in the search for the elusive Cliffblossom.

english: You made it so easy to ask for help. Sometimes, I didn't even need to ask.
french: C'était si simple de te demander de l'aide. Et parfois, je n'avais même pas à le faire.
bulgarian: You made it so easy to ask for help. Sometimes, I didn't even need to ask.

english: Don't misunderstand, I like that I can depend on myself.
french: Ne te méprends pas, j'aime être une femme indépendante.
bulgarian: Don't misunderstand, I like that I can depend on myself.

english: But being self-sufficient doesn't need to mean... being alone.
french: Mais cette indépendance ne doit pas nécessairement signifier... vivre seule.
bulgarian: But being self-sufficient doesn't need to mean... being alone.

english: Thank you for reminding me of that.
french: Merci de me l'avoir rappelé.
bulgarian: Thank you for reminding me of that.

english: It's an understatement, but... you've truly enriched my life, [Ari].
french: C'est un euphémisme, mais... tu as vraiment embelli ma vie, [Ari].
bulgarian: It's an understatement, but... you've truly enriched my life, [Ari].

english: I'm always here for you... no matter what you need!
french: Peu importe ce dont tu as besoin, je serai toujours là pour toi !
bulgarian: I'm always here for you... no matter what you need!

english: I feel the same. You taught me to take better care of myself.
french: Je ressens la même chose. Tu m'as appris à mieux prendre soin de moi.
bulgarian: I feel the same. You taught me to take better care of myself.

english: Oh? I'll make a note of that. Haha!
french: Oh ? Ça, je me le note. Ha ha !
bulgarian: Oh? I'll make a note of that. Haha!

english: I suppose I've never articulated this, but... there aren't many people I can turn to for help.
french: Je suppose que je ne t'en ai jamais fait part, mais rares sont les personnes vers lesquelles je peux demander de l'aide.
bulgarian: I suppose I've never articulated this, but... there aren't many people I can turn to for help.

english: Oh? I'll take that to heart.
french: Oh ? Ça me va droit au cœur.
bulgarian: Oh? I'll take that to heart.

french: Je...

english: How do I say this? I'm thankful to know you...
french: J'aimerais m'exprimer correctement ! Je suis si reconnaissante de t'avoir dans ma vie...
bulgarian: How do I say this? I'm thankful to know you...

english: And to be close to you.
french: Et auprès de moi.
bulgarian: And to be close to you.

english: You're precious to me, [Ari].
french: Tu es inestimable à mes yeux, [Ari].
bulgarian: You're precious to me, [Ari].

english: Which reminds me... I have something for you. It's a $Panacea Jar$.
french: Ce qui me fait penser que... j'ai quelque chose pour toi. C'est un flacon de $panacée$.
bulgarian: Which reminds me... I have something for you. It's a $Panacea Jar$.

english: That's why I gave you the $Panacea Jar$.
french: C'est pour cela que je t'ai offert ce flacon de $panacée$.
bulgarian: That's why I gave you the $Panacea Jar$.

english: The $Panacea$ is still quite rare, but I want you to always have some on hand.
french: La $panacée$ reste assez rare, mais je voulais que tu en aies un peu, en cas de besoin.
bulgarian: The $Panacea$ is still quite rare, but I want you to always have some on hand.

english: So you'll always be safe. That's important to me.
french: Comme ça, tu seras toujours en sécurité. C'est important pour moi.
bulgarian: So you'll always be safe. That's important to me.

english: I care for all the townsfolk, but...
french: Je souhaite que tous les habitants de la ville soient en sécurité, mais...
bulgarian: I care for all the townsfolk, but...

english: It's different, with you.
french: En ce qui te concerne, c'est différent.
bulgarian: It's different, with you.

english: Mistria is a place where neighbors support each other, but...
french: À Mistria, les voisins sont toujours là pour s'entraider, mais...
bulgarian: Mistria is a place where neighbors support each other, but...

english: I suppose I am, ah... more personally invested in your well-being.
french: J'imagine que je me sens, hum... bien plus responsable de ton bien-être.
bulgarian: I suppose I am, ah... more personally invested in your well-being.

english: But you know that already, don't you? O-of course you do...
french: Mais ça, tu le sais déjà, n'est-ce pas ? B-Bien évidemment...
bulgarian: But you know that already, don't you? O-of course you do...

english: Sorry... I don't know what's gotten into me today.
french: Désolée... Je ne sais pas ce qui me prend aujourd'hui.
bulgarian: Sorry... I don't know what's gotten into me today.

english: I'm not usually one to be so talkative, nor to have so much trouble with my words...
french: D'habitude, je ne suis pas aussi bavarde, et j'ai généralement plus de facilité pour m'exprimer.
bulgarian: I'm not usually one to be so talkative, nor to have so much trouble with my words...

english: In any case, you had mentioned there was something you wanted to discuss?
french: Bref, tu disais que tu voulais discuter de quelque chose ?
bulgarian: In any case, you had mentioned there was something you wanted to discuss?

english: I wanted to talk to you about our future together...
french: Je voulais te parler de notre avenir ensemble...
bulgarian: I wanted to talk to you about our future together...

english: Let's talk about it another time...
french: Parlons-en une autre fois...
bulgarian: Let's talk about it another time...

english: Our future?
french: De notre avenir ?
bulgarian: Our future?

english: In what sense?
french: Dans quel sens ?
bulgarian: In what sense?

english: I love you, Valen. Will you marry me?
french: Je t'aime, Valen. Veux-tu m'épouser ?
bulgarian: I love you, Valen. Will you marry me?

english: Actually, let's talk about it more another day.
french: Mais parlons-en plus longuement une autre fois, plutôt.
bulgarian: Actually, let's talk about it more another day.

english: You want to... marry me?
french: Tu veux te marier... avec moi ?
bulgarian: You want to... marry me?

english: Yes! Of course I will!
french: Mais oui ! Bien sûr que je le veux !
bulgarian: Yes! Of course I will!

english: I'm a doctor, and the townsfolk are my patients.
french: Je suis docteure et ce sont mes patients.
bulgarian: I'm a doctor, and the townsfolk are my patients.

english: There's nothing I want more.
french: Il n'y a rien que je désire plus.
bulgarian: There's nothing I want more.

english: I'm so happy I can hardly think straight!
french: Je suis si heureuse que j'en perds mes moyens !
bulgarian: I'm so happy I can hardly think straight!

english: I love you, [Ari]!
french: Je t'aime, [Ari] !
bulgarian: I love you, [Ari]!

english: I love you so much!
french: Je t'aime tellement !
bulgarian: I love you so much!

english: Another day? Of course.
french: Un autre jour ? Bien sûr.
bulgarian: Another day? Of course.

english: Come find me whenever you'd like to talk. I'm always here for you.
french: Viens me voir quand tu voudras parler. Je serai toujours à ton écoute.
bulgarian: Come find me whenever you'd like to talk. I'm always here for you.

english: As a professional, it stands to reason that I try not to speak much about my own troubles.
french: En tant que professionnelle, je me dois de garder mes problèmes personnels pour moi.
bulgarian: As a professional, it stands to reason that I try not to speak much about my own troubles.

english: That line of thinking began at my practice, but eventually it appeared in most facets of my life.
french: J'ai agi ainsi dans mon travail, mais cela a fini par toucher d'autres aspects de ma vie.
bulgarian: That line of thinking began at my practice, but eventually it appeared in most facets of my life.

english: And over time I simply... got used to thinking that way. Perhaps I even began to prefer it.
french: Et avec le temps, je suis simplement... habituée à me comporter comme ça. Je préférais même peut-être qu'il en soit ainsi.
bulgarian: And over time I simply... got used to thinking that way. Perhaps I even began to prefer it.

english: I took it as a fact of life, that I had to do things alone... until you walked into my Clinic.
french: Être seule est devenu une façon de vivre... jusqu'à ce que tu débarques à ma clinique.
bulgarian: I took it as a fact of life, that I had to do things alone... until you walked into my Clinic.

english: What did you even think of me, walking in straight from my work in the fields?
french: Qu'est-ce que tu as pensé de moi quand je suis arrivé<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they> directement de mon travail aux champs ?
bulgarian: What did you even think of me, walking in straight from my work in the fields?

english: I'm glad I came in for a checkup that day.
french: Je suis content<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they> d'être venu<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they> en consultation, ce jour-là.
bulgarian: I'm glad I came in for a checkup that day.

english: That you were awfully cute, with that smudge of dirt on your cheek and the sweat on your brow.
french: Que tu étais tout à fait adorable, dégoulinant<she>e</she><he></he><they>·e</they> de sueur et avec une marque de terre sur la joue.
bulgarian: That you were awfully cute, with that smudge of dirt on your cheek and the sweat on your brow.

english: Thanks for coming out here with me, [Ari].
french: Merci de m'avoir accompagnée jusqu'ici, [Ari].
bulgarian: Thanks for coming out here with me, [Ari].

english: You twisted your ankle tripping over a sack of grain, Hayden.
french: Hayden, tu t'es simplement foulé la cheville en trébuchant sur un sac de grains.
russian: Ты споткнулся о мешок зерна и подвернул голеностоп, Хейден.
bulgarian: You twisted your ankle tripping over a sack of grain, Hayden.

english: Just a moment, [Ari], speed is essential to an effective application.
french: Donne-moi un instant, [Ari]. Il faut agir vite pour que le traitement soit efficace.
russian: Минутку, [Ari], для хорошего эффекта надо применять её быстро.
bulgarian: Just a moment, [Ari], speed is essential to an effective application.

english: Ah, in a moment [Ari], I need to focus.
french: Un instant, [Ari]. Je dois me concentrer.
russian: А, минутку, [Ari], мне надо сосредоточиться.
bulgarian: Ah, in a moment [Ari], I need to focus.

english: Oh... ohhh! Amazing!
french: Oh... Oooh ! Eh ben ça alors !
russian: Ох... о-о-ох! Потрясающе!
bulgarian: Oh... ohhh! Amazing!

english: I'm CURED! You're a miracle worker, Doctor!
french: Je suis GUÉRI ! C'est miraculeux, docteure Valen !
russian: Я ВЫЗДОРОВЕЛ! Ты просто чудеса творишь, доктор!
bulgarian: I'm CURED! You're a miracle worker, Doctor!

english: Don't run, Hayden! Stay hydrated! Make sure you get plenty of rest!
french: Ne cours pas, Hayden ! Bois beaucoup d'eau ! Et prends beaucoup de repos !
russian: Не беги, Хейден! Пей побольше воды! Не забывай про здоровый отдых!
bulgarian: Don't run, Hayden! Stay hydrated! Make sure you get plenty of rest!

english: Thanks for helping out, [Ari]. You're here for your check-up?
french: Merci pour ton aide, [Ari]. Tu venais pour ton bilan de santé ?
russian:
Спасибо за помощь, [Ari]. Ты

пришли

пришлапришёлпришло на обследование?
bulgarian: Thanks for helping out, [Ari]. You're here for your check-up?

english: Good, go lie down on the bed, I'll be right with you.
french: Alors, allonge-toi sur le lit, je suis à toi dans une minute.
russian: Хорошо, ложись на кушетку. Я сейчас подойду.
bulgarian: Good, go lie down on the bed, I'll be right with you.

english: You've got a clean bill of health, [Ari]. All that fresh air and outdoor work have you in tiptop shape.
french: Tu es en pleine forme, [Ari]. Tout ce travail au grand air te fait le plus grand bien.
russian:
Ты

здоровы

здороваздоровздоровое как бык, [Ari]. Всё благодаря свежему воздуху и физической активности.
bulgarian: You've got a clean bill of health, [Ari]. All that fresh air and outdoor work have you in tiptop shape.

english: Anything else you'd like to ask me? Don't hesitate, patient confidentiality is part of a doctor's code.
french: Tu avais autre chose à me demander ? N'hésite pas, un docteur est tenu à la confidentialité.
russian: Хочешь спросить что-то ещё? Не стесняйся, личная информация от пациента — врачебная тайна.
bulgarian: Anything else you'd like to ask me? Don't hesitate, patient confidentiality is part of a doctor's code.

english: What's with the creepy basement?
french: C'est quoi, cette cave mystérieuse ?
russian: Что у тебя за жуткий подвал?
bulgarian: What's with the creepy basement?

english: What was that powder in the barrel? Can I have some?
french: C'était quoi cette poudre, dans le tonneau ? Je peux en avoir ?
russian: Что за порошок был в бочке? Дашь мне тоже?
bulgarian: What was that powder in the barrel? Can I have some?

english: Is there anything about your personal health you'd like to ask me about?
french: Tu n'as pas plutôt des questions concernant ta propre santé ?
russian: У тебя есть ко мне вопросы о твоём здоровье?
bulgarian: Is there anything about your personal health you'd like to ask me about?

english: Keep off that foot for two weeks... I'll come check up on you, and we can go from there.
french: Ne t'appuie pas sur ce pied pendant deux semaines... Je passerai et on verra la suite à donner.
russian: Не нагружай эту ногу ближайшие две недели... Я зайду тебя осмотреть и решим, что делать дальше.
bulgarian: Keep off that foot for two weeks... I'll come check up on you, and we can go from there.

english: Now, I've got to get ready for my next patient... have a nice day, [Ari].
french: Bon, je dois sortir le dossier du patient suivant... Passe une bonne journée, [Ari].
russian: Так, у меня уже скоро придёт новый пациент... Хорошего дня, [Ari].
bulgarian: Now, I've got to get ready for my next patient... have a nice day, [Ari].

english: [Ari], I'm doomed... I can't work my field for two weeks. My harvest is going to be ruined...
french: [Ari], c'est la fin... Je ne vais pas pouvoir m'occuper de mes champs pendant deux semaines. Je vais perdre toute ma récolte...
russian: [Ari], это катастрофа... Я не могу работать в поле целых две недели. Мой урожай погибнет...
bulgarian: [Ari], I'm doomed... I can't work my field for two weeks. My harvest is going to be ruined...

english: And then I'll starve to death... and my poor, dear chicken Henrietta... she'll have to arrange the funeral herself, and...
french: Ensuite, ce sera la famine... Et Henrietta, ma pauvre petite poule... C'est elle qui devra organiser mes funérailles.
russian: И тогда я помру с голоду... А моя бедная милая курица Генриетта... Она одна будет устраивать по мне поминки, а потом...
bulgarian: And then I'll starve to death... and my poor, dear chicken Henrietta... she'll have to arrange the funeral herself, and...

english: Oh, hush, Hayden. You should have said as much earlier.
french: Oh, mais tais-toi donc, Hayden. Tu aurais dû me dire tout ça plus tôt.
russian: Ладно тебе, Хейден. Сразу бы сказал, что тебе надо работать.
bulgarian: Oh, hush, Hayden. You should have said as much earlier.

english: [Ari], could you go into the basement? There's a barrel in the corner... bring me one scoop of what's inside.
french: [Ari], tu peux aller à la cave ? Il y a un tonneau, dans un coin. Apporte-moi une cuillérée de ce qu'il contient.
russian: [Ari], можешь сходить в подвал? Там в углу стоит бочка... Зачерпни мне оттуда немного.
bulgarian: [Ari], could you go into the basement? There's a barrel in the corner... bring me one scoop of what's inside.

english: Barrel?
french: Un tonneau ?
russian: Бочка?
bulgarian: Barrel?

english: Basement?
french: À la cave ?
russian: В подвал?
bulgarian: Basement?

english: You'll see. Now, quickly please, Hayden is in no danger of expiring, but his belly-aching isn't doing any of us any good.
french: Tu ne peux pas le rater. Fais vite, s'il te plaît. Hayden n'est pas à l'article de la mort, mais je n'en peux plus de l'entendre geindre.
russian: Увидишь. Сходи побыстрее, пожалуйста: Хейден у нас не умирает, но его хныканье долго терпеть не выйдет.
bulgarian: You'll see. Now, quickly please, Hayden is in no danger of expiring, but his belly-aching isn't doing any of us any good.

english: Yes, the cellar door in the corner. Quickly, please.
french: Oui, la trappe dans l'angle mène à la cave. Fais vite.
russian: Да, вон, в углу вход. Сбегай, пожалуйста.
bulgarian: Yes, the cellar door in the corner. Quickly, please.

english: Thank you, [Ari].
french: Merci, [Ari].
russian: Спасибо, [Ari].
bulgarian: Thank you, [Ari].

english: What are you doing?
french: Qu'est-ce que tu fais ?
russian: Что ты делаешь?
bulgarian: What are you doing?

english: What is that?
french: Qu'est-ce que c'est ?
russian: А что это?
bulgarian: What is that?

english: Don't sugarcoat it, Valen! You're gonna have to take off the foot, I just know it!
french: Arrête de me cacher la vérité, Valen ! Je sais très bien que tu vas devoir m'amputer du pied !
russian: Не надо лукавить, Вален! Я знаю, ногу придётся отрезать!
bulgarian: Don't sugarcoat it, Valen! You're gonna have to take off the foot, I just know it!

english: Ahhh... it almost feels like I'm dreaming...
french: Aaah... J'ai l'impression de vivre un rêve...
bulgarian: Ahhh... it almost feels like I'm dreaming...

english: Welcome, one and all. We are gathered here today to celebrate the union of Adeline and [Ari], as they join their light in matrimony.
french: Bienvenue à tout le monde. Nous voilà réunis ici aujourd'hui pour célébrer l'union d'Adeline et [Ari]. Par ce mariage, ils combineront leurs lumières.
bulgarian: Welcome, one and all. We are gathered here today to celebrate the union of Adeline and [Ari], as they join their light in matrimony.

english: Two radiant souls-
french: Ces deux âmes rayonnantes...
bulgarian: Two radiant souls-

english: Brilliant lights, united in their love of Mistria, dedicated to illuminating this land...
french: Des lumières éclatantes liées par leur amour de Mistria. Elles éclaireront ces terres...
bulgarian: Brilliant lights, united in their love of Mistria, dedicated to illuminating this land...

english: Destined to shine as one, to share this lifetime together.
french: Elles sont destinées à briller ensemble et à partager leur vie.
bulgarian: Destined to shine as one, to share this lifetime together.

english: Adeline, [Ari], if you would...
french: Adeline, [Ari], si vous voulez bien vous donner la peine...
bulgarian: Adeline, [Ari], if you would...

english: Please go ahead and light your candles.
french: Allumez vos bougies, je vous prie.
bulgarian: Please go ahead and light your candles.

english: Your light... It's radiating! As if it's casting over the whole village!
french: Ta lumière... Elle brille si fort ! J'ai l'impression qu'elle illumine tout le village !
bulgarian: Your light... It's radiating! As if it's casting over the whole village!

english: So is yours. It's glowing so passionately...
french: La tienne aussi. Elle luit avec une telle passion...
bulgarian: So is yours. It's glowing so passionately...

english: Yours too! It's burning so eagerly!
french: Tout comme la tienne ! Elle brille de mille feux !
bulgarian: Yours too! It's burning so eagerly!

english: But my heart is beating so fast, this must be real!
french: Mais mon cœur bat si vite que c'est sans doute vrai !
bulgarian: But my heart is beating so fast, this must be real!

english: Mine is racing too!
french: Le mien aussi bat la chamade !
bulgarian: Mine is racing too!

english: It's okay! Here, take my hand.
french: Ne t'en fais pas ! Donne ta main !
bulgarian: It's okay! Here, take my hand.

english: My, my.
french: Ça alors...
bulgarian: My, my.

english: Your feelings for each other are brilliant indeed!
french: Vos sentiments réciproques sont en effet resplendissants !
bulgarian: Your feelings for each other are brilliant indeed!

english: Now, it is time for the joining.
french: Bien, il est temps d'unir vos flammes.
bulgarian: Now, it is time for the joining.

english: [Ari]... your light is the sun that brightens my world.
french: [Ari]... ta lumière est le soleil qui illumine mon monde.
bulgarian: [Ari]... your light is the sun that brightens my world.

english: It illuminates the path before us, as we work toward achieving our dreams.
french: Elle nous guide sur le chemin qui nous attend, alors que nous nous efforçons de réaliser nos rêves.
bulgarian: It illuminates the path before us, as we work toward achieving our dreams.

english: You have brought warmth and life to the very land we stand upon.
french: Tu as apporté vie et chaleur sur ces terres.
bulgarian: You have brought warmth and life to the very land we stand upon.

english: This land that we would protect and lead together... side by side.
french: Cet endroit que nous protégerons et guiderons... ensemble.
bulgarian: This land that we would protect and lead together... side by side.

english: I adore you with all that I am, [Ari], and all that I will be.
french: Je t'aime de tout mon être, [Ari], et ce à tout jamais.
bulgarian: I adore you with all that I am, [Ari], and all that I will be.

english: I love you, Adeline. You are my everything.
french: Je t'aime, Adeline. Tu es tout pour moi.
bulgarian: I love you, Adeline. You are my everything.

english: I love you, Adeline. I promise that I'll always be by your side.
french: Je t'aime, Adeline. Je te promets de toujours être à tes côtés.
bulgarian: I love you, Adeline. I promise that I'll always be by your side.

english: I love you too, [Ari].
french: Je t'aime aussi, [Ari].
bulgarian: I love you too, [Ari].

english: Is it really? But you look so calm!
french: Vraiment ? Tu as pourtant l'air si calme.
bulgarian: Is it really? But you look so calm!

english: I love you too.
french: Je t'aime aussi.
bulgarian: I love you too.

english: By the power vested in me by the Kingdom of Aldaria...
french: Par les pouvoirs qui m'ont été conférés par le roi d'Aldaria...
bulgarian: By the power vested in me by the Kingdom of Aldaria...

english: I now pronounce you married!
french: Je proclame l'officialisation de votre mariage !
bulgarian: I now pronounce you married!

english: May the love and joy of your union illuminate your lives forevermore.
french: Que le bonheur et l'amour de votre union illuminent vos vies pour l'éternité.
bulgarian: May the love and joy of your union illuminate your lives forevermore.

english: Congratulations!
french: Félicitations !
bulgarian: Congratulations!

english: Here... take my hand.
french: Là... Donne-moi la main.
bulgarian: Here... take my hand.

english: Oh! [Ari]...
french: Oh, [Ari]...
bulgarian: Oh! [Ari]...

english: I'm glad it's not just me...
french: Je suis contente de ne pas être la seule...
bulgarian: I'm glad it's not just me...

english: It'll be okay, let's just take a deep breath...
french: Ça ira, il faut juste inspirer profondément...
bulgarian: It'll be okay, let's just take a deep breath...

english: There there, you two are doing great. If you're ready now... shall we begin the ceremony?
french: Là, là, vous vous en sortez très bien, vous deux. Si tout est prêt... que diriez-vous de commencer la cérémonie ?
bulgarian: There there, you two are doing great. If you're ready now... shall we begin the ceremony?

english: Ahem.
french: Hum.
bulgarian: Ahem.

english: [Ari]! You look amazing!
french: [Ari] ! Tu es magnifique !
bulgarian: [Ari]! You look amazing!

english: My fellow Mistrians... We thank you for joining us today, to celebrate the marriage of our daughter, Adeline.
french: Chers habitants et chères habitantes de Mistria... Merci d'être là en ce jour faste où nous célébrons le mariage de notre fille, Adeline.
bulgarian: My fellow Mistrians... We thank you for joining us today, to celebrate the marriage of our daughter, Adeline.

english: I hope that the happiness of this special day will continue to shine throughout the rest of your lives together...
french: J'espère que le bonheur de ce jour si spécial continuera à vous éclairer pour le restant de vos vies...
bulgarian: I hope that the happiness of this special day will continue to shine throughout the rest of your lives together...

english: And while I match your father's trust and faith in your leadership abilites...
french: Et bien que je rejoins ton père sur vos capacités à administrer ces terres...
bulgarian: And while I match your father's trust and faith in your leadership abilites...

english: As a mother, just know that if you two need anything... We're only a few day's carriage ride away.
french: En tant que mère, je veux que tu saches que si vous avez besoin de quoi que ce soit, nous ne sommes qu'à quelques jours en calèche.
bulgarian: As a mother, just know that if you two need anything... We're only a few day's carriage ride away.

english: Cheers! To the newly married couple!
french: Santé ! Au jeune couple !
bulgarian: Cheers! To the newly married couple!

english: Hear, hear!
french: Allons, allons !
bulgarian: Hear, hear!

english: You spent the rest of the evening enjoying the celebration together...
french: Vous passez le reste de la soirée à profiter des réjouissances...
bulgarian: You spent the rest of the evening enjoying the celebration together...

english: It is our great honor to officially welcome you to the family, [Ari].
french: C'est un grand honneur de t'accueillir officiellement dans notre famille, [Ari].
bulgarian: It is our great honor to officially welcome you to the family, [Ari].

english: The two of you have worked very hard for the sake of Mistria. The proof is all around us.
french: Vous avez travaillé d'arrache-pied pour Mistria. Nous en voyons les preuves tout autour de nous.
bulgarian: The two of you have worked very hard for the sake of Mistria. The proof is all around us.

english: I am immensely proud of you both, and I wholeheartedly support and rejoice in your union.
french: Je suis très fier de vous, je me réjouis et je soutiens sincèrement votre décision de vous unir.
bulgarian: I am immensely proud of you both, and I wholeheartedly support and rejoice in your union.

english: I feel that I can rest assured, knowing that Mistria is safe in your capable hands.
french: Je sais que je n'aurai pas de souci à me faire, sachant que Mistria est entre vos mains expertes.
bulgarian: I feel that I can rest assured, knowing that Mistria is safe in your capable hands.

english: Aww, Father...
french: Oooh, papa...
bulgarian: Aww, Father...

english: My darling Adeline...
french: Ma douce Adeline...
bulgarian: My darling Adeline...

english: Your letters over these past seasons had long convinced me that what had begun to grow between you and [Ari] would one day blossom.
french: Tes lettres de ces dernières saisons m'avaient convaincue que ce qui avait commencé à se développer entre [Ari] et toi finirait par éclater au grand jour.
bulgarian: Your letters over these past seasons had long convinced me that what had begun to grow between you and [Ari] would one day blossom.

english: Just how brilliantly, I'm not sure that I could have guessed...
french: Cependant, jamais je n'aurais cru que cela donnerait naissance à un amour aussi lumineux...
bulgarian: Just how brilliantly, I'm not sure that I could have guessed...

english: Ahem!
french: Hum hum !
bulgarian: Ahem!

english: I keep thinking to myself that we're really married now...
french: Je n'arrête pas de penser au fait que notre mariage soit une réalité, maintenant...
bulgarian: I keep thinking to myself that we're really married now...

english: And every time I do, it makes my heart flutter.
french: Et à chaque fois, je sens mon cœur qui palpite.
bulgarian: And every time I do, it makes my heart flutter.

english: Picturing our lives intertwined, the future we'll make together...
french: Je vois nos vies liées à jamais et je vois l'avenir que nous bâtirons ensemble...
bulgarian: Picturing our lives intertwined, the future we'll make together...

english: I've never been so happy.
french: Jamais je n'avais ressenti une telle joie.
bulgarian: I've never been so happy.

english: Me too, Adeline.
french: Moi aussi, Adeline.
bulgarian: Me too, Adeline.

english: Welcome home, Adeline.
french: Bienvenue chez toi, Adeline.
bulgarian: Welcome home, Adeline.

english: Oh, [Ari]...
french: Oh, [Ari]...
bulgarian: Oh, [Ari]...

english: You know, it's gotten awfully late.
french: Tu sais, il est terriblement tard.
bulgarian: You know, it's gotten awfully late.

english: And we're... a bit behind schedule. Shall we call it a night?
french: Et nous risquons de prendre un peu de retard dans notre travail... Si nous allions nous coucher ?
bulgarian: And we're... a bit behind schedule. Shall we call it a night?

english: What a wonderful day!
french: Quelle journée parfaite !
bulgarian: What a wonderful day!

english: It's really nice that so many people want to celebrate our happiness with us.
french: C'est fantastique de voir que tout le monde est à nos côtés pour célébrer notre bonheur.
bulgarian: It's really nice that so many people want to celebrate our happiness with us.

english: Ahem.
french: Hum.
bulgarian: Ahem.

english: Welcome, one and all. We are gathered here today to celebrate the union of Balor and [Ari], as they join their light in matrimony.
french: Bienvenue à tout le monde. Nous voilà réunis ici aujourd'hui pour célébrer l'union de Balor et [Ari]. Par ce mariage, ils combineront leurs lumières.
bulgarian: Welcome, one and all. We are gathered here today to celebrate the union of Balor and [Ari], as they join their light in matrimony.

english: Two radiant souls-
french: Ces deux âmes rayonnantes...
bulgarian: Two radiant souls-

english: Sharing in a bright vision of the future, where all can enjoy shared peace and prosperity...
french: Elles ont en commun la vision d'un avenir radieux dans lequel tout ne sera que paix et prospérité...
bulgarian: Sharing in a bright vision of the future, where all can enjoy shared peace and prosperity...

english: Destined to shine as one, to spend this lifetime together.
french: Elles sont destinées à briller et à passer leur vie ensemble.
bulgarian: Destined to shine as one, to spend this lifetime together.

english: Balor, [Ari], if you would...
french: Balor, [Ari], si vous voulez bien vous donner la peine...
bulgarian: Balor, [Ari], if you would...

english: Please go ahead and light your candles.
french: Allumez vos bougies, je vous prie.
bulgarian: Please go ahead and light your candles.

english: Your light... It's amazing! It seems like all of Mistria has lit up!
french: Ta lumière est si intense ! J'ai l'impression qu'elle illumine tout Mistria !
bulgarian: Your light... It's amazing! It seems like all of Mistria has lit up!

english: So is yours. It's filling the whole town with warmth...
french: La tienne aussi. Elle baigne toute la ville de sa douce chaleur...
bulgarian: So is yours. It's filling the whole town with warmth...

english: Yours too! It's burning so beautifully!
french: Tout comme la tienne ! Elle est si belle !
bulgarian: Yours too! It's burning so beautifully!

english: Although it wouldn't surprise me if they were mostly here for you.
french: Même si ça ne m'étonnerait pas qu'ils soient plus là pour toi que pour moi.
bulgarian: Although it wouldn't surprise me if they were mostly here for you.

english: My, my.
french: Ça alors...
bulgarian: My, my.

english: Your feelings for each other are brilliant indeed!
french: Vos sentiments réciproques sont en effet resplendissants !
bulgarian: Your feelings for each other are brilliant indeed!

english: Now, it is time for the joining.
french: Bien, il est temps d'unir vos flammes.
bulgarian: Now, it is time for the joining.

english: [Ari]... you are the light that brightens my world.
french: [Ari]... Tu es la lumière qui illumine mon monde.
bulgarian: [Ari]... you are the light that brightens my world.

english: Driving away the shadows that once lingered in my heart.
french: Tu as chassé les ombres qui peuplaient mon cœur autrefois.
bulgarian: Driving away the shadows that once lingered in my heart.

english: Your love has inspired me to embrace my true self. To never stop striving to make things better.
french: L'amour que tu m'as montré m'a incité à m'accepter comme je suis réellement. Et à m'efforcer de toujours m'améliorer.
bulgarian: Your love has inspired me to embrace my true self. To never stop striving to make things better.

english: I want nothing more than to share this life with you. To be yours, forevermore.
french: Je ne souhaite qu'une chose, partager ma vie avec toi. Être à toi, pour toujours.
bulgarian: I want nothing more than to share this life with you. To be yours, forevermore.

english: I love you, Balor. I want the same thing.
french: Je t'aime, Balor. C'est ce que je veux aussi.
bulgarian: I love you, Balor. I want the same thing.

english: I love you, Balor. You make my days better, just being you.
french: Je t'aime, Balor. Tu égaies ma vie, en étant toi-même.
bulgarian: I love you, Balor. You make my days better, just being you.

english: I love you too.
french: Je t'aime aussi.
bulgarian: I love you too.

english: By the power vested in me by the Kingdom of Aldaria...
french: Par les pouvoirs qui m'ont été conférés par le roi d'Aldaria...
bulgarian: By the power vested in me by the Kingdom of Aldaria...

english: I certainly can't keep my eyes off you.
french: En ce qui me concerne, je n'ai d'yeux que pour toi.
bulgarian: I certainly can't keep my eyes off you.

english: So you like my outfit?
french: Alors, tu aimes ma tenue ?
bulgarian: So you like my outfit?

english: You clean up very well yourself, Balor.
french: Toi aussi, tu es tiré à quatre épingles, Balor.
bulgarian: You clean up very well yourself, Balor.

english: I now pronounce you married!
french: Je proclame l'officialisation de votre mariage !
bulgarian: I now pronounce you married!

english: May the love and joy of your union illuminate your lives forevermore.
french: Que le bonheur et l'amour de votre union illuminent vos vies pour l'éternité.
bulgarian: May the love and joy of your union illuminate your lives forevermore.

english: Congratulations!
french: Félicitations !
bulgarian: Congratulations!

english: Oh, I don't know if "like" fully covers it.
french: Oh, c'est un euphémisme.
bulgarian: Oh, I don't know if "like" fully covers it.

english: It seems like every day that goes by, I fall more in love with you, [Ari].
french: J'ai l'impression qu'à chaque jour qui passe, je suis un peu plus amoureux de toi, [Ari].
bulgarian: It seems like every day that goes by, I fall more in love with you, [Ari].

english: Haha!
french: Ha ha !
bulgarian: Haha!

english: If there was ever an occasion for it, it's our wedding.
french: S'il y avait bien un jour pour ça, c'était bien celui de notre mariage.
bulgarian: If there was ever an occasion for it, it's our wedding.

english: I wanted everything to be... perfect.
french: Je voulais que tout soit... parfait.
bulgarian: I wanted everything to be... perfect.

english: Not to interrupt you two, but if you're ready... shall we begin the ceremony?
french: Désolée de vous interrompre, mais si tout est prêt... peut-on commencer la cérémonie ?
bulgarian: Not to interrupt you two, but if you're ready... shall we begin the ceremony?

english: [Ari], can you believe it? The whole town is here!
french: [Ari], tu le crois ? Toute la ville est là !
bulgarian: [Ari], can you believe it? The whole town is here!

english: My fellow Mistrians... Thank you for joining us today, to celebrate the marriage of Balor and [Ari].
french: Chers habitants et chères habitantes de Mistria... Merci d'être avec nous aujourd'hui pour célébrer le mariage entre Balor et [Ari].
bulgarian: My fellow Mistrians... Thank you for joining us today, to celebrate the marriage of Balor and [Ari].

english: May mom let me take over Balor's old room! Expanding my territory twofold!
french: Et que maman me laisse m'installer dans l'ancienne chambre de Balor afin de doubler la superficie de mon domaine !
bulgarian: May mom let me take over Balor's old room! Expanding my territory twofold!

english: May your life together be like a legendary bug... one of a kind!
french: Que votre vie ensemble soit aussi unique qu'un insecte légendaire !
bulgarian: May your life together be like a legendary bug... one of a kind!

english: Cheers! To the newly married couple!
french: Santé ! Au jeune couple !
bulgarian: Cheers! To the newly married couple!

english: You spent the rest of the evening enjoying the celebration together...
french: Vous avez passé le reste de la soirée à profiter des réjouissances...
bulgarian: You spent the rest of the evening enjoying the celebration together...

english: They both came to this village as strangers, during its time of greatest need.
french: Nul ne les connaissait à leur arrivée à Mistria à une époque où notre ville était mal en point.
bulgarian: They both came to this village as strangers, during its time of greatest need.

english: A time when many had already left, and few would venture to come here...
french: De nombreux habitants étaient déjà partis, et peu de visiteurs se risquaient à venir...
bulgarian: A time when many had already left, and few would venture to come here...

english: But they did. And despite the challenges that faced them, they stayed.
french: Eux n'ont pas hésité. Malgré les nombreuses épreuves qu'il leur a fallu surmonter, ils ont décidé de rester.
bulgarian: But they did. And despite the challenges that faced them, they stayed.

english: Through their tireless hard work, they not only helped to improve the town, but became a treasured part of it.
french: Par leur travail acharné, ils ont non seulement aidé à rebâtir la ville, mais ils en sont devenus une de ses grandes richesses.
bulgarian: Through their tireless hard work, they not only helped to improve the town, but became a treasured part of it.

english: Why, I don't think there's a soul in town who hasn't benefited from their care and dedication to making Mistria a better place for all.
french: Je crois qu'il n'y a ici personne qui n'ait bénéficié de leur aide et qui n'ait été témoin de leur détermination à faire de Mistria un endroit à vivre.
bulgarian: Why, I don't think there's a soul in town who hasn't benefited from their care and dedication to making Mistria a better place for all.

english: You are truly part of the family. We are honored and delighted to celebrate this special day with you both.
french: Vous faites partie de la famille. C'est un honneur et une grande joie de célébrer ce jour si spécial à vos côtés.
bulgarian: You are truly part of the family. We are honored and delighted to celebrate this special day with you both.

english: Jo... everyone, thank you. I think I speak for [Ari] and I both when I say that we're lucky to call Mistria our home.
french: Jo... et vous autres, merci. Je pense également parler pour [Ari] en disant que nous avons de la chance de considérer Mistria comme notre ville.
bulgarian: Jo... everyone, thank you. I think I speak for [Ari] and I both when I say that we're lucky to call Mistria our home.

english: To [Ari] and Balor! May the care you show us all return to you tenfold.
french: Pour [Ari] et Balor ! Que votre gentillesse à notre égard vous soit rendue au centuple.
bulgarian: To [Ari] and Balor! May the care you show us all return to you tenfold.

english: Ahem!
french: Hum hum !
bulgarian: Ahem!

english: So many toasts...
french: On a trinqué tellement de fois...
bulgarian: So many toasts...

english: We've done something worthwhile here, haven't we [Ari]?
french: Tout cela valait le coup, n'est-ce pas, [Ari] ?
bulgarian: We've done something worthwhile here, haven't we [Ari]?

english: Somewhere along the way, it became about more than just helping Mistria...
french: À un moment, il ne s'agissait plus seulement d'aider Mistria...
bulgarian: Somewhere along the way, it became about more than just helping Mistria...

english: It became about making a home for the two of us.
french: Il s'agissait de nous trouver un endroit où vivre.
bulgarian: It became about making a home for the two of us.

english: You always did dream big.
french: Tu as toujours vu les choses en grand.
bulgarian: You always did dream big.

english: I'd say... this is only the beginning.
french: Je dirais que... ce n'est que le début.
bulgarian: I'd say... this is only the beginning.

english: You're the only person I've met who dreams as big as I do, [Ari].
french: Tu es la seule personne que je connaisse qui voit les choses en plus grand que moi, [Ari].
bulgarian: You're the only person I've met who dreams as big as I do, [Ari].

english: That's just one of the things I love about you, [Ari]. You always know how to get me fired up.
french: C'est l'une des nombreuses choses que j'aime chez toi, [Ari]. Tu sais toujours t'y prendre pour me motiver.
bulgarian: That's just one of the things I love about you, [Ari]. You always know how to get me fired up.

english: Well... the night is still young.
french: Et... la nuit est loin d'être finie.
bulgarian: Well... the night is still young.

english: Shall we head inside and continue the celebration?
french: Si on rentrait pour poursuivre la fête ?
bulgarian: Shall we head inside and continue the celebration?

english: What a wonderful night!
french: Quelle nuit merveilleuse !
bulgarian: What a wonderful night!

english: You are like a dream.
french: Quand je te vois, j'ai l'impression de rêver.
bulgarian: You are like a dream.

english: You look wonderful.
french: Tu es superbe.
bulgarian: You look wonderful.

english: But you're awake!
french: Tu es pourtant éveillé !
bulgarian: But you're awake!

english: Oh my... a flustered dragon, how delightful. Now, now, there's nothing to be nervous about. Let's begin the ceremony!
french: Oh là là... Un dragon qui perd ses moyens, voyez-vous cela. Allons, allons ! Il n'y a aucune raison d'être nerveux. Que la cérémonie commence !
bulgarian: Oh my... a flustered dragon, how delightful. Now, now, there's nothing to be nervous about. Let's begin the ceremony!

english: Ahem.
french: Hum.
bulgarian: Ahem.

english: Welcome, one and all. We are gathered here today to celebrate the union of Caldarus and [Ari], as they join their light in matrimony.
french: Bienvenue à tout le monde. Nous voilà réunis ici aujourd'hui pour célébrer l'union de Caldarus et [Ari]. Par ce mariage, ils combineront leurs lumières.
bulgarian: Welcome, one and all. We are gathered here today to celebrate the union of Caldarus and [Ari], as they join their light in matrimony.

english: Two shining souls-
french: Deux âmes radieuses...
bulgarian: Two shining souls-

english: Separated by time, joined by promise...
french: Le temps les séparait, mais elles étaient unies par une promesse...
bulgarian: Separated by time, joined by promise...

english: Destined to meet on these emerald fields once more.
french: Elles étaient destinées à se retrouver sur ces prairies d'émeraude.
bulgarian: Destined to meet on these emerald fields once more.

english: Caldarus, [Ari], if you would...
french: Caldarus, [Ari], si vous voulez bien vous donner la peine...
bulgarian: Caldarus, [Ari], if you would...

english: Please go ahead and light your candles.
french: Allumez vos bougies, je vous prie.
bulgarian: Please go ahead and light your candles.

english: In my long life, I have never seen a light shine more brilliantly than yours.
french: De toute ma longue vie, jamais je n'avais vu une lumière scintiller aussi intensément.
bulgarian: In my long life, I have never seen a light shine more brilliantly than yours.

english: Who do you think you are talking to? Such a matter is trivial.

russian: Итак...
bulgarian: Now...

bulgarian: I think it is time for me to get settled into this new life of mine.

russian: Не бойся. Я не причиню тебе вреда.
bulgarian: Fear not. I shall not harm you.

english: The world above must be quite different from the one I remember.

russian: Мир на поверхности наверняка не такой, каким я его запомнила.
bulgarian: The world above must be quite different from the one I remember.

english: I should like to go and see the consequences of your actions for myself, Caldarus.
french: J'aimerais aller constater par moi-même les conséquences de tes actes, Caldarus.
russian: Я желаю сама лицезреть последствия твоих злоключений, Кальдарус.
bulgarian: I should like to go and see the consequences of your actions for myself, Caldarus.

english: Hm. Who put this statue here?
french: Hm. Qui a placé cette statue ici ?
russian: Хм. Кто поставил здесь эту статую?
bulgarian: Hm. Who put this statue here?

russian: Впрочем, не важно.
bulgarian: Well, no matter.

english: Yes... much better.

russian: Да... Вот так гораздо лучше.
bulgarian: Yes... much better.

english: Thank you... for everything.
french: Merci... pour tout.
russian: Спасибо тебе... за всё.
bulgarian: Thank you... for everything.

english: Although we stand at the threshold of rather unprecedented times...
french: Bien que nous nous trouvions au seuil d'une époque sans précédent...
russian: Мы стоим на пороге небывалых времён...
bulgarian: Although we stand at the threshold of rather unprecedented times...

english: Although we stand at the threshold of rather unprecedented times...
french: Bien que nous nous trouvions au seuil d'une époque sans précédent...
russian: Мы стоим на пороге небывалых времён...
bulgarian: Although we stand at the threshold of rather unprecedented times...

english: I am certain we shall navigate them together, side by side.

russian: И всё же я уверен, что мы вступаем в них рука об руку, вместе с тобой.

russian: Ведь только благодаря тебе я смогла обрести свободу.
bulgarian: After all, it is thanks to you that I have finally attained my freedom.

english: Shall I walk you back to the farm?
french: Et si je te reconduisais à la ferme ?
russian: Стоит ли мне проводить тебя до фермы?
bulgarian: Shall I walk you back to the farm?

english: With my power restored, I need no longer confine myself to the $Deep Woods$.
french: Puisque j'ai retrouvé mon pouvoir, je n'ai plus besoin de me confiner à $Boissombre$.
russian: Ко мне вернулись силы, так что теперь я не скован границами $Глубокой чащи$.
bulgarian: With my power restored, I need no longer confine myself to the $Deep Woods$.

english: Ahahaha!
french: Ha ha ha ha !
russian: А-ха-ха-ха!
bulgarian: Ahahaha!

english: Come, let us go.
french: Viens, allons-y.
russian: Идём же, нам пора.
bulgarian: Come, let us go.

english: I was sealed at the bottom of these $Ruins$ for centuries. Powerless, alone... and left to rot.

russian: Долгие столетия я была заперта в самой глубине $Руин$. Меня оставили тут гнить... В одиночестве и без сил.
bulgarian: I was sealed at the bottom of these $Ruins$ for centuries. Powerless, alone... and left to rot.

english: I never imagined that $an earthquake would reveal my Shrine at the entrance on the surface$.
french: Jamais je n'aurais imaginé qu'un $tremblement de terre révélerait mon autel et l'entrée, en surface$.
russian: Я и подумать не могла, что $землетрясение открыло моё святилище у входа на поверхности$.
bulgarian: I never imagined that $an earthquake would reveal my Shrine at the entrance on the surface$.

english: Nor that you would appear, bringing with you $offerings of Essence$...

russian: Лишь это судьбоносное стечение событий позволило мне собрать достаточно сил и позвать тебя, [Ari]...
bulgarian: This confluence of events is what allowed me to harness enough power to call out to you, [Ari]...

bulgarian: Betrayer of his own kind, and of his Queen.

english: A traitor even to his own beliefs!

bulgarian: A traitor even to his own beliefs!

russian: Она говорит правду, [Ari]. Я хотел спасти тебя, и...

french: Je n'ai eu d'autre choix que de renoncer à l'éternité... et devenir $mortel$.
russian: У меня не было выбора. Я отказался от вечной жизни... и стал $смертным$.
bulgarian: I had no choice but to relinquish eternity... and become $Mortal$.

french: Je suis désolé. Je ne souhaitais pas t'imposer le fardeau de cette connaissance.
russian: Прости меня. Я не хотел тревожить тебя этим знанием.
bulgarian: I am sorry. I did not wish to burden you with this knowledge...

english: Tsk. Your deceit knows no bounds!
french: Tsss. Ta duplicité est vraiment sans limites !
russian: Ц-ц-ц! Твой обман проникает повсюду!
bulgarian: Tsk. Your deceit knows no bounds!

russian: Благодаря твоим стараниям.

french: Ça suffit !
russian: Довольно!
bulgarian: Enough!

english: It was you who first betrayed our kind, Seridia.
french: C'est toi qui, la première, as trahi notre espèce, Seridia.
russian: Ты первая предала наш род, Серидия.
bulgarian: It was you who first betrayed our kind, Seridia.

english: You, who chose to take on $Mortal Form$ in order to crown yourself $Witch Queen$.
french: Toi, qui as choisi d'adopter une $forme mortelle$ afin de te couronner toi-même $Reine-sorcière$.
russian: Это ты решила принять $смертное обличье$, чтобы увенчать себя короной $королевы-ведьмы$.
bulgarian: You, who chose to take on $Mortal Form$ in order to crown yourself $Witch Queen$.

english: Accumulating more power with each successive incarnation-
french: Accumulant davantage de pouvoir à chaque nouvelle incarnation...
russian: Каждое новое воплощение давало тебе больше власти...
bulgarian: Accumulating more power with each successive incarnation-

english: Causing untold suffering to those we swore to protect. Completely disrupting the harmony and balance of the world...
french: Provoquant d'indicibles souffrances à ceux que nous avions juré de protéger. Perturbant totalement l'harmonie et l'équilibre du monde...
russian: И приносило бессчётные страдания тем, кого мы поклялись защищать. Ты совершенно разрушила мировую гармонию и равновесие...
bulgarian: Causing untold suffering to those we swore to protect. Completely disrupting the harmony and balance of the world...

english: I had no choice but to $seal you along with the source of your power$!
french: Je n'ai eu d'autre choix que de $t'enfermer avec la source de ton pouvoir$ !
russian: У меня не было иного выбора. Я просто обязан был $запечатать тебя вместе с источником твоей силы$!
bulgarian: I had no choice but to $seal you along with the source of your power$!

french: Même si cela impliquait également de $me couper de mon propre pouvoir$.
russian: Хотя знал, что $мои силы тоже исходили от него$.

bulgarian: Pay him no heed, [Ari].

bulgarian: It is true that I have long enjoyed taking $Mortal Form$.

bulgarian: No, he preferred to stay in $Draconic Form$. Hiding away for all eternity in that forest of his.

russian: Он никогда не умел жить со вкусом.
bulgarian: He never was any fun.

english: S-Seridia...
french: S-Seridia...
russian: С-Серидия...
bulgarian: S-Seridia...

french: Tu vois, la mort et la renaissance ne signifient rien pour un être aussi puissant que moi.
russian: Для таких могущественных созданий, как я, смерть и перерождение ничего не значат.
bulgarian: You see, death and rebirth mean nothing to one as powerful as I.

russian: Ведь я прожила уже тысячу жизней...
bulgarian: For I have lived a thousand lives...

french: Et j'en vivrai mille autres !
russian: И ещё тысячу проживу!
bulgarian: And I shall live a thousand more!

russian: Ты... [Ari], не приближайся к ней!
bulgarian: You... stay away from [Ari]!

bulgarian: Oh, did you not know?

bulgarian: I truly cannot thank you enough, $Dragonsworn$. Or should I call you... $[Ari]$?
